import { 
  renderServerHtml, 
  generateDynamicSitemap, 
  generateRobotsTxt,
  SUPPORTED_LANGS,
  VALID_TOOLS 
} from '../src/server/seoPrerender';
import { ToolId } from '../src/types';

interface Env {
  GEMINI_API_KEY?: string;
  APP_URL?: string;
  [key: string]: any;
}

interface EventContext {
  request: Request;
  env: Env;
  next: () => Promise<Response>;
}

// Map Cloudflare cf-ipcountry to supported ISO languages
const GEO_COUNTRY_MAP: Record<string, string> = {
  VN: 'vi',
  JP: 'ja',
  KR: 'ko',
  CN: 'zh', TW: 'zh', HK: 'zh',
  ES: 'es', MX: 'es', AR: 'es', CO: 'es', CL: 'es', PE: 'es',
  FR: 'fr', BE: 'fr',
  DE: 'de', AT: 'de', CH: 'de',
  BR: 'pt', PT: 'pt',
  RU: 'ru', BY: 'ru', KZ: 'ru',
  ID: 'id',
  TH: 'th',
  IN: 'hi',
  SA: 'ar', AE: 'ar', EG: 'ar', QA: 'ar', KW: 'ar', OM: 'ar',
  IT: 'it',
  NL: 'nl',
  TR: 'tr',
  PL: 'pl',
  MY: 'ms',
  SE: 'sv',
  US: 'en', GB: 'en', CA: 'en', AU: 'en', NZ: 'en', IE: 'en', SG: 'en'
};

export async function onRequest(context: EventContext): Promise<Response> {
  const { request, env, next } = context;
  const url = new URL(request.url);
  const pathname = url.pathname;

  // Determine base domain from config or current request
  const baseUrl = (env.APP_URL || url.origin).replace(/\/+$/, '');

  // 1. Dynamic Sitemap.xml (180+ international URLs with hreflang)
  if (pathname === '/sitemap.xml') {
    const xml = generateDynamicSitemap(baseUrl);
    return new Response(xml, {
      status: 200,
      headers: {
        'Content-Type': 'application/xml; charset=utf-8',
        'Cache-Control': 'public, max-age=86400, s-maxage=86400',
      },
    });
  }

  // 2. Dynamic Robots.txt
  if (pathname === '/robots.txt') {
    const txt = generateRobotsTxt(baseUrl);
    return new Response(txt, {
      status: 200,
      headers: {
        'Content-Type': 'text/plain; charset=utf-8',
        'Cache-Control': 'public, max-age=86400, s-maxage=86400',
      },
    });
  }

  // 3. Health check API
  if (pathname === '/api/health') {
    return new Response(
      JSON.stringify({
        status: 'ok',
        platform: 'cloudflare-pages',
        timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
      }),
      {
        status: 200,
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json; charset=utf-8' },
      }
    );
  }

  // 4. Gemini AI API endpoint for Cloudflare Pages Functions
  if (pathname === '/api/gemini/answer' && request.method === 'POST') {
    try {
      const apiKey = env.GEMINI_API_KEY;
      if (!apiKey) {
        return new Response(
          JSON.stringify({ error: 'GEMINI_API_KEY is not configured on Cloudflare' }),
          { status: 500, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json; charset=utf-8' } }
        );
      }

      const body = (await request.json()) as { prompt?: string; context?: string };
      const userPrompt = body.prompt;

      if (!userPrompt || typeof userPrompt !== 'string' || !userPrompt.trim()) {
        return new Response(
          JSON.stringify({ error: 'Missing prompt parameter' }),
          { status: 400, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json; charset=utf-8' } }
        );
      }

      const systemInstruction = `You are an expert mathematician and financial calculator assistant for Web Calculator (AC Studio). 
Give concise, clear step-by-step explanations for mathematical, financial, health (BMI), or unit conversion queries. 
Always output clean plain text or simple markdown. Keep answers under 150 words.`;

      const fullPrompt = body.context 
        ? `${systemInstruction}\nContext: ${body.context}\nUser Question: ${userPrompt}`
        : `${systemInstruction}\nUser Question: ${userPrompt}`;

      const geminiUrl = `https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/gemini-2.5-flash:generateContent?key=${apiKey}`;
      const geminiRes = await fetch(geminiUrl, {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          contents: [{ parts: [{ text: fullPrompt }] }],
          generationConfig: {
            temperature: 0.2,
            maxOutputTokens: 600,
          },
        }),
      });

      if (!geminiRes.ok) {
        const errorText = await geminiRes.text();
        return new Response(
          JSON.stringify({ error: 'Gemini API Error', details: errorText }),
          { status: 502, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json; charset=utf-8' } }
        );
      }

      const geminiData = (await geminiRes.json()) as any;
      const answer = geminiData.candidates?.[0]?.content?.parts?.[0]?.text || 'No explanation generated.';

      return new Response(
        JSON.stringify({ answer }),
        { status: 200, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json; charset=utf-8' } }
      );
    } catch (err: any) {
      return new Response(
        JSON.stringify({ error: 'Internal Server Error', details: err?.message || String(err) }),
        { status: 500, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json; charset=utf-8' } }
      );
    }
  }

  // 5. Geo-redirect for root '/'
  if (pathname === '/' || pathname === '') {
    const cfCountry = request.headers.get('cf-ipcountry') || '';
    const detectedLang = GEO_COUNTRY_MAP[cfCountry.toUpperCase()] || 'en';
    
    // Redirect to localized default (e.g. /vi/ or /en/)
    const redirectUrl = new URL(`/${detectedLang}/`, request.url);
    return Response.redirect(redirectUrl.toString(), 302);
  }

  // 6. Check if URL matches /:lang or /:lang/:toolId for Server-Side Prerendering
  const pathParts = pathname.split('/').filter(Boolean);
  if (pathParts.length >= 1) {
    const langCandidate = pathParts[0].toLowerCase();

    if (SUPPORTED_LANGS.includes(langCandidate as any)) {
      const toolCandidate = pathParts[1]?.toLowerCase();
      const toolId: ToolId = (toolCandidate && VALID_TOOLS.includes(toolCandidate as any))
        ? (toolCandidate as ToolId)
        : 'basic';

      // Fetch the static index.html built by Vite from Cloudflare Pages static assets
      const response = await next();
      
      // If the static asset was fetched successfully, inject the complete SEO Prerender markup only for HTML responses
      const contentType = response.headers.get('content-type') || '';
      if (contentType.includes('text/html')) {
        const templateHtml = await response.text();
        const renderedHtml = renderServerHtml(templateHtml, langCandidate as any, toolId, baseUrl);

        const newHeaders = new Headers(response.headers);
        newHeaders.set('Content-Type', 'text/html; charset=utf-8');
        newHeaders.set('Cache-Control', 'public, max-age=3600, s-maxage=86400, stale-while-revalidate=604800');

        return new Response(renderedHtml, {
          status: 200,
          headers: newHeaders,
        });
      }

      return response;
    }
  }

  // Default passthrough to static assets
  return next();
}

FILE: /metadata.json

{
  "name": "Web Calculator",

import express from "express";
import path from "path";
import fs from "fs";
import { createServer as createViteServer } from "vite";
import { GoogleGenAI } from "@google/genai";
import dotenv from "dotenv";
import { 
  renderServerHtml, 
  generateDynamicSitemap, 
  generateRobotsTxt 
} from "./src/server/seoPrerender";

dotenv.config();

let aiClient: GoogleGenAI | null = null;

function getGenAI(): GoogleGenAI {
  const apiKey = process.env.GEMINI_API_KEY;
  if (!apiKey) {
    throw new Error("GEMINI_API_KEY environment variable is missing.");
  }
  if (!aiClient) {
    aiClient = new GoogleGenAI({
      apiKey,
      httpOptions: {
        headers: {
          "User-Agent": "aistudio-build",
        },
      },
    });
  }
  return aiClient;
}

async function startServer() {
  const app = express();
  const PORT = 3000;

  // Enable trust proxy for Cloudflare (CF-Connecting-IP, CF-IPCountry, X-Forwarded-Proto)
  app.set("trust proxy", true);

  app.use(express.json({ limit: "25mb" }));
  app.use(express.urlencoded({ extended: true, limit: "25mb" }));

  // Global HTTP Security Headers (Cloudflare & Core Web Vitals best practices)
  app.use((_req, res, next) => {
    res.setHeader("X-Robots-Tag", "noindex, nofollow, noarchive, nosnippet");
    res.setHeader("X-Content-Type-Options", "nosniff");
    res.setHeader("X-XSS-Protection", "1; mode=block");
    res.setHeader("Referrer-Policy", "strict-origin-when-cross-origin");
    next();
  });

  // Helper to determine active base URL from environment or request headers
  const getBaseUrl = (req: express.Request): string => {
    if (process.env.APP_URL) {
      return process.env.APP_URL.replace(/\/+$/, '');
    }
    const forwardedProto = req.headers['x-forwarded-proto'] as string;
    const protocol = forwardedProto ? forwardedProto.split(',')[0].trim() : req.protocol;
    const host = req.get('host') || 'web-calculator.com';
    return `${protocol}://${host}`;
  };

  // Health check endpoint
  app.get("/api/health", (_req, res) => {
    res.json({
      status: "ok",
      hasGeminiKey: Boolean(process.env.GEMINI_API_KEY),
      timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
    });
  });

  // Dynamic International Sitemap for 20 markets & 9 tools (Cloudflare & Google Search Console ready)
  app.get("/sitemap.xml", (req, res) => {
    const baseUrl = getBaseUrl(req);
    const xml = generateDynamicSitemap(baseUrl);
    res.setHeader("Content-Type", "application/xml; charset=utf-8");
    res.setHeader("Cache-Control", "public, max-age=86400, s-maxage=86400");
    return res.status(200).send(xml);
  });

  // Dynamic robots.txt pointing to dynamic sitemap
  app.get("/robots.txt", (req, res) => {
    const baseUrl = getBaseUrl(req);
    const txt = generateRobotsTxt(baseUrl);
    res.setHeader("Content-Type", "text/plain; charset=utf-8");
    res.setHeader("Cache-Control", "public, max-age=86400, s-maxage=86400");
    return res.status(200).send(txt);
  });

  // Gemini AI endpoint for answering & explaining math / calculations / multimodal files
  app.post("/api/gemini/answer", async (req, res) => {
    try {
      const { prompt, context, toolName, file } = req.body;

      if ((!prompt || typeof prompt !== "string" || !prompt.trim()) && !file) {
        return res.status(400).json({ error: "Vui lòng cung cấp câu hỏi, biểu thức hoặc tệp đính kèm cần giải đáp." });
      }

      const effectivePrompt = (prompt && typeof prompt === "string" && prompt.trim()) 
        ? prompt.trim() 
        : "Hãy đọc, giải chi tiết bài toán hoặc phân tích nội dung trong tệp đính kèm này.";

      const ai = getGenAI();

      const systemInstruction = `Bạn là Trợ lý AI Chuyên gia Giải Toán, Tính toán & Phân tích Đa phương thức cao cấp của ứng dụng Web Calculator.

QUY TẮC NHẬN DIỆN VÀ GIẢI BÀI TẬP TỪ HÌNH ẢNH / TỆP ĐA PHƯƠNG THỨC (CỰC KỲ QUAN TRỌNG):
1. Tính nhất quán và Trích xuất đề bài (Chain-of-Thought OCR Grounding):
   - Khi nhận được ảnh bài tập, ĐẦU TIÊN bạn BẮT BUỘC phải hiển thị mục "**1. Đề bài nhận diện từ hình ảnh:**" và chép lại trung thực, chính xác tuyệt đối từng con số, dấu phép tính (+, -, ×, ÷), biến số và phương trình có trong ảnh dưới dạng KaTeX ($...$).
   - Tuyệt đối không tự ý suy diễn hoặc thay đổi số liệu so với hình ảnh. Nếu ảnh có chữ viết tay mờ hoặc có nhiều câu, hãy liệt kê rõ từng câu (ví dụ: Câu 1, Câu 2...).
2. Phương pháp sư phạm chuẩn mực SGK:
   - Mục "**2. Hướng dẫn & Các bước giải chi tiết:**": Luôn trình bày cách giải chuẩn mực theo sách giáo khoa trước. Giải thích rõ ràng từng bước biến đổi, công thức áp dụng (ví dụ: $\\Delta = b^2 - 4ac$, Vi-ét, lượng giác...).
   - Nếu có thể, hãy chỉ ra thêm cách giải nhanh hoặc mẹo kiểm tra lại kết quả.
3. Quy chuẩn công thức toán học KaTeX:
   - Đặt tất cả biểu thức toán, biến số ($x, y, a, b...$) và phương trình trong cặp dấu $...$ (trong dòng) hoặc $$...$$ (căn giữa khối).
   - Dùng cú pháp LaTeX chuẩn KaTeX: phân số $\\frac{a}{b}$, căn bậc hai $\\sqrt{x}$, dấu nhân $\\cdot$, ký hiệu $\\Delta$.
4. Kết luận rõ ràng:
   - Luôn kết thúc bằng mục "**3. Kết luận:**" nêu rõ đáp số cuối cùng hoặc tập nghiệm $S$ in đậm.
${toolName ? `Công cụ người dùng đang tương tác: ${toolName}.` : ""}
${context ? `Dữ liệu và kết quả tính hiện tại: ${context}` : ""}`;

      let contents: any;
      if (file && file.extractedText && typeof file.extractedText === "string") {
        // Handle extracted content from Excel (.xlsx, .xls), Word (.docx, .doc), CSV, TXT
        const docName = file.name || "tài liệu";
        const docCategory = file.category || "văn bản/bảng tính";
        const textContent = file.extractedText.slice(0, 120000); // limit to reasonable length
        const composedPrompt = `[Tài liệu đính kèm: "${docName}" - Phân loại: ${docCategory}]\n\`\`\`\n${textContent}\n\`\`\`\n\n[Yêu cầu/Câu hỏi của người dùng]:\n${effectivePrompt}`;
        contents = composedPrompt;
      } else if (file && file.data && file.mimeType) {
        let base64Data = file.data;
        if (base64Data.includes(";base64,")) {
          base64Data = base64Data.split(";base64,")[1];
        }
        // Sanitize base64 payload to prevent binary corruption from newlines or spaces
        base64Data = base64Data.replace(/[\r\n\s]+/g, "");

        let lowerMime = file.mimeType.toLowerCase();
        if (lowerMime === "image/jpg") {
          lowerMime = "image/jpeg";
        }

        const allowedMimes = [
          "image/png",
          "image/jpeg",
          "image/webp",
          "image/gif",
          "application/pdf",
          "text/plain",
          "text/csv",
          "text/markdown"
        ];

        if (!allowedMimes.includes(lowerMime)) {
          return res.status(400).json({ 
            error: "Định dạng tệp không được hỗ trợ. Vui lòng tải ảnh (PNG, JPG, WebP), file PDF, Excel (XLSX, XLS) hoặc Word (DOCX, DOC)." 
          });
        }

        const filePart = {
          inlineData: {
            data: base64Data,
            mimeType: lowerMime,
          },
        };

        const isImage = lowerMime.startsWith("image/") || file.category === "image";
        const imagePrompt = isImage
          ? `[YÊU CẦU BẮT BUỘC CHO HÌNH ẢNH BÀI TẬP]:
Bước 1: Trích xuất và chép lại chính xác 100% đề bài, biểu thức toán học hoặc câu hỏi nhìn thấy từ hình ảnh (dùng KaTeX $...$).
Bước 2: Giải chi tiết từng bước theo phương pháp sư phạm chuẩn SGK.
Bước 3: Kết luận rõ ràng đáp số.

[Câu hỏi/Yêu cầu từ người dùng]: ${effectivePrompt}`
          : effectivePrompt;

        const textPart = {
          text: imagePrompt,
        };

        contents = { parts: [filePart, textPart] };
      } else {
        contents = effectivePrompt;
      }

      // Candidate models in order of preference: Primary -> Alias -> Lightweight high-throughput
      const candidateModels = [
        "gemini-3.8-flash",
        "gemini-flash-latest",
        "gemini-3.1-flash-lite",
      ];

      let lastError: any = null;
      let response: any = null;

      for (const model of candidateModels) {
        for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 2; attempt++) {
          try {
            response = await ai.models.generateContent({
              model,
              contents,
              config: {
                systemInstruction,
                temperature: 0.1, // Deterministic temperature for math precision and consistent OCR
              },
            });
            if (response?.text) {
              break;
            }
          } catch (err: any) {
            lastError = err;
            const errStr = String(err?.message || err || "");
            const isTransient = 
              errStr.includes("503") || 
              errStr.includes("UNAVAILABLE") || 
              errStr.includes("high demand") || 
              errStr.includes("429") || 
              errStr.includes("RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED") ||
              errStr.includes("ECONNRESET") ||
              errStr.includes("fetch failed");

            console.warn(`[Gemini API] Attempt ${attempt + 1} with ${model} failed: ${errStr.slice(0, 100)}`);

            if (isTransient && attempt === 0) {
              // Quick backoff before 1 retry on the same model
              await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 800));
              continue;
            }
            // Move to next candidate model
            break;
          }
        }

        if (response?.text) {
          break;
        }
      }

      if (!response?.text) {
        throw lastError || new Error("Không thể nhận phản hồi từ các mô hình AI.");
      }

      const answerText = response.text || "Xin lỗi, hiện tại không nhận được câu trả lời từ AI.";
      return res.json({ answer: answerText });
    } catch (error: any) {
      console.error("Gemini API error:", error);
      const isMissingKey = !process.env.GEMINI_API_KEY;
      if (isMissingKey) {
        return res.status(503).json({
          error: "Khóa API GEMINI_API_KEY chưa được cấu hình. Vui lòng thiết lập trong Settings > Secrets.",
        });
      }

      const rawMsg = String(error?.message || error || "");
      let friendlyMsg = "Đã xảy ra lỗi khi kết nối với Gemini AI. Vui lòng thử lại.";

      if (rawMsg.includes("503") || rawMsg.includes("high demand") || rawMsg.includes("UNAVAILABLE")) {
        friendlyMsg = "Mô hình AI hiện đang có lượng truy vấn rất cao từ Google (503 Service Unavailable). Hệ thống đã tự động thử các mô hình dự phòng. Vui lòng bấm 'Thử lại' sau 10-15 giây.";
      } else if (rawMsg.includes("429") || rawMsg.includes("RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED")) {
        friendlyMsg = "Hệ thống AI đạt giới hạn tần suất yêu cầu tạm thời (429 Rate Limit). Vui lòng đợi vài giây và bấm 'Thử lại'.";
      } else if (rawMsg.includes("API key not valid") || rawMsg.includes("API_KEY_INVALID")) {
        friendlyMsg = "Khóa API GEMINI_API_KEY không hợp lệ hoặc đã hết hạn. Vui lòng kiểm tra lại cấu hình.";
      }

      return res.status(503).json({ error: friendlyMsg });
    }
  });

  const SUPPORTED_LANGS = [
    'en', 'vi', 'ja', 'ko', 'zh', 'es', 'fr', 'de', 'pt', 'ru',
    'id', 'th', 'hi', 'ar', 'it', 'nl', 'tr', 'pl', 'ms', 'sv'
  ];

  const COUNTRY_TO_LANG: Record<string, string> = {
    VN: 'vi',
    JP: 'ja',
    KR: 'ko',
    CN: 'zh',
    TW: 'zh',
    HK: 'zh',
    ES: 'es',
    MX: 'es',
    AR: 'es',
    CO: 'es',
    CL: 'es',
    PE: 'es',
    FR: 'fr',
    DE: 'de',
    AT: 'de',
    CH: 'de',
    BR: 'pt',
    PT: 'pt',
    RU: 'ru',
    BY: 'ru',
    KZ: 'ru',
    ID: 'id',
    TH: 'th',
    IN: 'hi',
    SA: 'ar',
    AE: 'ar',
    EG: 'ar',
    IQ: 'ar',
    MA: 'ar',
    IT: 'it',
    NL: 'nl',
    TR: 'tr',
    PL: 'pl',
    MY: 'ms',
    SE: 'sv',
    US: 'en',
    GB: 'en',
    CA: 'en',
    AU: 'en',
    NZ: 'en',
  };

  // International SEO Routing & Geo-Targeting for root /
  app.get('/', (req, res, next) => {
    // Skip if user explicitly requests no redirect
    if (req.query.noredirect === '1') {
      return next();
    }

    const toolParam = typeof req.query.tool === 'string' && req.query.tool ? `/${req.query.tool}` : '';

    // 1. Explicit query parameter ?lang=...
    if (typeof req.query.lang === 'string') {
      const qLang = req.query.lang.toLowerCase();
      if (SUPPORTED_LANGS.includes(qLang)) {
        return res.redirect(302, `/${qLang}${toolParam}`);
      }
    }

    // 2. Check Geo-IP Country header (Cloudflare, GCP, or CDN)
    const countryHeader = (req.headers['cf-ipcountry'] || req.headers['x-country-code'] || req.headers['geoip-country-code'] || '') as string;
    const countryCode = countryHeader.toUpperCase();
    if (countryCode && COUNTRY_TO_LANG[countryCode]) {
      const matchedLang = COUNTRY_TO_LANG[countryCode];
      return res.redirect(302, `/${matchedLang}${toolParam}`);
    }

    // 3. Check Accept-Language header from client browser
    const acceptLang = (req.headers['accept-language'] as string) || '';
    if (acceptLang) {
      const languages = acceptLang.split(',').map(item => {
        const [code, qVal] = item.trim().split(';q=');
        return {
          code: code.trim().toLowerCase().slice(0, 2),
          weight: qVal ? parseFloat(qVal) : 1.0
        };
      });

      // Find highest weighted supported language
      languages.sort((a, b) => b.weight - a.weight);
      for (const item of languages) {
        if (SUPPORTED_LANGS.includes(item.code)) {
          return res.redirect(302, `/${item.code}${toolParam}`);
        }
      }
    }

    // 4. Default fallback: x-default (/en/) for all global visitors outside target countries
    return res.redirect(302, `/en${toolParam}`);
  });

  // 301 Permanent Canonical Redirect for /:lang/basic -> /:lang/ (Eliminates duplicate content and consolidates PageRank)
  app.get("/:lang([a-z]{2})/basic", (req, res) => {
    const lang = req.params.lang.toLowerCase();
    return res.redirect(301, `/${lang}/`);
  });

  // Helper to handle SSR prerendering for any /:lang or /:lang/:toolId route
  const handleSSRRoute = async (
    req: express.Request,
    res: express.Response,
    next: express.NextFunction,
    viteServer?: any
  ) => {
    try {
      const { lang, toolId } = req.params;
      const lowerLang = (lang || 'en').toLowerCase() as any;
      
      // If it is a static asset request with an extension, let next middleware handle it
      if (req.path.includes('.') && !req.path.endsWith('.html')) {
        return next();
      }

      let templateHtml = '';
      if (process.env.NODE_ENV !== "production" && viteServer) {
        const rawTemplate = fs.readFileSync(path.join(process.cwd(), "index.html"), "utf-8");
        templateHtml = await viteServer.transformIndexHtml(req.originalUrl || req.url, rawTemplate);
      } else {
        const distIndexPath = path.join(process.cwd(), "dist", "index.html");
        if (fs.existsSync(distIndexPath)) {
          templateHtml = fs.readFileSync(distIndexPath, "utf-8");
        } else {
          templateHtml = fs.readFileSync(path.join(process.cwd(), "index.html"), "utf-8");
        }
      }

      const domain = getBaseUrl(req);
      const finalHtml = renderServerHtml(templateHtml, lowerLang, toolId as any, domain);
      
      res.setHeader("Content-Type", "text/html; charset=utf-8");
      // HTML must never be cached by CDNs or browsers so asset hashes are always up-to-date
      res.setHeader("Cache-Control", "no-cache, no-store, must-revalidate");
      res.setHeader("Pragma", "no-cache");
      res.setHeader("Expires", "0");
      return res.status(200).send(finalHtml);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("SSR Prerender Error:", err);
      return next();
    }
  };

  // Vite middleware for development
  if (process.env.NODE_ENV !== "production") {
    const vite = await createViteServer({
      server: { middlewareMode: true },
      appType: "spa",
    });

    // Handle SSR for localized tool routes in development
    app.get(["/:lang([a-z]{2})/:toolId([a-z]+)", "/:lang([a-z]{2})", "/:lang([a-z]{2})/"], (req, res, next) => {
      return handleSSRRoute(req, res, next, vite);
    });

    app.use(vite.middlewares);
  } else {
    const distPath = path.join(process.cwd(), "dist");

    // Serve immutable hashed assets
    app.use("/assets", express.static(path.join(distPath, "assets"), {
      maxAge: "1y",
      immutable: true,
      fallthrough: false
    }));

    // Serve raw static assets in src/assets
    app.use("/src/assets", express.static(path.join(process.cwd(), "src/assets"), {
      maxAge: "1d",
      fallthrough: true
    }));

    // Serve other public static files from dist
    app.use(express.static(distPath, { index: false }));

    // Never return index.html for missing static assets or files with extensions
    app.use((req, res, next) => {
      if (req.path.startsWith('/assets/') || (req.path.includes('.') && !req.path.endsWith('.html'))) {
        return res.status(404).type('text/plain').send('File not found');
      }
      next();
    });

    // Handle SSR for localized tool routes in production
    app.get(["/:lang([a-z]{2})/:toolId([a-z]+)", "/:lang([a-z]{2})", "/:lang([a-z]{2})/"], (req, res, next) => {
      return handleSSRRoute(req, res, next);
    });

    app.get("*", (req, res, next) => {
      if (req.path.includes('.') && !req.path.endsWith('.html')) {
        return res.status(404).type('text/plain').send('File not found');
      }

      const segments = req.path.split('/').filter(Boolean);
      const possibleLang = segments[0]?.toLowerCase();
      const possibleTool = segments[1]?.toLowerCase();
      
      if (possibleLang && SUPPORTED_LANGS.includes(possibleLang as any)) {
        return handleSSRRoute({
          ...req,
          params: { lang: possibleLang, toolId: possibleTool }
        } as any, res, next);
      }

      res.setHeader("Cache-Control", "no-cache, no-store, must-revalidate");
      res.sendFile(path.join(distPath, "index.html"));
    });
  }

  app.listen(PORT, "0.0.0.0", () => {
    console.log(`Server running on http://localhost:${PORT}`);
  });
}

startServer();

// Helper to parse tool ID from clean path or hash
const parseToolFromUrl = (): ToolId => {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return 'basic';

  const parts = window.location.pathname.replace(/^\/+|\/+$/g, '').split('/').filter(Boolean);
  
  // 1. Check path with language prefix (e.g. /en/bmi, /vi/salary, /ja/loan)
  if (parts.length >= 2) {
    const candidate = parts[1].toLowerCase();
    if (TOOLS_CONFIG[candidate as ToolId]) {
      return candidate as ToolId;
    }
  }

  // 2. Check path without language prefix (e.g. /bmi, /salary, /loan)
  if (parts.length === 1) {
    const candidate = parts[0].toLowerCase();
    if (TOOLS_CONFIG[candidate as ToolId]) {
      return candidate as ToolId;
    }
  }

  // 3. Fallback to hash (e.g. #salary, #bmi)
  const hash = window.location.hash.replace(/^#\/?/, '').toLowerCase() as ToolId;
  if (hash && TOOLS_CONFIG[hash]) {
    return hash;
  }

  return 'basic';
};

export default function App() {
  const { language, t } = useLanguage();

  // Initialize tool from clean path or URL hash
  const [currentToolId, setCurrentToolId] = useState<ToolId>(() => parseToolFromUrl());

  const [isSidebarOpen, setIsSidebarOpen] = useState<boolean>(true);
  const [resetKey, setResetKey] = useState<number>(0);
  const [isGeminiDrawerOpen, setIsGeminiDrawerOpen] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [geminiToolKey, setGeminiToolKey] = useState<ToolId>('basic');
  const [isTermsOpen, setIsTermsOpen] = useState<boolean>(false);

  const handleOpenGeminiDrawer = (toolKey?: ToolId) => {
    if (toolKey) {
      setGeminiToolKey(toolKey);
    } else {
      setGeminiToolKey(currentToolId);
    }
    setIsGeminiDrawerOpen(true);
  };

  // Sync tool change with clean path URL: /${language}/${toolId}
  const handleSelectTool = (id: ToolId) => {
    setCurrentToolId(id);
    const cleanPath = id === 'basic' ? `/${language}/` : `/${language}/${id}`;
    const search = window.location.search || '';
    const fullUrl = `${cleanPath}${search}`;
    if (window.location.pathname !== cleanPath) {
      window.history.pushState({ lang: language, toolId: id }, '', fullUrl);
    }
    window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'smooth' });
  };

  // Listen to popstate (browser back/forward) and hashchange
  useEffect(() => {
    const onLocationChange = () => {
      const toolId = parseToolFromUrl();
      if (toolId !== currentToolId) {
        setCurrentToolId(toolId);
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener('popstate', onLocationChange);
    window.addEventListener('hashchange', onLocationChange);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('popstate', onLocationChange);
      window.removeEventListener('hashchange', onLocationChange);
    };
  }, [currentToolId]);

  // Dynamic SEO synchronization across tool changes & language changes
  useEffect(() => {
    if (typeof window === 'undefined') return;

    const isHome = currentToolId === 'basic';
    const toolSEO = getToolSEO(currentToolId, language);
    const domain = window.location.origin;
    const cleanPath = isHome ? `/${language}/` : `/${language}/${currentToolId}`;
    const canonicalUrl = `${domain}${cleanPath}`;

    const title = toolSEO.title.includes('Web Calculator')
      ? toolSEO.title
      : `${toolSEO.title} | Web Calculator`;

    // 1. Update Title
    document.title = title;

    // 2. Update Meta Description
    const metaDesc = document.querySelector('meta[name="description"]');
    if (metaDesc) {
      metaDesc.setAttribute('content', toolSEO.description);
    }

    // 3. Update Meta Keywords
    let metaKeywords = document.querySelector('meta[name="keywords"]');
    if (!metaKeywords) {
      metaKeywords = document.createElement('meta');
      metaKeywords.setAttribute('name', 'keywords');
      document.head.appendChild(metaKeywords);
    }
    metaKeywords.setAttribute('content', toolSEO.keywords.join(', '));

    // 4. Update Canonical Link
    let canonicalLink = document.querySelector('link[rel="canonical"]');
    if (!canonicalLink) {
      canonicalLink = document.createElement('link');
      canonicalLink.setAttribute('rel', 'canonical');
      document.head.appendChild(canonicalLink);
    }
    canonicalLink.setAttribute('href', canonicalUrl);

    // 5. Update Open Graph
    const ogTitle = document.querySelector('meta[property="og:title"]');
    if (ogTitle) ogTitle.setAttribute('content', title);

    const ogDesc = document.querySelector('meta[property="og:description"]');
    if (ogDesc) ogDesc.setAttribute('content', toolSEO.description);

    const ogUrl = document.querySelector('meta[property="og:url"]');
    if (ogUrl) ogUrl.setAttribute('content', canonicalUrl);

    // 6. Update Twitter Card
    const twTitle = document.querySelector('meta[name="twitter:title"]');
    if (twTitle) twTitle.setAttribute('content', title);

    const twDesc = document.querySelector('meta[name="twitter:description"]');
    if (twDesc) twDesc.setAttribute('content', toolSEO.description);
  }, [currentToolId, language]);

import React, { useState, useMemo } from 'react';
import { 
  Calculator, 
  Search,
  Activity, 
  Banknote, 
  Calendar, 
  Percent, 
  Wallet,
  Menu,
  ArrowLeftRight,
  Triangle,
  TrendingUp,
  X,
  ChevronRight,
  Sparkles,
  Home,
  Flame,
  Clock,
  CalendarDays,
  Receipt,
  Tag,
  Building2,
  Footprints,
  Heart,
  GraduationCap,
  Boxes,
  Dice5,
  KeyRound,
  Zap,
  BookOpen
} from 'lucide-react';
import { ToolId } from '../../types';
import { TOOLS_CONFIG } from '../../data/toolsData';
import { AppLogo } from './AppLogo';
import { ToolIcon } from './ToolIcon';
import { getToolColorTheme } from '../../data/toolColors';
import { useLanguage } from '../../context/LanguageContext';
import { getSectionUi } from '../../data/internationalSections';

interface BottomTabBarProps {
  currentToolId: ToolId;
  onSelectTool: (id: ToolId) => void;
}

export const BottomTabBar: React.FC<BottomTabBarProps> = ({
  currentToolId,
  onSelectTool
}) => {
  const { language, t } = useLanguage();
  const secUi = getSectionUi(language);
  const [isMoreMenuOpen, setIsMoreMenuOpen] = useState(false);
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('');

  const primaryToolIds: ToolId[] = ['basic', 'ai', 'bmi', 'loan', 'love'];

  // 5 primary tier 1 tools for mobile bottom bar
  const primaryTools: { id: ToolId; label: string; icon: React.ReactNode }[] = [
    { id: 'basic', label: t.toolShortNames.basic || 'Cơ bản', icon: <ToolIcon id="basic" className="w-5 h-5" /> },
    { id: 'ai', label: t.toolShortNames.ai || 'AI Tool', icon: <ToolIcon id="ai" className="w-5 h-5" /> },
    { id: 'bmi', label: t.toolShortNames.bmi || 'BMI', icon: <ToolIcon id="bmi" className="w-5 h-5" /> },
    { id: 'loan', label: t.toolShortNames.loan || 'Lãi vay', icon: <ToolIcon id="loan" className="w-5 h-5" /> },
    { id: 'love', label: t.toolShortNames.love || (language === 'vi' ? 'Tình yêu' : 'Love'), icon: <ToolIcon id="love" className="w-5 h-5" /> },
  ];

  // All remaining tools for "More" modal
  const secondaryTools = useMemo(() => {
    return Object.values(TOOLS_CONFIG)
      .filter(tc => !primaryToolIds.includes(tc.id))
      .map(tc => ({
        id: tc.id,
        label: t.toolNames[tc.id] || tc.name,
        desc: t.toolDescriptions[tc.id] || tc.description,
        icon: <ToolIcon id={tc.id} className="w-5 h-5" />
      }));
  }, [t]);

  // Dynamic search filtering inside modal (allows finding any tool across the platform)
  const displayedModalTools = useMemo(() => {
    if (!searchQuery.trim()) {
      return secondaryTools;
    }
    const q = searchQuery.toLowerCase().trim();
    return Object.values(TOOLS_CONFIG)
      .filter(tc => {
        const name = (t.toolNames[tc.id] || tc.name).toLowerCase();
        const short = (t.toolShortNames[tc.id] || tc.shortName || '').toLowerCase();
        const desc = (t.toolDescriptions[tc.id] || tc.description || '').toLowerCase();
        const id = tc.id.toLowerCase();
        return name.includes(q) || short.includes(q) || desc.includes(q) || id.includes(q);
      })
      .map(tc => ({
        id: tc.id,
        label: t.toolNames[tc.id] || tc.name,
        desc: t.toolDescriptions[tc.id] || tc.description,
        icon: <ToolIcon id={tc.id} className="w-5 h-5" />
      }));
  }, [searchQuery, secondaryTools, t]);

  const isCurrentInSecondary = secondaryTools.some(t => t.id === currentToolId);

  return (
    <>
      <nav 
        id="mobile-bottom-tab-bar"
        className="md:hidden fixed bottom-0 left-0 right-0 z-40 backdrop-blur-md border-t pb-[env(safe-area-inset-bottom)] dark:shadow-[0_-8px_20px_rgba(0,0,0,0.5)] shadow-[0_-1px_4px_rgba(0,0,0,0.03)] transition-colors duration-200"
        style={{
          backgroundColor: 'var(--app-header-bg, #ffffff)',
          borderColor: 'var(--app-border, #ffffff)'
        }}
      >
        <div className="grid grid-cols-6 items-center h-16 px-1">
          {primaryTools.map((tool) => {
            const isActive = currentToolId === tool.id;
            const theme = getToolColorTheme(tool.id);
            const isLove = tool.id === 'love';
            return (
              <button
                key={tool.id}
                id={`bottom-tab-${tool.id}`}
                onClick={() => {
                  onSelectTool(tool.id);
                  setIsMoreMenuOpen(false);
                }}
                className={`flex flex-col items-center justify-center h-full min-h-[48px] py-1 transition-all ${
                  isActive 
                    ? (isLove ? 'text-red-600 dark:text-red-500 font-bold scale-105' : 'text-[#3B82F6] font-bold scale-105') 
                    : 'text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-900 dark:hover:text-slate-200'
                }`}
              >
                <div className={`p-1.5 transition-all ${
                  isLove 
                    ? 'text-red-600 dark:text-red-500' 
                    : (isActive ? 'text-[#3B82F6]' : theme.iconColor)
                }`}>
                  {isLove ? (
                    <Heart className={`w-5 h-5 text-red-600 dark:text-red-500 transition-all ${isActive ? 'fill-red-600 dark:fill-red-500 scale-110' : 'fill-red-500/20'}`} />
                  ) : (
                    tool.icon
                  )}
                </div>
                <span className={`text-[10px] mt-0.5 whitespace-nowrap tracking-tight font-medium ${
                  isLove && isActive ? 'text-red-600 dark:text-red-500 font-bold' : ''
                }`}>
                  {tool.label}
                </span>
                {isActive && (
                  <span className={`w-1.5 h-1 rounded-full mt-0.5 ${
                    isLove ? 'bg-red-500' : 'bg-[#10B981]'
                  }`} />
                )}
              </button>
            );
          })}

          {/* More button */}
          <button
            id="bottom-tab-more"
            onClick={() => setIsMoreMenuOpen(true)}
            aria-label="More"
            className={`flex flex-col items-center justify-center h-full min-h-[48px] py-1 transition-all ${
              isCurrentInSecondary 
                ? 'text-[#3B82F6] font-bold' 
                : 'text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-900 dark:hover:text-slate-200'
            }`}
          >
            <div className={`p-1 rounded-lg ${
              isCurrentInSecondary ? 'bg-blue-500/15 text-[#3B82F6]' : ''
            }`}>
              <Menu className="w-5 h-5" />
            </div>
            <span className="text-[10px] mt-0.5 whitespace-nowrap tracking-tight font-medium">
              More
            </span>
            {isCurrentInSecondary && (
              <span className="w-1.5 h-1 bg-[#10B981] rounded-full mt-0.5" />
            )}
          </button>
        </div>
      </nav>

      {/* More Modal / Bottom Sheet */}
      {isMoreMenuOpen && (
        <div 
          id="more-tools-modal-backdrop"
          onClick={() => setIsMoreMenuOpen(false)}
          className="fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-black/70 backdrop-blur-sm flex items-end md:hidden animate-in fade-in"
        >
          <div 
            onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
            className="w-full border-t rounded-t-3xl p-5 pb-8 space-y-4 animate-in slide-in-from-bottom duration-200 transition-colors"
            style={{
              backgroundColor: 'var(--app-surface, #1b1d33)',
              borderColor: 'var(--app-border, #272a47)'
            }}
          >
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-2 border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800">
              <div>
                <h3 className="text-base font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white">{secUi.bottomMoreTitle}</h3>
                <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">{secUi.bottomMoreSubtitle}</p>
              </div>
              <button
                onClick={() => {
                  setIsMoreMenuOpen(false);
                  setSearchQuery('');
                }}
                className="w-9 h-9 rounded-full bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-800 flex items-center justify-center text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 hover:text-slate-900 dark:hover:text-white transition-colors cursor-pointer"
              >
                <X className="w-5 h-5" />
              </button>
            </div>

            {/* Direct Blog & Guides Banner */}
            <button
              id="mobile-modal-blog-btn"
              onClick={() => {
                onSelectTool('blog');
                setIsMoreMenuOpen(false);
                setSearchQuery('');
                window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'smooth' });
              }}
              className={`w-full flex items-center justify-between p-3 rounded-2xl border transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                currentToolId === 'blog'
                  ? 'bg-blue-600 text-white border-blue-500 shadow-md shadow-blue-500/20'
                  : 'bg-blue-50/70 dark:bg-blue-950/40 border-blue-200 dark:border-blue-900/60 text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100 hover:bg-blue-100 dark:hover:bg-blue-900/50'
              }`}
            >
              <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                <div className={`w-9 h-9 rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 ${
                  currentToolId === 'blog' ? 'bg-white/20 text-white' : 'bg-blue-500 text-white'
                }`}>
                  <BookOpen className="w-5 h-5" />
                </div>
                <div className="text-left">
                  <div className="text-xs font-bold">{language === 'vi' ? 'Cẩm nang & Blog Tính Toán' : 'Calculation Guides & Blog'}</div>
                  <div className="text-[11px] opacity-75">{language === 'vi' ? '12+ bài viết tài chính, thuế & sức khỏe' : '12+ finance, tax & health articles'}</div>
                </div>
              </div>
              <ChevronRight className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0 opacity-70" />
            </button>

            {/* Quick Search Bar */}
            <div className="relative">
              <Search className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-400 absolute left-3.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 pointer-events-none" />
              <input
                id="mobile-tools-search-input"
                type="text"
                value={searchQuery}
                onChange={(e) => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
                placeholder={language === 'vi' ? 'Tìm kiếm công cụ tính toán...' : 'Search calculator tools...'}
                className="w-full pl-10 pr-9 py-2.5 text-sm bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200/50 dark:bg-slate-800/90 text-slate-900 dark:text-white rounded-xl border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 placeholder-slate-500 dark:placeholder-slate-400 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500/30 focus:border-blue-500 transition-all shadow-xs"
              />
              {searchQuery && (
                <button
                  onClick={() => setSearchQuery('')}
                  className="w-6 h-6 rounded-full bg-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-300 dark:bg-slate-700 dark:hover:bg-slate-600 flex items-center justify-center text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 absolute right-2.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 cursor-pointer transition-colors"
                  aria-label="Xóa tìm kiếm"
                >
                  <X className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                </button>
              )}
            </div>

            {/* Tools List or Empty Search Results */}
            {displayedModalTools.length === 0 ? (
              <div className="py-8 text-center space-y-2">
                <Search className="w-8 h-8 text-slate-300 dark:text-slate-600 mx-auto" />
                <p className="text-sm font-medium text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400">
                  {language === 'vi' 
                    ? `Không tìm thấy công cụ nào cho "${searchQuery}"`
                    : `No tools found for "${searchQuery}"`}
                </p>
                <button
                  onClick={() => setSearchQuery('')}
                  className="text-xs font-semibold text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 hover:underline pt-1 cursor-pointer"
                >
                  {language === 'vi' ? 'Xóa từ khóa tìm kiếm' : 'Clear search'}
                </button>
              </div>
            ) : (
              <div className="space-y-2.5 max-h-[58vh] overflow-y-auto pr-1">
                {displayedModalTools.map((tool) => {
                  const isActive = currentToolId === tool.id;
                  const theme = getToolColorTheme(tool.id);
                  return (
                    <button
                      key={tool.id}
                      id={`more-tool-select-${tool.id}`}
                      onClick={() => {
                        onSelectTool(tool.id);
                        setIsMoreMenuOpen(false);
                        setSearchQuery('');
                      }}
                      className={`w-full flex items-center justify-between p-3 rounded-2xl border transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                        isActive 
                          ? 'bg-blue-600/15 border-blue-500 text-slate-900 dark:text-white shadow-md' 
                          : 'bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-900/60 border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-800'
                      }`}
                    >
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                        <div className={`w-8 h-8 flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 transition-transform ${
                          isActive ? 'text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400' : theme.iconColor
                        }`}>
                          {tool.icon}
                        </div>
                        <div className="text-left">
                          <span className="font-semibold text-sm text-slate-900 dark:text-white">{tool.label}</span>
                          <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 mt-0.5 line-clamp-1">{tool.desc}</p>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                      <ChevronRight className="w-5 h-5 text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 shrink-0" />
                    </button>
                  );
                })}
              </div>
            )}

            <div className="pt-2 text-center">
              <span className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 font-medium">
                Bản quyền thuộc về @MCTLab Inc
              </span>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </>
  );
};

FILE: /src/components/common/CurrencySelector.tsx

import React, { useState, useRef, useEffect } from 'react';
import { useCurrency, CurrencyCode } from '../../context/CurrencyContext';
import { useLanguage } from '../../context/LanguageContext';
import { ChevronDown, Check, Coins } from 'lucide-react';

interface CurrencySelectorProps {
  variant?: 'header' | 'inline' | 'compact';
  className?: string;
  align?: 'left' | 'right' | 'auto';
}

export const CurrencySelector: React.FC<CurrencySelectorProps> = ({
  variant = 'header',
  className = '',
  align = 'auto'
}) => {
  const { currency, setCurrency, currencyInfo, currencies } = useCurrency();
  const { language } = useLanguage();
  const isVi = language === 'vi';
  const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(false);
  const [dropdownSide, setDropdownSide] = useState<'left' | 'right'>(align === 'left' ? 'left' : 'right');
  const [dropdownStyle, setDropdownStyle] = useState<React.CSSProperties>({});
  const dropdownRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  const calculatePosition = () => {
    if (!dropdownRef.current) return;
    const rect = dropdownRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
    const screenWidth = window.innerWidth;

    if (variant === 'compact') {
      const dropdownWidth = 224;
      if (align === 'left' || rect.right - dropdownWidth < 15 || rect.left < screenWidth / 2) {
        setDropdownSide('left');
        if (rect.left + dropdownWidth > screenWidth - 12) {
          const shift = (rect.left + dropdownWidth) - (screenWidth - 12);
          setDropdownStyle({ transform: `translateX(-${shift}px)` });
        } else {
          setDropdownStyle({});
        }
      } else {
        setDropdownSide('right');
        if (rect.right - dropdownWidth < 12) {
          const shift = 12 - (rect.right - dropdownWidth);
          setDropdownStyle({ transform: `translateX(${shift}px)` });
        } else {
          setDropdownStyle({});
        }
      }
      return;
    }

    // Default 'header' variant
    const dropdownWidth = 256;
    const naturalLeft = rect.right - dropdownWidth;
    let shiftX = 0;
    if (naturalLeft < 12) {
      shiftX = 12 - naturalLeft;
    } else if (rect.right > screenWidth - 12) {
      shiftX = (screenWidth - 12) - rect.right;
    }

    setDropdownStyle({
      transform: shiftX !== 0 ? `translateX(${shiftX}px)` : undefined,
    });
  };

  const toggleOpen = () => {
    if (!isOpen) {
      calculatePosition();
    }
    setIsOpen(!isOpen);
  };

  // Close when clicking outside
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleClickOutside = (event: MouseEvent) => {
      if (dropdownRef.current && !dropdownRef.current.contains(event.target as Node)) {
        setIsOpen(false);
      }
    };
    if (isOpen) {
      calculatePosition();
      document.addEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
      window.addEventListener('resize', calculatePosition);
    }
    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
      window.removeEventListener('resize', calculatePosition);
    };
  }, [isOpen, align, variant]);

  const handleSelect = (code: CurrencyCode) => {
    setCurrency(code);
    setIsOpen(false);
  };

  if (variant === 'compact') {
    return (
      <div className={`relative inline-block ${className}`} ref={dropdownRef}>
        <button
          id="currency-compact-selector-btn"
          type="button"
          onClick={toggleOpen}
          className="currency-compact-btn flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-semibold rounded-lg bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800/80 hover:bg-slate-200 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
          title={isVi ? 'Đổi đơn vị tiền tệ' : 'Change Currency'}
        >
          <span>{currencyInfo.flag}</span>
          <span className="font-mono text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 font-bold">{currencyInfo.symbol}</span>
          <span className="text-[11px] text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300">{currencyInfo.code}</span>
          <ChevronDown className={`w-3 h-3 text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 transition-transform ${isOpen ? 'rotate-180' : ''}`} />
        </button>

        {isOpen && (
          <div 
            style={dropdownStyle}
            className={`currency-compact-dropdown absolute ${dropdownSide === 'left' ? 'left-0' : 'right-0'} mt-1.5 w-56 max-w-[calc(100vw-2rem)] max-h-72 overflow-y-auto rounded-xl bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 shadow-2xl z-50 p-1.5 scrollbar-thin scrollbar-thumb-slate-300 dark:scrollbar-thumb-slate-700 animate-in fade-in zoom-in-95 duration-150`}
          >
            <div className="px-2.5 py-1 text-[11px] font-bold tracking-wider text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 uppercase border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800">
              {isVi ? 'Chọn tiền tệ (Gốc: $ USD)' : 'Select Currency (Base: $ USD)'}
            </div>
            {currencies.map((curr) => {
              const isSelected = curr.code === currency;
              return (
                <button
                  key={curr.code}
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => handleSelect(curr.code)}
                  className={`currency-option-btn w-full flex items-center justify-between px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs transition-colors cursor-pointer text-left ${
                    isSelected ? 'bg-blue-600 text-white font-semibold shadow-xs' : 'text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 hover:text-slate-900 dark:hover:text-white'
                  }`}
                >
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <span className="text-base">{curr.flag}</span>
                    <div>
                      <span className={`currency-code-text font-bold mr-1.5 ${isSelected ? 'text-white' : 'text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200'}`}>{curr.code}</span>
                      <span className="text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 font-mono">({curr.symbol})</span>
                      <div className="currency-subtext text-[10px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 leading-tight">
                        {isVi ? curr.nameVi : curr.nameEn}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  {isSelected && <Check className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-400 shrink-0" />}
                </button>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (variant === 'inline') {
    return (
      <div className={`flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5 ${className}`}>
        {currencies.map((curr) => {
          const isSelected = curr.code === currency;
          return (
            <button
              key={curr.code}
              type="button"
              onClick={() => handleSelect(curr.code)}
              className={`flex items-center gap-1 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg text-xs font-semibold transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                isSelected
                  ? 'bg-blue-600 text-white shadow-sm ring-1 ring-blue-400'
                  : 'bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800/70 hover:bg-slate-200 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 hover:text-slate-900 dark:hover:text-white border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700/60'
              }`}
            >
              <span>{curr.flag}</span>
              <span className="font-mono">{curr.symbol}</span>
              <span className="text-[11px] opacity-80">{curr.code}</span>
            </button>
          );
        })}
      </div>
    );
  }

  // Default 'header' variant
  return (
    <div className={`relative ${className}`} ref={dropdownRef}>
      <button
        id="header-currency-selector-btn"
        type="button"
        onClick={() => setIsOpen(!isOpen)}
        aria-label="Select Currency"
        className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2 sm:px-2.5 py-1.5 sm:py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 hover:text-slate-900 dark:hover:text-white bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800/60 hover:bg-slate-200 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700/60 rounded-xl transition-all cursor-pointer shadow-xs focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500/50 scale-95 origin-center"
      >
        <span className="text-sm leading-none">{currencyInfo.flag}</span>
        <span className="font-bold font-mono text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400">{currencyInfo.symbol}</span>
        <span className="text-[11px] text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 hidden sm:inline">{currencyInfo.code}</span>
        <ChevronDown className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 transition-transform duration-200 ${isOpen ? 'rotate-180' : ''}`} />
      </button>

      {isOpen && (
        <div 
          id="header-currency-dropdown"
          style={dropdownStyle}
          className="absolute right-0 mt-2 w-64 max-w-[calc(100vw-1.5rem)] max-h-80 overflow-y-auto rounded-2xl bg-white dark:bg-slate-900/95 backdrop-blur-md border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700/80 shadow-2xl z-50 p-2 scrollbar-thin scrollbar-thumb-slate-300 dark:scrollbar-thumb-slate-700 animate-in fade-in zoom-in-95 duration-150"
        >
          <div className="px-3 py-2 border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 mb-1 flex items-center justify-between">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <Coins className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-500 dark:text-emerald-400" />
              <span className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200">
                {isVi ? 'Đơn vị tiền tệ (Gốc: $ USD)' : 'Currency (Base: $ USD)'}
              </span>
            </div>
            <span className="text-[10px] font-mono text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 bg-emerald-500/10 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded border border-emerald-500/20">
              13 Quốc gia
            </span>
          </div>

          <div className="space-y-0.5">
            {currencies.map((curr) => {
              const isSelected = curr.code === currency;
              return (
                <button
                  key={curr.code}
                  id={`currency-option-${curr.code}`}
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => handleSelect(curr.code)}
                  className={`w-full flex items-center justify-between px-3 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs transition-all cursor-pointer text-left ${
                    isSelected 
                      ? 'bg-blue-600 text-white font-semibold shadow-sm' 
                      : 'text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 hover:text-slate-900 dark:hover:text-white'
                  }`}
                >
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
                    <span className="text-base shrink-0">{curr.flag}</span>
                    <div>
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                        <span className="font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white">{curr.code}</span>
                        <span className={`font-mono text-xs font-bold ${isSelected ? 'text-white' : 'text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400'}`}>
                          ({curr.symbol})
                        </span>
                        {curr.code === 'USD' && (
                          <span className="text-[9px] px-1 py-0.2 rounded bg-amber-500/20 text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-300 border border-amber-500/30 font-medium">
                            {isVi ? 'Gốc' : 'Base'}
                          </span>
                        )}
                      </div>
                      <div className={`text-[11px] truncate max-w-[150px] ${isSelected ? 'text-blue-100' : 'text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400'}`}>
                        {isVi ? curr.nameVi : curr.nameEn}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  {isSelected && (
                    <span className="w-5 h-5 rounded-full bg-white/20 flex items-center justify-center shrink-0">
                      <Check className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-white" />
                    </span>
                  )}

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { 
  Sparkles, 
  Share2, 
  X, 
  RefreshCw, 
  Send, 
  ExternalLink, 
  Bot, 
  Check, 
  Globe, 
  ShieldCheck 
} from 'lucide-react';
import Markdown from 'react-markdown';
import { ToolId } from '../../types';
import { TOOLS_CONFIG } from '../../data/toolsData';
import { AD_CLIENT_ID } from './AdBanner';

interface GeminiDrawerProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  currentToolId: ToolId;
  onSelectTool: (id: ToolId) => void;
  initialToolKey?: ToolId;
}

interface CalculatorInsightItem {
  id: ToolId;
  name: string;
  category: string;
  title: string;
  content: string;
}

// Full domain insights covering all 8 calculator tools of this web application
const CALCULATOR_INSIGHTS: Partial<Record<ToolId, CalculatorInsightItem>> = {
  basic: {
    id: 'basic',
    name: 'Máy tính khoa học',
    category: 'MÁY TÍNH KHOA HỌC & ĐẠI SỐ',
    title: 'Máy Tính Khoa Học 10 Cột: Nguyên Lý Số Học & Giải Thuật Chuẩn Xác',
    content: `Giới thiệu chuyên sâu về Máy tính Khoa học & Hàm số đa năng

**Nguyên lý hoạt động:** Thiết bị sử dụng bộ giải thuật toán chuyển đổi biểu thức trung tố sang hậu tố (Shunting-yard Algorithm) kết hợp bộ xử lý số học dấu phẩy động độ chính xác cao IEEE 754. Hệ thống tính toán tức thời thứ tự ưu tiên các phép toán đại số (nhân chia trước, cộng trừ sau, trong ngoặc trước), các hàm lượng giác (Deg/Rad), hàm mũ, căn bậc n và lưu trữ giá trị bộ nhớ đệm (MC, MR, M+, M-).

**Ứng dụng thực tế:**

export const GeminiDrawer: React.FC<GeminiDrawerProps> = ({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  currentToolId,
  onSelectTool,
  initialToolKey
}) => {
  const [selectedKey, setSelectedKey] = useState<ToolId>(initialToolKey || currentToolId || 'basic');
  const [customQuestion, setCustomQuestion] = useState('');
  const [dynamicAiContent, setDynamicAiContent] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState(false);

  // Sync initialToolKey when updated from outside
  useEffect(() => {
    if (initialToolKey) {
      setSelectedKey(initialToolKey);
      setDynamicAiContent(null);
    }
  }, [initialToolKey]);

  // If tool changed from primary app
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!initialToolKey && CALCULATOR_INSIGHTS[currentToolId]) {
      setSelectedKey(currentToolId);
    }
  }, [currentToolId, initialToolKey]);

  const currentInsight = CALCULATOR_INSIGHTS[selectedKey] || CALCULATOR_INSIGHTS.basic;

  // Ask Gemini AI dynamic questions
  const handleFetchAiAnalysis = async (customPrompt?: string) => {
    setIsLoading(true);
    const promptToSend = customPrompt || `Hãy phân tích chuyên sâu, nguyên lý hoạt động và ứng dụng thực tế chuẩn xác nhất của công cụ ${currentInsight.name}. Trình bày bố cục chuyên nghiệp theo cấu trúc: Giới thiệu chuyên sâu, Nguyên lý hoạt động, Ứng dụng thực tế, Mẹo sử dụng chuẩn xác.`;

    try {
      const response = await fetch('/api/gemini/answer', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          prompt: promptToSend,
          toolName: currentInsight.name,
          context: `Người dùng đang xem công cụ tính toán: ${currentInsight.name} (${currentInsight.title})`
        })
      });

      const data = await response.json();
      if (response.ok && data.answer) {
        setDynamicAiContent(data.answer);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Lỗi tải phân tích Gemini:', err);
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false);
      setCustomQuestion('');
    }
  };

  const handleShare = () => {
    if (navigator.share) {
      navigator.share({
        title: `Phân tích Gemini AI - ${currentInsight.name}`,
        url: window.location.href
      }).catch(() => {});
    } else {
      navigator.clipboard.writeText(window.location.href);
      setCopied(true);
      setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 2000);
    }
  };

  return (
    <>
      {/* BACKDROP SHADOW WHEN DRAWER IS OPEN */}
      {isOpen && (
        <div
          onClick={onClose}
          className="fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-slate-900/40 backdrop-blur-xs transition-opacity duration-300"
          aria-hidden="true"
        />
      )}

      {/* 
        RIGHT SLIDE-OVER DRAWER (Matches user's Image 2):
        Clean Light theme: bg-white, border-slate-200, crisp slate-900 typography
      */}
      <aside
        id="gemini-right-drawer"
        aria-label="Khối phân tích Gemini AI và Quảng cáo"
        className={`fixed top-0 right-0 bottom-0 z-50 w-full sm:w-[500px] md:w-[540px] lg:w-[580px] bg-white border-l border-slate-200 text-slate-800 flex flex-col transition-all duration-300 ease-out transform ${
          isOpen 
            ? 'translate-x-0 shadow-2xl visible pointer-events-auto opacity-100' 
            : 'translate-x-full shadow-none invisible pointer-events-none opacity-0'
        }`}
      >
        {/* 1. Header (Icon hoa mai vàng + Tên công cụ + "✨ Do Gemini tạo" + Nút Share & Close) */}
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between px-4 sm:px-5 py-3.5 bg-white border-b border-slate-200/90 shrink-0">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            {/* Sparkles Yellow Badge Icon matching Image 2 */}
            <div className="w-9 h-9 rounded-xl bg-amber-400 flex items-center justify-center shadow-sm shrink-0">
              <Sparkles className="w-5 h-5 text-slate-950 fill-slate-950/20" />
            </div>
            <div className="leading-tight">
              <h2 className="font-bold text-slate-900 text-sm sm:text-base line-clamp-1">
                {currentInsight.name}
              </h2>
              <p className="text-xs text-amber-600 font-semibold flex items-center gap-1 mt-0.5">
                <span>✨ Do Gemini tạo</span>
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Action buttons (Share & Close) matching Image 2 */}
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
            <button
              onClick={handleShare}
              title="Chia sẻ phân tích"
              className="w-8 h-8 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 bg-white text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-900 hover:bg-slate-100 flex items-center justify-center transition-colors cursor-pointer"
            >
              {copied ? <Check className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-600" /> : <Share2 className="w-4 h-4" />}
            </button>
            <button
              onClick={onClose}
              title="Đóng bảng phân tích"
              className="w-8 h-8 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 bg-white text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-900 hover:bg-slate-100 flex items-center justify-center transition-colors cursor-pointer"
            >
              <X className="w-5 h-5" />
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* 2. Horizontal Scrollable Tool/Pills Tags Bar matching Image 2 */}
        <div className="px-4 py-2.5 bg-slate-50/90 border-b border-slate-200 overflow-x-auto scrollbar-none shrink-0 flex items-center gap-2">
          {Object.values(CALCULATOR_INSIGHTS).map((item) => {
            const isActive = item.id === selectedKey;
            return (
              <button
                key={item.id}
                onClick={() => {
                  setSelectedKey(item.id);
                  setDynamicAiContent(null);
                  if (TOOLS_CONFIG[item.id]) {
                    onSelectTool(item.id);
                  }
                }}
                className={`shrink-0 px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold transition-all cursor-pointer whitespace-nowrap ${
                  isActive
                    ? 'bg-amber-400 text-slate-950 font-bold shadow-xs'
                    : 'bg-white text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-100 hover:text-slate-900 border border-slate-200/90'
                }`}
              >
                {item.name}
              </button>
            );
          })}
        </div>

        {/* 3. Main Scrollable Body */}
        <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-4 sm:p-5 space-y-5 scrollbar-thin">

          {/* 
            TOP ADVERTISEMENT BLOCK - GOOGLE ADSENSE READY (Matches Image 2 exactly) 
            "QUẢNG CÁO BÊN TRÊN"
          */}
          <div 
            id="drawer-top-adsense-card" 
            className="rounded-2xl border border-slate-200/90 bg-white p-4 sm:p-5 shadow-xs relative overflow-hidden"
          >
            {/* Ad Header */}
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-[10px] sm:text-[11px] font-bold tracking-wider uppercase mb-3">
              <span className="text-slate-400">QUẢNG CÁO • GOOGLE ADSENSE</span>
              <span className="text-emerald-600">ĐƯỢC TÀI TRỢ</span>
            </div>

            {/* Ad Body: Glowing Blue Circle Icon + Title + Description + Button */}
            <div className="flex flex-col items-center text-center space-y-2.5 pt-1 pb-1">
              {/* Blue Orb / Tech Icon */}
              <div className="w-12 h-12 rounded-2xl bg-blue-600 flex items-center justify-center shadow-md shadow-blue-600/20">
                <Globe className="w-6 h-6 text-white" />
              </div>

              <div className="space-y-1">
                <h3 className="text-slate-900 font-bold text-sm sm:text-base">
                  Tối Ưu Hiển Thị Quảng Cáo Google (AdSense Ready)
                </h3>
                <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 leading-relaxed max-w-sm">
                  Hệ sinh thái máy tính và công cụ số học thế hệ mới, tối ưu hóa 100% trên Điện thoại, Tablet và Máy tính.
                </p>
                <div className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 font-mono pt-0.5">
                  ID: {AD_CLIENT_ID}
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Blue CTA Button */}
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => window.open('https://adsense.google.com/start/', '_blank', 'noopener,noreferrer')}
                className="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 px-5 py-2 rounded-xl bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700 text-white font-bold text-xs shadow-sm transition-all active:scale-95 cursor-pointer mt-1"
              >
                <span>Khám phá ngay</span>
                <ExternalLink className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* ORANGE CATEGORY TAG & H2 TITLE matching Image 2 */}
          <div className="space-y-1">
            <span className="text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-amber-600">
              {currentInsight.category}
            </span>
            <h2 className="text-lg sm:text-xl font-bold text-slate-900 leading-snug">
              {currentInsight.title}
            </h2>
          </div>

          {/* AI ANALYSIS CONTENT CONTAINER matching Image 2 */}
          <div className="rounded-2xl border border-slate-200/90 bg-white overflow-hidden shadow-xs">
            
            {/* Sub-Header: ✨ Nội dung phân tích từ Gemini AI + 🔄 Làm mới button */}
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between px-4 py-3 border-b border-slate-100 bg-slate-50/70">

                <Sparkles className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-500 shrink-0" />
                <span>Nội dung phân tích từ Gemini AI</span>
              </div>
              <button
                onClick={() => handleFetchAiAnalysis()}
                disabled={isLoading}
                className="flex items-center gap-1 px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-semibold rounded-lg border border-slate-200 bg-white text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-900 hover:bg-slate-50 transition-all active:scale-95 disabled:opacity-50 cursor-pointer shadow-2xs"
              >
                <RefreshCw className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 ${isLoading ? 'animate-spin' : ''}`} />
                <span>Làm mới</span>
              </button>
            </div>

            {/* Analysis Text Body with High-Contrast Typography */}
            <div className="p-4 sm:p-5 text-sm text-slate-700 leading-relaxed font-sans space-y-3">
              {isLoading ? (
                <div className="py-8 text-center space-y-2">
                  <div className="w-8 h-8 border-2 border-amber-500 border-t-transparent rounded-full animate-spin mx-auto" />
                  <p className="text-xs text-slate-500">Gemini AI đang tổng hợp và phân tích dữ liệu chuyên sâu...</p>
                </div>
              ) : (
                <div className="prose max-w-none text-sm text-slate-700 prose-p:my-2 prose-strong:text-slate-900 prose-strong:font-bold prose-ul:my-2 prose-li:my-1">
                  <Markdown>
                    {dynamicAiContent || currentInsight.content}
                  </Markdown>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>

          </div>

          {/* 
            BOTTOM ADVERTISEMENT BLOCK - AS REQUESTED BY USER
            "QUẢNG CÁO BÊN DƯỚI"
          */}
          <div 
            id="drawer-bottom-adsense-card" 
            className="rounded-2xl border border-slate-200/90 bg-gradient-to-br from-slate-50 to-blue-50/30 p-4 shadow-xs relative overflow-hidden"
          >
            {/* Ad Header */}
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-[10px] sm:text-[11px] font-bold tracking-wider uppercase mb-2.5">
              <span className="text-slate-400">QUẢNG CÁO TÀI TRỢ • GOOGLE ADS</span>
              <span className="text-blue-600 flex items-center gap-1">
                <ShieldCheck className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                <span>XÁC MINH CHUẨN SEO</span>
              </span>
            </div>

            {/* Ad Content */}
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
              <div className="space-y-0.5">
                <h4 className="text-xs sm:text-sm font-bold text-slate-900">
                  Nền Tảng Tiện Ích & Toán Học Trực Tuyến
                </h4>
                <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 line-clamp-1">
                  Khám phá thêm hàng chục công cụ chuẩn xác và giải pháp thông minh
                </p>
                <div className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 font-mono">
                  Pub ID: {AD_CLIENT_ID}
                </div>
              </div>

              <button

                className="shrink-0 px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-slate-900 hover:bg-slate-800 text-white font-bold text-xs shadow-xs transition-all active:scale-95 cursor-pointer"
              >
                <span>Xem thêm</span>
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* INTERACTIVE QUESTION FORM: User can ask Gemini anything */}
          <div className="rounded-2xl border border-slate-200/90 bg-white p-3.5 space-y-2.5 shadow-xs">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-bold text-slate-700">
              <Bot className="w-4 h-4 text-blue-600" />
              <span>Hỏi Gemini thêm về công cụ này:</span>
            </div>
            <form
              onSubmit={(e) => {
                e.preventDefault();
                if (customQuestion.trim()) {
                  handleFetchAiAnalysis(customQuestion);
                }
              }}
              className="flex items-center gap-2"
            >
              <input
                type="text"
                value={customQuestion}
                onChange={(e) => setCustomQuestion(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="Nhập câu hỏi bạn muốn giải đáp..."
                disabled={isLoading}
                className="flex-1 px-3.5 py-2 bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl text-xs text-slate-900 placeholder:text-slate-400 outline-none focus:border-amber-500 focus:bg-white transition-colors"
              />
              <button
                type="submit"
                disabled={!customQuestion.trim() || isLoading}
                className="px-3.5 py-2 rounded-xl bg-amber-400 hover:bg-amber-500 disabled:opacity-40 text-slate-950 font-bold text-xs flex items-center gap-1 transition-all active:scale-95 cursor-pointer shadow-xs"
              >
                <Send className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                <span>Gửi</span>
              </button>
            </form>
          </div>

        </div>

        {/* 4. Footer */}
        <div className="px-4 py-3 bg-slate-50 border-t border-slate-200 text-[11px] text-slate-500 flex items-center justify-between shrink-0">
          <span>Công nghệ Gemini 3.8 Flash • Google Cloud</span>
          <span className="text-slate-400">Hỗ trợ 24/7</span>
        </div>
      </aside>
    </>
  );
};

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { 
  Calculator, 
  Search, 
  Command, 
  X, 
  Sun,
  Moon
} from 'lucide-react';
import { ToolId } from '../../types';
import { TOOLS_CONFIG } from '../../data/toolsData';
import { LanguageSelector } from './LanguageSelector';
import { CurrencySelector } from './CurrencySelector';
import { AppLogo } from './AppLogo';
import { useLanguage } from '../../context/LanguageContext';
import { useTheme } from '../../context/ThemeContext';

interface HeaderProps {
  currentToolId: ToolId;
  onSelectTool: (id: ToolId) => void;
  isSidebarOpen: boolean;
  onToggleSidebar: () => void;
  onOpenTerms?: () => void;
}

export const Header: React.FC<HeaderProps> = ({
  currentToolId,
  onSelectTool,
  isSidebarOpen,
  onToggleSidebar,
  onOpenTerms,
}) => {
  const [isSearchOpen, setIsSearchOpen] = useState(false);
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('');
  const { t, language } = useLanguage();
  const { themeId, toggleTheme } = useTheme();
  const isVi = language === 'vi';

  const filteredTools = Object.values(TOOLS_CONFIG).filter(tool => {
    const localizedName = t.toolNames[tool.id] || tool.name;
    const localizedShort = t.toolShortNames[tool.id] || tool.shortName;
    const query = searchQuery.toLowerCase();
    return (
      tool.name.toLowerCase().includes(query) ||
      tool.shortName.toLowerCase().includes(query) ||
      localizedName.toLowerCase().includes(query) ||
      localizedShort.toLowerCase().includes(query) ||
      tool.description.toLowerCase().includes(query)
    );
  });

  return (
    <>
      <header 
        id="main-header" 
        className="sticky top-0 z-30 flex items-center justify-between px-3 sm:px-6 h-16 backdrop-blur-md border-b transition-colors duration-200"

          backgroundColor: 'var(--app-header-bg, rgba(20, 21, 38, 0.95))',
          borderColor: 'var(--app-border, #272a47)'
        }}
      >
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 sm:gap-3">
          <button
            id="sidebar-toggle-btn"
            onClick={onToggleSidebar}
            aria-label="Toggle Sidebar"
            className="hidden md:flex items-center justify-center w-10 h-10 rounded-xl text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 hover:text-slate-900 dark:hover:text-white hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-800/80 transition-colors focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 cursor-pointer"
          >
            <div className="w-5 flex flex-col gap-1 items-start">
              <span className={`h-0.5 bg-current rounded-full transition-all duration-300 ${isSidebarOpen ? 'w-5' : 'w-5'}`} />
              <span className={`h-0.5 bg-current rounded-full transition-all duration-300 ${isSidebarOpen ? 'w-3.5' : 'w-5'}`} />
              <span className={`h-0.5 bg-current rounded-full transition-all duration-300 ${isSidebarOpen ? 'w-4' : 'w-5'}`} />
            </div>
          </button>

          {/* Logo branding */}
          <div 
            onClick={() => onSelectTool('basic')}
            className="flex items-center gap-2.5 sm:gap-3 cursor-pointer group"
          >
            <div className="w-9 h-9 sm:w-10 sm:h-10 flex items-center justify-center group-hover:scale-105 group-hover:rotate-1 transition-all duration-300">
              <AppLogo className="w-full h-full drop-shadow-md" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 sm:gap-2">
                <span 
                  className="font-extrabold text-base sm:text-lg tracking-tight text-slate-900 dark:text-white"
                  aria-label="Web Calculator"
                >
                  <span>Web</span>
                  <span className="ml-1.5 font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white">Calculator</span>

          >
            {themeId === 'light' ? (
              <>

            ) : (

        >
          <div 
            onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
            className="w-full max-w-xl border rounded-2xl shadow-2xl overflow-hidden animate-in fade-in zoom-in-95 duration-150"
            style={{
              backgroundColor: 'var(--app-surface, #1b1d33)',
              borderColor: 'var(--app-border, #272a47)'

            <div className="flex items-center gap-3 px-4 py-3.5 border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-900/50">

              <input
                id="search-input"
                type="text"
                autoFocus
                placeholder={t.searchPlaceholder || "Search tools..."}

              />
              <button
                onClick={() => setIsSearchOpen(false)}

FILE: /src/components/common/LanguageSelector.tsx
