import React, { useState, useRef, useEffect } from 'react';
import { Check, ChevronDown, Search } from 'lucide-react';
import { useLanguage } from '../../context/LanguageContext';
import { LanguageItem } from '../../i18n/languages';

interface LanguageSelectorProps {
  variant?: 'header' | 'footer';
}

export const LanguageSelector: React.FC<LanguageSelectorProps> = ({ variant = 'header' }) => {
  const { language, setLanguage, languages, currentLanguageItem } = useLanguage();
  const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(false);
  const [search, setSearch] = useState('');
  const [dropdownStyle, setDropdownStyle] = useState<React.CSSProperties>({});
  const dropdownRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  const calculatePosition = () => {
    if (!dropdownRef.current) return;
    const rect = dropdownRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
    const screenWidth = window.innerWidth;
    const dropdownWidth = 256;
    const naturalLeft = rect.right - dropdownWidth;
    let shiftX = 0;
    if (naturalLeft < 12) {
      shiftX = 12 - naturalLeft;
    } else if (rect.right > screenWidth - 12) {
      shiftX = (screenWidth - 12) - rect.right;
    }

    setDropdownStyle({
      transform: shiftX !== 0 ? `translateX(${shiftX}px)` : undefined,
    });
  };

  const toggleOpen = () => {
    if (!isOpen) {
      calculatePosition();
    }
    setIsOpen(!isOpen);
  };

  // Close dropdown on outside click
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleClickOutside = (event: MouseEvent) => {
      if (dropdownRef.current && !dropdownRef.current.contains(event.target as Node)) {
        setIsOpen(false);
      }
    };
    if (isOpen) {
      calculatePosition();
      document.addEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
      window.addEventListener('resize', calculatePosition);
    }
    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
      window.removeEventListener('resize', calculatePosition);
    };
  }, [isOpen]);

  const filteredLanguages = languages.filter((l: LanguageItem) => 
    l.nativeName.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase()) ||
    l.name.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase()) ||
    l.code.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase())
  );

  return (
    <div className="relative inline-block text-left" ref={dropdownRef}>
      {/* Trigger Button */}
      <button
        type="button"
        id={`language-selector-btn-${variant}`}
        onClick={toggleOpen}
        aria-expanded={isOpen}
        aria-haspopup="listbox"
        aria-label={`Chọn ngôn ngữ (Đang chọn: ${currentLanguageItem.nativeName})`}
        className={`flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-xl transition-all cursor-pointer select-none ${
          variant === 'header'
            ? 'px-2.5 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800/80 hover:bg-slate-200 dark:hover:bg-slate-700/80 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700/70 hover:border-slate-400 dark:hover:border-slate-600 shadow-2xs scale-95 origin-center'
            : 'px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800/50 hover:bg-slate-200 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 hover:text-slate-900 dark:hover:text-slate-200 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700/60'
        }`}
      >
        <span className="text-sm">{currentLanguageItem.flag}</span>
        <span className="hidden sm:inline font-medium">{currentLanguageItem.nativeName}</span>
        <span className="sm:hidden font-mono uppercase text-[11px]">{currentLanguageItem.code}</span>
        <ChevronDown className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 transition-transform ${isOpen ? 'rotate-180' : ''}`} />
      </button>

      {/* Dropdown Menu (16 Major Languages) */}
      {isOpen && (
        <div 
          id="header-language-dropdown"
          role="listbox"
          style={dropdownStyle}
          className="absolute right-0 bottom-auto mt-2 w-64 max-w-[calc(100vw-1.5rem)] max-h-80 overflow-hidden bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-2xl shadow-2xl z-50 flex flex-col animate-in fade-in zoom-in-95 duration-150"
        >
          {/* Header / Search input */}
          <div className="p-2.5 border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-900/90 language-search-header">
            <div className="relative flex items-center">
              <Search className="absolute left-2.5 w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-400" />
              <input
                id="language-search-input"
                type="text"
                value={search}
                onChange={(e) => setSearch(e.target.value)}
                placeholder={`${languages.length} languages...`}
                className="w-full pl-8 pr-3 py-1.5 text-xs bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-lg text-slate-900 dark:text-white placeholder:text-slate-400 outline-none focus:border-blue-500 transition-colors"
                autoFocus
              />
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Languages List */}
          <div className="overflow-y-auto p-1.5 space-y-0.5 scrollbar-thin">
            {filteredLanguages.length === 0 ? (
              <div className="py-4 text-center text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                {language === 'vi' ? 'Không tìm thấy ngôn ngữ' : 'No language found'}
              </div>
            ) : (
              filteredLanguages.map((langItem) => {
                const isSelected = langItem.code === language;
                return (
                  <button
                    key={langItem.code}
                    role="option"
                    aria-selected={isSelected}
                    onClick={() => {
                      setLanguage(langItem.code as any);
                      setIsOpen(false);
                      setSearch('');
                    }}
                    className={`language-option-btn w-full flex items-center justify-between px-3 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs transition-colors cursor-pointer ${
                      isSelected
                        ? 'is-selected bg-blue-600 text-white font-bold shadow-xs'
                        : 'text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 hover:text-slate-900 dark:hover:text-white'
                    }`}
                  >
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
                      <span className="text-base shrink-0">{langItem.flag}</span>
                      <div className="text-left">
                        <div className="lang-native-name font-semibold leading-tight">{langItem.nativeName}</div>
                        <div className={`lang-sub-name text-[10px] ${isSelected ? 'text-blue-100' : 'text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400'}`}>
                          {langItem.name}
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                    {isSelected && <Check className="w-4 h-4 text-white shrink-0" />}
                  </button>
                );
              })
            )}
          </div>

          {/* Footer of Dropdown */}
          <div className="language-dropdown-footer px-3 py-2 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950/60 border-t border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800/80 text-[10px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 flex items-center justify-between">
            <span>{languages.length} {language === 'vi' ? 'Ngôn ngữ' : 'Languages'}</span>
            <span className="font-mono">AC Studio i18n</span>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

import React, { useEffect } from 'react';
import { ToolMeta, ToolId } from '../../types';
import { LanguageCode } from '../../i18n/languages';
import { getToolSEO } from '../../data/internationalSEO';
import { getLocalizedToolContent } from '../../data/localizedToolContent';

interface SEOManagerProps {
  tool: ToolMeta;
  lang: LanguageCode;
}

export const SUPPORTED_SEO_MARKETS: { code: string; hreflang: string }[] = [
  { code: 'en', hreflang: 'en' },
  { code: 'vi', hreflang: 'vi' },
  { code: 'ja', hreflang: 'ja' },
  { code: 'ko', hreflang: 'ko' },
  { code: 'zh', hreflang: 'zh-Hans' },
  { code: 'es', hreflang: 'es' },
  { code: 'fr', hreflang: 'fr' },
  { code: 'de', hreflang: 'de' },
  { code: 'pt', hreflang: 'pt' },
  { code: 'ru', hreflang: 'ru' },
  { code: 'id', hreflang: 'id' },
  { code: 'th', hreflang: 'th' },
  { code: 'hi', hreflang: 'hi' },
  { code: 'ar', hreflang: 'ar' },
  { code: 'it', hreflang: 'it' },
  { code: 'nl', hreflang: 'nl' },
  { code: 'tr', hreflang: 'tr' },
  { code: 'pl', hreflang: 'pl' },
  { code: 'ms', hreflang: 'ms' },
  { code: 'sv', hreflang: 'sv' }
];

const getEffectiveDomain = () => {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return 'https://web-calculator.com';
  const customUrl = (import.meta as any).env?.VITE_APP_URL;
  if (customUrl) return customUrl.replace(/\/+$/, '');
  const origin = window.location.origin;
  if (!origin.includes('localhost') && !origin.includes('127.0.0.1')) {
    return origin;
  }
  return 'https://web-calculator.com';
};

const getApplicationCategory = (toolId: ToolId): string => {
  switch (toolId) {
    case 'bmi':
    case 'calorie':
    case 'bodyfat':
    case 'ovulation':
    case 'pace':
      return 'HealthApplication';
    case 'salary':
    case 'loan':
    case 'compound':
    case 'mortgage':
    case 'tax':
    case 'tip':
    case 'discount':
    case 'percentage':
      return 'FinanceApplication';
    case 'trigonometry':
    case 'gpa':
    case 'concrete':
      return 'EducationalApplication';
    case 'basic':
    case 'unit':
    case 'age':
    case 'time':
    case 'date':
    case 'random':
    case 'password':
    case 'ai':
    default:
      return 'UtilitiesApplication';
  }
};

export const SEOManager: React.FC<SEOManagerProps> = ({ tool, lang }) => {
  useEffect(() => {
    const DOMAIN = getEffectiveDomain();
    const prevTitle = document.title;
    const isBasic = tool.id === 'basic';
    const toolSlug = isBasic ? '' : tool.id;
    const currentCanonicalUrl = isBasic ? `${DOMAIN}/${lang}/` : `${DOMAIN}/${lang}/${tool.id}`;
    const isRtl = lang === 'ar';
    const localizedSEO = getToolSEO(tool.id, lang);
    const localizedContent = getLocalizedToolContent(tool.id, lang);

    // 1. Update HTML language & direction attributes
    document.documentElement.lang = lang;
    document.documentElement.dir = isRtl ? 'rtl' : 'ltr';

    // 2. Update Title
    const fullTitle = `${localizedSEO.title} | Web Calculator`;
    document.title = fullTitle;

    // 3. Update Meta Description
    let metaDesc = document.querySelector('meta[name="description"]') as HTMLMetaElement | null;
    if (!metaDesc) {
      metaDesc = document.createElement('meta');
      metaDesc.name = 'description';
      document.head.appendChild(metaDesc);
    }
    metaDesc.content = localizedSEO.description;

    // 3b. Update Meta Keywords
    let metaKeywords = document.querySelector('meta[name="keywords"]') as HTMLMetaElement | null;
    if (!metaKeywords) {
      metaKeywords = document.createElement('meta');
      metaKeywords.name = 'keywords';
      document.head.appendChild(metaKeywords);
    }
    metaKeywords.content = localizedSEO.keywords.join(', ');

    // 4. Update OpenGraph & Twitter
    const updateOrCreateMeta = (property: string, content: string, isName = false) => {
      const selector = isName ? `meta[name="${property}"]` : `meta[property="${property}"]`;
      let el = document.querySelector(selector) as HTMLMetaElement | null;
      if (!el) {
        el = document.createElement('meta');
        if (isName) {
          el.name = property;
        } else {
          el.setAttribute('property', property);
        }
        document.head.appendChild(el);
      }
      el.content = content;
    };

    updateOrCreateMeta('og:title', fullTitle);
    updateOrCreateMeta('og:description', localizedSEO.description);
    updateOrCreateMeta('og:url', currentCanonicalUrl);
    updateOrCreateMeta('og:type', 'website');
    updateOrCreateMeta('og:image', `${DOMAIN}/og-image.png`);
    updateOrCreateMeta('twitter:card', 'summary_large_image', true);
    updateOrCreateMeta('twitter:title', fullTitle, true);
    updateOrCreateMeta('twitter:description', localizedSEO.description, true);
    updateOrCreateMeta('twitter:image', `${DOMAIN}/og-image.png`, true);

    // Enforce No-Index & No-Follow for Testing & Staging (Googlebot, Bingbot, etc.)
    updateOrCreateMeta('robots', 'noindex, nofollow, noarchive, nosnippet', true);
    updateOrCreateMeta('googlebot', 'noindex, nofollow, noarchive, nosnippet', true);
    updateOrCreateMeta('googlebot-news', 'noindex, nofollow', true);

    // 5. Update Canonical Link
    let canonical = document.querySelector('link[rel="canonical"]') as HTMLLinkElement | null;
    if (!canonical) {
      canonical = document.createElement('link');
      canonical.rel = 'canonical';
      document.head.appendChild(canonical);
    }
    canonical.href = currentCanonicalUrl;

    // 6. Dynamic Hreflang Alternates (20 International Markets + x-default) directly in <head>
    // Remove all previous alternate hreflang tags (including static template tags from index.html) to prevent duplicates
    document.querySelectorAll('link[rel="alternate"][hreflang]').forEach(el => el.remove());

    // x-default points to English
    const xDefaultLink = document.createElement('link');
    xDefaultLink.rel = 'alternate';
    xDefaultLink.hreflang = 'x-default';
    xDefaultLink.href = `${DOMAIN}/en/${toolSlug}`;
    xDefaultLink.setAttribute('data-dynamic-hreflang', 'true');
    document.head.appendChild(xDefaultLink);

    // 20 markets
    SUPPORTED_SEO_MARKETS.forEach(market => {
      const link = document.createElement('link');
      link.rel = 'alternate';
      link.hreflang = market.hreflang;
      link.href = `${DOMAIN}/${market.code}/${toolSlug}`;
      link.setAttribute('data-dynamic-hreflang', 'true');
      document.head.appendChild(link);
    });

    // 7. Dynamic JSON-LD Structured Data Schema (WebApplication, FAQPage, BreadcrumbList, HowTo)
    const schemaData = {
      "@context": "https://schema.org",
      "@graph": [
        {
          "@type": "WebApplication",
          "@id": `${currentCanonicalUrl}#webapp`,
          "url": currentCanonicalUrl,
          "name": localizedSEO.title,
          "alternateName": localizedContent.name,
          "applicationCategory": getApplicationCategory(tool.id),
          "operatingSystem": "All modern browsers (Chrome, Safari, Firefox, Edge, Android, iOS)",
          "browserRequirements": "Requires JavaScript. Requires HTML5.",
          "inLanguage": lang,
          "description": localizedSEO.description,
          "featureList": localizedContent.usageSteps,
          "offers": {
            "@type": "Offer",
            "price": "0",
            "priceCurrency": "USD"
          }
        },
        {
          "@type": "BreadcrumbList",
          "@id": `${currentCanonicalUrl}#breadcrumb`,
          "itemListElement": [
            {
              "@type": "ListItem",
              "position": 1,
              "name": "Web Calculator",
              "item": `${DOMAIN}/${lang}/`
            },
            ...(!isBasic ? [{
              "@type": "ListItem",
              "position": 2,
              "name": localizedContent.name,
              "item": currentCanonicalUrl
            }] : [])
          ]
        },
        {
          "@type": "FAQPage",
          "@id": `${currentCanonicalUrl}#faq`,
          "mainEntity": localizedContent.faqs.map(faq => ({
            "@type": "Question",
            "name": faq.question,
            "acceptedAnswer": {
              "@type": "Answer",
              "text": faq.answer
            }
          }))
        },
        {
          "@type": "HowTo",
          "@id": `${currentCanonicalUrl}#howto`,
          "name": `How to use ${localizedContent.name}`,
          "description": localizedSEO.description,
          "step": localizedContent.usageSteps.map((step, idx) => ({
            "@type": "HowToStep",
            "position": idx + 1,
            "name": `${localizedContent.name} - Step ${idx + 1}`,
            "text": step
          }))
        }
      ]
    };

    const schemaId = 'dynamic-tool-schema-jsonld';
    let scriptTag = document.getElementById(schemaId) as HTMLScriptElement | null;
    if (!scriptTag) {
      scriptTag = document.createElement('script');
      scriptTag.id = schemaId;
      scriptTag.type = 'application/ld+json';
      document.head.appendChild(scriptTag);
    }
    scriptTag.text = JSON.stringify(schemaData);

    return () => {
      document.title = prevTitle;
    };
  }, [tool, lang]);

  return null;
};

export const Sidebar: React.FC<SidebarProps> = ({
  currentToolId,
  onSelectTool,
  isOpen
}) => {
  const { language, t } = useLanguage();
  const secUi = getSectionUi(language);
  const isVi = language === 'vi';

  // Track open/collapsed categories: only 'hot' is expanded by default, all 6 other categories are collapsed
  const [collapsedCategories, setCollapsedCategories] = useState<Record<string, boolean>>({
    financial: true,
    fitness: true,
    math: true,
    geometry: true,
    conversion: true,
    utility: true,
    hot: false
  });

  const toggleCategory = (catId: string) => {
    setCollapsedCategories(prev => {
      const currentVal = catId === 'hot' ? (prev['hot'] ?? false) : (prev[catId] ?? true);
      return {
        ...prev,
        [catId]: !currentVal
      };
    });
  };

  const tools = useMemo(() => Object.values(TOOLS_CONFIG), []);

  // Featured Hot Calculators
  const hotTools = useMemo(() => {
    return HOT_TOOL_IDS
      .map(id => tools.find(t => t.id === id))
      .filter(Boolean) as typeof tools;
  }, [tools]);

  const renderToolButton = (tool: typeof tools[0]) => {
    const isActive = currentToolId === tool.id;
    const localizedName = t.toolNames[tool.id] || tool.name;
    const colorTheme = getToolColorTheme(tool.id);

    return (
      <button
        key={tool.id}
        id={`sidebar-nav-${tool.id}`}
        onClick={() => onSelectTool(tool.id)}
        title={localizedName}
        className={`w-full group flex items-center justify-between px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-xl text-left transition-all duration-200 cursor-pointer ${
          isActive 
            ? 'sidebar-tool-active bg-blue-600 text-white shadow-md shadow-blue-500/25 ring-1 ring-blue-400/40' 
            : 'sidebar-tool-inactive text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 hover:text-blue-600 dark:hover:text-sky-300 hover:bg-slate-100/90 dark:hover:bg-slate-800/60'
        }`}
      >
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5 min-w-0 flex-1 pr-2">
          <span className={`w-7 h-7 flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 transition-transform duration-200 group-hover:scale-110 ${
            isActive 
              ? 'text-white' 
              : colorTheme.iconColor
          }`}>
            <ToolIcon id={tool.id} className="w-[19px] h-[19px]" />
          </span>
          <span className="text-[14px] font-medium leading-snug break-words group-hover:text-blue-600 dark:group-hover:text-sky-300">
            {localizedName}
          </span>
        </div>
        
        {isActive ? (
          <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-[#10B981] ring-2 ring-white/20 shrink-0" />
        ) : (
          <ChevronRight className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-400 group-hover:text-blue-500 dark:group-hover:text-sky-300 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity shrink-0" />
        )}
      </button>
    );
  };

  return (
    <aside 
      id="desktop-sidebar"
      className={`hidden md:flex flex-col shrink-0 border-r transition-all duration-300 ease-in-out ${
        isOpen ? 'w-80' : 'w-0 -translate-x-full overflow-hidden'
      }`}
      style={{
        backgroundColor: 'var(--app-bg, #141526)',
        borderColor: 'var(--app-border, #272a47)'
      }}
    >
      {/* Scrollable Tool Categories */}
      <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-3 space-y-4 scrollbar-thin scrollbar-thumb-slate-300 dark:scrollbar-thumb-slate-800">
        {CATEGORIES.map(cat => {
          const catTools = cat.id === 'hot'
            ? hotTools
            : tools.filter(t => t.category === cat.id);

          if (catTools.length === 0) return null;

          const isCollapsed = cat.id === 'hot' 
            ? (collapsedCategories['hot'] ?? false) 
            : (collapsedCategories[cat.id] ?? true);
          const hasActiveTool = catTools.some(t => t.id === currentToolId);

          return (
            <div key={cat.id} className="space-y-1">
              {/* Category Group Header */}
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => toggleCategory(cat.id)}
                className={`w-full flex items-center justify-between px-2 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-left transition-colors cursor-pointer group ${
                  cat.id === 'hot'
                    ? 'hover:bg-amber-500/10 dark:hover:bg-amber-500/15'
                    : 'hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-800/50'
                }`}
              >
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  {cat.id === 'hot' && (
                    <Flame className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-500 fill-amber-500 shrink-0 animate-pulse" />
                  )}
                  <span className={`text-[12.5px] font-bold tracking-wider uppercase ${cat.color} group-hover:brightness-110 flex items-center gap-1.5`}>
                    <span>{isVi ? cat.nameVi : cat.nameEn}</span>
                    {cat.id === 'hot' && (
                      <span className="px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[9px] font-black uppercase rounded-md bg-gradient-to-r from-amber-500 to-rose-500 text-white shadow-xs">
                        HOT
                      </span>
                    )}
                  </span>
                  {hasActiveTool && (
                    <span className={`w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full animate-pulse ${
                      cat.id === 'hot' ? 'bg-amber-400' : 'bg-emerald-400'
                    }`} />
                  )}
                </div>
                <div className="flex items-center">
                  {isCollapsed ? (
                    <ChevronRight className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-400 group-hover:text-slate-600 dark:group-hover:text-slate-200" />
                  ) : (
                    <ChevronDown className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-400 group-hover:text-slate-600 dark:group-hover:text-slate-200" />
                  )}
                </div>
              </button>

              {/* Tool Buttons in this Category */}
              {!isCollapsed && (
                <div className="space-y-0.5 pt-0.5">
                  {catTools.map(renderToolButton)}
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          );
        })}

        {/* SEO Trust Guarantee Badge */}
        <div className="p-3.5 rounded-xl bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-900/60 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 text-[13.5px] text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 space-y-1.5 mt-4">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-300 font-semibold">
            <ShieldCheck className="w-4 h-4 text-[#10B981]" />
            <span>{secUi.sidebarGuaranteeTitle}</span>
          </div>
          <p className="text-[12.5px] leading-relaxed">
            {secUi.sidebarGuaranteeText}
          </p>
        </div>
      </div>
    </aside>
  );
};

import { X, ShieldCheck, FileText, CheckCircle2, Lock, Sparkles, Copyright, Mail } from 'lucide-react';
import { useLanguage } from '../../context/LanguageContext';

interface TermsModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import {
  ChevronRight,
  HelpCircle,
  BookOpen,
  Link as LinkIcon,
  ChevronDown,
  Check,
  Share2,
  RotateCcw,
  Sparkles,
  ArrowRight
} from 'lucide-react';
import { ToolId, ToolMeta } from '../../types';
import { TOOLS_CONFIG } from '../../data/toolsData';
import { AdBanner } from './AdBanner';
import { ExploreMoreSection } from './ExploreMoreSection';
import { SEOManager } from './SEOManager';
import { useLanguage } from '../../context/LanguageContext';
import { getToolSEO } from '../../data/internationalSEO';
import { getSectionUi } from '../../data/internationalSections';

interface ToolLayoutProps {
  tool: ToolMeta;
  onSelectTool: (id: ToolId) => void;
  onResetTool?: () => void;
  onOpenGemini?: (toolKey?: ToolId) => void;
  children: React.ReactNode;
}

export const ToolLayout: React.FC<ToolLayoutProps> = ({
  tool,
  onSelectTool,
  onResetTool,
  onOpenGemini,
  children
}) => {
  const { language, t } = useLanguage();
  const toolSEO = getToolSEO(tool.id, language);
  const secUi = getSectionUi(language);
  const [openFaqIndex, setOpenFaqIndex] = useState<number | null>(0);
  const [copiedLink, setCopiedLink] = useState(false);
  const [toastMessage, setToastMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const showToast = (msg: string) => {
    setToastMessage(msg);
    setTimeout(() => {
      setToastMessage(null);
    }, 2500);
  };

  const handleCopyLink = () => {
    const search = window.location.search || '';
    const cleanToolUrl = `${window.location.origin}/${language}/${tool.id}${search}`;
    navigator.clipboard?.writeText(cleanToolUrl);
    setCopiedLink(true);
    showToast(t.copiedToast || secUi.shareCopied);
    setTimeout(() => setCopiedLink(false), 2000);
  };

  const handleResetWithToast = () => {
    if (onResetTool) {
      onResetTool();
      showToast(secUi.resetButton);
    }
  };

  const currentToolName = t.toolNames[tool.id] || tool.name;

  return (
    <div id={`tool-page-${tool.id}`} className="w-full max-w-5xl mx-auto space-y-4 sm:space-y-6 animate-in fade-in duration-200">
      {/* Dynamic SEO Manager: Hreflang for 20 markets & Rich Results JSON-LD */}
      <SEOManager tool={tool} lang={language} />
      
      {/* Mobile Top Bar (< sm): Ultra-compact header so calculator is immediately at top */}
      <div className="flex sm:hidden items-center justify-between gap-2 px-1 py-0.5">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 min-w-0">
          <button 
            onClick={() => onSelectTool('basic')} 
            className="text-xs text-slate-400 hover:text-blue-500 transition-colors shrink-0"
          >
            {secUi.homeBreadcrumb}
          </button>
          <ChevronRight className="w-3 h-3 text-slate-400 shrink-0" />
          <span 
            className="text-xs font-bold truncate"
            style={{ color: 'var(--app-text-primary, #ffffff)' }}
          >
            {currentToolName}
          </span>
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 shrink-0">
          {onResetTool && (
            <button
              id={`mobile-reset-btn-${tool.id}`}
              onClick={handleResetWithToast}
              title={secUi.resetTooltip}
              className="flex items-center gap-1 px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-medium rounded-lg transition-all active:scale-95 cursor-pointer tool-reset-btn"
            >
              <RotateCcw className="w-3 h-3" />
              <span>{secUi.resetButton}</span>
            </button>
          )}

          <button
            id={`mobile-copy-tool-link-${tool.id}`}
            onClick={handleCopyLink}
            title={secUi.shareTooltip}
            className="flex items-center gap-1 px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-medium rounded-lg transition-all active:scale-95 cursor-pointer tool-share-btn"
          >
            {copiedLink ? (
              <>
                <Check className="w-3 h-3 text-[#10B981]" />
                <span className="text-[#10B981]">{secUi.shareCopied}</span>
              </>
            ) : (
              <>
                <Share2 className="w-3 h-3" />
                <span>{secUi.shareButton}</span>
              </>
            )}
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Desktop Top Bar (>= sm): Compact header elevating calculator to the top */}
      <div className="hidden sm:flex items-center justify-between gap-4 py-1">
        {/* Breadcrumb Navigation */}
        <nav aria-label="Breadcrumb" className="flex items-center text-xs text-slate-400 space-x-1.5 overflow-x-auto whitespace-nowrap py-0.5">
          <button 
            onClick={() => onSelectTool('basic')} 
            className="hover:text-blue-500 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
          >
            {secUi.homeBreadcrumb}
          </button>
          <ChevronRight className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-400 shrink-0" />
          <span className="text-slate-500">{secUi.toolsBreadcrumb}</span>
          <ChevronRight className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-400 shrink-0" />
          <span 
            className="font-bold"
            style={{ color: 'var(--app-text-primary, #ffffff)' }}
          >
            {currentToolName}
          </span>
        </nav>

        {/* Desktop Action buttons */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 shrink-0">
          {onResetTool && (
            <button
              id={`reset-btn-${tool.id}`}
              onClick={handleResetWithToast}
              title={secUi.resetTooltip}
              className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold rounded-xl transition-colors cursor-pointer tool-reset-btn"
            >
              <RotateCcw className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              <span>{secUi.resetButton}</span>
            </button>
          )}

          <button
            id={`copy-tool-link-${tool.id}`}
            onClick={handleCopyLink}
            title={secUi.shareTooltip}
            className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold rounded-xl transition-all cursor-pointer tool-share-btn"
          >
            {copiedLink ? (
              <>
                <Check className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[#10B981]" />
                <span className="text-[#10B981]">{secUi.shareCopied}</span>
              </>
            ) : (
              <>
                <Share2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                <span>{secUi.shareButton}</span>
              </>
            )}
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* 3. Main Calculator Card - Themed Surface */}
      <section 
        id={`calculator-card-${tool.id}`}
        className="tool-themed-card rounded-2xl sm:rounded-3xl shadow-xs dark:shadow-2xl dark:shadow-black/50 overflow-hidden border transition-colors duration-200"
        style={{
          backgroundColor: 'var(--app-surface, #1b1d33)',
          borderColor: 'var(--app-border, #272a47)',
        }}
      >
        {children}
      </section>

      {/* Description & SEO Tagline Card: Placed below the calculator card */}
      <div 
        className="tool-seo-desc-card rounded-2xl p-4 sm:p-5 space-y-2 border transition-colors shadow-sm"
        style={{

        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-baseline gap-2">
          <h1 
            className="text-base sm:text-lg font-bold tracking-tight leading-snug"
            style={{ color: 'var(--app-text-primary, #ffffff)' }}
          >
            {toolSEO?.title || tool.seoH1}
          </h1>
          {tool.tagline && (
            <span 
              className="font-normal text-xs sm:text-sm"
              style={{ color: 'var(--app-text-muted, #94a3b8)' }}
            >
              – {tool.tagline}
            </span>
          )}
        </div>
        {(toolSEO?.description || tool.description) && (
          <p 
            className="text-xs sm:text-sm leading-relaxed max-w-4xl"
            style={{ color: 'var(--app-text-secondary, #cbd5e1)' }}
          >
            {toolSEO?.description || tool.description}
          </p>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Sponsored Ad Banner - Optimized for SEO Core Web Vitals (Zero CLS) */}
      <section id={`ad-container-${tool.id}`} aria-label="Quảng cáo tài trợ">
        <AdBanner slot="middle" format="horizontal" />

      <section id="seo-formula-usage" className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-5">
        {/* Usage Guide (H2) */}
        <div 
          className="rounded-2xl p-5 sm:p-6 space-y-4 border transition-colors shadow-sm"
          style={{
            backgroundColor: 'var(--app-surface, #1b1d33)',
            borderColor: 'var(--app-border, #272a47)',
          }}
        >
          <div 
            className="flex items-center gap-2 font-bold text-lg"
            style={{ color: 'var(--app-text-primary, #ffffff)' }}
          >
            <BookOpen className="w-5 h-5 text-blue-500" />
            <h2>{secUi.guideTitle(currentToolName)}</h2>
          </div>
          <ol 
            className="space-y-3 text-sm"
            style={{ color: 'var(--app-text-secondary, #cbd5e1)' }}
          >
            {tool.usageSteps.map((step, idx) => (
              <li key={idx} className="flex items-start gap-3">
                <span className="flex items-center justify-center w-6 h-6 rounded-full bg-blue-600/20 border border-blue-500/40 text-blue-500 dark:text-blue-400 text-xs font-bold shrink-0 mt-0.5">
                  {idx + 1}
                </span>
                <span className="leading-relaxed">{step}</span>
              </li>
            ))}
          </ol>
        </div>

        {/* Formula & Principles (H2) */}
        <div 
          className="rounded-2xl p-5 sm:p-6 space-y-4 border transition-colors shadow-sm"
          style={{
            backgroundColor: 'var(--app-surface, #1b1d33)',
            borderColor: 'var(--app-border, #272a47)',
          }}
        >
          <div 
            className="flex items-center gap-2 font-bold text-lg"
            style={{ color: 'var(--app-text-primary, #ffffff)' }}
          >
            <Sparkles className="w-5 h-5 text-emerald-500" />
            <h2>{secUi.formulaTitle}</h2>
          </div>
          <p 
            className="text-sm leading-relaxed"
            style={{ color: 'var(--app-text-secondary, #cbd5e1)' }}
          >
            {tool.formulaDescription}
          </p>
          {tool.formulaEquation && (
            <div 
              className="p-3.5 rounded-xl text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 font-mono text-sm tracking-wide overflow-x-auto text-center font-bold border"
              style={{
                backgroundColor: 'var(--app-subsurface, #141526)',
                borderColor: 'var(--app-border, #272a47)',
              }}
            >
              {tool.formulaEquation}
            </div>
          )}
          <div 
            className="text-xs flex items-center gap-1.5 pt-1"
            style={{ color: 'var(--app-text-muted, #94a3b8)' }}
          >
            <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-[#10B981]" />
            <span>{secUi.formulaVerified}</span>
          </div>
        </div>
      </section>

      {/* Explore More Section (Matches user's screenshot with `>` button on each card) */}
      <ExploreMoreSection
        onOpenGeminiDrawer={(key) => {
          if (onOpenGemini) {
            onOpenGemini(key);
          }
        }}
      />

      {/* Bottom Ad Banner - Multi-device responsive (Desktop, Tablet, Mobile) */}
      <section id={`bottom-ad-container-${tool.id}`} aria-label="Quảng cáo tài trợ đối tác">
        <AdBanner slot="bottom" format="horizontal" />
      </section>

      {/* 5. FAQ Accordion (Schema FAQPage) */}
      <section 
        id="faq-section" 
        className="rounded-2xl p-5 sm:p-6 space-y-4 border transition-colors shadow-sm"
        style={{
          backgroundColor: 'var(--app-surface, #1b1d33)',
          borderColor: 'var(--app-border, #272a47)',
        }}
      >
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
          <div 
            className="flex items-center gap-2 font-bold text-lg"
            style={{ color: 'var(--app-text-primary, #ffffff)' }}
          >
            <HelpCircle className="w-5 h-5 text-blue-500" />
            <h2>{secUi.faqTitle}</h2>
          </div>
          <span 
            className="text-xs font-mono"
            style={{ color: 'var(--app-text-muted, #94a3b8)' }}
          >
            Schema FAQPage ✓
          </span>
        </div>

        <div className="space-y-2.5">
          {tool.faqs.map((faq, index) => {
            const isOpen = openFaqIndex === index;
            return (
              <div 
                key={index}
                className="border rounded-xl overflow-hidden transition-colors"
                style={{
                  backgroundColor: 'var(--app-subsurface, #141526)',
                  borderColor: 'var(--app-border, #272a47)',
                }}
              >
                <button
                  onClick={() => setOpenFaqIndex(isOpen ? null : index)}
                  className="w-full flex items-center justify-between p-4 text-left text-sm font-semibold transition-colors"
                  style={{ color: 'var(--app-text-primary, #ffffff)' }}
                >
                  <span className="pr-4">{faq.question}</span>
                  <ChevronDown className={`w-4 h-4 shrink-0 transition-transform duration-200 ${
                    isOpen ? 'rotate-180 text-blue-500' : 'text-slate-400'
                  }`} />
                </button>
                {isOpen && (
                  <div 
                    className="px-4 pb-4 text-sm leading-relaxed border-t pt-3 animate-in fade-in"
                    style={{ 
                      color: 'var(--app-text-secondary, #cbd5e1)',
                      borderColor: 'var(--app-border, #272a47)'
                    }}
                  >
                    {faq.answer}
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      </section>

      {/* 6. Internal Linking (Cross links between related tools) */}
      <section 
        id="internal-links-section" 
        className="rounded-2xl p-5 space-y-3 border transition-colors shadow-sm"
        style={{
          backgroundColor: 'var(--app-surface, #1b1d33)',
          borderColor: 'var(--app-border, #272a47)',
        }}
      >
        <div 
          className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm font-bold"
          style={{ color: 'var(--app-text-primary, #ffffff)' }}
        >
          <LinkIcon className="w-4 h-4 text-blue-500" />
          <span>{secUi.relatedTitle}</span>
        </div>
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-3">
          {tool.relatedToolIds.map((relId) => {
            const relTool = TOOLS_CONFIG[relId];
            if (!relTool) return null;
            const relName = t.toolNames[relId] || relTool.name;
            return (
              <button
                key={relId}
                id={`related-tool-${relId}`}
                onClick={() => {
                  onSelectTool(relId);
                  window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'smooth' });
                }}
                className="flex items-center justify-between p-3 rounded-xl border text-left transition-all group hover:shadow-md cursor-pointer"
                style={{
                  backgroundColor: 'var(--app-subsurface, #141526)',
                  borderColor: 'var(--app-border, #272a47)',
                }}
              >
                <div>
                  <h4 
                    className="text-sm font-semibold group-hover:text-blue-500 transition-colors"
                    style={{ color: 'var(--app-text-primary, #ffffff)' }}
                  >
                    {relName}
                  </h4>
                  <span 
                    className="text-[11px]"
                    style={{ color: 'var(--app-text-muted, #94a3b8)' }}
                  >
                    {relTool.badge}
                  </span>
                </div>
                <ArrowRight className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-400 group-hover:text-blue-500 group-hover:translate-x-0.5 transition-all" />
              </button>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      </section>

      {/* Bottom spacer for mobile bar */}
      <div className="h-16 md:hidden" />

      {/* Floating Toast Notification */}
      {toastMessage && (
        <div className="fixed bottom-20 md:bottom-20 right-4 md:right-8 z-50 flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-slate-900/95 text-white text-xs font-semibold shadow-2xl border border-blue-500/40 backdrop-blur-md animate-in fade-in slide-in-from-bottom-2 duration-200">
          <Sparkles className="w-4 h-4 text-blue-400 shrink-0" />
          <span>{toastMessage}</span>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};


================================================================================
FILE: /src/components/tools/AgeCalculator.tsx

import React, { useState, useMemo } from 'react';
import {
  Calendar as CalendarIcon,
  Cake,
  Clock,
  Copy,
  Check,
  Sparkles
} from 'lucide-react';
import {
  parseLocalDate,
  formatLocalISODate,
  getTodayLocalISODate,
  calculateCalendarAge
} from '../../utils/dateUtils';

export const AgeCalculator: React.FC = () => {
  // Default birth date: 25 years ago in local time
  const defaultBirthDate = useMemo(() => {
    const d = new Date();
    d.setFullYear(d.getFullYear() - 25);
    return formatLocalISODate(d);
  }, []);

  const todayStr = useMemo(() => getTodayLocalISODate(), []);

  const [birthDateStr, setBirthDateStr] = useState<string>(defaultBirthDate);
  const [targetDateStr, setTargetDateStr] = useState<string>(todayStr);
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState<boolean>(false);

  // Age calculations
  const ageData = useMemo(() => {
    const birth = parseLocalDate(birthDateStr);
    const target = parseLocalDate(targetDateStr);

    if (isNaN(birth.getTime()) || isNaN(target.getTime()) || target < birth) {
      return null;
    }

    const { years, months, days } = calculateCalendarAge(birth, target);

    // Total milliseconds
    const diffMs = target.getTime() - birth.getTime();
    const totalDays = Math.round(diffMs / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));
    const totalWeeks = Math.floor(totalDays / 7);
    const totalMonths = years * 12 + months;
    const totalHours = totalDays * 24;
    const totalMinutes = totalHours * 60;

    // Next birthday calculation
    let nextBdayYear = target.getFullYear();
    let nextBday = new Date(nextBdayYear, birth.getMonth(), birth.getDate(), 0, 0, 0, 0);
    if (nextBday < target) {
      nextBday = new Date(nextBdayYear + 1, birth.getMonth(), birth.getDate(), 0, 0, 0, 0);
    }
    const daysToNextBday = Math.max(0, Math.ceil((nextBday.getTime() - target.getTime()) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24)));
    
    // Day of week born
    const daysOfWeek = ['Chủ Nhật', 'Thứ Hai', 'Thứ Ba', 'Thứ Tư', 'Thứ Năm', 'Thứ Sáu', 'Thứ Bảy'];
    const bornDayOfWeek = daysOfWeek[birth.getDay()];
    const nextBdayDayOfWeek = daysOfWeek[nextBday.getDay()];

    // Zodiac Sign
    const day = birth.getDate();
    const month = birth.getMonth() + 1;
    let zodiac = { name: '', symbol: '', trait: '' };

    if ((month === 3 && day >= 21) || (month === 4 && day <= 19)) {
      zodiac = { name: 'Bạch Dương (Aries)', symbol: '♈', trait: 'Nhiệt huyết, dũng cảm, quyết đoán' };
    } else if ((month === 4 && day >= 20) || (month === 5 && day <= 20)) {
      zodiac = { name: 'Kim Ngưu (Taurus)', symbol: '♉', trait: 'Kiên nhẫn, thực tế, đáng tin cậy' };
    } else if ((month === 5 && day >= 21) || (month === 6 && day <= 21)) {
      zodiac = { name: 'Song Tử (Gemini)', symbol: '♊', trait: 'Thông minh, linh hoạt, thích giao tiếp' };
    } else if ((month === 6 && day >= 22) || (month === 7 && day <= 22)) {
      zodiac = { name: 'Cự Giải (Cancer)', symbol: '♋', trait: 'Giàu cảm xúc, chăm sóc, trực giác tốt' };
    } else if ((month === 7 && day >= 23) || (month === 8 && day <= 22)) {
      zodiac = { name: 'Sư Tử (Leo)', symbol: '♌', trait: 'Tự tin, hào phóng, có tố chất lãnh đạo' };
    } else if ((month === 8 && day >= 23) || (month === 9 && day <= 22)) {
      zodiac = { name: 'Xử Nữ (Virgo)', symbol: '♍', trait: 'Tỉ mỉ, cẩn thận, có trách nhiệm cao' };
    } else if ((month === 9 && day >= 23) || (month === 10 && day <= 23)) {
      zodiac = { name: 'Thiên Bình (Libra)', symbol: '♎', trait: 'Công bằng, hài hòa, duyên dáng' };
    } else if ((month === 10 && day >= 24) || (month === 11 && day <= 21)) {
      zodiac = { name: 'Bọ Cạp (Scorpio)', symbol: '♏', trait: 'Mạnh mẽ, sâu sắc, trực giác nhạy bén' };
    } else if ((month === 11 && day >= 22) || (month === 12 && day <= 21)) {
      zodiac = { name: 'Nhân Mã (Sagittarius)', symbol: '♐', trait: 'Lạc quan, yêu tự do, thích khám phá' };
    } else if ((month === 12 && day >= 22) || (month === 1 && day <= 19)) {
      zodiac = { name: 'Ma Kết (Capricorn)', symbol: '♑', trait: 'Kiên định, kỷ luật, có hoài bão lớn' };
    } else if ((month === 1 && day >= 20) || (month === 2 && day <= 18)) {
      zodiac = { name: 'Bảo Bình (Aquarius)', symbol: '♒', trait: 'Sáng tạo, độc lập, nhân ái' };
    } else {
      zodiac = { name: 'Song Ngư (Pisces)', symbol: '♓', trait: 'Thấu hiểu, giàu lòng trắc ẩn, nghệ sĩ' };
    }

    // Chinese Zodiac (Can Chi)
    const can = ['Giáp', 'Ất', 'Bính', 'Đinh', 'Mậu', 'Kỷ', 'Canh', 'Tân', 'Nhâm', 'Quý'];
    const chi = ['Tý (Chuột)', 'Sửu (Trâu)', 'Dần (Hổ)', 'Mão (Mèo)', 'Thìn (Rồng)', 'Tỵ (Rắn)', 'Ngọ (Ngựa)', 'Mùi (Dê)', 'Thân (Khỉ)', 'Dậu (Gà)', 'Tuất (Chó)', 'Hợi (Lợn)'];
    const birthYear = birth.getFullYear();
    const canIndex = (birthYear + 6) % 10;
    const chiIndex = (birthYear + 8) % 12;
    const canChi = `${can[canIndex]} ${chi[chiIndex]}`;

    return {
      years,
      months,
      days,
      totalDays,
      totalWeeks,
      totalMonths,
      totalHours,
      totalMinutes,
      daysToNextBday,
      bornDayOfWeek,
      nextBdayDayOfWeek,
      zodiac,
      canChi,
    };
  }, [birthDateStr, targetDateStr]);

  const copyResult = () => {
    if (!ageData) return;
    const text = `Tuổi của tôi: ${ageData.years} tuổi, ${ageData.months} tháng, ${ageData.days} ngày (Tổng ${ageData.totalDays.toLocaleString('vi-VN')} ngày sống). Sinh vào ${ageData.bornDayOfWeek}, Cung ${ageData.zodiac.name}, Năm ${ageData.canChi}. Tính tại Web Calculator`;
    navigator.clipboard?.writeText(text);
    setCopied(true);
    setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 2000);
  };

  return (
    <div className="p-4 sm:p-6 lg:p-8 space-y-6">
      
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6 lg:gap-8">
        
        {/* Left Inputs (Col 1-5) */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-5 space-y-5">
          
          {/* Birth Date Picker */}
          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <label className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <CalendarIcon className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-blue-600" />
              <span>Ngày, tháng, năm sinh</span>
            </label>
            <input
              type="date"
              value={birthDateStr}
              max={todayStr}
              onChange={(e) => setBirthDateStr(e.target.value)}
              className="w-full h-12 px-4 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 text-base font-bold text-slate-900 focus:border-blue-500 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500/20 outline-none"
            />
          </div>

          {/* Calculate to date */}
          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <label className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <Clock className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-blue-600" />
              <span>Tính tuổi đến thời điểm</span>
            </label>
            <input
              type="date"
              value={targetDateStr}
              onChange={(e) => setTargetDateStr(e.target.value)}
              className="w-full h-12 px-4 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 text-base font-bold text-slate-900 focus:border-blue-500 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500/20 outline-none"
            />
          </div>

          {/* Quick preset birth years */}
          <div className="pt-2">
            <span className="text-[11px] text-slate-400 font-medium">Chọn nhanh năm sinh thế hệ:</span>
            <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5 mt-1.5">
              {[2005, 2000, 1995, 1990, 1985, 1980].map((year) => (
                <button
                  key={year}
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setBirthDateStr(`${year}-06-15`)}
                  className="px-2.5 py-1 text-xs bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 text-slate-700 rounded-lg transition-colors"
                >
                  Năm {year}
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Life philosophy quote */}
          <div className="p-3.5 bg-blue-50/60 rounded-xl border border-blue-100 text-xs text-blue-900 space-y-1">
            <span className="font-bold flex items-center gap-1">
              <Sparkles className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-blue-600" />
              Thời gian là vốn quý nhất
            </span>
            <p className="text-[11px] leading-relaxed text-blue-800">
              Mỗi ngày trôi qua là một trang nhật ký mới. Hãy trân trọng từng khoảnh khắc ý nghĩa bên những người bạn thương yêu!
            </p>
          </div>

        </div>

        {/* Right Results Card (Col 6-12) */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-7 flex flex-col justify-between bg-slate-50 rounded-2xl p-5 sm:p-6 border border-slate-200 space-y-5">
          
          {ageData ? (
            <>
              {/* Primary Age Result - Highlight color: #10B981 */}
              <div>
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                  <span className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500">
                    Độ Tuổi Chính Xác Của Bạn
                  </span>
                  <button
                    onClick={copyResult}
                    className="flex items-center gap-1 text-xs text-blue-600 hover:text-blue-800 font-medium"
                  >
                    {copied ? <Check className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[#10B981]" /> : <Copy className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />}
                    <span>{copied ? 'Đã sao chép' : 'Sao chép'}</span>
                  </button>
                </div>

                {/* Big Age Stat */}
                <div className="flex flex-wrap items-baseline gap-2 mt-2">
                  <span className="text-4xl sm:text-5xl font-black text-slate-900 font-mono tracking-tight">
                    {ageData.years}
                  </span>
                  <span className="text-lg font-bold text-slate-600">tuổi</span>
                  <span className="text-2xl font-bold text-blue-600 font-mono">
                    {ageData.months}
                  </span>
                  <span className="text-sm font-semibold text-slate-600">tháng</span>
                  <span className="text-2xl font-bold text-[#10B981] font-mono">
                    {ageData.days}
                  </span>
                  <span className="text-sm font-semibold text-slate-600">ngày</span>
                </div>

                <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 mt-1">
                  Bạn sinh vào <strong>{ageData.bornDayOfWeek}</strong>
                </p>
              </div>

              {/* Next Birthday Countdown */}
              <div className="p-3.5 bg-white rounded-xl border border-slate-200 shadow-xs flex items-center justify-between">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                  <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-pink-50 text-pink-600 flex items-center justify-center shrink-0">
                    <Cake className="w-5 h-5" />
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <span className="text-[11px] font-medium text-slate-500 block">Sinh nhật kế tiếp</span>
                    <span className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-900">
                      Còn {ageData.daysToNextBday} ngày nữa ({ageData.nextBdayDayOfWeek})
                    </span>
                  </div>
                </div>
                <span className="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-bold bg-pink-100 text-pink-700">
                  {ageData.daysToNextBday === 0 ? 'Hôm nay! 🎂' : `${ageData.daysToNextBday} ngày`}
                </span>
              </div>

              {/* Lived Metrics Grid */}
              <div>
                <span className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500 block mb-2">
                  Tổng Thời Gian Đã Trải Qua
                </span>
                <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-2 text-center">
                  <div className="p-2.5 bg-white rounded-xl border border-slate-200 shadow-xs">
                    <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 uppercase font-semibold block">Tổng số ngày</span>
                    <span className="text-base font-bold text-blue-600 font-mono">
                      {ageData.totalDays.toLocaleString('vi-VN')}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="p-2.5 bg-white rounded-xl border border-slate-200 shadow-xs">
                    <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 uppercase font-semibold block">Tổng số tuần</span>
                    <span className="text-base font-bold text-slate-800 font-mono">
                      {ageData.totalWeeks.toLocaleString('vi-VN')}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="p-2.5 bg-white rounded-xl border border-slate-200 shadow-xs">
                    <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 uppercase font-semibold block">Tổng số tháng</span>
                    <span className="text-base font-bold text-slate-800 font-mono">
                      {ageData.totalMonths.toLocaleString('vi-VN')}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="p-2.5 bg-white rounded-xl border border-slate-200 shadow-xs col-span-1 sm:col-span-1">
                    <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 uppercase font-semibold block">Tổng số giờ</span>
                    <span className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-800 font-mono">
                      {ageData.totalHours.toLocaleString('vi-VN')}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="p-2.5 bg-white rounded-xl border border-slate-200 shadow-xs col-span-1 sm:col-span-2">
                    <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 uppercase font-semibold block">Tổng số phút</span>
                    <span className="text-sm font-bold text-emerald-600 font-mono">
                      {ageData.totalMinutes.toLocaleString('vi-VN')}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Zodiac & Can Chi Details */}
              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-2.5 pt-2 border-t border-slate-200">
                <div className="p-3 bg-white rounded-xl border border-slate-200 shadow-xs">
                  <span className="text-[11px] font-medium text-slate-500 block">Cung Hoàng Đạo</span>
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 mt-0.5">
                    <span className="text-base">{ageData.zodiac.symbol}</span>
                    <span className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-900">{ageData.zodiac.name}</span>
                  </div>
                  <p className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 mt-1 line-clamp-1">{ageData.zodiac.trait}</p>
                </div>

                <div className="p-3 bg-white rounded-xl border border-slate-200 shadow-xs">
                  <span className="text-[11px] font-medium text-slate-500 block">Năm Âm Lịch (Can Chi)</span>
                  <div className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-900 mt-0.5">
                    Năm {ageData.canChi}
                  </div>
                  <p className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 mt-1">Con giáp tính theo chu kỳ Can Chi</p>
                </div>
              </div>
            </>
          ) : (
            <div className="h-64 flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-rose-500 text-sm font-medium">
              Vui lòng chọn ngày kết thúc lớn hơn hoặc bằng ngày sinh.
            </div>
          )}

        </div>

      </div>
    </div>
  );
};


================================================================================
FILE: /src/components/tools/AiTool.tsx
