import React, { useState, useRef } from 'react';
import { X, FileDown, Printer, Check, Loader2, Calendar, FileSpreadsheet, ShieldAlert, Sparkles, CheckCircle2, Share2 } from 'lucide-react';
import { useCurrency } from '../../context/CurrencyContext';
import { useLanguage } from '../../context/LanguageContext';
import { exportElementPagesToPdf, PdfExportResult } from '../../utils/pdfExportHelper';

export interface MonthlyScheduleItem {
  month: number;
  year: number;
  payment: number;
  principal: number;
  interest: number;
  balance: number;
}

export interface YearlyScheduleItem {
  year: number;
  principal: number;
  interest: number;
  balance: number;
  extra: number;
}

export interface AmortizationPdfModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  loanAmount: number;
  interestRate: number;
  loanTermYears: number;
  extraMonthlyPayment: number;
  calculations: {
    baseMonthlyPayment: number;
    actualMonthlyPayment: number;
    totalInterestPaid: number;
    totalPaid: number;
    actualMonthsTaken: number;
    interestSaved: number;
    monthsSaved: number;
    monthlySchedule: MonthlyScheduleItem[];
    yearlySchedule: YearlyScheduleItem[];
  };
}

export const AmortizationPdfModal: React.FC<AmortizationPdfModalProps> = ({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  loanAmount,
  interestRate,
  loanTermYears,
  extraMonthlyPayment,
  calculations
}) => {
  const { currencyInfo, formatMoney } = useCurrency();
  const { language } = useLanguage();
  const isVi = language === 'vi';

  // Export options: 'comprehensive' (both yearly + monthly), 'yearly' (summary only), 'monthly' (monthly only)
  const [exportScope, setExportScope] = useState<'comprehensive' | 'yearly' | 'monthly'>('comprehensive');
  const [isExporting, setIsExporting] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [exportProgress, setExportProgress] = useState<string>('');
  const [isDone, setIsDone] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [exportResult, setExportResult] = useState<PdfExportResult | null>(null);

  const printContainerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  // Split monthly schedule into pages (approx 32 rows per page for perfect A4 fit)
  const ROWS_PER_MONTHLY_PAGE = 32;
  const monthlyPages: MonthlyScheduleItem[][] = [];
  if (exportScope === 'comprehensive' || exportScope === 'monthly') {
    for (let i = 0; i < calculations.monthlySchedule.length; i += ROWS_PER_MONTHLY_PAGE) {
      monthlyPages.push(calculations.monthlySchedule.slice(i, i + ROWS_PER_MONTHLY_PAGE));
    }
  }

  // Calculate total pages for display and PDF metadata
  const totalPagesCount = (exportScope === 'monthly' ? 0 : 1) + monthlyPages.length;

  const handleExportPDF = async () => {
    if (isExporting || !printContainerRef.current) return;
    try {
      setIsExporting(true);
      setIsDone(false);
      setExportProgress(isVi ? 'Đang chuẩn bị trang in...' : 'Preparing document pages...');

      const now = new Date();
      const dateStr = now.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
      const safeAmount = Math.round(loanAmount).toString();
      const fileName = isVi
        ? `Lich_Trinh_Tra_No_${safeAmount}_${currencyInfo.code}_${dateStr}.pdf`
        : `Amortization_Schedule_${safeAmount}_${currencyInfo.code}_${dateStr}.pdf`;

      const result = await exportElementPagesToPdf(printContainerRef.current, {
        fileName,
        pageSelector: '.pdf-report-page',
        onProgress: (text) => setExportProgress(text),
      });

      setExportResult(result);
      setIsDone(true);
      setExportProgress(isVi ? 'Xuất PDF thành công!' : 'PDF export complete!');
      setTimeout(() => {
        setIsDone(false);
        setExportProgress('');
      }, 4000);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Lỗi khi xuất file PDF:', error);
      alert(isVi ? 'Có lỗi xảy ra khi tạo PDF. Bạn có thể thử chức năng "In trực tiếp".' : 'Error generating PDF. You can try "Print directly".');
    } finally {
      setIsExporting(false);
    }
  };

  const handlePrint = () => {
    window.print();
  };

  const currentDateFormatted = new Date().toLocaleDateString(isVi ? 'vi-VN' : 'en-US', {
    year: 'numeric',
    month: 'long',
    day: 'numeric',
  });

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-3 sm:p-4 bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-xs animate-in fade-in duration-200 print:hidden">
      <div className="bg-slate-900 rounded-2xl shadow-2xl border border-slate-800 w-full max-w-2xl max-h-[92vh] flex flex-col overflow-hidden text-slate-200">
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="px-5 py-4 border-b border-slate-800 flex items-center justify-between bg-slate-950/80">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-cyan-600/20 border border-cyan-500/40 text-cyan-400 flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs">
              <FileDown className="w-5 h-5" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <h3 className="text-base sm:text-lg font-bold text-white flex items-center gap-2">
                <span>{isVi ? 'Xuất File PDF Lịch Trình Trả Nợ' : 'Export Amortization Schedule to PDF'}</span>
              </h3>
              <p className="text-xs text-slate-400">
                {isVi 
                  ? 'Bao gồm đầy đủ thông số khoản vay, bảng tổng hợp theo năm và lịch phân bổ theo tháng' 
                  : 'Includes complete loan parameters, yearly summary, and monthly breakdown'}
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
          <button
            onClick={onClose}
            disabled={isExporting}
            className="p-2 text-slate-400 hover:text-white hover:bg-slate-800 rounded-lg transition-colors cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-50"
          >
            <X className="w-5 h-5" />
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Modal Body */}
        <div className="p-5 overflow-y-auto space-y-5 text-sm">
          {/* Quick Loan Overview Card */}
          <div className="p-4 bg-slate-950/60 rounded-xl border border-slate-800 space-y-3">
            <div className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-wider flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <Calendar className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-cyan-400" />
              <span>{isVi ? 'Tóm tắt thông số sẽ xuất trong báo cáo' : 'Summary of exported loan parameters'}</span>
            </div>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-4 gap-3 text-xs">
              <div className="bg-slate-900 p-2.5 rounded-lg border border-slate-800">
                <span className="text-slate-400 block">{isVi ? 'Số tiền vay' : 'Loan Amount'}</span>
                <span className="text-sm font-bold text-white tabular-nums">{formatMoney(loanAmount)}</span>
              </div>
              <div className="bg-slate-900 p-2.5 rounded-lg border border-slate-800">
                <span className="text-slate-400 block">{isVi ? 'Lãi suất' : 'Interest Rate'}</span>
                <span className="text-sm font-bold text-cyan-400 tabular-nums">{interestRate}% / {isVi ? 'năm' : 'yr'}</span>
              </div>
              <div className="bg-slate-900 p-2.5 rounded-lg border border-slate-800">
                <span className="text-slate-400 block">{isVi ? 'Thời hạn vay' : 'Loan Term'}</span>
                <span className="text-sm font-bold text-white tabular-nums">{loanTermYears} {isVi ? 'năm' : 'years'}</span>
              </div>
              <div className="bg-slate-900 p-2.5 rounded-lg border border-slate-800">
                <span className="text-slate-400 block">{isVi ? 'Trả mỗi tháng' : 'Monthly Payment'}</span>
                <span className="text-sm font-bold text-emerald-400 tabular-nums">{formatMoney(calculations.actualMonthlyPayment)}</span>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-2.5 pt-1 text-xs">
              <div className="flex justify-between p-2 rounded bg-slate-900/50">
                <span className="text-slate-400">{isVi ? 'Tổng tiền lãi:' : 'Total Interest:'}</span>
                <span className="font-bold text-rose-400 tabular-nums">{formatMoney(calculations.totalInterestPaid)}</span>
              </div>
              <div className="flex justify-between p-2 rounded bg-slate-900/50">
                <span className="text-slate-400">{isVi ? 'Tổng gốc & lãi:' : 'Total Repayment:'}</span>
                <span className="font-bold text-white tabular-nums">{formatMoney(calculations.totalPaid)}</span>
              </div>
              <div className="flex justify-between p-2 rounded bg-slate-900/50 col-span-2 sm:col-span-1">
                <span className="text-slate-400">{isVi ? 'Kỳ trả nợ:' : 'Total Months:'}</span>
                <span className="font-bold text-cyan-400 tabular-nums">{calculations.actualMonthsTaken} {isVi ? 'tháng' : 'months'}</span>
              </div>
            </div>

            {extraMonthlyPayment > 0 && calculations.interestSaved > 0 && (
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 p-2.5 rounded-lg bg-emerald-950/40 border border-emerald-500/30 text-xs text-emerald-300">
                <Sparkles className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0 text-emerald-400" />
                <span>
                  {isVi 
                    ? `Trả thêm ${formatMoney(extraMonthlyPayment)}/tháng giúp tiết kiệm ${formatMoney(calculations.interestSaved)} tiền lãi và tất toán sớm ${calculations.monthsSaved} tháng.`
                    : `Paying an extra ${formatMoney(extraMonthlyPayment)}/mo saves ${formatMoney(calculations.interestSaved)} in interest and pays off ${calculations.monthsSaved} months earlier.`}
                </span>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>

          {/* Scope Selector */}
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <label className="block text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-300">
              {isVi ? 'Chọn phạm vi nội dung xuất file PDF:' : 'Select PDF Export Scope:'}
            </label>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-2.5">
              {/* Option 1: Comprehensive (Default - Exactly what user asked) */}
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setExportScope('comprehensive')}
                className={`p-3 rounded-xl border text-left transition-all cursor-pointer flex flex-col justify-between ${
                  exportScope === 'comprehensive'
                    ? 'bg-cyan-950/50 border-cyan-500 text-white shadow-xs'
                    : 'bg-slate-950/50 border-slate-800 text-slate-400 hover:border-slate-700'
                }`}
              >
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-1">
                  <span className="font-bold text-xs text-cyan-300 flex items-center gap-1.5">
                    <FileSpreadsheet className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                    <span>{isVi ? 'Toàn diện (Khuyên dùng)' : 'Comprehensive'}</span>
                  </span>
                  {exportScope === 'comprehensive' && <Check className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-cyan-400" />}
                </div>
                <p className="text-[11px] leading-relaxed text-slate-400">
                  {isVi 
                    ? 'Thông số + Lịch trình năm + Toàn bộ các tháng' 
                    : 'Loan params + Yearly schedule + All months'}
                </p>
                <span className="text-[10px] text-cyan-400/80 mt-2 font-mono">
                  ~{1 + Math.ceil(calculations.monthlySchedule.length / ROWS_PER_MONTHLY_PAGE)} {isVi ? 'trang A4' : 'A4 pages'}
                </span>
              </button>

              {/* Option 2: Yearly summary */}
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setExportScope('yearly')}
                className={`p-3 rounded-xl border text-left transition-all cursor-pointer flex flex-col justify-between ${
                  exportScope === 'yearly'
                    ? 'bg-cyan-950/50 border-cyan-500 text-white shadow-xs'
                    : 'bg-slate-950/50 border-slate-800 text-slate-400 hover:border-slate-700'
                }`}
              >
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-1">
                  <span className="font-bold text-xs text-slate-200 flex items-center gap-1.5">
                    <Calendar className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                    <span>{isVi ? 'Tóm tắt theo năm' : 'Yearly Summary'}</span>
                  </span>
                  {exportScope === 'yearly' && <Check className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-cyan-400" />}
                </div>
                <p className="text-[11px] leading-relaxed text-slate-400">
                  {isVi 
                    ? 'Thông số khoản vay + Bảng tổng hợp các năm' 
                    : 'Loan params + Yearly summary table'}
                </p>
                <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 mt-2 font-mono">
                  1 {isVi ? 'trang A4 gọn' : 'compact A4 page'}
                </span>
              </button>

              {/* Option 3: Monthly schedule */}
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setExportScope('monthly')}
                className={`p-3 rounded-xl border text-left transition-all cursor-pointer flex flex-col justify-between ${
                  exportScope === 'monthly'
                    ? 'bg-cyan-950/50 border-cyan-500 text-white shadow-xs'
                    : 'bg-slate-950/50 border-slate-800 text-slate-400 hover:border-slate-700'
                }`}
              >
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-1">
                  <span className="font-bold text-xs text-slate-200 flex items-center gap-1.5">
                    <Calendar className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                    <span>{isVi ? 'Chi tiết theo tháng' : 'Monthly Only'}</span>
                  </span>
                  {exportScope === 'monthly' && <Check className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-cyan-400" />}
                </div>
                <p className="text-[11px] leading-relaxed text-slate-400">
                  {isVi 
                    ? 'Thông số khoản vay + Lịch trình từng tháng' 
                    : 'Loan params + Detailed monthly table'}
                </p>
                <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 mt-2 font-mono">
                  ~{Math.ceil(calculations.monthlySchedule.length / ROWS_PER_MONTHLY_PAGE)} {isVi ? 'trang A4' : 'A4 pages'}
                </span>
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Progress / Status indicator */}
          {exportProgress && (
            <div className="p-3 bg-cyan-950/60 border border-cyan-500/40 rounded-xl flex items-center gap-2.5 text-xs text-cyan-300">
              {isExporting ? (
                <Loader2 className="w-4 h-4 animate-spin text-cyan-400 shrink-0" />
              ) : isDone ? (
                <Check className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-400 shrink-0" />
              ) : null}
              <span>{exportProgress}</span>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Khi file PDF đã sẵn sàng, hiển thị nút tải trực tiếp và share (hữu ích tối đa trên điện thoại) */}
          {exportResult && (
            <div className="p-3 bg-emerald-950/60 border border-emerald-500/50 rounded-xl flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-center justify-between gap-3 text-xs shadow-xs">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-emerald-300 min-w-0">
                <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-400 shrink-0" />
                <span className="font-semibold shrink-0">{isVi ? 'File PDF đã sẵn sàng:' : 'PDF ready:'}</span>
                <span className="font-mono text-[11px] truncate max-w-[170px] text-slate-300">{exportResult.fileName}</span>
              </div>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 w-full sm:w-auto shrink-0">
                <a
                  href={exportResult.blobUrl}
                  download={exportResult.fileName}
                  target="_blank"
                  rel="noopener noreferrer"
                  className="flex-1 sm:flex-none px-3.5 py-1.5 bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-500 text-white font-bold rounded-lg text-center shadow-xs flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 transition-colors"
                >
                  <FileDown className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  <span>{isVi ? 'Mở / Tải file' : 'Open / Save'}</span>
                </a>
                {typeof navigator !== 'undefined' && !!navigator.share && (
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={async () => {
                      try {
                        const file = new File([exportResult.blob], exportResult.fileName, { type: 'application/pdf' });
                        if (navigator.canShare && navigator.canShare({ files: [file] })) {
                          await navigator.share({ files: [file], title: exportResult.fileName });
                        } else {
                          window.open(exportResult.blobUrl, '_blank');
                        }
                      } catch (err: any) {
                        if (err.name !== 'AbortError') {
                          window.open(exportResult.blobUrl, '_blank');
                        }
                      }
                    }}
                    className="flex-1 sm:flex-none px-3 py-1.5 bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-200 font-bold rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 border border-slate-700 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                  >
                    <Share2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                    <span>{isVi ? 'Lưu vào Tệp' : 'Save to Files'}</span>
                  </button>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* Modal Footer */}
        <div className="px-5 py-4 border-t border-slate-800 bg-slate-950/80 flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-center justify-between gap-3">
          <div className="text-xs text-slate-400 flex items-center gap-1.5">
            <ShieldAlert className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-500 shrink-0" />
            <span>{isVi ? 'Định dạng tài liệu A4 chuẩn ngân hàng, nền trắng sắc nét' : 'Bank-standard A4 format, high-contrast white layout'}</span>
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 w-full sm:w-auto">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={handlePrint}
              disabled={isExporting}
              className="flex-1 sm:flex-none px-3.5 py-2 bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-200 border border-slate-700 text-xs font-semibold rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 transition-colors cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-50"
              title={isVi ? 'Mở hộp thoại In hoặc Lưu PDF của trình duyệt' : 'Open browser print or Save as PDF'}
            >
              <Printer className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              <span>{isVi ? 'In / Lưu PDF' : 'Print / Save'}</span>
            </button>

            <button
              type="button"
              id="confirm-download-pdf-btn"
              onClick={handleExportPDF}
              disabled={isExporting}
              className="flex-1 sm:flex-none px-5 py-2 bg-cyan-600 hover:bg-cyan-500 text-white text-xs font-bold rounded-xl shadow-xs flex items-center justify-center gap-2 transition-all cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-50"
            >
              {isExporting ? (
                <>
                  <Loader2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5 animate-spin" />
                  <span>{isVi ? 'Đang tạo PDF...' : 'Generating PDF...'}</span>
                </>
              ) : isDone ? (
                <>
                  <Check className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-300" />
                  <span>{isVi ? 'Đã tải xong!' : 'Downloaded!'}</span>
                </>
              ) : (
                <>
                  <FileDown className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />

            </button>
          </div>

      </div>

      {/* ========================================================================= */}

      {/* ========================================================================= */}
      <div
        ref={printContainerRef}
        id="amortization-pdf-printable-source"
        aria-hidden="true"
        style={{
          position: 'fixed',
          left: '-9999px',
          top: 0,

          height: 'auto',
          overflow: 'hidden',
          pointerEvents: 'none',
          backgroundColor: '#ffffff',
          color: '#0f172a',
          zIndex: -9999,
        }}
      >
        {/* ===================================================================== */}
        {/* PAGE 1: HEADER + LOAN PARAMETERS + YEARLY SCHEDULE                    */}
        {/* ===================================================================== */}
        {exportScope !== 'monthly' && (
          <div
            className="pdf-report-page bg-white text-slate-900"
            style={{

              minHeight: '1123px',
              height: '1123px',

              boxSizing: 'border-box',
              display: 'flex',
              flexDirection: 'column',
              justifyContent: 'space-between',

              {/* Report Header Bar */}

                    <div style={{ fontSize: '10px', fontWeight: 800, textTransform: 'uppercase', letterSpacing: '1px', color: '#0284c7' }}>
                      WEB CALCULATOR FINANCIAL TOOLS • BÁO CÁO TÀI CHÍNH
                    </div>
                    <h1 style={{ fontSize: '20px', fontWeight: 900, color: '#0f172a', margin: '4px 0 2px 0', letterSpacing: '-0.5px' }}>

                        <td style={{ padding: '5px 8px', textAlign: 'right', color: '#0284c7', fontWeight: 700 }}>{formatMoney(row.principal + row.interest)}</td>
                        <td style={{ padding: '5px 8px', textAlign: 'right', color: '#0f172a', fontWeight: 700 }}>{formatMoney(row.balance)}</td>
                      </tr>
                    ))}
                    {/* Totals Row */}
                    <tr style={{ background: '#e2e8f0', borderTop: '2px solid #94a3b8', fontWeight: 800 }}>
                      <td style={{ padding: '6px 8px', color: '#0f172a' }}>TỔNG CỘNG</td>
                      <td style={{ padding: '6px 8px', textAlign: 'right', color: '#059669' }}>{formatMoney(loanAmount)}</td>
                      <td style={{ padding: '6px 8px', textAlign: 'right', color: '#e11d48' }}>{formatMoney(calculations.totalInterestPaid)}</td>
                      <td style={{ padding: '6px 8px', textAlign: 'right', color: '#0284c7' }}>{formatMoney(calculations.totalPaid)}</td>
                      <td style={{ padding: '6px 8px', textAlign: 'right', color: '#0f172a' }}>0 {currencyInfo.symbol}</td>
                    </tr>
                  </tbody>
                </table>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Page 1 Footer */}
            <div style={{ borderTop: '1px solid #e2e8f0', paddingTop: '8px', display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', fontSize: '9px', color: '#94a3b8' }}>
              <div>Web Calculator • Công cụ tính toán tài chính &amp; Lịch trình phân bổ nợ vay</div>

        {/* ===================================================================== */}

        {/* ===================================================================== */}
        {(exportScope === 'comprehensive' || exportScope === 'monthly') && (
          monthlyPages.map((pageRows, pageIdx) => {
            const pageNumber = (exportScope === 'monthly' ? 1 : 2) + pageIdx;
            const startMonth = pageRows[0]?.month || 1;
            const endMonth = pageRows[pageRows.length - 1]?.month || pageRows.length;

                      </h2>

                      <div>Khoản vay: <strong style={{ color: '#0f172a' }}>{formatMoney(loanAmount)}</strong> ({interestRate}%)</div>
                      <div>Trả hàng tháng: <strong style={{ color: '#059669' }}>{formatMoney(calculations.actualMonthlyPayment)}</strong></div>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  {/* Monthly Table */}
                  <table style={{ width: '100%', borderCollapse: 'collapse', fontSize: '9.5px' }}>
                    <thead>
                      <tr style={{ background: '#f1f5f9', borderTop: '1px solid #cbd5e1', borderBottom: '1px solid #cbd5e1' }}>

                        <th style={{ padding: '5px 6px', textAlign: 'right', fontWeight: 700, color: '#0f172a' }}>DƯ NỢ CÒN LẠI</th>
                      </tr>
                    </thead>
                    <tbody>
                      {pageRows.map((row, rIdx) => (

FILE: /src/components/tools/AreaCalculator.tsx

import React, { useState, useMemo } from 'react';
import { Square, RotateCcw } from 'lucide-react';
import { AreaVisualizer } from './geometry/AreaVisualizer';

type Shape = 'rectangle' | 'circle' | 'triangle' | 'trapezoid' | 'ellipse';

export const AreaCalculator: React.FC = () => {
  const [shape, setShape] = useState<Shape>('rectangle');
  const [dim1, setDim1] = useState<number>(10);
  const [dim2, setDim2] = useState<number>(5);
  const [dim3, setDim3] = useState<number>(8); // for trapezoid height or base2

  const calculations = useMemo(() => {
    let area = 0;
    let formula = '';

    if (shape === 'rectangle') {
      area = dim1 * dim2;
      formula = `Dài × Rộng = ${dim1} × ${dim2}`;
    } else if (shape === 'circle') {
      area = Math.PI * dim1 * dim1;
      formula = `π × r² = 3.14159 × ${dim1}²`;
    } else if (shape === 'triangle') {
      area = 0.5 * dim1 * dim2;
      formula = `(Đáy × Chiều cao) / 2 = (${dim1} × ${dim2}) / 2`;
    } else if (shape === 'trapezoid') {
      area = 0.5 * (dim1 + dim2) * dim3;
      formula = `((Đáy lớn + Đáy bé) × Chiều cao) / 2 = ((${dim1} + ${dim2}) × ${dim3}) / 2`;
    } else if (shape === 'ellipse') {
      area = Math.PI * dim1 * dim2;
      formula = `π × a × b = 3.14159 × ${dim1} × ${dim2}`;
    }

    return {
      area: Number(area.toFixed(4)),
      formula
    };
  }, [shape, dim1, dim2, dim3]);

  return (
    <div className="w-full max-w-4xl mx-auto space-y-6">
      <div className="p-4 sm:p-6 rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-r from-blue-900/40 via-slate-800 to-slate-900 border border-blue-500/30 flex items-center justify-between">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <div className="p-3 bg-blue-600/20 text-blue-400 rounded-xl border border-blue-500/30">
            <Square className="w-6 h-6" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <h1 className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-bold text-white tracking-tight">Area Calculator – Tính Diện Tích Hình Học</h1>
            <p className="text-xs sm:text-sm text-slate-400">Tính diện tích hình chữ nhật, hình tròn, tam giác, hình thang và elip</p>
          </div>
        </div>
        <button
          id="area-reset-btn"
          onClick={() => { setShape('rectangle'); setDim1(10); setDim2(5); setDim3(8); }}
          className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs text-slate-300 hover:text-white bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 border border-slate-700 rounded-lg transition-colors cursor-pointer"
        >
          <RotateCcw className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
          <span>Đặt lại</span>
        </button>
      </div>

      <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
        {[
          { id: 'rectangle', label: 'Hình chữ nhật' },
          { id: 'circle', label: 'Hình tròn' },
          { id: 'triangle', label: 'Tam giác' },
          { id: 'trapezoid', label: 'Hình thang' },
          { id: 'ellipse', label: 'Hình Elip' },
        ].map((s) => (
          <button
            key={s.id}
            id={`area-shape-${s.id}`}
            onClick={() => setShape(s.id as Shape)}
            className={`px-3.5 py-2 text-xs rounded-xl border font-medium transition-all ${
              shape === s.id
                ? 'bg-blue-600 text-white border-blue-500 font-bold'
                : 'bg-slate-800 text-slate-300 border-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-700'
            }`}
          >
            {s.label}
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6">
        <div className="lg:col-span-5 space-y-4 bg-slate-900/80 p-5 rounded-2xl border border-slate-800">
          <h2 className="text-base font-semibold text-white">Kích thước hình</h2>

          <div>
            <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-300 mb-1">
              {shape === 'rectangle' ? 'Chiều dài' : shape === 'circle' ? 'Bán kính r' : shape === 'triangle' ? 'Độ dài đáy' : shape === 'trapezoid' ? 'Đáy lớn a' : 'Bán trục lớn a'}
            </label>
            <input
              id="area-dim1"
              type="number"
              value={dim1}
              onChange={(e) => setDim1(Number(e.target.value))}
              className="w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-white font-sans focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 outline-none"
            />
          </div>

          {shape !== 'circle' && (
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-300 mb-1">
                {shape === 'rectangle' ? 'Chiều rộng' : shape === 'triangle' ? 'Chiều cao h' : shape === 'trapezoid' ? 'Đáy bé b' : 'Bán trục bé b'}
              </label>
              <input
                id="area-dim2"
                type="number"
                value={dim2}
                onChange={(e) => setDim2(Number(e.target.value))}
                className="w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-white font-sans focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 outline-none"
              />
            </div>
          )}

          {shape === 'trapezoid' && (
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-300 mb-1">Chiều cao h</label>
              <input
                id="area-dim3"
                type="number"
                value={dim3}
                onChange={(e) => setDim3(Number(e.target.value))}
                className="w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-white font-sans focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 outline-none"
              />
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        <div className="lg:col-span-7 space-y-4">
          <div className="p-6 rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-b from-blue-950/40 to-slate-900 border border-blue-500/40 text-center space-y-2">
            <span className="text-xs uppercase tracking-wider text-blue-300 font-semibold">DIỆN TÍCH TÍNH ĐƯỢC</span>
            <div className="text-4xl sm:text-5xl font-extrabold text-blue-400 font-sans tabular-nums">
              {calculations.area.toLocaleString()}
            </div>
            <p className="text-xs text-slate-400 font-mono mt-2">
              Công thức: {calculations.formula}
            </p>
          </div>

          <AreaVisualizer
            shape={shape}
            dim1={dim1}
            dim2={dim2}
            dim3={dim3}
            area={calculations.area}
            formula={calculations.formula}
          />
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

import React, { useState, useMemo } from 'react';
import {
  Shield,
  RotateCcw,
  User,
  AlertCircle,
  CheckCircle2
} from 'lucide-react';

export const ArmyBodyFatCalculator: React.FC = () => {
  const [gender, setGender] = useState<'male' | 'female'>('male');
  const [age, setAge] = useState<number>(24);
  const [heightCm, setHeightCm] = useState<number>(178);
  const [neckCm, setNeckCm] = useState<number>(38);
  const [waistCm, setWaistCm] = useState<number>(84);
  const [hipCm, setHipCm] = useState<number>(96); // only for females

  const calculations = useMemo(() => {
    // Convert cm to inches for standard DoD/Army formula:
    // Men: %BF = 86.010 * log10(waist - neck) - 70.041 * log10(height) + 36.76
    // Women: %BF = 163.205 * log10(waist + hip - neck) - 97.684 * log10(height) - 78.387
    const heightIn = heightCm / 2.54;
    const neckIn = neckCm / 2.54;
    const waistIn = waistCm / 2.54;
    const hipIn = hipCm / 2.54;

    let bodyFat = 0;
    if (gender === 'male') {
      const diff = waistIn - neckIn;
      if (diff > 0 && heightIn > 0) {
        bodyFat = 86.010 * Math.log10(diff) - 70.041 * Math.log10(heightIn) + 36.76;
      }
    } else {
      const sum = waistIn + hipIn - neckIn;
      if (sum > 0 && heightIn > 0) {
        bodyFat = 163.205 * Math.log10(sum) - 97.684 * Math.log10(heightIn) - 78.387;
      }
    }

    bodyFat = Math.max(2, Math.min(60, bodyFat));

    // Army Max Allowable BF Standards by age:
    // 17-20: M: 20%, F: 30%
    // 21-27: M: 22%, F: 32%
    // 28-39: M: 24%, F: 34%
    // 40+:   M: 26%, F: 36%
    let maxAllowed = 22;
    if (gender === 'male') {
      if (age <= 20) maxAllowed = 20;
      else if (age <= 27) maxAllowed = 22;
      else if (age <= 39) maxAllowed = 24;
      else maxAllowed = 26;
    } else {
      if (age <= 20) maxAllowed = 30;
      else if (age <= 27) maxAllowed = 32;
      else if (age <= 39) maxAllowed = 34;
      else maxAllowed = 36;
    }

    const passesStandard = bodyFat <= maxAllowed;

    return {
      bodyFat: Math.round(bodyFat * 10) / 10,
      maxAllowed,
      passesStandard
    };
  }, [gender, age, heightCm, neckCm, waistCm, hipCm]);

  return (
    <div className="w-full max-w-5xl mx-auto space-y-6">
      <div className="p-4 sm:p-6 rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-r from-emerald-950/50 via-slate-800 to-slate-900 border border-emerald-500/30 flex items-center justify-between">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <div className="p-3 bg-emerald-600/20 text-emerald-400 rounded-xl border border-emerald-500/30">
            <Shield className="w-6 h-6" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <h1 className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-bold text-white tracking-tight">Army Body Fat Calculator – Tiêu Chuẩn Quân Đội Hoa Kỳ</h1>
            <p className="text-xs sm:text-sm text-slate-400">Đo tỷ lệ phần trăm mỡ cơ thể theo chuẩn Army Regulation 600-9 (Băng đo chu vi)</p>
          </div>
        </div>
        <button
          id="army-fat-reset-btn"
          onClick={() => { setGender('male'); setAge(24); setHeightCm(178); setNeckCm(38); setWaistCm(84); setHipCm(96); }}
          className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs text-slate-300 hover:text-white bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 border border-slate-700 rounded-lg transition-colors cursor-pointer"
        >
          <RotateCcw className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
          <span>Đặt lại</span>
        </button>
      </div>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6">
        <div className="lg:col-span-5 space-y-4 bg-slate-900/80 p-5 rounded-2xl border border-slate-800">
          <h2 className="text-base font-semibold text-white flex items-center gap-2">
            <User className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-400" />
            Số đo chu vi cơ thể (cm)
          </h2>

          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
            <button
              type="button"
              id="army-gender-male"
              onClick={() => setGender('male')}
              className={`py-2 px-3 text-xs rounded-xl border font-medium transition-all ${
                gender === 'male' ? 'bg-blue-600 text-white border-blue-500' : 'bg-slate-800 text-slate-300 border-slate-700'
              }`}
            >
              Nam quân nhân
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              id="army-gender-female"
              onClick={() => setGender('female')}
              className={`py-2 px-3 text-xs rounded-xl border font-medium transition-all ${
                gender === 'female' ? 'bg-blue-600 text-white border-blue-500' : 'bg-slate-800 text-slate-300 border-slate-700'
              }`}
            >
              Nữ quân nhân
            </button>
          </div>

          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-300 mb-1">Tuổi</label>
              <input
                id="army-age"
                type="number"
                value={age}
                onChange={(e) => setAge(Number(e.target.value))}
                className="w-full px-3 py-2 bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-white font-sans focus:ring-2 focus:ring-emerald-500 outline-none"
              />
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-300 mb-1">Chiều cao (cm)</label>
              <input
                id="army-height"
                type="number"
                value={heightCm}
                onChange={(e) => setHeightCm(Number(e.target.value))}
                className="w-full px-3 py-2 bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-white font-sans focus:ring-2 focus:ring-emerald-500 outline-none"
              />
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-300 mb-1">Vòng cổ (cm)</label>
              <input
                id="army-neck"
                type="number"
                value={neckCm}
                onChange={(e) => setNeckCm(Number(e.target.value))}
                className="w-full px-3 py-2 bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-white font-sans focus:ring-2 focus:ring-emerald-500 outline-none"
              />
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-300 mb-1">Vòng bụng/eo (cm)</label>
              <input
                id="army-waist"
                type="number"
                value={waistCm}
                onChange={(e) => setWaistCm(Number(e.target.value))}
                className="w-full px-3 py-2 bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-white font-sans focus:ring-2 focus:ring-emerald-500 outline-none"
              />
            </div>
          </div>

          {gender === 'female' && (
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-300 mb-1">Vòng mông (Hip - cm)</label>
              <input
                id="army-hip"
                type="number"
                value={hipCm}
                onChange={(e) => setHipCm(Number(e.target.value))}
                className="w-full px-3 py-2 bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-white font-sans focus:ring-2 focus:ring-emerald-500 outline-none"
              />
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        <div className="lg:col-span-7 space-y-4">
          <div className="p-6 rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-b from-emerald-950/40 to-slate-900 border border-emerald-500/40 text-center space-y-2">
            <span className="text-xs uppercase tracking-wider text-emerald-300 font-semibold">Tỷ lệ mỡ cơ thể ước tính (Body Fat)</span>
            <div className="text-4xl sm:text-5xl font-extrabold text-emerald-400 font-sans tabular-nums">
              {calculations.bodyFat}%
            </div>
            <p className="text-xs text-slate-400">
              Giới hạn tối đa cho phép theo độ tuổi ({age} tuổi): <span className="text-white font-semibold font-sans">{calculations.maxAllowed}%</span>
            </p>
          </div>

          <div className={`p-4 rounded-xl border flex items-center gap-3 ${
            calculations.passesStandard
              ? 'bg-emerald-950/30 border-emerald-500/40 text-emerald-300'
              : 'bg-rose-950/30 border-rose-500/40 text-rose-300'
          }`}>
            {calculations.passesStandard ? (
              <CheckCircle2 className="w-6 h-6 text-emerald-400 shrink-0" />
            ) : (
              <AlertCircle className="w-6 h-6 text-rose-400 shrink-0" />
            )}
            <div>
              <div className="font-bold text-sm">
                {calculations.passesStandard ? 'Đạt tiêu chuẩn thể lực quân đội' : 'Chưa đạt tiêu chuẩn quân đội'}
              </div>
              <p className="text-xs opacity-80">
                {calculations.passesStandard
                  ? `Mức mỡ của bạn nằm trong giới hạn an toàn quy định của U.S. Army AR 600-9.`
                  : `Tỷ lệ mỡ vượt quá ngưỡng ${calculations.maxAllowed}% cho phép, cần tập luyện và điều chỉnh dinh dưỡng.`}
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

FILE: /src/components/tools/AutoLoanCalculator.tsx

import React, { useState, useMemo, useEffect } from 'react';
import { Car, DollarSign, RotateCcw, Calendar, FileDown } from 'lucide-react';
import { useCurrency } from '../../context/CurrencyContext';
import { CurrencySelector } from '../common/CurrencySelector';
import { AutoLoanPdfModal } from './AutoLoanPdfModal';

export const AutoLoanCalculator: React.FC = () => {
  const { currency, currencyInfo, formatMoney } = useCurrency();

  const [vehiclePrice, setVehiclePrice] = useState<number>(() => {
    return currency === 'VND' ? 800000000 : 35000;
  });
  const [loanTermMonths, setLoanTermMonths] = useState<number>(60);
  const [interestRate, setInterestRate] = useState<number>(5.5);
  const [downPayment, setDownPayment] = useState<number>(() => {
    return currency === 'VND' ? 150000000 : 5000;
  });
  const [tradeInValue, setTradeInValue] = useState<number>(() => {
    return currency === 'VND' ? 50000000 : 2000;
  });
  const [salesTaxRate, setSalesTaxRate] = useState<number>(6.5);
  const [otherFees, setOtherFees] = useState<number>(() => {
    return currency === 'VND' ? 20000000 : 800;
  });
  const [isPdfModalOpen, setIsPdfModalOpen] = useState<boolean>(false);

  // Synchronize when switching currency
  useEffect(() => {
    if (currency === 'VND') {
      setVehiclePrice((prev) => (prev < 100000 ? 800000000 : prev));
      setDownPayment((prev) => (prev < 10000 ? 150000000 : prev));
      setTradeInValue((prev) => (prev < 5000 ? 50000000 : prev));
      setOtherFees((prev) => (prev < 2000 ? 20000000 : prev));
    } else {
      setVehiclePrice((prev) => (prev >= 1000000 ? 35000 : prev));
      setDownPayment((prev) => (prev >= 100000 ? 5000 : prev));
      setTradeInValue((prev) => (prev >= 100000 ? 2000 : prev));
      setOtherFees((prev) => (prev >= 100000 ? 800 : prev));
    }
  }, [currency]);

  const calculations = useMemo(() => {
    const netPrice = Math.max(0, vehiclePrice - tradeInValue);
    const salesTaxAmount = (netPrice * salesTaxRate) / 100;
    const totalPurchaseCost = vehiclePrice + salesTaxAmount + otherFees;
    const totalCredits = downPayment + tradeInValue;
    const loanAmount = Math.max(0, totalPurchaseCost - totalCredits);

    const monthlyRate = interestRate / 100 / 12;
    let monthlyPayment = 0;
    let totalInterest = 0;

    if (monthlyRate > 0 && loanTermMonths > 0) {
      monthlyPayment = (loanAmount * (monthlyRate * Math.pow(1 + monthlyRate, loanTermMonths))) / 
                       (Math.pow(1 + monthlyRate, loanTermMonths) - 1);
      totalInterest = (monthlyPayment * loanTermMonths) - loanAmount;
    } else if (loanTermMonths > 0) {
      monthlyPayment = loanAmount / loanTermMonths;
      totalInterest = 0;
    }

    const totalLoanCost = loanAmount + totalInterest;

    // First 12 months amortization preview
    const schedule = [];
    let balance = loanAmount;
    for (let m = 1; m <= Math.min(12, loanTermMonths); m++) {
      const interestForMonth = balance * monthlyRate;
      const principalForMonth = monthlyPayment - interestForMonth;
      balance = Math.max(0, balance - principalForMonth);
      schedule.push({
        month: m,
        principal: principalForMonth,
        interest: interestForMonth,
        balance
      });
    }

    return {
      salesTaxAmount,
      loanAmount,
      monthlyPayment,
      totalInterest,
      totalLoanCost,
      totalPurchaseCost,
      schedule
    };
  }, [vehiclePrice, loanTermMonths, interestRate, downPayment, tradeInValue, salesTaxRate, otherFees]);

  const handleReset = () => {
    setVehiclePrice(currency === 'VND' ? 800000000 : 35000);
    setLoanTermMonths(60);
    setInterestRate(5.5);
    setDownPayment(currency === 'VND' ? 150000000 : 5000);
    setTradeInValue(currency === 'VND' ? 50000000 : 2000);
    setSalesTaxRate(6.5);
    setOtherFees(currency === 'VND' ? 20000000 : 800);
  };

  return (
    <div className="w-full max-w-5xl mx-auto space-y-6">
      {/* Header Banner */}
      <div className="tool-header-banner p-4 sm:p-6 rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-r from-emerald-950/40 via-slate-800 to-slate-900 border border-emerald-500/30 flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-3">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <div className="banner-icon-box p-3 bg-emerald-600/20 text-emerald-400 rounded-xl border border-emerald-500/30">
            <Car className="w-6 h-6" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <h1 className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-bold text-white tracking-tight">Auto Loan Calculator – Tính Khoản Vay Mua Ô Tô</h1>
            <p className="text-xs sm:text-sm text-slate-400">Dự toán tiền trả hàng tháng, thuế trước bạ, lãi suất và tổng chi phí mua xe</p>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <CurrencySelector variant="compact" />
          <button
            id="autoloan-export-pdf-header-btn"
            onClick={() => setIsPdfModalOpen(true)}
            className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs text-emerald-300 hover:text-white bg-emerald-950/60 hover:bg-emerald-900 border border-emerald-600/40 rounded-lg transition-colors cursor-pointer font-medium"
            title="Xuất bảng trả nợ PDF hoặc In ấn"
          >
            <FileDown className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            <span>Xuất PDF / In</span>
          </button>
          <button
            id="autoloan-reset-btn"
            onClick={handleReset}
            className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs text-slate-300 hover:text-white bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 border border-slate-700 rounded-lg transition-colors cursor-pointer"
          >
            <RotateCcw className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            <span>Đặt lại</span>
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6">
        {/* Left Form: Inputs */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-6 space-y-4 bg-slate-900/80 p-5 rounded-2xl border border-slate-800">
          <h2 className="text-base font-semibold text-white flex items-center gap-2">
            <DollarSign className="w-4 h-4 text-blue-400" />
            Thông số khoản vay &amp; Xe
          </h2>

          <div>
            <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-300 mb-1">
              Giá xe niêm yết ({currencyInfo.symbol} {currencyInfo.code})
            </label>
            <div className="relative">
              <span className="absolute left-3.5 top-2.5 text-slate-400 font-bold">{currencyInfo.symbol}</span>
              <input
                id="autoloan-vehicle-price"
                type="number"
                step={currency === 'VND' ? 20000000 : 500}
                value={vehiclePrice}
                onChange={(e) => setVehiclePrice(Number(e.target.value))}
                className="w-full pl-9 pr-14 py-2.5 bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-white font-sans focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 outline-none"
              />
              <span className="absolute right-3.5 top-2.5 text-slate-400 text-xs font-bold">{currencyInfo.code}</span>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-300 mb-1">Thời hạn vay (tháng)</label>
              <select
                id="autoloan-term-select"
                value={loanTermMonths}
                onChange={(e) => setLoanTermMonths(Number(e.target.value))}
                className="w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-white font-sans focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 outline-none"
              >
                <option value={24}>24 tháng (2 năm)</option>
                <option value={36}>36 tháng (3 năm)</option>
                <option value={48}>48 tháng (4 năm)</option>
                <option value={60}>60 tháng (5 năm)</option>
                <option value={72}>72 tháng (6 năm)</option>
                <option value={84}>84 tháng (7 năm)</option>
              </select>
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-300 mb-1">Lãi suất năm (%/năm)</label>
              <input
                id="autoloan-rate"
                type="number"
                step="0.1"
                value={interestRate}
                onChange={(e) => setInterestRate(Number(e.target.value))}
                className="w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-white font-sans focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 outline-none"
              />
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-300 mb-1">
                Tiền trả trước ({currencyInfo.symbol})
              </label>
              <input
                id="autoloan-down-payment"
                type="number"
                step={currency === 'VND' ? 5000000 : 250}
                value={downPayment}
                onChange={(e) => setDownPayment(Number(e.target.value))}
                className="w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-white font-sans focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 outline-none"
              />
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-300 mb-1">
                Đổi xe cũ (Trade-in {currencyInfo.symbol})
              </label>
              <input
                id="autoloan-trade-in"
                type="number"
                step={currency === 'VND' ? 5000000 : 250}
                value={tradeInValue}
                onChange={(e) => setTradeInValue(Number(e.target.value))}
                className="w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-white font-sans focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 outline-none"
              />
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-300 mb-1">Thuế bán hàng / trước bạ (%)</label>
              <input
                id="autoloan-tax-rate"
                type="number"
                step="0.1"
                value={salesTaxRate}
                onChange={(e) => setSalesTaxRate(Number(e.target.value))}
                className="w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-white font-sans focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 outline-none"
              />
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-300 mb-1">
                Phí biển số &amp; Đăng kiểm ({currencyInfo.symbol})
              </label>
              <input
                id="autoloan-other-fees"
                type="number"
                step={currency === 'VND' ? 1000000 : 50}
                value={otherFees}
                onChange={(e) => setOtherFees(Number(e.target.value))}
                className="w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-white font-sans focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 outline-none"
              />
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Right Output: Key Metrics */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-6 space-y-4">
          <div className="tool-hero-banner p-6 rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-b from-emerald-950/30 to-slate-900 border border-emerald-500/40 text-center space-y-2">
            <span className="text-xs uppercase tracking-wider text-emerald-400 font-semibold">Khoản thanh toán ước tính hàng tháng</span>
            <div className="text-3xl sm:text-5xl font-extrabold text-emerald-400 font-sans tabular-nums">
              {formatMoney(calculations.monthlyPayment)}
              <span className="text-sm text-slate-400 font-normal"> /tháng</span>
            </div>
            <p className="text-xs text-slate-400">
              Trong vòng {loanTermMonths} tháng với lãi suất {interestRate}%/năm
            </p>
          </div>

          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-3">
            <div className="p-3.5 bg-slate-900/80 rounded-xl border border-slate-800">
              <span className="text-xs text-slate-400 block">Số tiền vay gốc</span>
              <span className="text-sm sm:text-base font-bold text-white font-sans tabular-nums">{formatMoney(calculations.loanAmount)}</span>
            </div>
            <div className="p-3.5 bg-slate-900/80 rounded-xl border border-slate-800">
              <span className="text-xs text-slate-400 block">Tổng tiền lãi</span>
              <span className="text-sm sm:text-base font-bold text-rose-400 font-sans tabular-nums">{formatMoney(calculations.totalInterest)}</span>
            </div>
            <div className="p-3.5 bg-slate-900/80 rounded-xl border border-slate-800">
              <span className="text-xs text-slate-400 block">Thuế trước bạ</span>
              <span className="text-sm sm:text-base font-bold text-amber-400 font-sans tabular-nums">{formatMoney(calculations.salesTaxAmount)}</span>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* 12 Months Amortization Preview */}
          <div className="p-4 bg-slate-900/80 rounded-2xl border border-slate-800 space-y-3">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <h3 className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-300 flex items-center gap-1.5">
                <Calendar className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-blue-400" />
                Lịch trả nợ năm đầu tiên (12 tháng)
              </h3>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  id="autoloan-export-pdf-table-btn"
                  onClick={() => setIsPdfModalOpen(true)}
                  className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-1 text-xs text-emerald-300 hover:text-white bg-emerald-950/40 hover:bg-emerald-900/60 border border-emerald-600/30 rounded-lg transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                >
                  <FileDown className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  <span>Xuất PDF / In</span>
                </button>
                <span className="text-[11px] text-slate-400 font-bold">{currencyInfo.code}</span>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="max-h-48 overflow-y-auto scrollbar-thin">
              <table className="w-full text-xs text-left text-slate-300">
                <thead className="text-[11px] uppercase bg-slate-800 text-slate-400 sticky top-0">
                  <tr>
                    <th className="p-2">Tháng</th>
                    <th className="p-2">Tiền gốc</th>
                    <th className="p-2">Tiền lãi</th>
                    <th className="p-2 text-right">Dư nợ còn lại</th>
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-800/60 font-sans tabular-nums">
                  {calculations.schedule.map((row) => (
                    <tr key={row.month} className="hover:bg-slate-800/40">
                      <td className="p-2 font-medium">#{row.month}</td>
                      <td className="p-2 text-emerald-400">{formatMoney(row.principal)}</td>
                      <td className="p-2 text-rose-400">{formatMoney(row.interest)}</td>
                      <td className="p-2 text-right text-slate-200">{formatMoney(row.balance)}</td>
                    </tr>
                  ))}
                </tbody>
              </table>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* PDF Export Modal */}
      <AutoLoanPdfModal
        isOpen={isPdfModalOpen}
        onClose={() => setIsPdfModalOpen(false)}
        vehiclePrice={vehiclePrice}
        downPayment={downPayment}
        tradeInValue={tradeInValue}
        interestRate={interestRate}
        loanTermMonths={loanTermMonths}
        salesTaxRate={salesTaxRate}
        otherFees={otherFees}
        calculations={calculations}
      />
    </div>
  );
};


================================================================================
FILE: /src/components/tools/AutoLoanPdfModal.tsx

import React, { useState, useRef, useMemo } from 'react';
import { X, FileDown, Printer, Check, Loader2, Calendar, Car, ShieldAlert, CheckCircle2, Share2 } from 'lucide-react';
import { useCurrency } from '../../context/CurrencyContext';
import { useLanguage } from '../../context/LanguageContext';
import { exportElementPagesToPdf, PdfExportResult } from '../../utils/pdfExportHelper';

export interface AutoLoanPdfModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  vehiclePrice: number;
  loanTermMonths: number;
  interestRate: number;
  downPayment: number;
  tradeInValue: number;
  salesTaxRate: number;
  otherFees: number;
  calculations: {
    salesTaxAmount: number;
    loanAmount: number;
    monthlyPayment: number;
    totalInterest: number;
    totalLoanCost: number;
    totalPurchaseCost: number;
  };
}

export const AutoLoanPdfModal: React.FC<AutoLoanPdfModalProps> = ({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  vehiclePrice,
  loanTermMonths,
  interestRate,
  downPayment,
  tradeInValue,
  salesTaxRate,
  otherFees,
  calculations
}) => {
  const { currencyInfo, formatMoney } = useCurrency();
  const { language } = useLanguage();
  const isVi = language === 'vi';

  const [exportScope, setExportScope] = useState<'full' | 'firstYear'>('firstYear');
  const [isExporting, setIsExporting] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [exportProgress, setExportProgress] = useState<string>('');
  const [isDone, setIsDone] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [exportResult, setExportResult] = useState<PdfExportResult | null>(null);

  const printContainerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  // Compute full monthly schedule
  const fullSchedule = useMemo(() => {
    const monthlyRate = interestRate / 100 / 12;
    const schedule = [];
    let balance = calculations.loanAmount;
    const count = exportScope === 'firstYear' ? Math.min(12, loanTermMonths) : loanTermMonths;

    for (let m = 1; m <= count; m++) {
      const interestForMonth = balance * monthlyRate;
      const principalForMonth = calculations.monthlyPayment - interestForMonth;
      balance = Math.max(0, balance - principalForMonth);
      schedule.push({
        month: m,
        payment: calculations.monthlyPayment,
        principal: principalForMonth,
        interest: interestForMonth,
        balance
      });
    }
    return schedule;
  }, [calculations.loanAmount, calculations.monthlyPayment, interestRate, loanTermMonths, exportScope]);

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  // Split schedule into pages (~26 rows per page)
  const ROWS_PER_PAGE = 26;
  const schedulePages = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < fullSchedule.length; i += ROWS_PER_PAGE) {
    schedulePages.push(fullSchedule.slice(i, i + ROWS_PER_PAGE));
  }
  const totalPagesCount = Math.max(1, schedulePages.length);

  const handleExportPDF = async () => {
    if (isExporting || !printContainerRef.current) return;
    try {
      setIsExporting(true);
      setIsDone(false);
      setExportProgress(isVi ? 'Đang chuẩn bị trang in...' : 'Preparing pages...');

      const dateStr = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
      const fileName = isVi
        ? `Lich_Tra_No_Vay_O_To_${Math.round(calculations.loanAmount)}_${currencyInfo.code}_${dateStr}.pdf`
        : `Auto_Loan_Payment_Plan_${Math.round(calculations.loanAmount)}_${currencyInfo.code}_${dateStr}.pdf`;

      const result = await exportElementPagesToPdf(printContainerRef.current, {
        fileName,
        pageSelector: '.pdf-report-page',
        onProgress: (text) => setExportProgress(text),
      });

      setExportResult(result);
      setIsDone(true);
      setExportProgress(isVi ? 'Xuất PDF thành công!' : 'PDF export complete!');
      setTimeout(() => {
        setIsDone(false);
        setExportProgress('');
      }, 4000);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Lỗi khi xuất PDF:', error);
      alert(isVi ? 'Có lỗi khi tạo PDF. Bạn có thể chọn In trực tiếp.' : 'Error generating PDF. Try Print directly.');
    } finally {
      setIsExporting(false);
    }
  };

  const handlePrint = () => {
    window.print();
  };

  const currentDateFormatted = new Date().toLocaleDateString(isVi ? 'vi-VN' : 'en-US', {
    year: 'numeric',
    month: 'long',
    day: 'numeric',
  });

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-3 sm:p-4 bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-xs animate-in fade-in duration-200 print:hidden">
      <div className="bg-slate-900 rounded-2xl shadow-2xl border border-slate-800 w-full max-w-xl max-h-[92vh] flex flex-col overflow-hidden text-slate-200">
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="px-5 py-4 border-b border-slate-800 flex items-center justify-between bg-slate-950/80">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-blue-600/20 border border-blue-500/40 text-blue-400 flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs">
              <Car className="w-5 h-5" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <h3 className="text-base sm:text-lg font-bold text-white">
                {isVi ? 'Xuất Báo Cáo & Lịch Trả Nợ Vay Mua Ô Tô' : 'Export Auto Loan Report & Schedule'}
              </h3>
              <p className="text-xs text-slate-400">
                {isVi 
                  ? 'Bao gồm giá xe, thuế phí lăn bánh, số tiền vay và bảng trả nợ định kỳ' 
                  : 'Includes vehicle cost, taxes & fees, loan amount, and monthly payment schedule'}
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
          <button
            onClick={onClose}
            disabled={isExporting}
            className="p-2 text-slate-400 hover:text-white hover:bg-slate-800 rounded-lg transition-colors cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-50"
          >
            <X className="w-5 h-5" />
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Modal Body */}
        <div className="p-5 overflow-y-auto space-y-4 text-sm">
          {/* Scope Selector */}
          <div className="p-3 bg-slate-950/60 rounded-xl border border-slate-800 space-y-2">
            <label className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-300 block">
              {isVi ? 'Phạm vi xuất lịch trả nợ:' : 'Schedule export scope:'}
            </label>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setExportScope('firstYear')}
                className={`px-3 py-2 rounded-lg text-xs font-medium border transition-colors cursor-pointer ${
                  exportScope === 'firstYear'
                    ? 'bg-blue-600/20 border-blue-500 text-blue-300 font-bold'
                    : 'bg-slate-900 border-slate-800 text-slate-400 hover:text-white'
                }`}
              >
                {isVi ? 'Năm đầu tiên (12 tháng)' : 'First Year (12 months)'}
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setExportScope('full')}
                className={`px-3 py-2 rounded-lg text-xs font-medium border transition-colors cursor-pointer ${
                  exportScope === 'full'
                    ? 'bg-blue-600/20 border-blue-500 text-blue-300 font-bold'
                    : 'bg-slate-900 border-slate-800 text-slate-400 hover:text-white'
                }`}
              >
                {isVi ? `Toàn bộ kỳ hạn (${loanTermMonths} tháng)` : `Full Loan (${loanTermMonths} months)`}
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="p-4 bg-slate-950/60 rounded-xl border border-slate-800 space-y-3">
            <div className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-wider flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <Calendar className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-blue-400" />
              <span>{isVi ? 'Tóm tắt thông số khoản vay xe' : 'Auto loan parameters summary'}</span>
            </div>
            
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-4 gap-2.5 text-xs">
              <div className="bg-slate-900 p-2.5 rounded-lg border border-slate-800">
                <span className="text-slate-400 block">{isVi ? 'Giá xe niêm yết' : 'Vehicle Price'}</span>
                <span className="text-sm font-bold text-white tabular-nums">{formatMoney(vehiclePrice)}</span>
              </div>
              <div className="bg-slate-900 p-2.5 rounded-lg border border-slate-800">
                <span className="text-slate-400 block">{isVi ? 'Trả trước + Đổi xe' : 'Down + Trade-in'}</span>
                <span className="text-sm font-bold text-emerald-400 tabular-nums">
                  {formatMoney(downPayment + tradeInValue)}
                </span>
              </div>
              <div className="bg-slate-900 p-2.5 rounded-lg border border-slate-800">
                <span className="text-slate-400 block">{isVi ? 'Lãi suất vay' : 'Interest Rate'}</span>
                <span className="text-sm font-bold text-blue-400 tabular-nums">{interestRate}% / {isVi ? 'năm' : 'yr'}</span>
              </div>
              <div className="bg-slate-900 p-2.5 rounded-lg border border-slate-800">
                <span className="text-slate-400 block">{isVi ? 'Thời gian vay' : 'Loan Term'}</span>
                <span className="text-sm font-bold text-white tabular-nums">{loanTermMonths} {isVi ? 'tháng' : 'months'}</span>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="p-4 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-r from-emerald-950/60 via-slate-900 to-blue-950/60 border border-emerald-500/40 text-center space-y-1">
              <span className="text-xs text-emerald-400 uppercase tracking-wider font-semibold">
                {isVi ? 'Ước tính trả góp hàng tháng' : 'Estimated Monthly Payment'}
              </span>
              <div className="text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-extrabold text-emerald-400 tabular-nums">
                {formatMoney(calculations.monthlyPayment)}
                <span className="text-xs text-slate-400 font-normal"> /{isVi ? 'tháng' : 'mo'}</span>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2 text-xs">
              <div className="p-2.5 rounded-lg bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800">
                <span className="text-slate-400 block">{isVi ? 'Số tiền vay' : 'Loan Amount'}</span>
                <span className="text-xs sm:text-sm font-bold text-white tabular-nums">{formatMoney(calculations.loanAmount)}</span>
              </div>
              <div className="p-2.5 rounded-lg bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800">
                <span className="text-slate-400 block">{isVi ? 'Tổng tiền lãi' : 'Total Interest'}</span>
                <span className="text-xs sm:text-sm font-bold text-rose-400 tabular-nums">{formatMoney(calculations.totalInterest)}</span>
              </div>
              <div className="p-2.5 rounded-lg bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800">
                <span className="text-slate-400 block">{isVi ? 'Thuế trước bạ' : 'Sales Tax'}</span>
                <span className="text-xs sm:text-sm font-bold text-amber-400 tabular-nums">{formatMoney(calculations.salesTaxAmount)}</span>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {exportProgress && (
            <div className="p-3 bg-blue-950/60 border border-blue-500/40 rounded-xl flex items-center gap-2.5 text-xs text-blue-300">
              {isExporting ? (
                <Loader2 className="w-4 h-4 animate-spin text-blue-400 shrink-0" />
              ) : isDone ? (
                <Check className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-400 shrink-0" />
              ) : null}
              <span>{exportProgress}</span>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Khi file PDF đã sẵn sàng, hiển thị nút tải trực tiếp và share (đặc biệt hữu ích trên iPhone/Android) */}
          {exportResult && (
            <div className="p-3 bg-emerald-950/60 border border-emerald-500/50 rounded-xl flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-center justify-between gap-3 text-xs shadow-xs">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-emerald-300 min-w-0">
                <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-400 shrink-0" />
                <span className="font-semibold shrink-0">{isVi ? 'File PDF đã sẵn sàng:' : 'PDF ready:'}</span>
                <span className="font-mono text-[11px] truncate max-w-[170px] text-slate-300">{exportResult.fileName}</span>
              </div>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 w-full sm:w-auto shrink-0">
                <a
                  href={exportResult.blobUrl}
                  download={exportResult.fileName}
                  target="_blank"
                  rel="noopener noreferrer"
                  className="flex-1 sm:flex-none px-3.5 py-1.5 bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-500 text-white font-bold rounded-lg text-center shadow-xs flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 transition-colors"
                >
                  <FileDown className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  <span>{isVi ? 'Mở / Tải file' : 'Open / Save'}</span>
                </a>
                {typeof navigator !== 'undefined' && !!navigator.share && (
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={async () => {
                      try {
                        const file = new File([exportResult.blob], exportResult.fileName, { type: 'application/pdf' });
                        if (navigator.canShare && navigator.canShare({ files: [file] })) {
                          await navigator.share({ files: [file], title: exportResult.fileName });
                        } else {
                          window.open(exportResult.blobUrl, '_blank');
                        }
                      } catch (err: any) {
                        if (err.name !== 'AbortError') {
                          window.open(exportResult.blobUrl, '_blank');
                        }
                      }
                    }}
                    className="flex-1 sm:flex-none px-3 py-1.5 bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-200 font-bold rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 border border-slate-700 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                  >
                    <Share2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                    <span>{isVi ? 'Lưu vào Tệp' : 'Save to Files'}</span>
                  </button>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* Modal Footer */}
        <div className="px-5 py-4 border-t border-slate-800 bg-slate-950/80 flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-center justify-between gap-3">
          <div className="text-xs text-slate-400 flex items-center gap-1.5">
            <ShieldAlert className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-500 shrink-0" />
            <span>{isVi ? 'Định dạng tài liệu A4 chuẩn ngân hàng' : 'Bank-standard A4 format'}</span>
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 w-full sm:w-auto">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={handlePrint}
              disabled={isExporting}
              className="flex-1 sm:flex-none px-3.5 py-2 bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-200 border border-slate-700 text-xs font-semibold rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 transition-colors cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-50"
            >
              <Printer className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              <span>{isVi ? 'In / Lưu PDF' : 'Print / Save'}</span>
            </button>

            <button
              type="button"
              id="confirm-download-autoloan-pdf-btn"
              onClick={handleExportPDF}
              disabled={isExporting}
              className="flex-1 sm:flex-none px-5 py-2 bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-500 text-white text-xs font-bold rounded-xl shadow-xs flex items-center justify-center gap-2 transition-all cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-50"
            >
              {isExporting ? (
                <>
                  <Loader2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5 animate-spin" />
                  <span>{isVi ? 'Đang tạo PDF...' : 'Generating...'}</span>
                </>
              ) : isDone ? (
                <>
                  <Check className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-300" />
                  <span>{isVi ? 'Đã tải xong!' : 'Downloaded!'}</span>
                </>
              ) : (
                <>
                  <FileDown className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  <span>{isVi ? 'Tải file PDF ngay' : 'Download PDF'}</span>
                </>
              )}
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* PRINTABLE CONTAINER (Off-screen, NOT display: none for sharp html2canvas rendering) */}
      <div
        ref={printContainerRef}
        id="autoloan-pdf-printable-source"
        aria-hidden="true"
        style={{
          position: 'fixed',
          left: '-9999px',
          top: 0,
          width: '794px',
          height: 'auto',
          overflow: 'hidden',
          pointerEvents: 'none',
          backgroundColor: '#ffffff',
          color: '#0f172a',
          zIndex: -9999,
        }}
      >
        {schedulePages.map((pageRows, pageIdx) => (
          <div
            key={`page-${pageIdx}`}
            className="pdf-report-page bg-white text-slate-900"
            style={{
              width: '794px',
              minHeight: '1123px',
              height: '1123px',
              padding: '36px 40px',
              boxSizing: 'border-box',
              display: 'flex',
              flexDirection: 'column',
              justifyContent: 'space-between',
              fontFamily: 'system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif',
            }}
          >
            <div>
              {/* Header */}
              <div style={{ borderBottom: '2px solid #2563eb', paddingBottom: '14px', marginBottom: '16px' }}>
                <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'flex-start' }}>
                  <div>
                    <div style={{ fontSize: '10px', fontWeight: 800, textTransform: 'uppercase', letterSpacing: '1px', color: '#2563eb' }}>
                      BÁO CÁO TÀI CHÍNH • AUTO FINANCING REPORT
                    </div>
                    <h1 style={{ fontSize: '20px', fontWeight: 900, color: '#0f172a', margin: '4px 0 2px 0', letterSpacing: '-0.5px' }}>
                      BẢNG DỰ TOÁN KHOẢN VAY MUA XE Ô TÔ
                    </h1>
                    <div style={{ fontSize: '11px', color: '#475569' }}>
                      Chi tiết chi phí mua xe, thuế trước bạ, phí lăn bánh và lịch trình trả góp định kỳ
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <div style={{ textAlign: 'right', fontSize: '10px', color: '#64748b' }}>
                    <div>Ngày lập: <strong style={{ color: '#0f172a' }}>{currentDateFormatted}</strong></div>
                    <div>Tiền tệ: <strong style={{ color: '#0f172a' }}>{currencyInfo.code} ({currencyInfo.symbol})</strong></div>
                    <div style={{ marginTop: '2px', display: 'inline-block', padding: '2px 6px', background: '#dbeafe', color: '#1e40af', borderRadius: '4px', fontWeight: 700 }}>
                      Phương thức: Trả góp dư nợ cố định (EMI)
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>

              {pageIdx === 0 && (
                <>
                  {/* Summary Cards */}
                  <div style={{ marginBottom: '16px' }}>
                    <div style={{ fontSize: '11px', fontWeight: 800, textTransform: 'uppercase', letterSpacing: '0.5px', color: '#0f172a', marginBottom: '8px', display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '6px' }}>
                      <span style={{ width: '8px', height: '8px', background: '#2563eb', borderRadius: '2px', display: 'inline-block' }} />
                      <span>1. THÔNG SỐ XE &amp; KHOẢN VAY</span>
                    </div>

                    <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(4, 1fr)', gap: '8px', marginBottom: '8px' }}>
                      <div style={{ background: '#f8fafc', border: '1px solid #e2e8f0', borderRadius: '8px', padding: '10px' }}>
                        <div style={{ fontSize: '9px', color: '#64748b', fontWeight: 600 }}>GIÁ XE NIÊM YẾT</div>
                        <div style={{ fontSize: '14px', fontWeight: 900, color: '#0f172a', marginTop: '2px' }}>{formatMoney(vehiclePrice)}</div>
                      </div>
                      <div style={{ background: '#f8fafc', border: '1px solid #e2e8f0', borderRadius: '8px', padding: '10px' }}>
                        <div style={{ fontSize: '9px', color: '#64748b', fontWeight: 600 }}>SỐ TIỀN TRẢ TRƯỚC</div>
                        <div style={{ fontSize: '14px', fontWeight: 900, color: '#059669', marginTop: '2px' }}>{formatMoney(downPayment)}</div>
                      </div>
                      <div style={{ background: '#f8fafc', border: '1px solid #e2e8f0', borderRadius: '8px', padding: '10px' }}>
                        <div style={{ fontSize: '9px', color: '#64748b', fontWeight: 600 }}>THUẾ TRƯỚC BẠ ({salesTaxRate}%)</div>
                        <div style={{ fontSize: '14px', fontWeight: 900, color: '#d97706', marginTop: '2px' }}>{formatMoney(calculations.salesTaxAmount)}</div>
                      </div>
                      <div style={{ background: '#f8fafc', border: '1px solid #e2e8f0', borderRadius: '8px', padding: '10px' }}>
                        <div style={{ fontSize: '9px', color: '#64748b', fontWeight: 600 }}>PHÍ LĂN BÁNH KHÁC</div>
                        <div style={{ fontSize: '14px', fontWeight: 900, color: '#0f172a', marginTop: '2px' }}>{formatMoney(otherFees)}</div>
                      </div>
                    </div>
