import React, { useState, useMemo, useEffect } from 'react';
import {
  Coins,
  RotateCcw,
  ArrowRightLeft,
  TrendingUp,
  Globe
} from 'lucide-react';
import { useCurrency } from '../../context/CurrencyContext';
import { CurrencySelector } from '../common/CurrencySelector';

interface CurrencyRateData {
  name: string;
  nameEn: string;
  symbol: string;
  rate: number; // units per 1 USD
  flag: string;
}

const RATES_TO_USD: Record<string, CurrencyRateData> = {
  USD: { name: 'Đô la Mỹ', nameEn: 'US Dollar', symbol: '$', rate: 1, flag: '🇺🇸' },
  EUR: { name: 'Đồng Euro', nameEn: 'Euro', symbol: '€', rate: 0.92, flag: '🇪🇺' },
  GBP: { name: 'Bảng Anh', nameEn: 'British Pound', symbol: '£', rate: 0.79, flag: '🇬🇧' },
  JPY: { name: 'Yên Nhật', nameEn: 'Japanese Yen', symbol: '¥', rate: 155.4, flag: '🇯🇵' },
  CAD: { name: 'Đô la Canada', nameEn: 'Canadian Dollar', symbol: 'C$', rate: 1.37, flag: '🇨🇦' },
  AUD: { name: 'Đô la Úc', nameEn: 'Australian Dollar', symbol: 'A$', rate: 1.52, flag: '🇦🇺' },
  CHF: { name: 'Franc Thụy Sĩ', nameEn: 'Swiss Franc', symbol: 'CHF', rate: 0.91, flag: '🇨🇭' },
  CNY: { name: 'Nhân dân tệ', nameEn: 'Chinese Yuan', symbol: '¥', rate: 7.24, flag: '🇨🇳' },
  SGD: { name: 'Đô la Singapore', nameEn: 'Singapore Dollar', symbol: 'S$', rate: 1.35, flag: '🇸🇬' },
  KRW: { name: 'Won Hàn Quốc', nameEn: 'South Korean Won', symbol: '₩', rate: 1380, flag: '🇰🇷' },
  VND: { name: 'Việt Nam Đồng', nameEn: 'Vietnamese Dong', symbol: '₫', rate: 25450, flag: '🇻🇳' },
  THB: { name: 'Baht Thái', nameEn: 'Thai Baht', symbol: '฿', rate: 36.8, flag: '🇹🇭' },
  INR: { name: 'Rupee Ấn Độ', nameEn: 'Indian Rupee', symbol: '₹', rate: 83.5, flag: '🇮🇳' },
  HKD: { name: 'Đô la Hồng Kông', nameEn: 'Hong Kong Dollar', symbol: 'HK$', rate: 7.82, flag: '🇭🇰' },
  BRL: { name: 'Real Brazil', nameEn: 'Brazilian Real', symbol: 'R$', rate: 5.45, flag: '🇧🇷' },
  MXN: { name: 'Peso Mexico', nameEn: 'Mexican Peso', symbol: 'Mex$', rate: 18.2, flag: '🇲🇽' }
};

export const CurrencyConverter: React.FC = () => {
  const { currency } = useCurrency();

  const [amount, setAmount] = useState<number>(100);
  const [fromCurr, setFromCurr] = useState<string>('USD');
  const [toCurr, setToCurr] = useState<string>(() => {
    return currency !== 'USD' && RATES_TO_USD[currency] ? currency : 'EUR';
  });

  // Keep target currency in sync if user changes global currency
  useEffect(() => {
    if (currency !== fromCurr && RATES_TO_USD[currency]) {
      setToCurr(currency);
    }
  }, [currency, fromCurr]);

  const converted = useMemo(() => {
    const fromRate = RATES_TO_USD[fromCurr]?.rate || 1;
    const toRate = RATES_TO_USD[toCurr]?.rate || 1;

    // Convert fromCurr to USD base, then USD to toCurr
    const inUSD = amount / fromRate;
    return inUSD * toRate;
  }, [amount, fromCurr, toCurr]);

  const exchangeRateInfo = useMemo(() => {
    const fromRate = RATES_TO_USD[fromCurr]?.rate || 1;
    const toRate = RATES_TO_USD[toCurr]?.rate || 1;
    const rate1Unit = (1 / fromRate) * toRate;
    const reverseRate = (1 / toRate) * fromRate;
    return { rate1Unit, reverseRate };
  }, [fromCurr, toCurr]);

  const allConverted = useMemo(() => {
    const fromRate = RATES_TO_USD[fromCurr]?.rate || 1;
    const inUSD = amount / fromRate;
    return Object.entries(RATES_TO_USD).map(([code, data]) => ({
      code,
      name: data.name,
      symbol: data.symbol,
      flag: data.flag,
      rate: data.rate,
      val: inUSD * data.rate
    }));
  }, [amount, fromCurr]);

  const handleSwap = () => {
    const temp = fromCurr;
    setFromCurr(toCurr);
    setToCurr(temp);
  };

  const handleReset = () => {
    setAmount(100);
    setFromCurr('USD');
    setToCurr(currency !== 'USD' && RATES_TO_USD[currency] ? currency : 'EUR');
  };

  const formatNumberWithDecimals = (val: number, maxDecimals = 2) => {
    if (val >= 1000) {
      return new Intl.NumberFormat('en-US', { maximumFractionDigits: maxDecimals }).format(val);
    }
    return new Intl.NumberFormat('en-US', { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 4 }).format(val);
  };

  return (
    <div className="w-full max-w-5xl mx-auto space-y-6">
      <div className="p-4 sm:p-6 rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-r from-blue-900/40 via-slate-800 to-slate-900 border border-blue-500/30 flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-3">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <div className="p-3 bg-blue-600/20 text-blue-400 rounded-xl border border-blue-500/30">
            <Coins className="w-6 h-6" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <h1 className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-bold text-white tracking-tight">Currency Converter – Chuyển Đổi Ngoại Tệ Quốc Tế</h1>
            <p className="text-xs sm:text-sm text-slate-400">Tỷ giá tham chiếu chuẩn quốc tế (USD Base) giữa hơn 16 đồng tiền phổ biến toàn cầu</p>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <CurrencySelector variant="compact" />
          <button
            id="curr-reset-btn"
            onClick={handleReset}
            className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs text-slate-300 hover:text-white bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 border border-slate-700 rounded-lg transition-colors cursor-pointer"
          >
            <RotateCcw className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            <span>Đặt lại</span>
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="p-6 bg-slate-900/90 rounded-2xl border border-slate-800 space-y-6">
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-7 gap-3 items-center">
          <div className="sm:col-span-3 space-y-2">
            <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-300">Số tiền chuyển đổi</label>
            <div className="relative">
              <span className="absolute left-3.5 top-2.5 text-slate-400 font-bold">{RATES_TO_USD[fromCurr]?.symbol}</span>
              <input
                id="curr-val-input"
                type="number"
                value={amount}
                onChange={(e) => setAmount(Number(e.target.value))}
                className="w-full pl-9 pr-4 py-2.5 bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-white font-sans text-lg font-semibold focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 outline-none"
              />
            </div>
            <select
              id="curr-from-select"
              value={fromCurr}
              onChange={(e) => setFromCurr(e.target.value)}
              className="w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-white font-sans focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 outline-none cursor-pointer"
            >
              {Object.entries(RATES_TO_USD).map(([code, item]) => (
                <option key={code} value={code}>
                  {item.flag} {code} - {item.name} ({item.symbol})
                </option>
              ))}
            </select>
          </div>

          <div className="sm:col-span-1 flex justify-center">
            <button
              id="curr-swap-btn"
              onClick={handleSwap}
              className="p-3 rounded-full bg-slate-800 hover:bg-blue-600 border border-slate-700 hover:border-blue-500 text-blue-400 hover:text-white transition-all cursor-pointer shadow-md"
              title="Đảo chiều ngoại tệ"
            >
              <ArrowRightLeft className="w-4 h-4" />
            </button>
          </div>

          <div className="sm:col-span-3 space-y-2">
            <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-300">Quy đổi tương đương</label>
            <div className="w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 bg-slate-800/60 border border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-emerald-400 font-bold font-sans text-xl tabular-nums truncate flex items-center justify-between">
              <span>{formatNumberWithDecimals(converted, toCurr === 'VND' || toCurr === 'JPY' || toCurr === 'KRW' ? 0 : 2)}</span>
              <span className="text-sm font-semibold text-slate-300">{RATES_TO_USD[toCurr]?.symbol} {toCurr}</span>
            </div>
            <select
              id="curr-to-select"
              value={toCurr}
              onChange={(e) => setToCurr(e.target.value)}
              className="w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-white font-sans focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 outline-none cursor-pointer"
            >
              {Object.entries(RATES_TO_USD).map(([code, item]) => (
                <option key={code} value={code}>
                  {item.flag} {code} - {item.name} ({item.symbol})
                </option>
              ))}
            </select>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Live exchange rate display */}
        <div className="p-3 bg-slate-800/50 rounded-xl border border-slate-700/60 flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-center justify-between text-xs text-slate-300 gap-2">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <TrendingUp className="w-4 h-4 text-blue-400" />
            <span>
              1 {fromCurr} = <strong className="text-white font-sans">{formatNumberWithDecimals(exchangeRateInfo.rate1Unit, 4)} {toCurr}</strong>
            </span>
          </div>
          <div className="text-slate-400">
            1 {toCurr} = <strong className="text-slate-200 font-sans">{formatNumberWithDecimals(exchangeRateInfo.reverseRate, 4)} {fromCurr}</strong>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Global Multi-Currency Grid */}
        <div className="pt-4 border-t border-slate-800 space-y-3">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
            <h3 className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-300 flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <Globe className="w-4 h-4 text-cyan-400" />
              Bảng quy đổi tương đương các đồng tiền chính toàn cầu
            </h3>
            <span className="text-[11px] text-slate-400">Gốc: {amount.toLocaleString()} {fromCurr}</span>
          </div>

          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-4 gap-2.5">
            {allConverted.map((item) => (
              <button
                key={item.code}
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setToCurr(item.code)}
                className={`p-3 rounded-xl border text-left transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                  toCurr === item.code
                    ? 'bg-blue-950/50 border-blue-500/50 ring-1 ring-blue-400/30'
                    : 'bg-slate-800/40 hover:bg-slate-800/80 border-slate-800 hover:border-slate-700'
                }`}
              >
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-1">
                  <span className="text-xs font-bold text-white flex items-center gap-1.5">
                    <span>{item.flag}</span>
                    <span>{item.code}</span>
                  </span>
                  <span className="text-[11px] text-slate-400 font-sans">{item.symbol}</span>
                </div>
                <div className="text-sm font-bold text-emerald-400 font-sans tabular-nums truncate">
                  {formatNumberWithDecimals(item.val, item.code === 'VND' || item.code === 'JPY' || item.code === 'KRW' ? 0 : 2)}
                </div>
                <div className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 truncate">{item.name}</div>
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};


================================================================================
FILE: /src/components/tools/DateCalculator.tsx

import React, { useState, useMemo } from 'react';
import {
  Check,
  Copy,
  Plus,
  Minus,
  CalendarDays,
  Clock,
  Briefcase
} from 'lucide-react';
import {
  parseLocalDate,
  formatLocalISODate,
  getTodayLocalISODate
} from '../../utils/dateUtils';

export const DateCalculator: React.FC = () => {
  const [tab, setTab] = useState<'difference' | 'add_subtract'>('difference');
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState<boolean>(false);

  // Mode 1: Difference
  const todayStr = useMemo(() => getTodayLocalISODate(), []);
  const [startDate, setStartDate] = useState<string>(todayStr);
  const [endDate, setEndDate] = useState<string>(() => {
    const d = new Date();
    d.setDate(d.getDate() + 45);
    return formatLocalISODate(d);
  });
  const [includeEndDate, setIncludeEndDate] = useState<boolean>(false);

  // Mode 2: Add/Subtract
  const [baseDate, setBaseDate] = useState<string>(todayStr);
  const [op, setOp] = useState<'add' | 'subtract'>('add');
  const [addYears, setAddYears] = useState<number>(0);
  const [addMonths, setAddMonths] = useState<number>(1);
  const [addWeeks, setAddWeeks] = useState<number>(0);
  const [addDays, setAddDays] = useState<number>(15);

  // Calculation for Difference
  const diffResult = useMemo(() => {
    const start = parseLocalDate(startDate);
    const end = parseLocalDate(endDate);

    if (isNaN(start.getTime()) || isNaN(end.getTime())) {
      return null;
    }

    let diffMs = end.getTime() - start.getTime();
    const isReversed = diffMs < 0;
    if (isReversed) diffMs = Math.abs(diffMs);

    let totalDays = Math.round(diffMs / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));
    if (includeEndDate && !isReversed) totalDays += 1;

    const weeks = Math.floor(totalDays / 7);
    const remainingDays = totalDays % 7;

    // Working days (business days excluding Saturday & Sunday)
    let businessDays = 0;
    const cur = new Date(isReversed ? end : start);
    const target = new Date(isReversed ? start : end);
    while (cur < target) {
      const dayOfWeek = cur.getDay();
      if (dayOfWeek !== 0 && dayOfWeek !== 6) {
        businessDays++;
      }
      cur.setDate(cur.getDate() + 1);
    }
    if (includeEndDate) {
      const endDayOfWeek = target.getDay();
      if (endDayOfWeek !== 0 && endDayOfWeek !== 6) businessDays++;
    }

    const hours = totalDays * 24;
    const minutes = hours * 60;

    return {
      totalDays,
      weeks,
      remainingDays,
      businessDays,
      hours,
      minutes,
      isReversed
    };
  }, [startDate, endDate, includeEndDate]);

  // Calculation for Add/Subtract
  const calcDateResult = useMemo(() => {
    const d = parseLocalDate(baseDate);
    if (isNaN(d.getTime())) return null;

    const sign = op === 'add' ? 1 : -1;
    d.setFullYear(d.getFullYear() + sign * addYears);
    d.setMonth(d.getMonth() + sign * addMonths);
    const daysOffset = (addWeeks * 7 + addDays) * sign;
    d.setDate(d.getDate() + daysOffset);

    const dayOfWeekNames = ['Chủ Nhật', 'Thứ Hai', 'Thứ Ba', 'Thứ Tư', 'Thứ Năm', 'Thứ Sáu', 'Thứ Bảy'];
    const dayOfWeek = dayOfWeekNames[d.getDay()];
    const formatted = d.toLocaleDateString('vi-VN', {
      year: 'numeric',
      month: 'long',
      day: 'numeric'
    });

    return {
      dateObj: d,
      dayOfWeek,
      formatted,
      iso: formatLocalISODate(d)
    };
  }, [baseDate, op, addYears, addMonths, addWeeks, addDays]);

  const handleCopy = () => {
    let text = '';
    if (tab === 'difference' && diffResult) {
      text = `Khoảng cách giữa ${startDate} và ${endDate}:
- Tổng số ngày: ${diffResult.totalDays} ngày
- Quy đổi: ${diffResult.weeks} tuần và ${diffResult.remainingDays} ngày
- Số ngày làm việc (không tính T7, CN): ${diffResult.businessDays} ngày`;
    } else if (tab === 'add_subtract' && calcDateResult) {
      text = `Kết quả tính ngày: ${baseDate} ${op === 'add' ? '+' : '-'} (${addYears} năm, ${addMonths} tháng, ${addDays} ngày) = ${calcDateResult.formatted} (${calcDateResult.dayOfWeek})`;
    }
    navigator.clipboard?.writeText(text);
    setCopied(true);
    setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 2000);
  };

  return (
    <div id="date-calculator" className="p-4 sm:p-7 space-y-6">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-3 pb-5 border-b border-slate-200">
        <div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <span className="p-2 rounded-xl bg-rose-50 text-rose-600 border border-rose-100">
              <CalendarDays className="w-5 h-5" />
            </span>
            <h2 className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-black text-slate-900 tracking-tight">
              Date Calculator (Tính Số Ngày)
            </h2>
          </div>
          <p className="text-xs sm:text-sm text-slate-500 mt-1">
            Tính khoảng cách số ngày, tuần, tháng giữa 2 mốc thời gian và cộng/trừ ngày tháng năm chính xác.
          </p>
        </div>

        <button
          onClick={handleCopy}
          className="self-start sm:self-auto flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3.5 py-2 text-xs font-semibold rounded-xl bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 text-slate-700 transition-colors active:scale-95"
        >
          {copied ? <Check className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-600" /> : <Copy className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-500" />}
          <span>{copied ? 'Đã sao chép' : 'Sao chép kết quả'}</span>
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* Tabs */}
      <div className="flex gap-2 p-1.5 bg-slate-100 rounded-2xl w-fit">
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => setTab('difference')}
          className={`px-4 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition-all ${
            tab === 'difference' ? 'bg-blue-600 text-white shadow-xs' : 'text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-900'
          }`}
        >
          Đếm số ngày giữa 2 ngày
        </button>
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => setTab('add_subtract')}
          className={`px-4 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition-all ${
            tab === 'add_subtract' ? 'bg-blue-600 text-white shadow-xs' : 'text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-900'
          }`}
        >
          Cộng / Trừ ngày tháng
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* Mode 1: Difference */}
      {tab === 'difference' && (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6">
          <div className="lg:col-span-6 bg-slate-50 p-5 rounded-3xl border border-slate-200 space-y-4">
            <h3 className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 uppercase tracking-wider">
              Chọn mốc ngày bắt đầu và kết thúc
            </h3>

            <div className="space-y-3 text-xs">
              <div>
                <label className="text-slate-600 font-semibold block mb-1">Ngày bắt đầu:</label>
                <input
                  type="date"
                  value={startDate}
                  onChange={(e) => setStartDate(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full p-2.5 bg-white border border-slate-300 rounded-xl font-bold text-sm text-slate-900"
                />
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="text-slate-600 font-semibold block mb-1">Ngày kết thúc:</label>
                <input
                  type="date"
                  value={endDate}
                  onChange={(e) => setEndDate(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full p-2.5 bg-white border border-slate-300 rounded-xl font-bold text-sm text-slate-900"
                />
              </div>

              <div className="pt-2">
                <label className="flex items-center gap-2 cursor-pointer select-none text-slate-700 font-medium">
                  <input
                    type="checkbox"
                    checked={includeEndDate}
                    onChange={(e) => setIncludeEndDate(e.target.checked)}
                    className="w-4 h-4 rounded text-rose-600 focus:ring-rose-500 accent-rose-600"
                  />
                  <span>Bao gồm cả ngày kết thúc (+1 ngày)</span>
                </label>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="lg:col-span-6 space-y-4">
            {diffResult && (
              <>
                <div className="bg-white dark:bg-gradient-to-br dark:from-rose-900 dark:via-slate-900 dark:to-pink-950 p-6 rounded-3xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-transparent text-slate-900 dark:text-white shadow-xs dark:shadow-xl space-y-4">
                  <span className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-rose-700 dark:text-rose-300">
                    Tổng số ngày cách biệt
                  </span>

                  <div className="flex items-baseline gap-2">
                    <span className="text-4xl sm:text-6xl font-black font-mono tracking-tight text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
                      {diffResult.totalDays.toLocaleString()}
                    </span>
                    <span className="text-sm font-semibold text-slate-700 dark:text-rose-200">ngày</span>
                  </div>

                  <p className="text-xs text-slate-600 dark:text-rose-200 pt-2 border-t border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800">
                    Tương đương: <strong className="text-slate-900 dark:text-white">{diffResult.weeks} tuần</strong> và <strong className="text-slate-900 dark:text-white">{diffResult.remainingDays} ngày</strong>.
                  </p>
                </div>

                <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                  <div className="bg-slate-50 p-4 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200">
                    <span className="text-xs text-slate-500 block mb-1 flex items-center gap-1">
                      <Briefcase className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-blue-600" /> Ngày làm việc (T2-T6)
                    </span>
                    <span className="text-2xl font-black text-blue-600 font-mono">
                      {diffResult.businessDays} ngày
                    </span>
                    <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-400 mt-1">Đã loại trừ Thứ 7 &amp; Chủ Nhật</p>
                  </div>

                  <div className="bg-slate-50 p-4 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200">
                    <span className="text-xs text-slate-500 block mb-1 flex items-center gap-1">
                      <Clock className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-amber-600" /> Tổng số giờ
                    </span>
                    <span className="text-2xl font-black text-slate-900 font-mono">
                      {diffResult.hours.toLocaleString()} h
                    </span>
                    <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-400 mt-1">={diffResult.minutes.toLocaleString()} phút</p>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Mode 2: Add/Subtract */}
      {tab === 'add_subtract' && (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6">
          <div className="lg:col-span-6 bg-slate-50 p-5 rounded-3xl border border-slate-200 space-y-4">
            <h3 className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 uppercase tracking-wider">
              Cộng hoặc trừ ngày từ mốc ban đầu
            </h3>

            <div className="text-xs">
              <label className="text-slate-600 font-semibold block mb-1">Mốc ngày gốc:</label>
              <input
                type="date"
                value={baseDate}
                onChange={(e) => setBaseDate(e.target.value)}
                className="w-full p-2.5 bg-white border border-slate-300 rounded-xl font-bold text-sm text-slate-900"
              />
            </div>

            <div className="flex gap-2 text-xs">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setOp('add')}
                className={`flex-1 py-2 rounded-xl font-bold flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 ${
                  op === 'add' ? 'bg-rose-600 text-white' : 'bg-white border border-slate-200 text-slate-700'

                type="button"

                className={`flex-1 py-2 rounded-xl font-bold flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 ${
                  op === 'subtract' ? 'bg-rose-600 text-white' : 'bg-white border border-slate-200 text-slate-700'
                }`}
              >
                <Minus className="w-4 h-4" /> Trừ lùi quá khứ (-)
              </button>
            </div>

            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-4 gap-2 text-xs">
              <div>

                <input
                  type="number"

                  max={100}
                  value={addYears}
                  onChange={(e) => setAddYears(Number(e.target.value))}
                  className="w-full p-2 bg-white border border-slate-300 rounded-xl font-bold"
                />
              </div>
              <div>
                <label className="text-slate-600 font-semibold block mb-1">Tháng:</label>
                <input
                  type="number"

                  className="w-full p-2 bg-white border border-slate-300 rounded-xl font-bold"
                />
              </div>
              <div>
                <label className="text-slate-600 font-semibold block mb-1">Tuần:</label>
                <input

                />
              </div>
              <div>
                <label className="text-slate-600 font-semibold block mb-1">Ngày:</label>
                <input
                  type="number"
                  min={0}
                  max={3650}
                  value={addDays}
                  onChange={(e) => setAddDays(Number(e.target.value))}
                  className="w-full p-2 bg-white border border-slate-300 rounded-xl font-bold"
                />
              </div>

          </div>

          <div className="lg:col-span-6 space-y-4">

                </div>

                  <span className="text-slate-600 dark:text-rose-200">Thứ trong tuần:</span>
                  <span className="font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white text-sm">{calcDateResult.dayOfWeek}</span>
                </div>

            )}

};


================================================================================
FILE: /src/components/tools/DiscountCalculator.tsx

import React, { useState, useMemo, useEffect } from 'react';
import {
  Tag,
  Check,
  Copy
} from 'lucide-react';
import { useCurrency } from '../../context/CurrencyContext';
import { CurrencySelector } from '../common/CurrencySelector';

export const DiscountCalculator: React.FC = () => {
  const { currency, currencyInfo, formatMoney } = useCurrency();

  // Base price in current currency (Base = $100 USD)
  const [originalPrice, setOriginalPrice] = useState<number>(() => {
    return currency === 'VND' ? 500000 : 100;
  });
  const [discountPercent, setDiscountPercent] = useState<number>(30);
  const [extraDiscountPercent, setExtraDiscountPercent] = useState<number>(10);
  const [enableExtraDiscount, setEnableExtraDiscount] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const taxPercent = 0;
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState<boolean>(false);

  // Sync default price when switching between VND and international
  useEffect(() => {
    setOriginalPrice((prev) => {
      if (currency === 'VND' && prev < 1000) return 500000;
      if (currency !== 'VND' && prev >= 10000) return 100;
      return prev;
    });
  }, [currency]);

  const calculations = useMemo(() => {
    // 1. First discount
    const firstDiscountAmount = (originalPrice * discountPercent) / 100;
    const priceAfterFirst = originalPrice - firstDiscountAmount;

    // 2. Extra discount (stacked on discounted price)
    let extraDiscountAmount = 0;
    if (enableExtraDiscount) {
      extraDiscountAmount = (priceAfterFirst * extraDiscountPercent) / 100;
    }
    const priceAfterDiscounts = priceAfterFirst - extraDiscountAmount;

    // Helper to round based on currency decimal precision
    const roundCurr = (val: number) => {
      return currencyInfo.decimals === 0 ? Math.round(val) : Number(val.toFixed(currencyInfo.decimals));
    };

    // 3. Tax / VAT
    const taxAmount = (priceAfterDiscounts * taxPercent) / 100;
    const finalPrice = roundCurr(priceAfterDiscounts + taxAmount);

    const totalSavings = roundCurr(originalPrice - priceAfterDiscounts);
    const effectiveDiscountPercent = originalPrice > 0 
      ? Number(((totalSavings / originalPrice) * 100).toFixed(1)) 
      : 0;

    return {
      firstDiscountAmount: roundCurr(firstDiscountAmount),
      extraDiscountAmount: roundCurr(extraDiscountAmount),
      taxAmount: roundCurr(taxAmount),
      finalPrice,
      totalSavings,
      effectiveDiscountPercent
    };
  }, [originalPrice, discountPercent, extraDiscountPercent, enableExtraDiscount, taxPercent, currencyInfo.decimals]);

  const handleCopy = () => {
    const text = `Tính giá khuyến mãi:
- Giá gốc: ${formatMoney(originalPrice)}
- Mức giảm giá: ${discountPercent}% ${enableExtraDiscount ? `+ giảm thêm ${extraDiscountPercent}%` : ''}
- Số tiền tiết kiệm: ${formatMoney(calculations.totalSavings)} (giảm ${calculations.effectiveDiscountPercent}%)
- Giá thực tế phải trả: ${formatMoney(calculations.finalPrice)}`;
    navigator.clipboard?.writeText(text);
    setCopied(true);
    setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 2000);
  };

  const pricePresets = useMemo(() => {
    if (currency === 'VND') {
      return [
        { label: '100k', val: 100000 },
        { label: '250k', val: 250000 },
        { label: '500k', val: 500000 },
        { label: '1 Triệu', val: 1000000 },
        { label: '2 Triệu', val: 2000000 },
      ];
    }
    return [
      { label: `${currencyInfo.symbol}25`, val: 25 },
      { label: `${currencyInfo.symbol}50`, val: 50 },
      { label: `${currencyInfo.symbol}100`, val: 100 },
      { label: `${currencyInfo.symbol}250`, val: 250 },
      { label: `${currencyInfo.symbol}500`, val: 500 },
    ];
  }, [currency, currencyInfo.symbol]);

  return (
    <div id="discount-calculator" className="p-4 sm:p-7 space-y-6">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-3 pb-5 border-b border-slate-200">
        <div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <span className="p-2 rounded-xl bg-pink-50 text-pink-600 border border-pink-100">
              <Tag className="w-5 h-5" />
            </span>
            <h2 className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-black text-slate-900 tracking-tight">
              Discount Calculator (Tính Giảm Giá)
            </h2>
          </div>
          <p className="text-xs sm:text-sm text-slate-500 mt-1">
            Tính toán giá sau giảm, chiết khấu kép (mã voucher thêm) và số tiền thực tế bạn tiết kiệm được.
          </p>
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <CurrencySelector variant="compact" />
          <button
            onClick={handleCopy}
            className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3.5 py-2 text-xs font-semibold rounded-xl bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 text-slate-700 transition-colors active:scale-95 cursor-pointer"
          >
            {copied ? <Check className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-600" /> : <Copy className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-500" />}
            <span>{copied ? 'Đã sao chép' : 'Sao chép kết quả'}</span>
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6">
        {/* Left Inputs */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-6 space-y-4">
          {/* 1. Original Price */}
          <div className="bg-slate-50 p-5 rounded-3xl border border-slate-200 space-y-3">
            <div className="flex justify-between items-center">
              <label className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 uppercase tracking-wider">
                Giá niêm yết ban đầu ({currencyInfo.symbol} {currencyInfo.code})
              </label>
              <span className="text-xs font-bold text-pink-600 font-mono">
                {formatMoney(originalPrice)}
              </span>
            </div>

            <div className="relative">
              <span className="absolute left-4 top-3 text-slate-400 font-bold">{currencyInfo.symbol}</span>
              <input
                type="number"
                min={0}
                step={currency === 'VND' ? 10000 : 5}
                value={originalPrice}
                onChange={(e) => setOriginalPrice(Math.max(0, Number(e.target.value)))}
                className="w-full pl-9 pr-14 py-2.5 bg-white border border-slate-300 rounded-2xl text-lg font-black text-slate-900 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-pink-500 outline-none"
              />
              <span className="absolute right-4 top-3 text-slate-400 font-bold text-xs">{currencyInfo.code}</span>
            </div>

            <div className="flex gap-1.5 overflow-x-auto pt-1">
              {pricePresets.map((p) => (
                <button
                  key={p.val}
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setOriginalPrice(p.val)}
                  className={`text-[11px] px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg border font-semibold transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                    originalPrice === p.val
                      ? 'bg-blue-600 text-white border-blue-600'
                      : 'bg-white text-slate-600 border-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-100'
                  }`}
                >
                  {p.label}
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* 2. Primary Discount Percent */}
          <div className="bg-slate-50 p-5 rounded-3xl border border-slate-200 space-y-3">
            <div className="flex justify-between items-center">
              <label className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 uppercase tracking-wider">
                Mức giảm giá chính
              </label>
              <span className="text-sm font-black text-slate-900 font-mono">
                {discountPercent}%
              </span>
            </div>

            <input
              type="range"
              min={0}
              max={99}
              step={1}
              value={discountPercent}
              onChange={(e) => setDiscountPercent(Number(e.target.value))}
              className="w-full accent-blue-600 cursor-pointer"
            />

            <div className="grid grid-cols-5 gap-1.5 pt-1">
              {[10, 20, 30, 50, 70].map(p => (
                <button
                  key={p}
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setDiscountPercent(p)}
                  className={`py-1.5 text-xs rounded-xl font-bold transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                    discountPercent === p ? 'bg-blue-600 text-white shadow-xs' : 'bg-white border border-slate-200 text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-100'
                  }`}
                >
                  {p}%
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* 3. Extra Voucher Stack */}
          <div className="bg-slate-50 p-5 rounded-3xl border border-slate-200 space-y-3">
            <label className="flex items-center justify-between cursor-pointer select-none">
              <span className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 uppercase tracking-wider">
                Áp dụng thêm mã giảm giá thứ 2 (Voucher / Thẻ thành viên)
              </span>
              <input
                type="checkbox"
                checked={enableExtraDiscount}
                onChange={(e) => setEnableExtraDiscount(e.target.checked)}
                className="w-4 h-4 rounded text-pink-600 accent-pink-600 cursor-pointer"
              />
            </label>

            {enableExtraDiscount && (
              <div className="space-y-3 pt-2 border-t border-slate-200 animate-in fade-in">
                <div className="flex justify-between items-center">
                  <span className="text-xs text-slate-500">Giảm thêm:</span>
                  <span className="text-xs font-bold text-purple-600 font-mono">{extraDiscountPercent}%</span>
                </div>
                <div className="grid grid-cols-4 gap-1.5">
                  {[5, 10, 15, 20].map(p => (
                    <button
                      key={p}
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => setExtraDiscountPercent(p)}
                      className={`py-1.5 text-xs rounded-xl font-bold cursor-pointer transition-all ${
                        extraDiscountPercent === p ? 'bg-blue-600 text-white shadow-xs' : 'bg-white border border-slate-200 text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-100'
                      }`}
                    >
                      {p}%
                    </button>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Right Output */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-6 space-y-4">
          {/* Main Price Card */}
          <div className="hero-result-card bg-white dark:bg-gradient-to-br dark:from-pink-900 dark:via-slate-900 dark:to-rose-950 p-6 rounded-3xl text-slate-900 dark:text-white border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 shadow-xl space-y-4">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <span className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-pink-700 dark:text-pink-300">
                Giá thực tế phải trả (Final Price)
              </span>
              <span className="px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-bold bg-pink-50 dark:bg-pink-500/20 text-pink-700 dark:text-pink-300 border border-pink-200 dark:border-pink-500/30">
                Tiết kiệm {calculations.effectiveDiscountPercent}%
              </span>
            </div>

            <div className="flex items-baseline gap-2">
              <span className="text-3xl sm:text-5xl font-black font-mono tracking-tight text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
                {formatMoney(calculations.finalPrice)}
              </span>
            </div>

            <div className="p-3 rounded-2xl bg-slate-50 dark:bg-white/10 border border-slate-200 dark:border-white/20 text-xs flex justify-between items-center">
              <span className="text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300">Số tiền bạn tiết kiệm được:</span>
              <span className="font-bold text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400 text-sm font-mono">
                {formatMoney(calculations.totalSavings)}
              </span>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Breakdown stats */}
          <div className="bg-slate-50 p-5 rounded-3xl border border-slate-200 space-y-3">
            <span className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 uppercase tracking-wider block">
              Chi tiết các khoản giảm
            </span>

            <div className="space-y-2 text-xs">
              <div className="flex justify-between items-center p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-white border border-slate-200">
                <span className="text-slate-600">Giá niêm yết ban đầu:</span>
                <span className="font-bold text-slate-800 font-mono">{formatMoney(originalPrice)}</span>
              </div>
              <div className="flex justify-between items-center p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-white border border-slate-200">
                <span className="text-slate-600">Giảm đợt 1 ({discountPercent}%):</span>
                <span className="font-bold text-pink-600 font-mono">-{formatMoney(calculations.firstDiscountAmount)}</span>
              </div>
              {enableExtraDiscount && (
                <div className="flex justify-between items-center p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-white border border-slate-200">
                  <span className="text-slate-600">Voucher bổ sung ({extraDiscountPercent}%):</span>
                  <span className="font-bold text-purple-600 font-mono">-{formatMoney(calculations.extraDiscountAmount)}</span>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};


================================================================================
FILE: /src/components/tools/ExponentCalculator.tsx
================================================================================
import React, { useState, useMemo } from 'react';
import { Superscript, RotateCcw } from 'lucide-react';

export const ExponentCalculator: React.FC = () => {
  const [base, setBase] = useState<number>(2);
  const [exponent, setExponent] = useState<number>(8);

  const calculations = useMemo(() => {
    const b = base;
    const exp = exponent;

    let result = 0;
    let isUndefined = false;

    if (b === 0 && exp <= 0) {
      isUndefined = true;
    } else {
      result = Math.pow(b, exp);
    }

    return {
      isUndefined,
      result,
      scientific: result.toExponential(4)
    };
  }, [base, exponent]);

  return (
    <div className="w-full max-w-4xl mx-auto space-y-6">
      <div className="p-4 sm:p-6 rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-r from-blue-900/40 via-slate-800 to-slate-900 border border-blue-500/30 flex items-center justify-between">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <div className="p-3 bg-blue-600/20 text-blue-400 rounded-xl border border-blue-500/30">
            <Superscript className="w-6 h-6" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <h1 className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-bold text-white tracking-tight">Exponent Calculator – Máy Tính Lũy Thừa</h1>
            <p className="text-xs sm:text-sm text-slate-400">Tính giá trị lũy thừa x^y với số mũ nguyên dương, nguyên âm hoặc số thập phân</p>
          </div>
        </div>
        <button
          id="exponent-reset-btn"
          onClick={() => { setBase(2); setExponent(8); }}
          className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs text-slate-300 hover:text-white bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 border border-slate-700 rounded-lg transition-colors cursor-pointer"
        >
          <RotateCcw className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
          <span>Đặt lại</span>
        </button>
      </div>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6">
        <div className="lg:col-span-5 space-y-4 bg-slate-900/80 p-5 rounded-2xl border border-slate-800">
          <h2 className="text-base font-semibold text-white">Nhập cơ số & số mũ</h2>

          <div>
            <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-300 mb-1">Cơ số (Base x)</label>
            <input
              id="exp-base"
              type="number"
              value={base}
              onChange={(e) => setBase(Number(e.target.value))}
              className="w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-white font-sans focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 outline-none"
            />
          </div>

          <div>
            <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-300 mb-1">Số mũ (Exponent y)</label>
            <input
              id="exp-exponent"
              type="number"
              value={exponent}
              onChange={(e) => setExponent(Number(e.target.value))}
              className="w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-white font-sans focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 outline-none"
            />
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="lg:col-span-7 space-y-4">
          {calculations.isUndefined ? (
            <div className="p-6 rounded-2xl bg-rose-950/40 border border-rose-500/40 text-rose-200 text-sm">
              Không xác định (0^0 hoặc 0 với số mũ âm không có nghĩa trong toán học).
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div className="p-6 rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-b from-blue-950/40 to-slate-900 border border-blue-500/40 text-center space-y-3">
              <span className="text-xs uppercase tracking-wider text-blue-300 font-semibold">
                {base} ^ {exponent}
              </span>
              <div className="text-4xl sm:text-5xl font-extrabold text-blue-400 font-sans tabular-nums break-all">
                {Math.abs(calculations.result) > 1e12 || (Math.abs(calculations.result) < 1e-4 && calculations.result !== 0)
                  ? calculations.scientific
                  : calculations.result.toLocaleString()}
              </div>
              <p className="text-xs text-slate-400">
                Ký hiệu khoa học (Scientific): <span className="text-white font-mono">{calculations.scientific}</span>
              </p>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};


================================================================================
FILE: /src/components/tools/FinanceCalculator.tsx
================================================================================
import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { Sliders, DollarSign, RotateCcw } from 'lucide-react';
import { useCurrency } from '../../context/CurrencyContext';
import { CurrencySelector } from '../common/CurrencySelector';

type SolveTarget = 'fv' | 'pv' | 'pmt' | 'n' | 'rate';

export const FinanceCalculator: React.FC = () => {
  const { currency, currencyInfo, formatMoney } = useCurrency();

  const [solveFor, setSolveFor] = useState<SolveTarget>('fv');
  const [periods, setPeriods] = useState<number>(60); // N
  const [interestRate, setInterestRate] = useState<number>(6.0); // I/Y (%)
  const [presentValue, setPresentValue] = useState<number>(() => {
    return currency === 'VND' ? -250000000 : -10000;
  }); // PV
  const [payment, setPayment] = useState<number>(() => {
    return currency === 'VND' ? -5000000 : -200;
  }); // PMT
  const [futureValue, setFutureValue] = useState<number>(0); // FV
  const [timing, setTiming] = useState<'end' | 'beginning'>('end');

  // Synchronize defaults on currency switch
  useEffect(() => {
    if (currency === 'VND') {
      setPresentValue((prev) => (Math.abs(prev) < 100000 ? -250000000 : prev));
      setPayment((prev) => (Math.abs(prev) < 5000 ? -5000000 : prev));
    } else {
      setPresentValue((prev) => (Math.abs(prev) >= 1000000 ? -10000 : prev));
      setPayment((prev) => (Math.abs(prev) >= 50000 ? -200 : prev));
    }
  }, [currency]);

  // Compute solved value
  const solvedResult = React.useMemo(() => {
    const r = (interestRate / 100) / 12; // monthly rate
    const n = periods;
    const pv = presentValue;
    const pmt = payment;
    const type = timing === 'beginning' ? 1 : 0;

    try {
      if (solveFor === 'fv') {
        if (r === 0) {
          return -(pv + pmt * n);
        }
        const fv = - (pv * Math.pow(1 + r, n) + pmt * (1 + r * type) * ((Math.pow(1 + r, n) - 1) / r));
        return fv;
      } else if (solveFor === 'pv') {
        if (r === 0) {
          return -(futureValue + pmt * n);
        }
        const pvCalc = - (futureValue + pmt * (1 + r * type) * ((Math.pow(1 + r, n) - 1) / r)) / Math.pow(1 + r, n);
        return pvCalc;
      } else if (solveFor === 'pmt') {
        if (r === 0) {
          return -(futureValue + pv) / n;
        }
        const pmtCalc = - (futureValue + pv * Math.pow(1 + r, n)) / ((1 + r * type) * ((Math.pow(1 + r, n) - 1) / r));
        return pmtCalc;
      } else if (solveFor === 'n') {
        if (r === 0) {
          return -(futureValue + pv) / pmt;
        }
        const num = (futureValue * r - pmt * (1 + r * type)) / (-pv * r - pmt * (1 + r * type));
        if (num <= 0) return 0;
        return Math.log(num) / Math.log(1 + r);
      } else if (solveFor === 'rate') {
        // Newton-Raphson approximation for rate
        let guess = 0.05 / 12;
        for (let i = 0; i < 20; i++) {
          const f = pv * Math.pow(1 + guess, n) + pmt * (1 + guess * type) * ((Math.pow(1 + guess, n) - 1) / guess) + futureValue;
          const df = n * pv * Math.pow(1 + guess, n - 1) + pmt * ((Math.pow(1 + guess, n) - 1) / guess);
          const nextGuess = guess - f / (df || 1);
          if (Math.abs(nextGuess - guess) < 1e-6) {
            guess = nextGuess;
            break;
          }
          guess = nextGuess;
        }
        return guess * 12 * 100;
      }
    } catch (e) {
      return 0;
    }
    return 0;
  }, [solveFor, periods, interestRate, presentValue, payment, futureValue, timing]);

  const formatNumber = (num: number, decimals = 2) => {
    return new Intl.NumberFormat('en-US', { maximumFractionDigits: decimals }).format(num);
  };

  const handleReset = () => {
    setPeriods(60);
    setInterestRate(6.0);
    setPresentValue(currency === 'VND' ? -250000000 : -10000);
    setPayment(currency === 'VND' ? -5000000 : -200);
    setFutureValue(0);
    setTiming('end');
  };

  return (
    <div className="w-full max-w-5xl mx-auto space-y-6">
      <div className="tool-header-banner p-4 sm:p-6 rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-r from-emerald-950/40 via-slate-800 to-slate-900 border border-emerald-500/30 flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-3">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <div className="banner-icon-box p-3 bg-emerald-600/20 text-emerald-400 rounded-xl border border-emerald-500/30">
            <Sliders className="w-6 h-6" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <h1 className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-bold text-white tracking-tight">Finance Calculator – Máy Tính Tài Chính Tổng Hợp (TVM)</h1>
            <p className="text-xs sm:text-sm text-slate-400">Giải phương trình Giá trị thời gian của tiền tệ (Time Value of Money: PV, FV, PMT, N, Rate)</p>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <CurrencySelector variant="compact" />
          <button
            id="finance-reset-btn"
            onClick={handleReset}
            className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs text-slate-300 hover:text-white bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 border border-slate-700 rounded-lg transition-colors cursor-pointer"
          >
            <RotateCcw className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            <span>Đặt lại</span>
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Target selector buttons */}
      <div className="bg-slate-900/80 p-4 rounded-2xl border border-slate-800 space-y-2">
        <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-300 uppercase tracking-wider block">Chọn đại lượng bạn cần tìm:</span>
        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-5 gap-2">
          {[
            { id: 'fv', label: 'Tương lai (FV)', desc: 'Future Value' },
            { id: 'pv', label: 'Hiện tại (PV)', desc: 'Present Value' },
            { id: 'pmt', label: 'Kỳ trả (PMT)', desc: 'Payment' },
            { id: 'n', label: 'Số kỳ (N)', desc: 'Number of periods' },
            { id: 'rate', label: 'Lãi suất (I/Y)', desc: 'Interest rate' },
          ].map((item) => (
            <button
              key={item.id}
              id={`solve-for-${item.id}`}
              onClick={() => setSolveFor(item.id as SolveTarget)}
              className={`p-3 rounded-xl border text-left transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                solveFor === item.id
                  ? 'bg-blue-600 border-blue-400 text-white shadow-lg shadow-blue-600/30 ring-1 ring-blue-300'
                  : 'bg-slate-800/80 border-slate-700 text-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-700'
              }`}
            >
              <span className="block font-bold text-xs sm:text-sm">{item.label}</span>
              <span className="text-[10px] opacity-75">{item.desc}</span>
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6">
        {/* Form Inputs */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-6 space-y-4 bg-slate-900/80 p-5 rounded-2xl border border-slate-800">
          <h2 className="text-base font-semibold text-white flex items-center gap-2">
            <DollarSign className="w-4 h-4 text-blue-400" />
            Nhập các thông số đã biết ({currencyInfo.symbol} {currencyInfo.code})
          </h2>

          {solveFor !== 'n' && (
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-300 mb-1">Số kỳ hạn (N - Tháng/Kỳ)</label>
              <input
                id="tvm-n"
                type="number"
                value={periods}
                onChange={(e) => setPeriods(Number(e.target.value))}
                className="w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-white font-sans focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 outline-none"
              />
            </div>
          )}

          {solveFor !== 'rate' && (
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-300 mb-1">Lãi suất hàng năm (I/Y - %/năm)</label>
              <input
                id="tvm-rate"
                type="number"
                step="0.01"
                value={interestRate}
                onChange={(e) => setInterestRate(Number(e.target.value))}
                className="w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-white font-sans focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 outline-none"
              />
            </div>
          )}

          {solveFor !== 'pv' && (
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-300 mb-1">
                Giá trị hiện tại (PV - âm nếu là tiền đầu tư/gửi ra) ({currencyInfo.symbol})
              </label>
              <input
                id="tvm-pv"
                type="number"
                step={currency === 'VND' ? 5000000 : 100}
                value={presentValue}
                onChange={(e) => setPresentValue(Number(e.target.value))}
                className="w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-white font-sans focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 outline-none"
              />
            </div>
          )}

          {solveFor !== 'pmt' && (
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-300 mb-1">
                Thanh toán định kỳ mỗi tháng (PMT) ({currencyInfo.symbol})
              </label>
              <input
                id="tvm-pmt"
                type="number"
                step={currency === 'VND' ? 500000 : 25}
                value={payment}
                onChange={(e) => setPayment(Number(e.target.value))}
                className="w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-white font-sans focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 outline-none"
              />
            </div>
          )}

          {solveFor !== 'fv' && (
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-300 mb-1">
                Giá trị tương lai (FV) ({currencyInfo.symbol})
              </label>
              <input
                id="tvm-fv"
                type="number"
                step={currency === 'VND' ? 5000000 : 100}
                value={futureValue}
                onChange={(e) => setFutureValue(Number(e.target.value))}
                className="w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-white font-sans focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 outline-none"
              />
            </div>
          )}

          <div>
            <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-300 mb-1">Thời điểm trả lãi/gửi tiền</label>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
              <button
                type="button"
                id="timing-end"
                onClick={() => setTiming('end')}
                className={`py-2 px-3 text-xs rounded-xl border font-medium transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                  timing === 'end' ? 'bg-blue-600 text-white border-blue-500 font-bold' : 'bg-slate-800 text-slate-400 border-slate-700'
                }`}
              >
                Cuối kỳ (End / Ordinary)
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                id="timing-beginning"
                onClick={() => setTiming('beginning')}
                className={`py-2 px-3 text-xs rounded-xl border font-medium transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                  timing === 'beginning' ? 'bg-blue-600 text-white border-blue-500 font-bold' : 'bg-slate-800 text-slate-400 border-slate-700'
                }`}
              >
                Đầu kỳ (Beginning / Due)
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Result */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-6 space-y-4">
          <div className="tool-hero-banner p-6 rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-b from-emerald-950/30 to-slate-900 border border-emerald-500/40 text-center space-y-3">
            <span className="text-xs uppercase tracking-wider text-emerald-400 font-semibold">
              KẾT QUẢ ĐẠI LƯỢNG {solveFor.toUpperCase()}
            </span>
            <div className="text-3xl sm:text-5xl font-extrabold text-emerald-400 font-sans tabular-nums">
              {solveFor === 'rate' 
                ? `${formatNumber(solvedResult, 2)}% /năm`
                : solveFor === 'n'
                ? `${formatNumber(solvedResult, 1)} kỳ`
                : formatMoney(Math.abs(solvedResult))}
            </div>
            <p className="text-xs text-slate-400">
              {solveFor === 'fv' && 'Giá trị tài sản tích lũy được trong tương lai sau thời hạn N.'}
              {solveFor === 'pv' && 'Giá trị quy đổi về thời điểm hiện tại của dòng tiền tương lai.'}
              {solveFor === 'pmt' && 'Khoản thanh toán cố định cần trả hoặc gửi định kỳ mỗi tháng.'}
              {solveFor === 'n' && 'Thời gian (số tháng) cần thiết để đạt mục tiêu tài chính.'}
              {solveFor === 'rate' && 'Tỷ suất lợi nhuận nội bộ hàng năm tương ứng.'}
            </p>
          </div>

          <div className="p-4 rounded-xl bg-slate-800/50 border border-slate-700 text-xs text-slate-300 space-y-2">
            <div className="font-semibold text-slate-200">Quy ước dấu dòng tiền (+ / -):</div>
            <ul className="list-disc list-inside space-y-1 text-slate-400">
              <li>Dấu âm (-): Tiền bạn bỏ ra (chi tiền, nạp tiền gửi tiết kiệm, đầu tư).</li>
              <li>Dấu dương (+): Tiền bạn thu về (nhận lại tiền, vay được tiền).</li>
            </ul>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};


================================================================================
FILE: /src/components/tools/FractionCalculator.tsx

import React, { useState, useMemo, useRef, useEffect } from 'react';
import {
  Divide,
  RotateCcw,
  Plus,
  Minus,
  X,
  ChevronDown
} from 'lucide-react';

export const FractionCalculator: React.FC = () => {
  const [num1, setNum1] = useState<number>(3);
  const [den1, setDen1] = useState<number>(4);
  const [num2, setNum2] = useState<number>(2);
  const [den2, setDen2] = useState<number>(5);
  const [operation, setOperation] = useState<'+' | '-' | '*' | '/'>('+');
  const [isOpMenuOpen, setIsOpMenuOpen] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const opMenuRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  // Close operator menu when clicking outside
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleClickOutside = (event: MouseEvent) => {
      if (opMenuRef.current && !opMenuRef.current.contains(event.target as Node)) {
        setIsOpMenuOpen(false);
      }
    };
    document.addEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
    return () => document.removeEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
  }, []);

  const opList: { id: '+' | '-' | '*' | '/'; symbol: string; label: string; desc: string }[] = [
    { id: '+', symbol: '+', label: 'Cộng (+)', desc: 'Phép cộng phân số' },
    { id: '-', symbol: '−', label: 'Trừ (−)', desc: 'Phép trừ phân số' },
    { id: '*', symbol: '×', label: 'Nhân (×)', desc: 'Phép nhân phân số' },
    { id: '/', symbol: '÷', label: 'Chia (÷)', desc: 'Phép chia phân số' },
  ];

  const gcd = (a: number, b: number): number => {
    return b === 0 ? Math.abs(a) : gcd(b, a % b);
  };

  const calculations = useMemo(() => {
    const d1 = den1 === 0 ? 1 : den1;
    const d2 = den2 === 0 ? 1 : den2;
    const n1 = num1;
    const n2 = num2;

    let resNum = 0;
    let resDen = 1;
    let steps: string[] = [];

    if (operation === '+') {
      resNum = n1 * d2 + n2 * d1;
      resDen = d1 * d2;
      steps = [
        `Quy đồng mẫu số: ${n1}/${d1} = (${n1} × ${d2}) / (${d1} × ${d2}) = ${n1 * d2}/${d1 * d2}`,
        `Quy đồng mẫu số: ${n2}/${d2} = (${n2} × ${d1}) / (${d2} × ${d1}) = ${n2 * d1}/${d1 * d2}`,
        `Cộng tử số: (${n1 * d2} + ${n2 * d1}) / ${d1 * d2} = ${resNum}/${resDen}`
      ];
    } else if (operation === '-') {
      resNum = n1 * d2 - n2 * d1;
      resDen = d1 * d2;
      steps = [
        `Quy đồng mẫu số: ${n1}/${d1} = (${n1} × ${d2}) / (${d1} × ${d2}) = ${n1 * d2}/${d1 * d2}`,
        `Quy đồng mẫu số: ${n2}/${d2} = (${n2} × ${d1}) / (${d2} × ${d1}) = ${n2 * d1}/${d1 * d2}`,
        `Trừ tử số: (${n1 * d2} - ${n2 * d1}) / ${d1 * d2} = ${resNum}/${resDen}`
      ];
    } else if (operation === '*') {
      resNum = n1 * n2;
      resDen = d1 * d2;
      steps = [
        `Nhân tử với tử: ${n1} × ${n2} = ${resNum}`,
        `Nhân mẫu với mẫu: ${d1} × ${d2} = ${resDen}`,
        `Phân số kết quả: ${resNum}/${resDen}`
      ];
    } else if (operation === '/') {
      resNum = n1 * d2;
      resDen = d1 * n2;
      steps = [
        `Đảo ngược phân số thứ hai: ${d2}/${n2}`,
        `Nhân với phân số nghịch đảo: (${n1} × ${d2}) / (${d1} × ${n2}) = ${resNum}/${resDen}`
      ];
    }

    // Simplification
    const common = gcd(resNum, resDen);
    let simpNum = resNum / (common || 1);
    let simpDen = resDen / (common || 1);

    if (simpDen < 0) {
      simpNum = -simpNum;
      simpDen = -simpDen;
    }

    // Mixed number
    const whole = Math.floor(Math.abs(simpNum) / simpDen);
    const remainder = Math.abs(simpNum) % simpDen;
    const isNegative = simpNum < 0;

    if (whole > 0 && remainder > 0) {
      steps.push(`Chuyển phân số lớn hơn 1 sang dạng hỗn số: ${simpNum}/${simpDen} = ${isNegative ? '-' : ''}${whole} và ${remainder}/${simpDen}`);
    }

    return {
      rawNum: resNum,
      rawDen: resDen,
      simpNum,
      simpDen,
      decimal: resDen !== 0 ? resNum / resDen : 0,
      whole,
      remainder,
      isNegative,
      steps
    };
  }, [num1, den1, num2, den2, operation]);

  const currentOpSymbol = useMemo(() => {
    switch (operation) {
      case '+': return '+';
      case '-': return '−';
      case '*': return '×';
      case '/': return '÷';
    }
  }, [operation]);

  return (
    <div className="w-full max-w-4xl mx-auto space-y-6">
      <div className="p-4 sm:p-6 rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-r from-blue-900/40 via-slate-800 to-slate-900 border border-blue-500/30 flex items-center justify-between">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <div className="p-3 bg-blue-600/20 text-blue-400 rounded-xl border border-blue-500/30">
            <Divide className="w-6 h-6" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <h1 className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-bold text-white tracking-tight">Fraction Calculator – Máy Tính Phân Số</h1>
            <p className="text-xs sm:text-sm text-slate-400">Cộng, trừ, nhân, chia phân số với các bước rút gọn tối giản và đổi sang hỗn số</p>
          </div>
        </div>
        <button
          id="fraction-reset-btn"
          onClick={() => { setNum1(3); setDen1(4); setNum2(2); setDen2(5); setOperation('+'); }}
          className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs text-slate-300 hover:text-white bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 border border-slate-700 rounded-lg transition-colors cursor-pointer"
        >
          <RotateCcw className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
          <span>Đặt lại</span>
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* Main Interactive Expression Box */}
      <div className="p-6 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900/90 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 shadow-sm flex flex-wrap items-center justify-center gap-4 sm:gap-6">
        {/* Fraction 1 */}
        <div className="flex flex-col items-center w-24">
          <input
            id="fraction-num1"
            type="number"
            value={num1}
            onChange={(e) => setNum1(Number(e.target.value))}
            className="w-full text-center py-2 bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-lg text-slate-900 dark:text-white font-bold text-lg font-sans outline-none focus:border-blue-500 shadow-xs"
          />
          <div className="w-full h-0.5 bg-slate-400 dark:bg-slate-500 my-1.5 rounded" />
          <input
            id="fraction-den1"
            type="number"
            value={den1}
            onChange={(e) => setDen1(Number(e.target.value))}
            className="w-full text-center py-2 bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-lg text-slate-900 dark:text-white font-bold text-lg font-sans outline-none focus:border-blue-500 shadow-xs"
          />
        </div>

        {/* Nút mũi tên lựa chọn gom + - * / */}
        <div className="relative" ref={opMenuRef}>
          <button
            type="button"
            id="fraction-op-dropdown-btn"
            onClick={() => setIsOpMenuOpen(!isOpMenuOpen)}
            className="flex items-center justify-center gap-2 px-3.5 py-2 sm:px-4 sm:py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 border-2 border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 hover:border-blue-500 dark:hover:border-blue-500 shadow-sm hover:shadow transition-all cursor-pointer group min-w-[76px]"
            title="Nhấp để chọn phép tính (+, −, ×, ÷)"
            aria-label="Chọn phép tính phân số"
            aria-haspopup="true"
            aria-expanded={isOpMenuOpen}
          >
            <span className="text-2xl font-black text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 select-none leading-none">
              {currentOpSymbol}
            </span>
            <ChevronDown
              className={`w-4 h-4 text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 group-hover:text-blue-600 dark:group-hover:text-blue-400 transition-transform duration-200 ${
                isOpMenuOpen ? 'rotate-180 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400' : ''
              }`}
            />
          </button>

          {/* Menu lựa chọn phép tính */}
          {isOpMenuOpen && (
            <div className="absolute top-full left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 mt-2 z-40 bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-xl shadow-xl p-1.5 min-w-[145px] flex flex-col gap-1 animate-in fade-in zoom-in-95 duration-150">
              {opList.map((op) => {
                const isSelected = operation === op.id;
                return (
                  <button
                    key={op.id}
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => {
                      setOperation(op.id);
                      setIsOpMenuOpen(false);
                    }}
                    className={`flex items-center justify-between gap-3 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg text-sm font-semibold transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                      isSelected
                        ? 'bg-blue-50 dark:bg-blue-900/40 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 border border-blue-200 dark:border-blue-800'
                        : 'text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-700/60'
                    }`}
                  >
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
                      <span className="text-base font-black w-4 text-center leading-none text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400">
                        {op.symbol}
                      </span>
                      <span className="text-xs">{op.label}</span>
                    </div>
                    {isSelected && (
                      <span className="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-blue-600 dark:bg-blue-400" />
                    )}
                  </button>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* Fraction 2 */}
        <div className="flex flex-col items-center w-24">
          <input
            id="fraction-num2"
            type="number"
            value={num2}
            onChange={(e) => setNum2(Number(e.target.value))}
            className="w-full text-center py-2 bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-lg text-slate-900 dark:text-white font-bold text-lg font-sans outline-none focus:border-blue-500 shadow-xs"
          />
          <div className="w-full h-0.5 bg-slate-400 dark:bg-slate-500 my-1.5 rounded" />
          <input
            id="fraction-den2"
            type="number"
            value={den2}
            onChange={(e) => setDen2(Number(e.target.value))}
            className="w-full text-center py-2 bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-lg text-slate-900 dark:text-white font-bold text-lg font-sans outline-none focus:border-blue-500 shadow-xs"
          />
        </div>

        <span className="text-2xl font-bold text-slate-400">=</span>

        {/* Result Fraction */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3 bg-white dark:bg-slate-800/80 p-4 rounded-xl border border-blue-500/40 shadow-xs">
          <div className="flex flex-col items-center min-w-16">
            <span className="text-2xl font-extrabold text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 font-sans tabular-nums">{calculations.simpNum}</span>
            {calculations.simpDen !== 1 && (
              <>
                <div className="w-full h-0.5 bg-blue-500 my-1 rounded" />
                <span className="text-2xl font-extrabold text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 font-sans tabular-nums">{calculations.simpDen}</span>
              </>
            )}
          </div>
          {calculations.whole > 0 && calculations.remainder > 0 && (
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 sm:gap-3 border-l border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 pl-3">
              <span className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-bold text-slate-400 select-none">=</span>
              <div className="flex flex-col">
                <span className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                  Hỗn số:
                </span>
                {/* Mathematical Mixed Number: Whole + Vertical Fraction */}
                <div 
                  className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 font-sans mt-0.5" 
                  title={`Hỗn số: ${calculations.isNegative ? '-' : ''}${calculations.whole} ${calculations.remainder}/${calculations.simpDen}`}
                >
                  <span className="text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-extrabold text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 tabular-nums leading-none">
                    {calculations.isNegative ? '−' : ''}{calculations.whole}
                  </span>
                  <div className="inline-flex flex-col items-center justify-center min-w-[16px] px-0.5">
                    <span className="text-xs sm:text-sm font-bold text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 leading-none pb-0.5 tabular-nums">
                      {calculations.remainder}
                    </span>
                    <div className="w-full min-w-[14px] h-[1.5px] bg-blue-500 dark:bg-blue-400 rounded-full my-0.5" />
                    <span className="text-xs sm:text-sm font-bold text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 leading-none pt-0.5 tabular-nums">
                      {calculations.simpDen}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Steps breakdown */}
      <div className="p-5 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900/80 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 space-y-3 shadow-xs">
        <h2 className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300">Các bước giải thích chi tiết</h2>
        <div className="space-y-2">
          {calculations.steps.map((step, idx) => (
            <div key={idx} className="p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800/50 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700/60 text-xs text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 font-mono">
              Bước {idx + 1}: {step}
            </div>
          ))}
          <div className="p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-blue-50 dark:bg-blue-950/30 border border-blue-200 dark:border-blue-500/30 text-xs text-blue-800 dark:text-blue-200">
            Giá trị số thập phân tương đương: <span className="font-bold font-sans">{calculations.decimal.toFixed(6)}</span>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};


================================================================================
FILE: /src/components/tools/GpaCalculator.tsx
