import React, { useState, useRef, useMemo } from 'react';
import {
  X,
  FileDown,
  Printer,
  Check,
  Loader2,
  LineChart,
  Sparkles,
  CheckCircle2,
  Share2,
  Table as TableIcon
} from 'lucide-react';
import { useLanguage } from '../../context/LanguageContext';
import { exportElementPagesToPdf, PdfExportResult } from '../../utils/pdfExportHelper';
import { KeyPoint } from './geometry/InteractiveGraphPlotter';
import { evaluateExpression } from '../../utils/mathParser';

export interface GraphingPdfModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  mode: 'quadratic' | 'cubic' | 'trigonometric' | 'custom';
  expression: string;
  expression2?: string;
  showSecondExpr?: boolean;
  paramD?: number;
  hasParameterD?: boolean;
  mathAnalysis: {
    title: string;
    formula: string;
    details: { label: string; value: string; note?: string }[];
  };
  keyPoints: KeyPoint[];
  tableData: {
    x: number;
    y1: number;
    y2: number | null;
    diff: number | null;
  }[];
}

export const GraphingPdfModal: React.FC<GraphingPdfModalProps> = ({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  mode,
  expression,
  expression2 = '',
  showSecondExpr = false,
  paramD = 1,
  hasParameterD = false,
  mathAnalysis,
  keyPoints,
  tableData,
}) => {
  const { language } = useLanguage();
  const isVi = language === 'vi';

  const [isExporting, setIsExporting] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [exportProgress, setExportProgress] = useState<string>('');
  const [isDone, setIsDone] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [exportResult, setExportResult] = useState<PdfExportResult | null>(null);

  const printContainerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  const currentDateFormatted = new Date().toLocaleDateString(isVi ? 'vi-VN' : 'en-US', {
    year: 'numeric',
    month: 'long',
    day: 'numeric'
  });

  // Calculate suitable Oxy range for SVG vector plot
  const svgPlot = useMemo(() => {
    // Determine bounds
    let xMin = -6;
    let xMax = 6;
    let yMin = -6;
    let yMax = 6;

    if (keyPoints.length > 0) {
      const validXs = keyPoints.map((p) => p.x).filter((x) => Number.isFinite(x) && Math.abs(x) < 50);
      const validYs = keyPoints.map((p) => p.y).filter((y) => Number.isFinite(y) && Math.abs(y) < 50);
      if (validXs.length > 0 && validYs.length > 0) {
        const minX = Math.min(...validXs);
        const maxX = Math.max(...validXs);
        const minY = Math.min(...validYs);
        const maxY = Math.max(...validYs);

        const padX = Math.max(2, (maxX - minX) * 0.4);
        const padY = Math.max(2, (maxY - minY) * 0.4);

        xMin = Math.floor(Math.min(-4, minX - padX));
        xMax = Math.ceil(Math.max(4, maxX + padX));
        yMin = Math.floor(Math.min(-4, minY - padY));
        yMax = Math.ceil(Math.max(4, maxY + padY));
      }
    }

    // Keep aspect ratio balanced
    const spanX = xMax - xMin;
    const spanY = yMax - yMin;
    if (spanX > spanY * 2) {
      const diff = spanX / 2 - spanY;
      yMin -= Math.round(diff / 2);
      yMax += Math.round(diff / 2);
    } else if (spanY > spanX * 2) {
      const diff = spanY / 2 - spanX;
      xMin -= Math.round(diff / 2);
      xMax += Math.round(diff / 2);
    }

    const svgWidth = 714;
    const svgHeight = 350;
    const pad = 30;
    const plotW = svgWidth - 2 * pad;
    const plotH = svgHeight - 2 * pad;

    const toSvgX = (x: number) => pad + ((x - xMin) / (xMax - xMin)) * plotW;
    const toSvgY = (y: number) => pad + ((yMax - y) / (yMax - yMin)) * plotH;

    // Origin (0,0) in SVG coords
    const originX = toSvgX(0);
    const originY = toSvgY(0);

    // Generate grid lines
    const xTicks: number[] = [];
    const stepX = (xMax - xMin) > 16 ? 2 : 1;
    for (let x = Math.ceil(xMin); x <= Math.floor(xMax); x += stepX) {
      if (x !== 0) xTicks.push(x);
    }

    const yTicks: number[] = [];
    const stepY = (yMax - yMin) > 16 ? 2 : 1;
    for (let y = Math.ceil(yMin); y <= Math.floor(yMax); y += stepY) {
      if (y !== 0) yTicks.push(y);
    }

    // Sample path 1: f(x)
    const samples = 300;
    const stepSample = (xMax - xMin) / samples;
    let path1 = '';
    let isDrawing1 = false;

    for (let i = 0; i <= samples; i++) {
      const x = xMin + i * stepSample;
      try {
        const y = evaluateExpression(expression, x);
        if (Number.isFinite(y) && y >= yMin - 10 && y <= yMax + 10) {
          const sx = toSvgX(x);
          const sy = toSvgY(y);
          if (!isDrawing1) {
            path1 += `M ${sx.toFixed(1)} ${sy.toFixed(1)}`;
            isDrawing1 = true;
          } else {
            path1 += ` L ${sx.toFixed(1)} ${sy.toFixed(1)}`;
          }
        } else {
          isDrawing1 = false;
        }
      } catch {
        isDrawing1 = false;
      }
    }

    // Sample path 2: g(x) if active
    let path2 = '';
    let isDrawing2 = false;
    if (showSecondExpr && expression2) {
      const expr2 = hasParameterD ? expression2.replace(/\bd\b/gi, `(${paramD})`) : expression2;
      for (let i = 0; i <= samples; i++) {
        const x = xMin + i * stepSample;
        try {
          const y = evaluateExpression(expr2, x);
          if (Number.isFinite(y) && y >= yMin - 10 && y <= yMax + 10) {
            const sx = toSvgX(x);
            const sy = toSvgY(y);
            if (!isDrawing2) {
              path2 += `M ${sx.toFixed(1)} ${sy.toFixed(1)}`;
              isDrawing2 = true;
            } else {
              path2 += ` L ${sx.toFixed(1)} ${sy.toFixed(1)}`;
            }
          } else {
            isDrawing2 = false;
          }
        } catch {
          isDrawing2 = false;
        }
      }
    }

    // Keypoints in SVG
    const keyPointSvgs = keyPoints
      .filter((p) => p.x >= xMin && p.x <= xMax && p.y >= yMin && p.y <= yMax)
      .map((p) => ({
        ...p,
        sx: toSvgX(p.x),
        sy: toSvgY(p.y),
      }));

    return {
      svgWidth,
      svgHeight,
      originX,
      originY,
      xMin,
      xMax,
      yMin,
      yMax,
      pad,
      xTicks,
      yTicks,
      toSvgX,
      toSvgY,
      path1,
      path2,
      keyPointSvgs,
    };
  }, [expression, expression2, showSecondExpr, hasParameterD, paramD, keyPoints]);

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const handleExportPDF = async () => {
    if (isExporting || !printContainerRef.current) return;
    try {
      setIsExporting(true);
      setIsDone(false);
      setExportProgress(isVi ? 'Đang chuẩn bị bản vẽ đồ thị & báo cáo...' : 'Preparing mathematical report...');

      const safeName = expression.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9]/g, '_').slice(0, 20);
      const fileName = `Do_Thi_Ham_So_${safeName}_${new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10)}.pdf`;

      const result = await exportElementPagesToPdf(printContainerRef.current, {
        fileName,
        pageSelector: '.pdf-report-page',
        onProgress: (text) => setExportProgress(text),
      });

      setExportResult(result);
      setIsDone(true);
      setTimeout(() => {
        setIsDone(false);
      }, 4000);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Lỗi khi xuất PDF đồ thị hàm số:', err);
      alert(isVi ? 'Có lỗi xảy ra khi tạo file PDF. Vui lòng thử lại.' : 'Error generating PDF. Please retry.');
    } finally {
      setIsExporting(false);
      setExportProgress('');
    }
  };

  const handleNativePrint = () => {
    window.print();
  };

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-black/75 backdrop-blur-sm animate-in fade-in duration-200 print:hidden">
      <div 
        className="w-full max-w-2xl bg-slate-900 border border-slate-700 rounded-2xl shadow-2xl overflow-hidden flex flex-col max-h-[90vh]"
        onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
      >
        {/* Modal Header */}
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between px-5 py-4 border-b border-slate-800 bg-slate-950/60">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
            <div className="p-2 rounded-xl bg-blue-500/20 text-blue-400 border border-blue-500/30">
              <LineChart className="w-5 h-5" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <h3 className="text-base font-bold text-white">
                {isVi ? 'Xuất Hồ Sơ Báo Cáo Đồ Thị Hàm Số (PDF A4)' : 'Export Function Graphing Report (PDF A4)'}
              </h3>
              <p className="text-xs text-slate-400">
                {isVi 
                  ? 'Bản vẽ hệ trục Oxy độ nét cao kèm phân tích đặc trưng toán học và bảng tọa độ điểm' 
                  : 'High-res Cartesian Oxy plot with math analysis and values table'}
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
          <button
            onClick={onClose}
            className="p-1.5 text-slate-400 hover:text-white hover:bg-slate-800 rounded-lg transition-colors cursor-pointer"
          >
            <X className="w-5 h-5" />
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Modal Body Preview Info */}
        <div className="p-5 space-y-4 overflow-y-auto">
          {/* Summary Box */}
          <div className="p-4 rounded-xl bg-slate-800/60 border border-slate-700/80 space-y-2">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-400">Hàm số chính y₁:</span>
              <span className="font-mono text-sm font-bold text-blue-400">y₁ = {expression}</span>
            </div>
            {showSecondExpr && expression2 && (
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-t border-slate-700/60 pt-2">
                <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-400">Đường thứ hai y₂:</span>
                <span className="font-mono text-sm font-bold text-amber-400">
                  y₂ = {hasParameterD ? `${expression2} (d=${paramD})` : expression2}
                </span>
              </div>
            )}
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-t border-slate-700/60 pt-2 text-xs text-slate-300">
              <span>Số điểm đặc trưng nhận diện:</span>
              <span className="font-bold text-white">{keyPoints.length} điểm (Đỉnh / Nghiệm / Cực trị)</span>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Quick Features List */}
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-2 text-xs text-slate-300">
            <div className="p-2.5 rounded-lg bg-slate-800/40 border border-slate-700/60 flex items-center gap-2">
              <Sparkles className="w-4 h-4 text-blue-400 shrink-0" />
              <span>Bản vẽ vector Oxy đen trắng chuẩn in ấn A4</span>
            </div>
            <div className="p-2.5 rounded-lg bg-slate-800/40 border border-slate-700/60 flex items-center gap-2">
              <TableIcon className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-400 shrink-0" />
              <span>Bảng tọa độ giá trị điểm (x, y) chi tiết</span>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Progress / Status */}
          {exportProgress && (
            <div className="p-3 bg-blue-950/60 border border-blue-500/40 rounded-xl flex items-center gap-2.5 text-xs text-blue-300">
              {isExporting ? (
                <Loader2 className="w-4 h-4 animate-spin text-blue-400 shrink-0" />
              ) : isDone ? (
                <Check className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-400 shrink-0" />
              ) : null}
              <span>{exportProgress}</span>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* PDF Ready Links */}
          {exportResult && (
            <div className="p-3 bg-slate-800 border border-slate-600 rounded-xl flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-center justify-between gap-3 text-xs shadow-xs">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-white min-w-0">
                <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4 text-white shrink-0" />
                <span className="font-semibold shrink-0">{isVi ? 'File PDF đã sẵn sàng:' : 'PDF ready:'}</span>
                <span className="font-mono text-[11px] truncate max-w-[170px] text-slate-300">{exportResult.fileName}</span>
              </div>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 w-full sm:w-auto shrink-0">
                <a
                  href={exportResult.blobUrl}
                  download={exportResult.fileName}
                  target="_blank"
                  rel="noopener noreferrer"
                  className="flex-1 sm:flex-none px-3.5 py-1.5 bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-500 text-white font-bold rounded-lg text-center shadow-xs flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 transition-colors"
                >
                  <FileDown className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  <span>{isVi ? 'Tải file PDF' : 'Download PDF'}</span>
                </a>
                {typeof navigator !== 'undefined' && !!navigator.share && (
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={async () => {
                      try {
                        const file = new File([exportResult.blob], exportResult.fileName, { type: 'application/pdf' });
                        if (navigator.canShare && navigator.canShare({ files: [file] })) {
                          await navigator.share({ files: [file], title: exportResult.fileName });
                        } else {
                          window.open(exportResult.blobUrl, '_blank');
                        }
                      } catch (err: any) {
                        if (err.name !== 'AbortError') {
                          window.open(exportResult.blobUrl, '_blank');
                        }
                      }
                    }}
                    className="flex-1 sm:flex-none px-3 py-1.5 bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-200 font-bold rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 border border-slate-700 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                  >
                    <Share2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                    <span>{isVi ? 'Chia sẻ' : 'Share'}</span>
                  </button>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* Modal Footer */}
        <div className="px-5 py-4 border-t border-slate-800 bg-slate-950/80 flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-center justify-between gap-3">
          <div className="text-xs text-slate-400">
            <span>Tiêu chuẩn tài liệu A4 • Định dạng đơn sắc đen trắng sắc nét</span>
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 w-full sm:w-auto">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={handleNativePrint}
              disabled={isExporting}
              className="flex-1 sm:flex-none px-3.5 py-2 bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-200 border border-slate-700 text-xs font-semibold rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 transition-colors cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-50"
            >
              <Printer className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              <span>{isVi ? 'In / Print' : 'Print'}</span>
            </button>

            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={handleExportPDF}
              disabled={isExporting}
              className="flex-1 sm:flex-none px-4 py-2 bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-500 text-white text-xs font-bold rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 shadow-lg shadow-blue-600/30 transition-all cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-50"
            >
              {isExporting ? (
                <>
                  <Loader2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5 animate-spin" />
                  <span>{isVi ? 'Đang tạo PDF...' : 'Generating...'}</span>
                </>
              ) : isDone ? (
                <>
                  <Check className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  <span>{isVi ? 'Đã xuất xong!' : 'Completed!'}</span>
                </>
              ) : (
                <>
                  <FileDown className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  <span>{isVi ? 'Tải PDF A4' : 'Download PDF'}</span>
                </>
              )}
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* PRINTABLE CONTAINER (Off-screen, purely rendered in black & white monochrome) */}
      <div
        ref={printContainerRef}

        aria-hidden="true"

                      </>
                    )}

                  </tr>
                </thead>

                  {tableData.slice(0, 11).map((row, idx) => {
                    const isRoot = Math.abs(row.y1) < 1e-4;
                    const isYIntercept = Math.abs(row.x) < 1e-4;
                    const isIntersection = row.diff !== null && row.diff < 1e-3;

                    return (
                      <tr
                        key={idx}

                          background: isIntersection || isRoot || isYIntercept ? '#f8fafc' : idx % 2 === 0 ? '#ffffff' : '#fafafa',
                          fontWeight: isIntersection || isRoot || isYIntercept ? 700 : 400,
                        }}
                      >
                        <td style={{ padding: '3.5px 6px', textAlign: 'center', color: '#000000' }}>{row.x}</td>
                        <td style={{ padding: '3.5px 6px', textAlign: 'center', color: '#000000' }}>

                          <>

          <div style={{ borderTop: '1px solid #cbd5e1', paddingTop: '8px', display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', fontSize: '8.5px', color: '#64748b' }}>
            <div>Graphing Calculator Engine • Hệ trục tọa độ chuẩn giáo dục &amp; kỹ thuật</div>

import React, { useState, useMemo } from 'react';
import { Heart, RotateCcw, User } from 'lucide-react';

export const HealthyWeightCalculator: React.FC = () => {
  const [heightCm, setHeightCm] = useState<number>(170);
  const [currentWeightKg, setCurrentWeightKg] = useState<number>(68);

  const calculations = useMemo(() => {
    const hMeter = Math.max(0.5, heightCm / 100);
    const w = Math.max(20, currentWeightKg);

    const currentBmi = w / (hMeter * hMeter);

    // WHO Standard BMI Categories:
    // Underweight: < 18.5
    // Normal / Healthy: 18.5 - 24.9
    // Overweight: 25.0 - 29.9
    // Obese: >= 30.0
    const minHealthyWeight = 18.5 * (hMeter * hMeter);
    const maxHealthyWeight = 24.9 * (hMeter * hMeter);
    const midHealthyWeight = 21.7 * (hMeter * hMeter);

    let status = 'Cân nặng bình thường, rất khỏe mạnh';
    let statusColor = 'text-emerald-400';
    let diff = 0;

    if (currentBmi < 18.5) {
      status = 'Thiếu cân (Underweight)';
      statusColor = 'text-amber-400';
      diff = minHealthyWeight - w;
    } else if (currentBmi > 24.9) {
      status = currentBmi >= 30 ? 'Béo phì (Obese)' : 'Thừa cân (Overweight)';
      statusColor = 'text-rose-400';
      diff = w - maxHealthyWeight;
    }

    return {
      currentBmi: Math.round(currentBmi * 10) / 10,
      minHealthyWeight: Math.round(minHealthyWeight * 10) / 10,
      maxHealthyWeight: Math.round(maxHealthyWeight * 10) / 10,
      midHealthyWeight: Math.round(midHealthyWeight * 10) / 10,
      status,
      statusColor,
      diff: Math.round(diff * 10) / 10,
      isHealthy: currentBmi >= 18.5 && currentBmi <= 24.9
    };
  }, [heightCm, currentWeightKg]);

  return (
    <div className="w-full max-w-5xl mx-auto space-y-6">
      <div className="p-4 sm:p-6 rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-r from-teal-900/40 via-slate-800 to-slate-900 border border-teal-500/30 flex items-center justify-between">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <div className="p-3 bg-teal-600/20 text-teal-400 rounded-xl border border-teal-500/30">
            <Heart className="w-6 h-6" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <h1 className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-bold text-white tracking-tight">Healthy Weight Calculator – Tính Cân Nặng Khỏe Mạnh</h1>
            <p className="text-xs sm:text-sm text-slate-400">Dải cân nặng tối ưu bảo vệ tim mạch và phòng ngừa bệnh lý theo khuyến cáo WHO</p>
          </div>
        </div>
        <button
          id="healthy-weight-reset-btn"
          onClick={() => { setHeightCm(170); setCurrentWeightKg(68); }}
          className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs text-slate-300 hover:text-white bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 border border-slate-700 rounded-lg transition-colors cursor-pointer"
        >
          <RotateCcw className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
          <span>Đặt lại</span>
        </button>
      </div>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6">
        <div className="lg:col-span-5 space-y-4 bg-slate-900/80 p-5 rounded-2xl border border-slate-800">
          <h2 className="text-base font-semibold text-white flex items-center gap-2">
            <User className="w-4 h-4 text-teal-400" />
            Chiều cao & Cân nặng
          </h2>

          <div>
            <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-300 mb-1">Chiều cao của bạn (cm)</label>
            <input
              id="healthy-height"
              type="number"
              value={heightCm}
              onChange={(e) => setHeightCm(Number(e.target.value))}
              className="w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-white font-sans focus:ring-2 focus:ring-teal-500 outline-none"
            />
          </div>

          <div>
            <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-300 mb-1">Cân nặng hiện tại (kg)</label>
            <input
              id="healthy-weight"
              type="number"
              value={currentWeightKg}
              onChange={(e) => setCurrentWeightKg(Number(e.target.value))}
              className="w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-white font-sans focus:ring-2 focus:ring-teal-500 outline-none"
            />
          </div>

          <div className="p-4 rounded-xl bg-slate-800/60 border border-slate-700 text-xs text-slate-300 space-y-1.5">
            <div className="font-semibold text-teal-400">Tiêu chuẩn BMI Quốc tế:</div>
            <div>• Dưới 18.5: Thiếu cân</div>
            <div>• 18.5 – 24.9: Cân nặng bình thường, lý tưởng</div>
            <div>• 25.0 – 29.9: Thừa cân</div>
            <div>• Trên 30.0: Béo phì</div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="lg:col-span-7 space-y-4">
          <div className="p-6 rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-b from-teal-950/40 to-slate-900 border border-teal-500/40 text-center space-y-2">
            <span className="text-xs uppercase tracking-wider text-teal-300 font-semibold">Dải cân nặng khỏe mạnh khuyến nghị</span>
            <div className="text-3xl sm:text-4xl font-extrabold text-teal-300 font-sans tabular-nums">
              {calculations.minHealthyWeight} kg – {calculations.maxHealthyWeight} kg
            </div>
            <p className="text-xs text-slate-400">
              Điểm cân nặng trung tâm lý tưởng: <span className="text-white font-bold font-sans">{calculations.midHealthyWeight} kg</span> (BMI 21.7)
            </p>
          </div>

          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
            <div className="p-4 bg-slate-900/80 rounded-xl border border-slate-800 space-y-1">
              <span className="text-xs text-slate-400">Chỉ số BMI hiện tại</span>
              <div className="text-xl font-bold text-white font-sans tabular-nums">
                {calculations.currentBmi} kg/m²
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="p-4 bg-slate-900/80 rounded-xl border border-slate-800 space-y-1">
              <span className="text-xs text-slate-400">Tình trạng thể chất</span>
              <div className={`text-sm font-bold ${calculations.statusColor}`}>
                {calculations.status}
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {!calculations.isHealthy && (
            <div className="p-4 rounded-xl bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 text-xs sm:text-sm text-slate-200 flex items-center justify-between">
              <span>{calculations.currentBmi < 18.5 ? 'Khuyến nghị tăng cân:' : 'Khuyến nghị giảm cân:'}</span>
              <span className="font-bold text-teal-400 font-sans tabular-nums">
                {calculations.currentBmi < 18.5 ? `Tăng thêm tối thiểu ${calculations.diff} kg` : `Giảm bớt khoảng ${calculations.diff} kg`}
              </span>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

FILE: /src/components/tools/IdealWeightCalculator.tsx

import React, { useState, useMemo } from 'react';
import { Scale, RotateCcw, User } from 'lucide-react';

export const IdealWeightCalculator: React.FC = () => {
  const [gender, setGender] = useState<'male' | 'female'>('male');
  const [heightCm, setHeightCm] = useState<number>(172);
  const [age, setAge] = useState<number>(28);
  const [currentWeight, setCurrentWeight] = useState<number>(68);

  const calculations = useMemo(() => {
    const h = heightCm;
    const heightInches = h / 2.54;
    const inchesOver5Ft = Math.max(0, heightInches - 60);

    // 1. Devine Formula (1974)
    const devine = gender === 'male' ? 50.0 + 2.3 * inchesOver5Ft : 45.5 + 2.3 * inchesOver5Ft;

    // 2. Robinson Formula (1983)
    const robinson = gender === 'male' ? 52.0 + 1.9 * inchesOver5Ft : 49.0 + 1.7 * inchesOver5Ft;

    // 3. Miller Formula (1983)
    const miller = gender === 'male' ? 56.2 + 1.41 * inchesOver5Ft : 53.1 + 1.36 * inchesOver5Ft;

    // 4. Hamwi Formula (1964)
    const hamwi = gender === 'male' ? 48.0 + 2.7 * inchesOver5Ft : 45.5 + 2.2 * inchesOver5Ft;

    // Healthy BMI Range WHO: 18.5 - 24.9 kg/m^2
    const hMeter = h / 100;
    const minBmiWeight = 18.5 * (hMeter * hMeter);
    const maxBmiWeight = 24.9 * (hMeter * hMeter);

    const averageIdeal = (devine + robinson + miller + hamwi) / 4;

    // Current Status
    const currentBmi = currentWeight / (hMeter * hMeter);
    const diffFromIdeal = currentWeight - averageIdeal;

    let statusText = 'Cân đối lý tưởng';
    let statusColor = 'text-emerald-400';
    let recommendation = 'Cân nặng hiện tại của bạn nằm trong khoảng chuẩn lý tưởng.';

    if (currentWeight < minBmiWeight) {
      statusText = 'Dưới chuẩn (Thiếu cân nhẹ)';
      statusColor = 'text-amber-400';
      recommendation = `Bạn đang nhẹ hơn khoảng an toàn tối thiểu ${(minBmiWeight - currentWeight).toFixed(1)} kg. Nên bổ sung dinh dưỡng hợp lý.`;
    } else if (currentWeight > maxBmiWeight) {
      statusText = 'Vượt chuẩn (Thừa cân)';
      statusColor = 'text-rose-400';
      recommendation = `Bạn đang nặng hơn ngưỡng an toàn ${(currentWeight - maxBmiWeight).toFixed(1)} kg. Nên điều chỉnh thâm hụt calo và vận động.`;
    } else {
      statusText = 'Khỏe mạnh chuẩn WHO';
      statusColor = 'text-emerald-400';
      recommendation = 'Tuyệt vời! Cân nặng của bạn nằm trọn vẹn trong dải cân nặng khỏe mạnh chuẩn WHO.';
    }

    return {
      devine: Math.round(devine * 10) / 10,
      robinson: Math.round(robinson * 10) / 10,
      miller: Math.round(miller * 10) / 10,
      hamwi: Math.round(hamwi * 10) / 10,
      averageIdeal: Math.round(averageIdeal * 10) / 10,
      minBmiWeight: Math.round(minBmiWeight * 10) / 10,
      maxBmiWeight: Math.round(maxBmiWeight * 10) / 10,
      currentBmi: Math.round(currentBmi * 10) / 10,
      diffFromIdeal: Math.round(diffFromIdeal * 10) / 10,
      statusText,
      statusColor,
      recommendation
    };
  }, [gender, heightCm, currentWeight]);

  return (
    <div className="w-full max-w-5xl mx-auto space-y-6">
      <div className="p-4 sm:p-6 rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-r from-teal-900/40 via-slate-800 to-slate-900 border border-teal-500/30 flex items-center justify-between">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <div className="p-3 bg-teal-600/20 text-teal-400 rounded-xl border border-teal-500/30">
            <Scale className="w-6 h-6" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <h1 className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-bold text-white tracking-tight">Ideal Weight Calculator – Tính Cân Nặng Lý Tưởng</h1>
            <p className="text-xs sm:text-sm text-slate-400">Xác định cân nặng chuẩn theo 4 công thức y khoa quốc tế (Devine, Robinson, Miller, Hamwi)</p>
          </div>
        </div>
        <button
          id="ideal-weight-reset-btn"
          onClick={() => { setGender('male'); setHeightCm(172); setAge(28); }}
          className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs text-slate-300 hover:text-white bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 border border-slate-700 rounded-lg transition-colors cursor-pointer"
        >
          <RotateCcw className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
          <span>Đặt lại</span>
        </button>
      </div>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6">
        <div className="lg:col-span-5 space-y-4 bg-slate-900/80 p-5 rounded-2xl border border-slate-800">
          <h2 className="text-base font-semibold text-white flex items-center gap-2">
            <User className="w-4 h-4 text-teal-400" />
            Thông số cá nhân
          </h2>

          <div>
            <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-300 mb-1">Giới tính</label>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
              <button
                type="button"
                id="ideal-gender-male"
                onClick={() => setGender('male')}
                className={`py-2 px-3 text-xs rounded-xl border font-medium transition-all ${
                  gender === 'male' ? 'bg-blue-600 text-white border-blue-500' : 'bg-slate-800 text-slate-300 border-slate-700'
                }`}
              >
                Nam giới
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                id="ideal-gender-female"
                onClick={() => setGender('female')}
                className={`py-2 px-3 text-xs rounded-xl border font-medium transition-all ${
                  gender === 'female' ? 'bg-blue-600 text-white border-blue-500' : 'bg-slate-800 text-slate-300 border-slate-700'
                }`}
              >
                Nữ giới
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2.5">
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-300 mb-1">Chiều cao (cm)</label>
              <input
                id="ideal-height"
                type="number"
                value={heightCm}
                onChange={(e) => setHeightCm(Number(e.target.value))}
                className="w-full px-3 py-2 bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-white font-sans focus:ring-2 focus:ring-teal-500 outline-none text-sm"
              />
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-300 mb-1">Cân nặng hiện tại (kg)</label>
              <input
                id="ideal-current-weight"
                type="number"
                value={currentWeight}
                onChange={(e) => setCurrentWeight(Number(e.target.value))}
                className="w-full px-3 py-2 bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-white font-sans focus:ring-2 focus:ring-teal-500 outline-none text-sm"
              />
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-300 mb-1">Độ tuổi</label>
              <input
                id="ideal-age"
                type="number"
                value={age}
                onChange={(e) => setAge(Number(e.target.value))}
                className="w-full px-3 py-2 bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-white font-sans focus:ring-2 focus:ring-teal-500 outline-none text-sm"
              />
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="lg:col-span-7 space-y-4">
          <div className="p-6 rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-b from-teal-950/40 to-slate-900 border border-teal-500/40 text-center space-y-2">
            <span className="text-xs uppercase tracking-wider text-teal-300 font-semibold">Cân nặng lý tưởng trung bình</span>
            <div className="text-4xl sm:text-5xl font-extrabold text-teal-400 font-sans tabular-nums">
              {calculations.averageIdeal} <span className="text-xl font-normal text-slate-400">kg</span>
            </div>
            <p className="text-xs text-slate-400">
              Khuyến nghị dải cân nặng an toàn theo WHO: <span className="text-emerald-400 font-bold font-sans">{calculations.minBmiWeight} kg – {calculations.maxBmiWeight} kg</span>
            </p>
          </div>

          {/* Assessment & Healthy Weight Status */}
          <div className="p-4 bg-slate-900/90 rounded-2xl border border-slate-800 space-y-2">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <span className="text-xs font-medium text-slate-400">Đánh giá thể trạng hiện tại:</span>
              <span className={`text-xs font-bold ${calculations.statusColor} px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700`}>
                {calculations.statusText} (BMI: {calculations.currentBmi})
              </span>
            </div>
            <p className="text-xs text-slate-300 leading-relaxed">
              {calculations.recommendation} {calculations.diffFromIdeal !== 0 && (

                  (Chênh lệch {calculations.diffFromIdeal > 0 ? `+${calculations.diffFromIdeal}` : calculations.diffFromIdeal} kg so với cân nặng lý tưởng).

FILE: /src/components/tools/InflationCalculator.tsx

import React, { useState, useMemo, useEffect } from 'react';
import { TrendingDown, DollarSign, RotateCcw, FileDown, Printer } from 'lucide-react';
import { useCurrency } from '../../context/CurrencyContext';
import { CurrencySelector } from '../common/CurrencySelector';
import { InflationPdfModal } from './InflationPdfModal';

export const InflationCalculator: React.FC = () => {
  const { currency, currencyInfo, formatMoney } = useCurrency();

  const [currentAmount, setCurrentAmount] = useState<number>(() => {
    return currency === 'VND' ? 50000000 : 1000;
  });
  const [inflationRate, setInflationRate] = useState<number>(3.5);
  const [years, setYears] = useState<number>(10);
  const [isPdfModalOpen, setIsPdfModalOpen] = useState<boolean>(false);

  // Synchronize defaults on currency switch
  useEffect(() => {
    if (currency === 'VND') {
      setCurrentAmount((prev) => (prev < 100000 ? 50000000 : prev));
    } else {
      setCurrentAmount((prev) => (prev >= 1000000 ? 1000 : prev));
    }
  }, [currency]);

  const calculations = useMemo(() => {
    const P = Math.max(0, currentAmount);
    const r = inflationRate / 100;
    const t = Math.max(1, years);

    // Future equivalent cost (how much you need in future to buy what P buys today)
    const futureEquivalentCost = P * Math.pow(1 + r, t);

    // Future purchasing power (how much today's P will be worth in real terms)
    const futurePurchasingPower = P / Math.pow(1 + r, t);

    const purchasingPowerLossPercent = P > 0 ? ((P - futurePurchasingPower) / P) * 100 : 0;

    const timeline = [];
    for (let yr = 1; yr <= t; yr++) {
      const equiv = P * Math.pow(1 + r, yr);
      const power = P / Math.pow(1 + r, yr);
      timeline.push({
        year: yr,
        equivalent: equiv,
        purchasingPower: power
      });
    }

    return {
      futureEquivalentCost,
      futurePurchasingPower,
      purchasingPowerLossPercent,
      timeline
    };
  }, [currentAmount, inflationRate, years]);

  const handleReset = () => {
    setCurrentAmount(currency === 'VND' ? 50000000 : 1000);
    setInflationRate(3.5);
    setYears(10);
  };

  return (
    <div className="w-full max-w-5xl mx-auto space-y-6">
      <div className="p-4 sm:p-6 rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-r from-rose-900/40 via-slate-800 to-slate-900 border border-rose-500/30 flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-3">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <div className="p-3 bg-rose-600/20 text-rose-400 rounded-xl border border-rose-500/30">
            <TrendingDown className="w-6 h-6" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <h1 className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-bold text-white tracking-tight">Inflation Calculator – Tính Toán Lạm Phát</h1>
            <p className="text-xs sm:text-sm text-slate-400">Đo lường sức mua bị bào mòn của đồng tiền và số tiền cần có trong tương lai</p>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <CurrencySelector variant="compact" />
          <button
            id="inflation-export-pdf-header-btn"
            onClick={() => setIsPdfModalOpen(true)}
            className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs text-rose-300 hover:text-white bg-rose-950/60 hover:bg-rose-900 border border-rose-600/40 rounded-lg transition-colors cursor-pointer font-medium"
            title="Xuất báo cáo PDF hoặc In ấn"
          >
            <FileDown className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            <span>Xuất PDF / In</span>
          </button>
          <button
            id="inflation-reset-btn"
            onClick={handleReset}
            className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs text-slate-300 hover:text-white bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 border border-slate-700 rounded-lg transition-colors cursor-pointer"
          >
            <RotateCcw className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            <span>Đặt lại</span>
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6">
        <div className="lg:col-span-5 space-y-4 bg-slate-900/80 p-5 rounded-2xl border border-slate-800">
          <h2 className="text-base font-semibold text-white flex items-center gap-2">
            <DollarSign className="w-4 h-4 text-rose-400" />
            Thông số tính lạm phát
          </h2>

          <div>
            <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-300 mb-1">
              Số tiền hiện tại ({currencyInfo.symbol} {currencyInfo.code})
            </label>
            <div className="relative">
              <span className="absolute left-3.5 top-2.5 text-slate-400 font-bold">{currencyInfo.symbol}</span>
              <input
                id="inflation-amount"
                type="number"
                step={currency === 'VND' ? 5000000 : 50}
                value={currentAmount}
                onChange={(e) => setCurrentAmount(Number(e.target.value))}
                className="w-full pl-9 pr-14 py-2.5 bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-white font-sans focus:ring-2 focus:ring-rose-500 outline-none"
              />
              <span className="absolute right-3.5 top-2.5 text-slate-400 text-xs font-bold">{currencyInfo.code}</span>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-300 mb-1">Tỷ lệ lạm phát (%/năm)</label>
              <input
                id="inflation-rate"
                type="number"
                step="0.1"
                value={inflationRate}
                onChange={(e) => setInflationRate(Number(e.target.value))}
                className="w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-white font-sans focus:ring-2 focus:ring-rose-500 outline-none"
              />
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-300 mb-1">Số năm tương lai</label>
              <input
                id="inflation-years"
                type="number"
                value={years}
                onChange={(e) => setYears(Number(e.target.value))}
                className="w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-white font-sans focus:ring-2 focus:ring-rose-500 outline-none"
              />
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="p-3.5 rounded-xl bg-slate-800/60 border border-slate-700/60 text-xs text-slate-300 space-y-1">
            <span className="font-semibold text-rose-400">Quy luật số 72:</span>
            <p>
              Với mức lạm phát {inflationRate}%/năm, giá cả hàng hóa sẽ tăng gấp đôi sau khoảng <span className="font-bold text-white font-sans">{(72 / Math.max(0.1, inflationRate)).toFixed(1)} năm</span>.
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="lg:col-span-7 space-y-4">
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
            <div className="p-5 rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-b from-rose-950/40 to-slate-900 border border-rose-500/40 space-y-2">
              <span className="text-xs uppercase tracking-wider text-rose-300 font-semibold">Sức mua còn lại của {formatMoney(currentAmount)}</span>
              <div className="text-xl sm:text-3xl font-extrabold text-rose-400 font-sans tabular-nums">
                {formatMoney(calculations.futurePurchasingPower)}
              </div>
              <p className="text-xs text-slate-400">
                Mất đi <span className="text-rose-400 font-bold font-sans">-{calculations.purchasingPowerLossPercent.toFixed(1)}%</span> giá trị thực tế do lạm phát sau {years} năm.
              </p>
            </div>

            <div className="p-5 rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-b from-amber-950/40 to-slate-900 border border-amber-500/40 space-y-2">
              <span className="text-xs uppercase tracking-wider text-amber-300 font-semibold">Cần có trong tương lai để mua hàng tương đương</span>
              <div className="text-xl sm:text-3xl font-extrabold text-amber-300 font-sans tabular-nums">
                {formatMoney(calculations.futureEquivalentCost)}
              </div>
              <p className="text-xs text-slate-400">
                Cần thêm <span className="text-amber-400 font-bold font-sans">+{formatMoney(calculations.futureEquivalentCost - currentAmount)}</span> để mua cùng giỏ hàng hóa.
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Timeline Table */}
          <div className="p-4 bg-slate-900/80 rounded-2xl border border-slate-800 space-y-3">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <h3 className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-300">
                Sức mua theo thời gian ({years} năm tới)
              </h3>
              <button
                type="button"
                id="inflation-export-pdf-table-btn"
                onClick={() => setIsPdfModalOpen(true)}
                className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-1 text-xs text-rose-300 hover:text-white bg-rose-950/40 hover:bg-rose-900/60 border border-rose-600/30 rounded-lg transition-colors cursor-pointer"
              >
                <FileDown className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                <span>Xuất PDF / In</span>
              </button>
            </div>
            <div className="max-h-52 overflow-y-auto scrollbar-thin">
              <table className="w-full text-xs text-left text-slate-300">
                <thead className="text-[11px] uppercase bg-slate-800 text-slate-400 sticky top-0">
                  <tr>
                    <th className="p-2">Năm</th>
                    <th className="p-2">Sức mua của {formatMoney(currentAmount)}</th>
                    <th className="p-2 text-right">Số tiền tương đương cần có</th>
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-800/60 font-sans tabular-nums">
                  {calculations.timeline.map((row) => (
                    <tr key={row.year} className="hover:bg-slate-800/40">
                      <td className="p-2 font-medium">Năm {row.year}</td>
                      <td className="p-2 text-rose-400">{formatMoney(row.purchasingPower)}</td>
                      <td className="p-2 text-right text-amber-300">{formatMoney(row.equivalent)}</td>
                    </tr>
                  ))}
                </tbody>
              </table>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* PDF Export Modal */}
      <InflationPdfModal
        isOpen={isPdfModalOpen}
        onClose={() => setIsPdfModalOpen(false)}
        currentAmount={currentAmount}
        inflationRate={inflationRate}
        years={years}
        calculations={calculations}
      />
    </div>
  );
};

FILE: /src/components/tools/InflationPdfModal.tsx

import React, { useState, useRef } from 'react';
import { X, FileDown, Printer, Check, Loader2, Calendar, TrendingDown, ShieldAlert, Sparkles, CheckCircle2, Share2 } from 'lucide-react';
import { useCurrency } from '../../context/CurrencyContext';
import { useLanguage } from '../../context/LanguageContext';
import { exportElementPagesToPdf, PdfExportResult } from '../../utils/pdfExportHelper';

export interface InflationPdfModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  currentAmount: number;
  inflationRate: number;
  years: number;
  calculations: {
    futureEquivalentCost: number;
    futurePurchasingPower: number;
    purchasingPowerLossPercent: number;
    timeline: {
      year: number;
      equivalent: number;
      purchasingPower: number;
    }[];
  };
}

export const InflationPdfModal: React.FC<InflationPdfModalProps> = ({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  currentAmount,
  inflationRate,
  years,
  calculations
}) => {
  const { currencyInfo, formatMoney } = useCurrency();
  const { language } = useLanguage();
  const isVi = language === 'vi';

  const [isExporting, setIsExporting] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [exportProgress, setExportProgress] = useState<string>('');
  const [isDone, setIsDone] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [exportResult, setExportResult] = useState<PdfExportResult | null>(null);

  const printContainerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  // Split timeline into pages (~30 rows per page if many years)
  const ROWS_PER_PAGE = 30;
  const timelinePages = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < calculations.timeline.length; i += ROWS_PER_PAGE) {
    timelinePages.push(calculations.timeline.slice(i, i + ROWS_PER_PAGE));
  }
  const totalPagesCount = Math.max(1, timelinePages.length);

  const handleExportPDF = async () => {
    if (isExporting || !printContainerRef.current) return;
    try {
      setIsExporting(true);
      setIsDone(false);
      setExportProgress(isVi ? 'Đang chuẩn bị trang in...' : 'Preparing pages...');

      const dateStr = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
      const fileName = isVi
        ? `Bao_Cao_Lam_Phat_Suc_Mua_${Math.round(currentAmount)}_${currencyInfo.code}_${dateStr}.pdf`
        : `Inflation_Purchasing_Power_Report_${Math.round(currentAmount)}_${currencyInfo.code}_${dateStr}.pdf`;

      const result = await exportElementPagesToPdf(printContainerRef.current, {
        fileName,
        pageSelector: '.pdf-report-page',
        onProgress: (text) => setExportProgress(text),
      });

      setExportResult(result);
      setIsDone(true);
      setExportProgress(isVi ? 'Xuất PDF thành công!' : 'PDF export complete!');
      setTimeout(() => {
        setIsDone(false);
        setExportProgress('');
      }, 4000);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Lỗi khi xuất PDF:', error);
      alert(isVi ? 'Có lỗi khi tạo PDF. Bạn có thể chọn In trực tiếp.' : 'Error generating PDF. Try Print directly.');
    } finally {
      setIsExporting(false);
    }
  };

  const handlePrint = () => {
    window.print();
  };

  const currentDateFormatted = new Date().toLocaleDateString(isVi ? 'vi-VN' : 'en-US', {
    year: 'numeric',
    month: 'long',
    day: 'numeric',
  });

  const rule72Years = (72 / Math.max(0.1, inflationRate)).toFixed(1);

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-3 sm:p-4 bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-xs animate-in fade-in duration-200 print:hidden">
      <div className="bg-slate-900 rounded-2xl shadow-2xl border border-slate-800 w-full max-w-xl max-h-[92vh] flex flex-col overflow-hidden text-slate-200">
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="px-5 py-4 border-b border-slate-800 flex items-center justify-between bg-slate-950/80">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-rose-600/20 border border-rose-500/40 text-rose-400 flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs">
              <TrendingDown className="w-5 h-5" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <h3 className="text-base sm:text-lg font-bold text-white">
                {isVi ? 'Xuất Báo Cáo Lạm Phát & Sức Mua' : 'Export Inflation & Purchasing Power Report'}
              </h3>
              <p className="text-xs text-slate-400">
                {isVi 
                  ? 'Bao gồm thông số lạm phát, mức bào mòn sức mua và tiến trình theo từng năm' 
                  : 'Includes inflation metrics, purchasing power depreciation, and yearly timeline'}
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
          <button
            onClick={onClose}
            disabled={isExporting}
            className="p-2 text-slate-400 hover:text-white hover:bg-slate-800 rounded-lg transition-colors cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-50"
          >
            <X className="w-5 h-5" />
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Modal Body */}
        <div className="p-5 overflow-y-auto space-y-4 text-sm">
          <div className="p-4 bg-slate-950/60 rounded-xl border border-slate-800 space-y-3">
            <div className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-wider flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <Calendar className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-rose-400" />
              <span>{isVi ? 'Tóm tắt thông số dự phóng' : 'Projection parameters summary'}</span>
            </div>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-2.5 text-xs">
              <div className="bg-slate-900 p-2.5 rounded-lg border border-slate-800">
                <span className="text-slate-400 block">{isVi ? 'Số tiền ban đầu' : 'Current Amount'}</span>
                <span className="text-sm font-bold text-white tabular-nums">{formatMoney(currentAmount)}</span>
              </div>
              <div className="bg-slate-900 p-2.5 rounded-lg border border-slate-800">
                <span className="text-slate-400 block">{isVi ? 'Tỷ lệ lạm phát' : 'Inflation Rate'}</span>
                <span className="text-sm font-bold text-rose-400 tabular-nums">{inflationRate}% / {isVi ? 'năm' : 'yr'}</span>
              </div>
              <div className="bg-slate-900 p-2.5 rounded-lg border border-slate-800 col-span-2 sm:col-span-1">
                <span className="text-slate-400 block">{isVi ? 'Thời gian' : 'Time Horizon'}</span>
                <span className="text-sm font-bold text-white tabular-nums">{years} {isVi ? 'năm' : 'years'}</span>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-2.5 pt-1 text-xs">
              <div className="p-3 rounded-lg bg-rose-950/40 border border-rose-500/30">
                <span className="text-rose-300 block mb-1">{isVi ? 'Sức mua còn lại thực tế:' : 'Future Purchasing Power:'}</span>
                <span className="text-base font-extrabold text-rose-400 tabular-nums">{formatMoney(calculations.futurePurchasingPower)}</span>
                <span className="block text-[11px] text-slate-400 mt-0.5">
                  ({isVi ? 'Giảm' : 'Down'} -{calculations.purchasingPowerLossPercent.toFixed(1)}% {isVi ? 'giá trị' : 'value'})
                </span>
              </div>
              <div className="p-3 rounded-lg bg-amber-950/40 border border-amber-500/30">
                <span className="text-amber-300 block mb-1">{isVi ? 'Số tiền tương đương cần có:' : 'Equivalent Future Cost:'}</span>
                <span className="text-base font-extrabold text-amber-300 tabular-nums">{formatMoney(calculations.futureEquivalentCost)}</span>
                <span className="block text-[11px] text-slate-400 mt-0.5">
                  (+{formatMoney(calculations.futureEquivalentCost - currentAmount)})
                </span>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="p-2.5 rounded-lg bg-slate-900/60 border border-slate-800 text-xs text-slate-300 flex items-center gap-2">
              <Sparkles className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-400 shrink-0" />
              <span>
                {isVi 
                  ? `Quy luật 72: Với mức lạm phát ${inflationRate}%/năm, giá cả hàng hóa sẽ tăng gấp đôi sau khoảng ${rule72Years} năm.`
                  : `Rule of 72: At ${inflationRate}% inflation, prices will double in approx ${rule72Years} years.`}
              </span>
            </div>
          </div>

          {exportProgress && (
            <div className="p-3 bg-rose-950/60 border border-rose-500/40 rounded-xl flex items-center gap-2.5 text-xs text-rose-300">
              {isExporting ? (
                <Loader2 className="w-4 h-4 animate-spin text-rose-400 shrink-0" />
              ) : isDone ? (
                <Check className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-400 shrink-0" />
              ) : null}
              <span>{exportProgress}</span>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Khi file PDF đã sẵn sàng, hiển thị nút tải trực tiếp và share (đặc biệt hữu ích trên iPhone/Android) */}
          {exportResult && (
            <div className="p-3 bg-emerald-950/60 border border-emerald-500/50 rounded-xl flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-center justify-between gap-3 text-xs shadow-xs">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-emerald-300 min-w-0">
                <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-400 shrink-0" />
                <span className="font-semibold shrink-0">{isVi ? 'File PDF đã sẵn sàng:' : 'PDF ready:'}</span>
                <span className="font-mono text-[11px] truncate max-w-[170px] text-slate-300">{exportResult.fileName}</span>
              </div>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 w-full sm:w-auto shrink-0">
                <a
                  href={exportResult.blobUrl}
                  download={exportResult.fileName}
                  target="_blank"
                  rel="noopener noreferrer"
                  className="flex-1 sm:flex-none px-3.5 py-1.5 bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-500 text-white font-bold rounded-lg text-center shadow-xs flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 transition-colors"
                >
                  <FileDown className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  <span>{isVi ? 'Mở / Tải file' : 'Open / Save'}</span>
                </a>
                {typeof navigator !== 'undefined' && !!navigator.share && (
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={async () => {
                      try {
                        const file = new File([exportResult.blob], exportResult.fileName, { type: 'application/pdf' });
                        if (navigator.canShare && navigator.canShare({ files: [file] })) {
                          await navigator.share({ files: [file], title: exportResult.fileName });
                        } else {
                          window.open(exportResult.blobUrl, '_blank');
                        }
                      } catch (err: any) {
                        if (err.name !== 'AbortError') {
                          window.open(exportResult.blobUrl, '_blank');
                        }
                      }
                    }}
                    className="flex-1 sm:flex-none px-3 py-1.5 bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-200 font-bold rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 border border-slate-700 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                  >
                    <Share2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                    <span>{isVi ? 'Lưu vào Tệp' : 'Save to Files'}</span>
                  </button>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* Modal Footer */}
        <div className="px-5 py-4 border-t border-slate-800 bg-slate-950/80 flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-center justify-between gap-3">
          <div className="text-xs text-slate-400 flex items-center gap-1.5">
            <ShieldAlert className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-500 shrink-0" />
            <span>{isVi ? 'Định dạng tài liệu A4 chuẩn in ấn, rõ nét' : 'Bank-standard A4 format'}</span>
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 w-full sm:w-auto">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={handlePrint}
              disabled={isExporting}
              className="flex-1 sm:flex-none px-3.5 py-2 bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-200 border border-slate-700 text-xs font-semibold rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 transition-colors cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-50"
            >
              <Printer className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              <span>{isVi ? 'In / Lưu PDF' : 'Print / Save'}</span>
            </button>

            <button
              type="button"
              id="confirm-download-inflation-pdf-btn"
              onClick={handleExportPDF}
              disabled={isExporting}
              className="flex-1 sm:flex-none px-5 py-2 bg-rose-600 hover:bg-rose-500 text-white text-xs font-bold rounded-xl shadow-xs flex items-center justify-center gap-2 transition-all cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-50"
            >
              {isExporting ? (
                <>
                  <Loader2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5 animate-spin" />
                  <span>{isVi ? 'Đang tạo PDF...' : 'Generating...'}</span>
                </>
              ) : isDone ? (
                <>
                  <Check className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-300" />
                  <span>{isVi ? 'Đã tải xong!' : 'Downloaded!'}</span>
                </>
              ) : (
                <>
                  <FileDown className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  <span>{isVi ? 'Tải file PDF ngay' : 'Download PDF'}</span>
                </>
              )}
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* PRINTABLE CONTAINER (Off-screen, NOT display: none for sharp html2canvas rendering) */}
      <div
        ref={printContainerRef}
        id="inflation-pdf-printable-source"
        aria-hidden="true"
        style={{
          position: 'fixed',
          left: '-9999px',
          top: 0,
          width: '794px',
          height: 'auto',
          overflow: 'hidden',
          pointerEvents: 'none',
          backgroundColor: '#ffffff',
          color: '#0f172a',
          zIndex: -9999,
        }}
      >
        {timelinePages.map((pageRows, pageIdx) => (
          <div
            key={`page-${pageIdx}`}
            className="pdf-report-page bg-white text-slate-900"
            style={{
              width: '794px',
              minHeight: '1123px',
              height: '1123px',
              padding: '36px 40px',
              boxSizing: 'border-box',
              display: 'flex',
              flexDirection: 'column',
              justifyContent: 'space-between',
              fontFamily: 'system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif',
            }}
          >
            <div>
              {/* Header */}
              <div style={{ borderBottom: '2px solid #e11d48', paddingBottom: '14px', marginBottom: '16px' }}>
                <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'flex-start' }}>
                  <div>
                    <div style={{ fontSize: '10px', fontWeight: 800, textTransform: 'uppercase', letterSpacing: '1px', color: '#e11d48' }}>
                      BÁO CÁO TÀI CHÍNH • FINANCIAL ANALYSIS REPORT
                    </div>
                    <h1 style={{ fontSize: '20px', fontWeight: 900, color: '#0f172a', margin: '4px 0 2px 0', letterSpacing: '-0.5px' }}>
                      BÁO CÁO DỰ BÁO LẠM PHÁT &amp; SỨC MUA
                    </h1>
                    <div style={{ fontSize: '11px', color: '#475569' }}>
                      Đo lường sự sụt giảm sức mua của tiền tệ và giá trị tương đương trong tương lai
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <div style={{ textAlign: 'right', fontSize: '10px', color: '#64748b' }}>
                    <div>Ngày lập: <strong style={{ color: '#0f172a' }}>{currentDateFormatted}</strong></div>
                    <div>Tiền tệ: <strong style={{ color: '#0f172a' }}>{currencyInfo.code} ({currencyInfo.symbol})</strong></div>
                    <div style={{ marginTop: '2px', display: 'inline-block', padding: '2px 6px', background: '#ffe4e6', color: '#be123c', borderRadius: '4px', fontWeight: 700 }}>
                      Mô hình: Tăng trưởng lũy kế hàng năm
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>

              {pageIdx === 0 && (
                <>
                  {/* Summary Cards */}
                  <div style={{ marginBottom: '16px' }}>
                    <div style={{ fontSize: '11px', fontWeight: 800, textTransform: 'uppercase', letterSpacing: '0.5px', color: '#0f172a', marginBottom: '8px', display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '6px' }}>
                      <span style={{ width: '8px', height: '8px', background: '#e11d48', borderRadius: '2px', display: 'inline-block' }} />
                      <span>1. THÔNG SỐ TÍNH TOÁN &amp; KẾT QUẢ DỰ PHÓNG</span>
                    </div>

                    <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(3, 1fr)', gap: '8px', marginBottom: '8px' }}>
                      <div style={{ background: '#f8fafc', border: '1px solid #e2e8f0', borderRadius: '8px', padding: '10px' }}>
                        <div style={{ fontSize: '10px', color: '#64748b', fontWeight: 600 }}>SỐ TIỀN BAN ĐẦU</div>
                        <div style={{ fontSize: '15px', fontWeight: 900, color: '#0f172a', marginTop: '2px' }}>{formatMoney(currentAmount)}</div>
                      </div>
                      <div style={{ background: '#f8fafc', border: '1px solid #e2e8f0', borderRadius: '8px', padding: '10px' }}>
                        <div style={{ fontSize: '10px', color: '#64748b', fontWeight: 600 }}>TỶ LỆ LẠM PHÁT DỰ KIẾN</div>
                        <div style={{ fontSize: '15px', fontWeight: 900, color: '#e11d48', marginTop: '2px' }}>{inflationRate}% / năm</div>
                      </div>
                      <div style={{ background: '#f8fafc', border: '1px solid #e2e8f0', borderRadius: '8px', padding: '10px' }}>
                        <div style={{ fontSize: '10px', color: '#64748b', fontWeight: 600 }}>THỜI GIAN DỰ PHÓNG</div>
                        <div style={{ fontSize: '15px', fontWeight: 900, color: '#0f172a', marginTop: '2px' }}>{years} năm</div>
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(2, 1fr)', gap: '8px', marginBottom: '8px' }}>
                      <div style={{ background: '#fff1f2', border: '1px solid #fecdd3', borderRadius: '8px', padding: '10px 12px' }}>
                        <div style={{ fontSize: '10px', color: '#9f1239', fontWeight: 700 }}>SỨC MUA CÒN LẠI SAU {years} NĂM</div>
                        <div style={{ fontSize: '18px', fontWeight: 900, color: '#be123c', marginTop: '3px' }}>
                          {formatMoney(calculations.futurePurchasingPower)}
                        </div>
                        <div style={{ fontSize: '10px', color: '#e11d48', marginTop: '2px' }}>
                          Mất đi <strong>-{calculations.purchasingPowerLossPercent.toFixed(1)}%</strong> giá trị thực tế do lạm phát
                        </div>
                      </div>

                      <div style={{ background: '#fffbeb', border: '1px solid #fef3c7', borderRadius: '8px', padding: '10px 12px' }}>
                        <div style={{ fontSize: '10px', color: '#92400e', fontWeight: 700 }}>SỐ TIỀN TƯƠNG ĐƯƠNG CẦN CÓ TRONG TƯƠNG LAI</div>
                        <div style={{ fontSize: '18px', fontWeight: 900, color: '#b45309', marginTop: '3px' }}>
                          {formatMoney(calculations.futureEquivalentCost)}
                        </div>
                        <div style={{ fontSize: '10px', color: '#d97706', marginTop: '2px' }}>
                          Cần thêm <strong>+{formatMoney(calculations.futureEquivalentCost - currentAmount)}</strong> để duy trì mức sống cũ
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    <div style={{ padding: '8px 12px', background: '#f8fafc', border: '1px solid #e2e8f0', borderRadius: '8px', fontSize: '10.5px', color: '#334155' }}>
                      💡 <strong>Quy luật 72:</strong> Với mức lạm phát <strong>{inflationRate}%/năm</strong>, giá cả thị trường sẽ tăng gấp đôi sau khoảng <strong>{rule72Years} năm</strong>.
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </>
              )}

              {/* Timeline Table */}
              <div>
                <div style={{ fontSize: '11px', fontWeight: 800, textTransform: 'uppercase', letterSpacing: '0.5px', color: '#0f172a', marginBottom: '8px', display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'space-between' }}>
                  <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '6px' }}>
                    <span style={{ width: '8px', height: '8px', background: '#f59e0b', borderRadius: '2px', display: 'inline-block' }} />
                    <span>2. TIẾN TRÌNH SỨC MUA VÀ GIÁ TRỊ TƯƠNG ĐƯƠNG THEO NĂM</span>
                  </div>
                  <span style={{ fontSize: '10px', color: '#64748b' }}>
                    (Từ Năm {pageRows[0]?.year} đến Năm {pageRows[pageRows.length - 1]?.year})
                  </span>
                </div>

                <table style={{ width: '100%', borderCollapse: 'collapse', fontSize: '10px' }}>
                  <thead>
                    <tr style={{ background: '#f1f5f9', borderTop: '1px solid #cbd5e1', borderBottom: '1px solid #cbd5e1' }}>
                      <th style={{ padding: '6px 8px', textAlign: 'left', fontWeight: 700, color: '#334155' }}>NĂM</th>
                      <th style={{ padding: '6px 8px', textAlign: 'right', fontWeight: 700, color: '#e11d48' }}>SỨC MUA CÒN LẠI CỦA {formatMoney(currentAmount)}</th>
                      <th style={{ padding: '6px 8px', textAlign: 'right', fontWeight: 700, color: '#d97706' }}>SỐ TIỀN TƯƠNG ĐƯƠNG CẦN CÓ</th>
                      <th style={{ padding: '6px 8px', textAlign: 'right', fontWeight: 700, color: '#64748b' }}>TỶ LỆ HAO HỤT LŨY KẾ</th>
                    </tr>
                  </thead>
                  <tbody>
                    {pageRows.map((row, idx) => {
                      const lossPercent = currentAmount > 0 ? ((currentAmount - row.purchasingPower) / currentAmount) * 100 : 0;
                      return (
                        <tr
                          key={row.year}
                          style={{
                            borderBottom: '1px solid #e2e8f0',
                            background: idx % 2 === 0 ? '#ffffff' : '#f8fafc',
                          }}
                        >
                          <td style={{ padding: '5px 8px', fontWeight: 700, color: '#0f172a' }}>Năm {row.year}</td>
                          <td style={{ padding: '5px 8px', textAlign: 'right', color: '#be123c', fontWeight: 600 }}>{formatMoney(row.purchasingPower)}</td>
                          <td style={{ padding: '5px 8px', textAlign: 'right', color: '#b45309', fontWeight: 700 }}>{formatMoney(row.equivalent)}</td>
                          <td style={{ padding: '5px 8px', textAlign: 'right', color: '#64748b', fontWeight: 600 }}>-{lossPercent.toFixed(1)}%</td>
                        </tr>
                      );
                    })}
                  </tbody>
                </table>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Footer */}
            <div style={{ borderTop: '1px solid #e2e8f0', paddingTop: '8px', display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', fontSize: '9px', color: '#94a3b8' }}>
              <div>Web Calculator • Công cụ phân tích lạm phát và sức mua tiền tệ</div>
              <div>Trang {pageIdx + 1} / {totalPagesCount}</div>
            </div>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

FILE: /src/components/tools/InterestCalculator.tsx

import React, { useState, useMemo, useEffect } from 'react';
import { DollarSign, RotateCcw, TrendingUp, Award, FileDown } from 'lucide-react';
import { useCurrency } from '../../context/CurrencyContext';
import { CurrencySelector } from '../common/CurrencySelector';
import { InterestPdfModal } from './InterestPdfModal';

export const InterestCalculator: React.FC = () => {
  const { currency, currencyInfo, formatMoney } = useCurrency();

  const [principal, setPrincipal] = useState<number>(() => {
    return currency === 'VND' ? 200000000 : 10000;
  });
  const [rate, setRate] = useState<number>(7.0);
  const [years, setYears] = useState<number>(5);
  const [compoundFreq, setCompoundFreq] = useState<number>(12); // 12 = monthly, 1 = yearly, 4 = quarterly, 365 = daily
  const [isPdfModalOpen, setIsPdfModalOpen] = useState<boolean>(false);

  // Synchronize when currency changes
  useEffect(() => {
    if (currency === 'VND') {
      setPrincipal((prev) => (prev < 100000 ? 200000000 : prev));
    } else {
      setPrincipal((prev) => (prev >= 1000000 ? 10000 : prev));
    }
  }, [currency]);

  const calculations = useMemo(() => {
    const p = Math.max(0, principal);
    const r = rate / 100;
    const t = Math.max(0, years);
    const n = compoundFreq;

    // Simple Interest: I = P * r * t
    const simpleInterest = p * r * t;
    const simpleTotal = p + simpleInterest;

    // Compound Interest: A = P * (1 + r/n)^(n*t)
    const compoundTotal = n > 0 ? p * Math.pow(1 + r / n, n * t) : simpleTotal;
    const compoundInterest = compoundTotal - p;
    const difference = compoundInterest - simpleInterest;

    // Year-by-year comparison
    const yearlyBreakdown = [];
    for (let yr = 1; yr <= Math.min(20, t); yr++) {
      const sTotal = p + (p * r * yr);
      const cTotal = p * Math.pow(1 + r / n, n * yr);
      yearlyBreakdown.push({
        year: yr,
        simple: sTotal,
        compound: cTotal,
        gain: cTotal - sTotal
      });
    }

    return {
      simpleInterest,
      simpleTotal,
      compoundTotal,
      compoundInterest,
      difference,
      yearlyBreakdown
    };
  }, [principal, rate, years, compoundFreq]);

  const handleReset = () => {
    setPrincipal(currency === 'VND' ? 200000000 : 10000);
    setRate(7.0);
    setYears(5);
    setCompoundFreq(12);
  };

  return (
    <div className="w-full max-w-5xl mx-auto space-y-6">
      {/* Banner */}
      <div className="p-4 sm:p-6 rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-r from-emerald-900/40 via-slate-800 to-slate-900 border border-emerald-500/30 flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-3">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <div className="p-3 bg-emerald-600/20 text-emerald-400 rounded-xl border border-emerald-500/30">
            <TrendingUp className="w-6 h-6" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <h1 className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-bold text-white tracking-tight">Interest Calculator – Tính Lãi Suất Đơn &amp; Lãi Kép</h1>
            <p className="text-xs sm:text-sm text-slate-400">So sánh trực quan sức mạnh kỳ diệu của lãi kép so với lãi đơn theo thời gian</p>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <CurrencySelector variant="compact" />
          <button
            id="interest-export-pdf-top-btn"
            onClick={() => setIsPdfModalOpen(true)}
            className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-white bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-500 rounded-lg shadow-sm transition-all cursor-pointer"
            title="Xuất file PDF so sánh lãi suất"
          >
            <FileDown className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            <span className="hidden sm:inline">Xuất PDF</span>
          </button>
          <button
            id="interest-reset-btn"
            onClick={handleReset}
            className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs text-slate-300 hover:text-white bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 border border-slate-700 rounded-lg transition-colors cursor-pointer"
          >
            <RotateCcw className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            <span>Đặt lại</span>
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6">
        {/* Input parameters */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-5 space-y-4 bg-slate-900/80 p-5 rounded-2xl border border-slate-800">
          <h2 className="text-base font-semibold text-white flex items-center gap-2">
            <DollarSign className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-400" />
            Thông số tiền gửi / đầu tư
          </h2>

          <div>
            <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-300 mb-1">
              Số tiền gốc ban đầu ({currencyInfo.symbol} {currencyInfo.code})
            </label>
            <div className="relative">
              <span className="absolute left-3.5 top-2.5 text-slate-400 font-bold">{currencyInfo.symbol}</span>
              <input
                id="interest-principal"
                type="number"
                step={currency === 'VND' ? 5000000 : 100}
                value={principal}
                onChange={(e) => setPrincipal(Number(e.target.value))}
                className="w-full pl-9 pr-14 py-2.5 bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-white font-sans focus:ring-2 focus:ring-emerald-500 outline-none"
              />
              <span className="absolute right-3.5 top-2.5 text-slate-400 text-xs font-bold">{currencyInfo.code}</span>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-300 mb-1">Lãi suất hàng năm (%/năm)</label>
              <input
                id="interest-rate"
                type="number"
                step="0.1"
                value={rate}
                onChange={(e) => setRate(Number(e.target.value))}
                className="w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-white font-sans focus:ring-2 focus:ring-emerald-500 outline-none"
              />
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-300 mb-1">Thời gian (năm)</label>
              <input
                id="interest-years"
                type="number"
                value={years}
                onChange={(e) => setYears(Number(e.target.value))}
                className="w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-white font-sans focus:ring-2 focus:ring-emerald-500 outline-none"
              />
            </div>
          </div>

          <div>
            <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-300 mb-1">Kỳ hạn ghép lãi (Lãi kép)</label>
            <select
              id="interest-compound-freq"
              value={compoundFreq}
              onChange={(e) => setCompoundFreq(Number(e.target.value))}
              className="w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-white font-sans focus:ring-2 focus:ring-emerald-500 outline-none"
            >
              <option value={1}>Hàng năm (1 lần/năm)</option>
              <option value={2}>Nửa năm (2 lần/năm)</option>
              <option value={4}>Hàng quý (4 lần/năm)</option>
              <option value={12}>Hàng tháng (12 lần/năm)</option>
              <option value={365}>Hàng ngày (365 lần/năm)</option>
            </select>
          </div>

          <div className="p-3.5 rounded-xl bg-slate-800/60 border border-slate-700/60 space-y-1.5 text-xs text-slate-300">
            <div className="font-semibold text-emerald-400">Công thức toán học áp dụng:</div>
            <div>• Lãi đơn: <span className="font-sans font-semibold text-white">I = P × r × t</span></div>
            <div>• Lãi kép: <span className="font-sans font-semibold text-white">A = P × (1 + r/n)^(n×t)</span></div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Results comparison */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-7 space-y-4">
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
            {/* Simple Interest Card */}
            <div className="p-5 rounded-2xl bg-white dark:bg-slate-900/90 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 space-y-2 shadow-xs">
              <span className="text-xs uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 font-semibold">LÃI ĐƠN (SIMPLE)</span>
              <div className="text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white font-sans tabular-nums">
                {formatMoney(calculations.simpleTotal)}
              </div>
              <div className="text-xs text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 flex justify-between pt-1 border-t border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800">
                <span>Tiền lãi sinh ra:</span>
                <span className="text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400 font-semibold">{formatMoney(calculations.simpleInterest)}</span>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Compound Interest Card */}
            <div className="p-5 rounded-2xl bg-white dark:bg-gradient-to-b dark:from-emerald-950/40 dark:to-slate-900 border border-emerald-300 dark:border-emerald-500/50 space-y-2 shadow-sm">
              <span className="text-xs uppercase tracking-wider text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400 font-bold flex items-center gap-1.5">
                <Award className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                LÃI KÉP (COMPOUND)
              </span>
              <div className="text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-extrabold text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-300 font-sans tabular-nums">
                {formatMoney(calculations.compoundTotal)}
              </div>
              <div className="text-xs text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 flex justify-between pt-1 border-t border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800">
                <span>Tiền lãi sinh ra:</span>
                <span className="text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400 font-semibold">{formatMoney(calculations.compoundInterest)}</span>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="p-4 rounded-xl bg-blue-50 dark:bg-blue-950/30 border border-blue-200 dark:border-blue-500/30 text-xs sm:text-sm text-blue-900 dark:text-blue-200 flex items-center justify-between">

          </div>
