import React, { useState, useRef } from 'react';
import { X, FileDown, Printer, Check, Loader2, TrendingUp, DollarSign, Calendar, Sparkles, CheckCircle2, Share2 } from 'lucide-react';
import { useCurrency } from '../../context/CurrencyContext';
import { useLanguage } from '../../context/LanguageContext';
import { exportElementPagesToPdf, PdfExportResult } from '../../utils/pdfExportHelper';

export interface InterestPdfModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  principal: number;
  rate: number;
  years: number;
  compoundFreq: number;
  calculations: {
    simpleInterest: number;
    simpleTotal: number;
    compoundTotal: number;
    compoundInterest: number;
    difference: number;
    yearlyBreakdown: {
      year: number;
      simple: number;
      compound: number;
      gain: number;
    }[];
  };
}

export const InterestPdfModal: React.FC<InterestPdfModalProps> = ({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  principal,
  rate,
  years,
  compoundFreq,
  calculations
}) => {
  const { currencyInfo, formatMoney } = useCurrency();
  const { language } = useLanguage();
  const isVi = language === 'vi';

  const [isExporting, setIsExporting] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [exportProgress, setExportProgress] = useState<string>('');
  const [isDone, setIsDone] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [exportResult, setExportResult] = useState<PdfExportResult | null>(null);

  const printContainerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const freqLabel = compoundFreq === 1 
    ? (isVi ? 'Hàng năm (1 lần/năm)' : 'Annually')
    : compoundFreq === 4 
      ? (isVi ? 'Hàng quý (4 lần/năm)' : 'Quarterly')
      : compoundFreq === 12 
        ? (isVi ? 'Hàng tháng (12 lần/năm)' : 'Monthly')
        : (isVi ? 'Hàng ngày (365 lần/năm)' : 'Daily');

  const currentDateFormatted = new Date().toLocaleDateString(isVi ? 'vi-VN' : 'en-US', {
    year: 'numeric',
    month: 'long',
    day: 'numeric'
  });

  const handleExportPDF = async () => {
    if (isExporting || !printContainerRef.current) return;
    try {
      setIsExporting(true);
      setIsDone(false);
      setExportProgress(isVi ? 'Đang chuẩn bị trang in...' : 'Preparing pages...');

      const fileName = `So_Sanh_Lai_Suat_${principal}_${years}nam_${new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10)}.pdf`;

      const result = await exportElementPagesToPdf(printContainerRef.current, {
        fileName,
        pageSelector: '.pdf-report-page',
        onProgress: (text) => setExportProgress(text),
      });

      setExportResult(result);
      setIsDone(true);
      setTimeout(() => {
        setIsDone(false);
      }, 4000);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Lỗi khi xuất PDF lãi suất:', err);
      alert(isVi ? 'Có lỗi xảy ra khi tạo file PDF. Vui lòng thử lại.' : 'Error generating PDF. Please retry.');
    } finally {
      setIsExporting(false);
      setExportProgress('');
    }
  };

  const handleNativePrint = () => {
    window.print();
  };

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-black/75 backdrop-blur-sm animate-in fade-in duration-200 print:hidden">
      <div 
        className="w-full max-w-2xl bg-slate-900 border border-slate-700 rounded-2xl shadow-2xl overflow-hidden flex flex-col max-h-[90vh]"
        onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
      >
        {/* Modal Header */}
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between px-5 py-4 border-b border-slate-800 bg-slate-950/60">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
            <div className="p-2 rounded-xl bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-400 border border-emerald-500/30">
              <TrendingUp className="w-5 h-5" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <h3 className="font-bold text-base text-white">
                {isVi ? 'Xuất Kế Hoạch & So Sánh Lãi Suất (PDF)' : 'Export Interest Comparison (PDF)'}
              </h3>
              <p className="text-xs text-slate-400">
                {isVi ? 'Định dạng chuẩn A4 in ấn, so sánh lãi đơn vs lãi kép' : 'Standard A4 ready for print & download'}
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
          <button
            onClick={onClose}
            className="p-1.5 rounded-lg text-slate-400 hover:text-white hover:bg-slate-800 transition-colors"
          >
            <X className="w-5 h-5" />
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Modal Body Preview */}
        <div className="p-5 overflow-y-auto space-y-4 text-sm scrollbar-thin">
          <div className="p-4 rounded-xl bg-slate-800/60 border border-slate-700/80 space-y-3">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs text-slate-400 pb-2 border-b border-slate-700/60">
              <span>{isVi ? 'Tổng quan hồ sơ so sánh' : 'Summary'}</span>
              <span className="text-emerald-400 font-semibold">{currentDateFormatted}</span>
            </div>

            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-4 gap-2.5 text-xs">
              <div className="p-2.5 rounded-lg bg-slate-900/80 border border-slate-800">
                <span className="text-slate-400 block">{isVi ? 'Vốn ban đầu' : 'Principal'}</span>
                <span className="font-bold text-white font-mono mt-0.5 block">{formatMoney(principal)}</span>
              </div>
              <div className="p-2.5 rounded-lg bg-slate-900/80 border border-slate-800">
                <span className="text-slate-400 block">{isVi ? 'Lãi suất / năm' : 'Annual Rate'}</span>
                <span className="font-bold text-emerald-400 font-mono mt-0.5 block">{rate}% / năm</span>
              </div>
              <div className="p-2.5 rounded-lg bg-slate-900/80 border border-slate-800">
                <span className="text-slate-400 block">{isVi ? 'Kỳ hạn gửi' : 'Duration'}</span>
                <span className="font-bold text-white font-mono mt-0.5 block">{years} {isVi ? 'năm' : 'years'}</span>
              </div>
              <div className="p-2.5 rounded-lg bg-slate-900/80 border border-slate-800">
                <span className="text-slate-400 block">{isVi ? 'Ghép lãi' : 'Compounding'}</span>
                <span className="font-bold text-blue-400 mt-0.5 block truncate">{freqLabel}</span>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3 pt-2">
              <div className="p-3 rounded-lg bg-slate-900/90 border border-slate-800">
                <span className="text-[11px] font-bold text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-wider block">Lãi Đơn Thu Về</span>
                <span className="text-lg font-black text-slate-200 font-mono mt-0.5 block">
                  {formatMoney(calculations.simpleTotal)}
                </span>
                <span className="text-xs text-slate-400">
                  Tiền lãi: +{formatMoney(calculations.simpleInterest)}
                </span>
              </div>

              <div className="p-3 rounded-lg bg-emerald-950/40 border border-emerald-500/40">
                <span className="text-[11px] font-bold text-emerald-400 uppercase tracking-wider block">Lãi Kép Thu Về</span>
                <span className="text-lg font-black text-emerald-300 font-mono mt-0.5 block">
                  {formatMoney(calculations.compoundTotal)}
                </span>
                <span className="text-xs text-emerald-400 font-semibold">
                  Tiền lãi: +{formatMoney(calculations.compoundInterest)} (Lãi kép hơn +{formatMoney(calculations.difference)})
                </span>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Khi file PDF đã sẵn sàng, hiển thị nút tải trực tiếp và share (đặc biệt hữu ích trên iPhone/Android) */}
            {exportResult && (
              <div className="p-3 bg-emerald-950/60 border border-emerald-500/50 rounded-xl flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-center justify-between gap-3 text-xs shadow-xs">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-emerald-300 min-w-0">
                  <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-400 shrink-0" />
                  <span className="font-semibold shrink-0">{isVi ? 'File PDF đã sẵn sàng:' : 'PDF ready:'}</span>
                  <span className="font-mono text-[11px] truncate max-w-[170px] text-slate-300">{exportResult.fileName}</span>
                </div>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2 w-full sm:w-auto shrink-0">
                  <a
                    href={exportResult.blobUrl}
                    download={exportResult.fileName}
                    target="_blank"
                    rel="noopener noreferrer"
                    className="flex-1 sm:flex-none px-3.5 py-1.5 bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-500 text-white font-bold rounded-lg text-center shadow-xs flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 transition-colors"
                  >
                    <FileDown className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                    <span>{isVi ? 'Mở / Tải file' : 'Open / Save'}</span>
                  </a>
                  {typeof navigator !== 'undefined' && !!navigator.share && (
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={async () => {
                        try {
                          const file = new File([exportResult.blob], exportResult.fileName, { type: 'application/pdf' });
                          if (navigator.canShare && navigator.canShare({ files: [file] })) {
                            await navigator.share({ files: [file], title: exportResult.fileName });
                          } else {
                            window.open(exportResult.blobUrl, '_blank');
                          }
                        } catch (err: any) {
                          if (err.name !== 'AbortError') {
                            window.open(exportResult.blobUrl, '_blank');
                          }
                        }
                      }}
                      className="flex-1 sm:flex-none px-3 py-1.5 bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-200 font-bold rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 border border-slate-700 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                    >
                      <Share2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                      <span>{isVi ? 'Lưu vào Tệp' : 'Save to Files'}</span>
                    </button>
                  )}
                </div>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Modal Footer */}
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between px-5 py-4 border-t border-slate-800 bg-slate-950/80">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={handleNativePrint}
            className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3.5 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-300 hover:text-white bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 border border-slate-700 rounded-xl transition-colors cursor-pointer"
          >
            <Printer className="w-4 h-4" />
            <span>{isVi ? 'In ấn ngay' : 'Print'}</span>
          </button>

          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={onClose}
              className="px-3.5 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-200 transition-colors"
            >
              {isVi ? 'Đóng' : 'Close'}
            </button>

            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={handleExportPDF}
              disabled={isExporting}
              className="flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2 text-xs font-bold text-white bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-500 rounded-xl shadow-lg shadow-emerald-900/30 transition-all cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-50"
            >
              {isExporting ? (
                <>
                  <Loader2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5 animate-spin" />
                  <span>{exportProgress || (isVi ? 'Đang tạo PDF...' : 'Generating...')}</span>
                </>
              ) : isDone ? (
                <>
                  <Check className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-300" />
                  <span>{isVi ? 'Đã tải xong!' : 'Downloaded!'}</span>
                </>
              ) : (
                <>
                  <FileDown className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  <span>{isVi ? 'Tải file PDF ngay' : 'Download PDF'}</span>
                </>
              )}
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* PRINTABLE CONTAINER (Off-screen, NOT display: none for sharp html2canvas rendering) */}
      <div
        ref={printContainerRef}
        id="interest-pdf-printable-source"
        aria-hidden="true"
        style={{
          position: 'fixed',
          left: '-9999px',
          top: 0,
          width: '794px',
          height: 'auto',
          overflow: 'hidden',
          pointerEvents: 'none',
          backgroundColor: '#ffffff',
          color: '#0f172a',
          zIndex: -9999,
        }}
      >
        <div
          className="pdf-report-page bg-white text-slate-900"
          style={{
            width: '794px',
            minHeight: '1123px',
            height: '1123px',
            padding: '36px 40px',
            boxSizing: 'border-box',
            display: 'flex',
            flexDirection: 'column',
            justifyContent: 'space-between',
            fontFamily: 'system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif',
          }}
        >
          <div>
            {/* Header */}
            <div style={{ borderBottom: '2px solid #059669', paddingBottom: '14px', marginBottom: '16px' }}>
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'flex-start' }}>
                <div>
                  <div style={{ fontSize: '10px', fontWeight: 800, textTransform: 'uppercase', letterSpacing: '1px', color: '#059669' }}>
                    BÁO CÁO TÀI CHÍNH • SAVINGS &amp; INTEREST ANALYSIS
                  </div>
                  <h1 style={{ fontSize: '20px', fontWeight: 900, color: '#0f172a', margin: '4px 0 2px 0', letterSpacing: '-0.5px' }}>
                    BÁO CÁO SO SÁNH LÃI SUẤT ĐƠN &amp; LÃI KÉP
                  </h1>
                  <div style={{ fontSize: '11px', color: '#475569' }}>
                    Phân tích hiệu quả sinh lời và chênh lệch tăng trưởng theo thời gian tích lũy
                  </div>
                </div>
                <div style={{ textAlign: 'right', fontSize: '10px', color: '#64748b' }}>
                  <div>Ngày lập: <strong style={{ color: '#0f172a' }}>{currentDateFormatted}</strong></div>
                  <div>Tiền tệ: <strong style={{ color: '#0f172a' }}>{currencyInfo.code} ({currencyInfo.symbol})</strong></div>
                  <div style={{ marginTop: '2px', display: 'inline-block', padding: '2px 6px', background: '#ecfdf5', color: '#047857', borderRadius: '4px', fontWeight: 700 }}>
                    Kỳ ghép lãi: {freqLabel}
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Thông số cơ sở */}
            <div style={{ background: '#f8fafc', border: '1px solid #e2e8f0', borderRadius: '8px', padding: '12px 16px', marginBottom: '16px' }}>
              <div style={{ fontSize: '11px', fontWeight: 700, textTransform: 'uppercase', color: '#334155', marginBottom: '8px' }}>
                Thông Số Đầu Vào Cơ Sở
              </div>
              <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(4, 1fr)', gap: '10px' }}>
                <div>
                  <div style={{ fontSize: '10px', color: '#64748b' }}>Vốn gốc ban đầu:</div>
                  <div style={{ fontSize: '13px', fontWeight: 800, color: '#0f172a' }}>{formatMoney(principal)}</div>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <div style={{ fontSize: '10px', color: '#64748b' }}>Lãi suất hàng năm:</div>
                  <div style={{ fontSize: '13px', fontWeight: 800, color: '#059669' }}>{rate}% / năm</div>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <div style={{ fontSize: '10px', color: '#64748b' }}>Thời gian đầu tư:</div>
                  <div style={{ fontSize: '13px', fontWeight: 800, color: '#0f172a' }}>{years} năm ({years * 12} tháng)</div>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <div style={{ fontSize: '10px', color: '#64748b' }}>Tần suất ghép lãi:</div>
                  <div style={{ fontSize: '13px', fontWeight: 800, color: '#2563eb' }}>{freqLabel}</div>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Bảng so sánh kết quả chính */}
            <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(3, 1fr)', gap: '12px', marginBottom: '18px' }}>
              <div style={{ border: '1px solid #cbd5e1', borderRadius: '8px', padding: '12px' }}>
                <div style={{ fontSize: '10px', fontWeight: 700, color: '#64748b', textTransform: 'uppercase' }}>KẾT QUẢ LÃI ĐƠN</div>
                <div style={{ fontSize: '17px', fontWeight: 900, color: '#334155', margin: '4px 0' }}>{formatMoney(calculations.simpleTotal)}</div>
                <div style={{ fontSize: '10px', color: '#475569' }}>Tiền lãi: +{formatMoney(calculations.simpleInterest)}</div>
              </div>

              <div style={{ border: '2px solid #059669', background: '#f0fdf4', borderRadius: '8px', padding: '12px' }}>
                <div style={{ fontSize: '10px', fontWeight: 800, color: '#047857', textTransform: 'uppercase' }}>KẾT QUẢ LÃI KÉP</div>
                <div style={{ fontSize: '17px', fontWeight: 900, color: '#047857', margin: '4px 0' }}>{formatMoney(calculations.compoundTotal)}</div>
                <div style={{ fontSize: '10px', color: '#065f46', fontWeight: 700 }}>Tiền lãi: +{formatMoney(calculations.compoundInterest)}</div>
              </div>

              <div style={{ border: '1px solid #93c5fd', background: '#eff6ff', borderRadius: '8px', padding: '12px' }}>
                <div style={{ fontSize: '10px', fontWeight: 800, color: '#1d4ed8', textTransform: 'uppercase' }}>LÃI KÉP VƯỢT TRỘI HƠN</div>
                <div style={{ fontSize: '17px', fontWeight: 900, color: '#1d4ed8', margin: '4px 0' }}>+{formatMoney(calculations.difference)}</div>
                <div style={{ fontSize: '10px', color: '#1e40af' }}>
                  Hiệu quả: +{((calculations.difference / Math.max(1, calculations.simpleInterest)) * 100).toFixed(1)}% so với lãi đơn
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Bảng tiến trình từng năm */}
            <div>
              <div style={{ fontSize: '11px', fontWeight: 800, textTransform: 'uppercase', color: '#334155', marginBottom: '6px' }}>
                Tiến Trình Tăng Trưởng Giá Trị Tài Sản Từng Năm
              </div>
              <table style={{ width: '100%', borderCollapse: 'collapse', fontSize: '10px' }}>
                <thead>
                  <tr style={{ background: '#f1f5f9', borderBottom: '1px solid #cbd5e1' }}>
                    <th style={{ padding: '6px 8px', textAlign: 'left', color: '#475569' }}>Năm</th>
                    <th style={{ padding: '6px 8px', textAlign: 'right', color: '#475569' }}>Tổng tiền (Lãi đơn)</th>
                    <th style={{ padding: '6px 8px', textAlign: 'right', color: '#047857' }}>Tổng tiền (Lãi kép)</th>
                    <th style={{ padding: '6px 8px', textAlign: 'right', color: '#1d4ed8' }}>Chênh lệch do lãi kép mang lại</th>
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody>
                  {calculations.yearlyBreakdown.map((row, idx) => (
                    <tr key={row.year} style={{ borderBottom: '1px solid #e2e8f0', background: idx % 2 === 0 ? '#ffffff' : '#f8fafc' }}>
                      <td style={{ padding: '5px 8px', fontWeight: 700, color: '#0f172a' }}>Năm {row.year}</td>
                      <td style={{ padding: '5px 8px', textAlign: 'right', color: '#475569' }}>{formatMoney(row.simple)}</td>
                      <td style={{ padding: '5px 8px', textAlign: 'right', fontWeight: 700, color: '#047857' }}>{formatMoney(row.compound)}</td>
                      <td style={{ padding: '5px 8px', textAlign: 'right', fontWeight: 700, color: '#1d4ed8' }}>+{formatMoney(row.gain)}</td>
                    </tr>
                  ))}
                </tbody>
              </table>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Footer */}
          <div style={{ borderTop: '1px solid #cbd5e1', paddingTop: '10px', fontSize: '9px', color: '#64748b', display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between' }}>
            <span>Tài liệu phân tích tự động từ Web Calculator (AC Studio)</span>
            <span>Trang 1 / 1</span>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

import React, { useState, useMemo, useEffect } from 'react';
import { Coins, DollarSign, RotateCcw, FileDown } from 'lucide-react';
import { useCurrency } from '../../context/CurrencyContext';
import { CurrencySelector } from '../common/CurrencySelector';
import { InvestmentPdfModal } from './InvestmentPdfModal';

export const InvestmentCalculator: React.FC = () => {
  const { currency, currencyInfo, formatMoney } = useCurrency();

  const [startingAmount, setStartingAmount] = useState<number>(() => {
    return currency === 'VND' ? 100000000 : 5000;
  });
  const [periodicDeposit, setPeriodicDeposit] = useState<number>(() => {
    return currency === 'VND' ? 5000000 : 300;
  });
  const [depositFrequency, setDepositFrequency] = useState<'monthly' | 'annually'>('monthly');
  const [durationYears, setDurationYears] = useState<number>(10);
  const [annualReturn, setAnnualReturn] = useState<number>(8.0);
  const [isPdfModalOpen, setIsPdfModalOpen] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const compounding: 'monthly' | 'annually' = 'monthly';

  // Synchronize when switching currency
  useEffect(() => {
    if (currency === 'VND') {
      setStartingAmount((prev) => (prev < 100000 ? 100000000 : prev));
      setPeriodicDeposit((prev) => (prev < 5000 ? 5000000 : prev));
    } else {
      setStartingAmount((prev) => (prev >= 1000000 ? 5000 : prev));
      setPeriodicDeposit((prev) => (prev >= 50000 ? 300 : prev));
    }
  }, [currency]);

  const calculations = useMemo(() => {
    const P = Math.max(0, startingAmount);
    const PMT = Math.max(0, periodicDeposit);
    const r = (annualReturn / 100);
    const t = Math.max(1, durationYears);

    let balance = P;
    let totalDeposits = P;
    const yearlyData = [];

    for (let yr = 1; yr <= t; yr++) {
      let yearlyInterestEarned = 0;
      let yearlyDepositAdded = 0;

      for (let m = 1; m <= 12; m++) {
        if (depositFrequency === 'monthly' || (depositFrequency === 'annually' && m === 1)) {
          balance += PMT;
          yearlyDepositAdded += PMT;
          totalDeposits += PMT;
        }

        const monthlyRate = r / 12;
        const interest = balance * monthlyRate;
        balance += interest;
        yearlyInterestEarned += interest;
      }

      yearlyData.push({
        year: yr,
        depositsAdded: yearlyDepositAdded,
        totalDeposits,
        interest: yearlyInterestEarned,
        balance
      });
    }

    const totalInterest = balance - totalDeposits;
    const roiPercentage = totalDeposits > 0 ? (totalInterest / totalDeposits) * 100 : 0;

    return {
      endBalance: balance,
      totalDeposits,
      totalInterest,
      roiPercentage,
      yearlyData
    };
  }, [startingAmount, periodicDeposit, depositFrequency, durationYears, annualReturn, compounding]);

  const handleReset = () => {
    setStartingAmount(currency === 'VND' ? 100000000 : 5000);
    setPeriodicDeposit(currency === 'VND' ? 5000000 : 300);
    setDurationYears(10);
    setAnnualReturn(8.0);
  };

  return (
    <div className="w-full max-w-5xl mx-auto space-y-6">
      <div className="p-4 sm:p-6 rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-r from-emerald-900/40 via-slate-800 to-slate-900 border border-emerald-500/30 flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-3">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <div className="p-3 bg-emerald-600/20 text-emerald-400 rounded-xl border border-emerald-500/30">
            <Coins className="w-6 h-6" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <h1 className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-bold text-white tracking-tight">Investment Calculator – Tính Toán Lợi Nhuận Đầu Tư</h1>
            <p className="text-xs sm:text-sm text-slate-400">Ước tính giá trị tài sản trong tương lai với số vốn ban đầu và tích lũy định kỳ</p>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <CurrencySelector variant="compact" />
          <button
            id="invest-export-pdf-header-btn"
            onClick={() => setIsPdfModalOpen(true)}
            className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs text-emerald-300 hover:text-white bg-emerald-950/60 hover:bg-emerald-900 border border-emerald-600/40 rounded-lg transition-colors cursor-pointer font-medium"
            title="Xuất báo cáo PDF hoặc In ấn"
          >
            <FileDown className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            <span>Xuất PDF / In</span>
          </button>
          <button
            id="invest-reset-btn"
            onClick={handleReset}
            className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs text-slate-300 hover:text-white bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 border border-slate-700 rounded-lg transition-colors cursor-pointer"
          >
            <RotateCcw className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            <span>Đặt lại</span>
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6">
        <div className="lg:col-span-5 space-y-4 bg-slate-900/80 p-5 rounded-2xl border border-slate-800">
          <h2 className="text-base font-semibold text-white flex items-center gap-2">
            <DollarSign className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-400" />
            Kế hoạch đầu tư
          </h2>

          <div>
            <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-300 mb-1">
              Vốn khởi đầu ({currencyInfo.symbol} {currencyInfo.code})
            </label>
            <div className="relative">
              <span className="absolute left-3.5 top-2.5 text-slate-400 font-bold">{currencyInfo.symbol}</span>
              <input
                id="invest-starting-amount"
                type="number"
                step={currency === 'VND' ? 5000000 : 100}
                value={startingAmount}
                onChange={(e) => setStartingAmount(Number(e.target.value))}
                className="w-full pl-9 pr-14 py-2.5 bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-white font-sans focus:ring-2 focus:ring-emerald-500 outline-none"
              />
              <span className="absolute right-3.5 top-2.5 text-slate-400 text-xs font-bold">{currencyInfo.code}</span>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-300 mb-1">
                Đóng góp thêm ({currencyInfo.symbol})
              </label>
              <div className="relative">
                <input
                  id="invest-periodic-deposit"
                  type="number"
                  step={currency === 'VND' ? 500000 : 25}
                  value={periodicDeposit}
                  onChange={(e) => setPeriodicDeposit(Number(e.target.value))}
                  className="w-full pl-3 pr-10 py-2.5 bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-white font-sans focus:ring-2 focus:ring-emerald-500 outline-none"
                />
                <span className="absolute right-3 top-2.5 text-slate-400 text-xs font-bold">{currencyInfo.code}</span>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-300 mb-1">Tần suất đóng góp</label>
              <select
                id="invest-frequency"
                value={depositFrequency}
                onChange={(e) => setDepositFrequency(e.target.value as any)}
                className="w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-white font-sans focus:ring-2 focus:ring-emerald-500 outline-none"
              >
                <option value="monthly">Mỗi tháng</option>
                <option value="annually">Mỗi năm</option>
              </select>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-300 mb-1">Lợi nhuận kỳ vọng (%/năm)</label>
              <input
                id="invest-annual-return"
                type="number"
                step="0.1"
                value={annualReturn}
                onChange={(e) => setAnnualReturn(Number(e.target.value))}
                className="w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-white font-sans focus:ring-2 focus:ring-emerald-500 outline-none"
              />
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-300 mb-1">Thời gian đầu tư (năm)</label>
              <input
                id="invest-duration-years"
                type="number"
                value={durationYears}
                onChange={(e) => setDurationYears(Number(e.target.value))}
                className="w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-white font-sans focus:ring-2 focus:ring-emerald-500 outline-none"
              />
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="lg:col-span-7 space-y-4">
          <div className="p-6 rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-b from-emerald-950/40 to-slate-900 border border-emerald-500/40 text-center space-y-2">
            <span className="text-xs uppercase tracking-wider text-emerald-300 font-semibold">
              Tổng giá trị tài sản sau {durationYears} năm
            </span>
            <div className="text-3xl sm:text-5xl font-extrabold text-emerald-300 font-sans tabular-nums">
              {formatMoney(calculations.endBalance)}
            </div>
            <p className="text-xs text-slate-400">
              Tỷ suất hoàn vốn đầu tư tổng thể (ROI): <span className="text-emerald-400 font-bold">+{calculations.roiPercentage.toFixed(1)}%</span>
            </p>
          </div>

          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
            <div className="p-4 bg-slate-900/80 rounded-2xl border border-slate-800 space-y-1">
              <span className="text-xs text-slate-400">Tổng vốn bạn đã bỏ ra</span>
              <div className="text-lg sm:text-2xl font-bold text-white font-sans tabular-nums">
                {formatMoney(calculations.totalDeposits)}
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="p-4 bg-slate-900/80 rounded-2xl border border-slate-800 space-y-1">
              <span className="text-xs text-slate-400">Tổng tiền lãi sinh lời</span>
              <div className="text-lg sm:text-2xl font-bold text-emerald-400 font-sans tabular-nums">
                {formatMoney(calculations.totalInterest)}
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Yearly Progress Table */}
          <div className="p-4 bg-slate-900/80 rounded-2xl border border-slate-800 space-y-3">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <h3 className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-300">
                Biểu đồ tăng trưởng theo từng năm
              </h3>
              <button
                type="button"
                id="invest-export-pdf-table-btn"
                onClick={() => setIsPdfModalOpen(true)}
                className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-1 text-xs text-emerald-300 hover:text-white bg-emerald-950/40 hover:bg-emerald-900/60 border border-emerald-600/30 rounded-lg transition-colors cursor-pointer"
              >
                <FileDown className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                <span>Xuất PDF / In</span>
              </button>
            </div>
            <div className="max-h-52 overflow-y-auto scrollbar-thin">
              <table className="w-full text-xs text-left text-slate-300">
                <thead className="text-[11px] uppercase bg-slate-800 text-slate-400 sticky top-0">
                  <tr>
                    <th className="p-2">Năm</th>
                    <th className="p-2">Tổng vốn nạp</th>
                    <th className="p-2">Tiền lời sinh ra</th>
                    <th className="p-2 text-right">Tổng tài sản</th>
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-800/60 font-sans tabular-nums">
                  {calculations.yearlyData.map((row) => (
                    <tr key={row.year} className="hover:bg-slate-800/40">
                      <td className="p-2 font-medium">Năm {row.year}</td>
                      <td className="p-2 text-slate-300">{formatMoney(row.totalDeposits)}</td>
                      <td className="p-2 text-emerald-400">+{formatMoney(row.interest)}</td>
                      <td className="p-2 text-right font-semibold text-white">{formatMoney(row.balance)}</td>
                    </tr>
                  ))}
                </tbody>
              </table>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* PDF Export Modal */}
      <InvestmentPdfModal
        isOpen={isPdfModalOpen}
        onClose={() => setIsPdfModalOpen(false)}
        startingAmount={startingAmount}
        periodicDeposit={periodicDeposit}
        depositFrequency={depositFrequency}
        durationYears={durationYears}
        annualReturn={annualReturn}
        calculations={calculations}
      />
    </div>
  );
};

import React, { useState, useRef } from 'react';
import { X, FileDown, Printer, Check, Loader2, Calendar, Coins, TrendingUp, ShieldAlert, DollarSign, CheckCircle2, Share2 } from 'lucide-react';
import { useCurrency } from '../../context/CurrencyContext';
import { useLanguage } from '../../context/LanguageContext';
import { exportElementPagesToPdf, PdfExportResult } from '../../utils/pdfExportHelper';

export interface InvestmentPdfModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  startingAmount: number;
  periodicDeposit: number;
  depositFrequency: 'monthly' | 'annually';
  durationYears: number;
  annualReturn: number;
  calculations: {
    endBalance: number;
    totalDeposits: number;
    totalInterest: number;
    roiPercentage: number;
    yearlyData: {
      year: number;
      depositsAdded: number;
      totalDeposits: number;
      interest: number;
      balance: number;
    }[];
  };
}

export const InvestmentPdfModal: React.FC<InvestmentPdfModalProps> = ({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  startingAmount,
  periodicDeposit,
  depositFrequency,
  durationYears,
  annualReturn,
  calculations
}) => {
  const { currencyInfo, formatMoney } = useCurrency();
  const { language } = useLanguage();
  const isVi = language === 'vi';

  const [isExporting, setIsExporting] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [exportProgress, setExportProgress] = useState<string>('');
  const [isDone, setIsDone] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [exportResult, setExportResult] = useState<PdfExportResult | null>(null);

  const printContainerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  // Split yearly data into pages (~28 rows per page)
  const ROWS_PER_PAGE = 28;
  const yearlyPages = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < calculations.yearlyData.length; i += ROWS_PER_PAGE) {
    yearlyPages.push(calculations.yearlyData.slice(i, i + ROWS_PER_PAGE));
  }
  const totalPagesCount = Math.max(1, yearlyPages.length);

  const handleExportPDF = async () => {
    if (isExporting || !printContainerRef.current) return;
    try {
      setIsExporting(true);
      setIsDone(false);
      setExportProgress(isVi ? 'Đang chuẩn bị trang in...' : 'Preparing pages...');

      const dateStr = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
      const fileName = isVi
        ? `Ke_Hoach_Dau_Tu_${Math.round(calculations.endBalance)}_${currencyInfo.code}_${dateStr}.pdf`
        : `Investment_Plan_${Math.round(calculations.endBalance)}_${currencyInfo.code}_${dateStr}.pdf`;

      const result = await exportElementPagesToPdf(printContainerRef.current, {
        fileName,
        pageSelector: '.pdf-report-page',
        onProgress: (text) => setExportProgress(text),
      });

      setExportResult(result);
      setIsDone(true);
      setExportProgress(isVi ? 'Xuất PDF thành công!' : 'PDF export complete!');
      setTimeout(() => {
        setIsDone(false);
        setExportProgress('');
      }, 4000);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Lỗi khi xuất PDF:', error);
      alert(isVi ? 'Có lỗi khi tạo PDF. Bạn có thể chọn In trực tiếp.' : 'Error generating PDF. Try Print directly.');
    } finally {
      setIsExporting(false);
    }
  };

  const handlePrint = () => {
    window.print();
  };

  const currentDateFormatted = new Date().toLocaleDateString(isVi ? 'vi-VN' : 'en-US', {
    year: 'numeric',
    month: 'long',
    day: 'numeric',
  });

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-3 sm:p-4 bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-xs animate-in fade-in duration-200 print:hidden">
      <div className="bg-slate-900 rounded-2xl shadow-2xl border border-slate-800 w-full max-w-xl max-h-[92vh] flex flex-col overflow-hidden text-slate-200">
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="px-5 py-4 border-b border-slate-800 flex items-center justify-between bg-slate-950/80">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-emerald-600/20 border border-emerald-500/40 text-emerald-400 flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs">
              <Coins className="w-5 h-5" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <h3 className="text-base sm:text-lg font-bold text-white">
                {isVi ? 'Xuất Báo Cáo Dự Phóng Lợi Nhuận Đầu Tư' : 'Export Investment Projection Report'}
              </h3>
              <p className="text-xs text-slate-400">
                {isVi 
                  ? 'Bao gồm kế hoạch góp vốn, tiền lãi sinh lời và tăng trưởng tài sản theo năm' 
                  : 'Includes deposit plan, compounding return, and yearly asset growth'}
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
          <button
            onClick={onClose}
            disabled={isExporting}
            className="p-2 text-slate-400 hover:text-white hover:bg-slate-800 rounded-lg transition-colors cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-50"
          >
            <X className="w-5 h-5" />
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Modal Body */}
        <div className="p-5 overflow-y-auto space-y-4 text-sm">
          <div className="p-4 bg-slate-950/60 rounded-xl border border-slate-800 space-y-3">
            <div className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-wider flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <Calendar className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-400" />
              <span>{isVi ? 'Tóm tắt thông số kế hoạch đầu tư' : 'Investment plan summary'}</span>
            </div>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-4 gap-2.5 text-xs">
              <div className="bg-slate-900 p-2.5 rounded-lg border border-slate-800">
                <span className="text-slate-400 block">{isVi ? 'Vốn khởi đầu' : 'Initial Deposit'}</span>
                <span className="text-sm font-bold text-white tabular-nums">{formatMoney(startingAmount)}</span>
              </div>
              <div className="bg-slate-900 p-2.5 rounded-lg border border-slate-800">
                <span className="text-slate-400 block">{isVi ? 'Đóng góp thêm' : 'Periodic Deposit'}</span>
                <span className="text-sm font-bold text-emerald-400 tabular-nums">
                  {formatMoney(periodicDeposit)}/{depositFrequency === 'monthly' ? (isVi ? 'tháng' : 'mo') : (isVi ? 'năm' : 'yr')}
                </span>
              </div>
              <div className="bg-slate-900 p-2.5 rounded-lg border border-slate-800">
                <span className="text-slate-400 block">{isVi ? 'Lợi nhuận kỳ vọng' : 'Expected Return'}</span>
                <span className="text-sm font-bold text-emerald-400 tabular-nums">{annualReturn}% / {isVi ? 'năm' : 'yr'}</span>
              </div>
              <div className="bg-slate-900 p-2.5 rounded-lg border border-slate-800">
                <span className="text-slate-400 block">{isVi ? 'Thời gian' : 'Duration'}</span>
                <span className="text-sm font-bold text-white tabular-nums">{durationYears} {isVi ? 'năm' : 'years'}</span>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="p-4 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-r from-emerald-950/60 to-slate-900 border border-emerald-500/40 text-center space-y-1">
              <span className="text-xs text-emerald-400 uppercase tracking-wider font-semibold">
                {isVi ? `Tổng tài sản sau ${durationYears} năm` : `Total Balance After ${durationYears} Years`}
              </span>
              <div className="text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-extrabold text-white tabular-nums">
                {formatMoney(calculations.endBalance)}
              </div>
              <div className="text-xs text-slate-400">
                {isVi ? 'Tỷ suất hoàn vốn ROI:' : 'Total ROI:'} <span className="text-emerald-400 font-bold">+{calculations.roiPercentage.toFixed(1)}%</span>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2.5 text-xs">
              <div className="p-3 rounded-lg bg-slate-900/90 border border-slate-800">
                <span className="text-slate-400 block mb-1">{isVi ? 'Tổng tiền vốn nạp vào:' : 'Total Capital Invested:'}</span>
                <span className="text-sm sm:text-base font-bold text-slate-200 tabular-nums">{formatMoney(calculations.totalDeposits)}</span>
              </div>
              <div className="p-3 rounded-lg bg-slate-900/90 border border-slate-800">
                <span className="text-slate-400 block mb-1">{isVi ? 'Tổng tiền lãi sinh sôi:' : 'Total Interest Earned:'}</span>
                <span className="text-sm sm:text-base font-bold text-emerald-400 tabular-nums">+{formatMoney(calculations.totalInterest)}</span>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {exportProgress && (
            <div className="p-3 bg-emerald-950/60 border border-emerald-500/40 rounded-xl flex items-center gap-2.5 text-xs text-emerald-300">
              {isExporting ? (
                <Loader2 className="w-4 h-4 animate-spin text-emerald-400 shrink-0" />
              ) : isDone ? (
                <Check className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-400 shrink-0" />
              ) : null}
              <span>{exportProgress}</span>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Khi file PDF đã sẵn sàng, hiển thị nút tải trực tiếp và share (đặc biệt hữu ích trên iPhone/Android) */}
          {exportResult && (
            <div className="p-3 bg-emerald-950/60 border border-emerald-500/50 rounded-xl flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-center justify-between gap-3 text-xs shadow-xs">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-emerald-300 min-w-0">
                <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-400 shrink-0" />
                <span className="font-semibold shrink-0">{isVi ? 'File PDF đã sẵn sàng:' : 'PDF ready:'}</span>
                <span className="font-mono text-[11px] truncate max-w-[170px] text-slate-300">{exportResult.fileName}</span>
              </div>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 w-full sm:w-auto shrink-0">
                <a
                  href={exportResult.blobUrl}
                  download={exportResult.fileName}
                  target="_blank"
                  rel="noopener noreferrer"
                  className="flex-1 sm:flex-none px-3.5 py-1.5 bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-500 text-white font-bold rounded-lg text-center shadow-xs flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 transition-colors"
                >
                  <FileDown className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  <span>{isVi ? 'Mở / Tải file' : 'Open / Save'}</span>
                </a>
                {typeof navigator !== 'undefined' && !!navigator.share && (
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={async () => {
                      try {
                        const file = new File([exportResult.blob], exportResult.fileName, { type: 'application/pdf' });
                        if (navigator.canShare && navigator.canShare({ files: [file] })) {
                          await navigator.share({ files: [file], title: exportResult.fileName });
                        } else {
                          window.open(exportResult.blobUrl, '_blank');
                        }
                      } catch (err: any) {
                        if (err.name !== 'AbortError') {
                          window.open(exportResult.blobUrl, '_blank');
                        }
                      }
                    }}
                    className="flex-1 sm:flex-none px-3 py-1.5 bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-200 font-bold rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 border border-slate-700 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                  >
                    <Share2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                    <span>{isVi ? 'Lưu vào Tệp' : 'Save to Files'}</span>
                  </button>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* Modal Footer */}
        <div className="px-5 py-4 border-t border-slate-800 bg-slate-950/80 flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-center justify-between gap-3">
          <div className="text-xs text-slate-400 flex items-center gap-1.5">
            <ShieldAlert className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-500 shrink-0" />
            <span>{isVi ? 'Định dạng tài liệu A4 chuẩn in ấn, rõ nét' : 'Bank-standard A4 format'}</span>
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 w-full sm:w-auto">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={handlePrint}
              disabled={isExporting}
              className="flex-1 sm:flex-none px-3.5 py-2 bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-200 border border-slate-700 text-xs font-semibold rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 transition-colors cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-50"
            >
              <Printer className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              <span>{isVi ? 'In / Lưu PDF' : 'Print / Save'}</span>
            </button>

            <button
              type="button"
              id="confirm-download-invest-pdf-btn"
              onClick={handleExportPDF}
              disabled={isExporting}
              className="flex-1 sm:flex-none px-5 py-2 bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-500 text-white text-xs font-bold rounded-xl shadow-xs flex items-center justify-center gap-2 transition-all cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-50"
            >
              {isExporting ? (
                <>
                  <Loader2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5 animate-spin" />
                  <span>{isVi ? 'Đang tạo PDF...' : 'Generating...'}</span>
                </>
              ) : isDone ? (
                <>
                  <Check className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-300" />
                  <span>{isVi ? 'Đã tải xong!' : 'Downloaded!'}</span>
                </>
              ) : (
                <>
                  <FileDown className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  <span>{isVi ? 'Tải file PDF ngay' : 'Download PDF'}</span>
                </>
              )}
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* PRINTABLE CONTAINER (Off-screen, NOT display: none for sharp html2canvas rendering) */}
      <div
        ref={printContainerRef}
        id="investment-pdf-printable-source"
        aria-hidden="true"
        style={{
          position: 'fixed',
          left: '-9999px',
          top: 0,
          width: '794px',
          height: 'auto',
          overflow: 'hidden',
          pointerEvents: 'none',
          backgroundColor: '#ffffff',
          color: '#0f172a',
          zIndex: -9999,
        }}
      >
        {yearlyPages.map((pageRows, pageIdx) => (
          <div
            key={`page-${pageIdx}`}
            className="pdf-report-page bg-white text-slate-900"
            style={{
              width: '794px',
              minHeight: '1123px',
              height: '1123px',
              padding: '36px 40px',
              boxSizing: 'border-box',
              display: 'flex',
              flexDirection: 'column',
              justifyContent: 'space-between',
              fontFamily: 'system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif',
            }}
          >
            <div>
              {/* Header */}
              <div style={{ borderBottom: '2px solid #059669', paddingBottom: '14px', marginBottom: '16px' }}>
                <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'flex-start' }}>
                  <div>
                    <div style={{ fontSize: '10px', fontWeight: 800, textTransform: 'uppercase', letterSpacing: '1px', color: '#059669' }}>
                      BÁO CÁO DỰ PHÓNG TÀI CHÍNH • INVESTMENT PROJECTION REPORT
                    </div>
                    <h1 style={{ fontSize: '20px', fontWeight: 900, color: '#0f172a', margin: '4px 0 2px 0', letterSpacing: '-0.5px' }}>
                      BÁO CÁO KẾ HOẠCH ĐẦU TƯ &amp; TÍCH LŨY TÀI SẢN
                    </h1>
                    <div style={{ fontSize: '11px', color: '#475569' }}>
                      Mô phỏng sự gia tăng giá trị danh mục đầu tư với vốn gốc ban đầu và tích lũy định kỳ
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <div style={{ textAlign: 'right', fontSize: '10px', color: '#64748b' }}>
                    <div>Ngày lập: <strong style={{ color: '#0f172a' }}>{currentDateFormatted}</strong></div>
                    <div>Tiền tệ: <strong style={{ color: '#0f172a' }}>{currencyInfo.code} ({currencyInfo.symbol})</strong></div>
                    <div style={{ marginTop: '2px', display: 'inline-block', padding: '2px 6px', background: '#d1fae5', color: '#065f46', borderRadius: '4px', fontWeight: 700 }}>

                      <span style={{ width: '8px', height: '8px', background: '#059669', borderRadius: '2px', display: 'inline-block' }} />
                      <span>1. THÔNG SỐ ĐẦU TƯ &amp; KẾT QUẢ DỰ PHÓNG TỔNG THỂ</span>

                    <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(4, 1fr)', gap: '8px', marginBottom: '8px' }}>
                      <div style={{ background: '#f8fafc', border: '1px solid #e2e8f0', borderRadius: '8px', padding: '10px' }}>

                      >

import React, { useState, useMemo } from 'react';
import { Network, RotateCcw } from 'lucide-react';

export const IpSubnetCalculator: React.FC = () => {
  const [ipAddress, setIpAddress] = useState<string>('192.168.1.150');
  const [cidr, setCidr] = useState<number>(24);

  const calculations = useMemo(() => {
    // Validate IPv4
    const parts = ipAddress.split('.').map(Number);
    if (parts.length !== 4 || parts.some((p) => isNaN(p) || p < 0 || p > 255)) {
      return {
        isValid: false,
        message: 'Địa chỉ IP không hợp lệ. Vui lòng nhập định dạng 4 octet IPv4 (0-255).'
      };
    }

    const ipNum = (parts[0] << 24) | (parts[1] << 16) | (parts[2] << 8) | parts[3];
    const maskNum = cidr === 0 ? 0 : (~0 << (32 - cidr)) >>> 0;
    const wildcardNum = (~maskNum) >>> 0;

    const netNum = (ipNum & maskNum) >>> 0;
    const bcastNum = (netNum | wildcardNum) >>> 0;

    const numToIp = (num: number) => {
      return [
        (num >>> 24) & 255,
        (num >>> 16) & 255,
        (num >>> 8) & 255,
        num & 255
      ].join('.');
    };

    const numToBinary = (num: number) => {
      return [
        ((num >>> 24) & 255).toString(2).padStart(8, '0'),
        ((num >>> 16) & 255).toString(2).padStart(8, '0'),
        ((num >>> 8) & 255).toString(2).padStart(8, '0'),
        (num & 255).toString(2).padStart(8, '0')
      ].join('.');
    };

    const totalHosts = Math.pow(2, 32 - cidr);
    const usableHosts = cidr >= 31 ? (cidr === 31 ? 2 : 1) : Math.max(0, totalHosts - 2);

    const firstUsable = cidr >= 31 ? netNum : netNum + 1;
    const lastUsable = cidr >= 31 ? bcastNum : bcastNum - 1;

    // IP Class
    let ipClass = 'Class C';
    if (parts[0] < 128) ipClass = 'Class A';
    else if (parts[0] < 192) ipClass = 'Class B';
    else if (parts[0] < 224) ipClass = 'Class C';
    else if (parts[0] < 240) ipClass = 'Class D (Multicast)';
    else ipClass = 'Class E (Experimental)';

    return {
      isValid: true,
      networkAddress: numToIp(netNum),
      broadcastAddress: numToIp(bcastNum),
      subnetMask: numToIp(maskNum),
      wildcardMask: numToIp(wildcardNum),
      firstUsableIp: numToIp(firstUsable),
      lastUsableIp: numToIp(lastUsable),
      totalHosts,
      usableHosts,
      ipClass,
      binaryIp: numToBinary(ipNum),
      binaryMask: numToBinary(maskNum)
    };
  }, [ipAddress, cidr]);

  return (
    <div className="w-full max-w-5xl mx-auto space-y-6">
      <div className="p-4 sm:p-6 rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-r from-blue-900/40 via-slate-800 to-slate-900 border border-blue-500/30 flex items-center justify-between">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <div className="p-3 bg-blue-600/20 text-blue-400 rounded-xl border border-blue-500/30">
            <Network className="w-6 h-6" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <h1 className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-bold text-white tracking-tight">IP Subnet Calculator – Tính Toán Chia Mạng Con IPv4</h1>
            <p className="text-xs sm:text-sm text-slate-400">Tính địa chỉ mạng (Network ID), Broadcast, Subnet Mask, dải IP khả dụng và số host</p>
          </div>
        </div>
        <button
          id="subnet-reset-btn"
          onClick={() => { setIpAddress('192.168.1.150'); setCidr(24); }}
          className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs text-slate-300 hover:text-white bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 border border-slate-700 rounded-lg transition-colors cursor-pointer"
        >
          <RotateCcw className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
          <span>Đặt lại</span>
        </button>
      </div>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6">
        <div className="lg:col-span-5 space-y-4 bg-slate-900/80 p-5 rounded-2xl border border-slate-800">
          <h2 className="text-base font-semibold text-white">Địa chỉ IP & Tiền tố CIDR</h2>

          <div>
            <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-300 mb-1">Địa chỉ IPv4</label>
            <input
              id="subnet-ip"
              type="text"
              value={ipAddress}
              onChange={(e) => setIpAddress(e.target.value.trim())}
              className="w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-white font-mono focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 outline-none"
              placeholder="VD: 192.168.1.1"
            />
          </div>

          <div>
            <div className="flex justify-between text-xs font-medium text-slate-300 mb-1">
              <span>Mặt nạ mạng con (CIDR Prefix)</span>
              <span className="text-blue-400 font-bold font-mono">/{cidr}</span>
            </div>
            <input
              id="subnet-cidr-slider"
              type="range"
              min={1}
              max={32}
              value={cidr}
              onChange={(e) => setCidr(Number(e.target.value))}
              className="w-full accent-blue-500"
            />
            <select
              id="subnet-cidr-select"
              value={cidr}
              onChange={(e) => setCidr(Number(e.target.value))}
              className="w-full mt-2 px-3.5 py-2 bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-white font-mono text-xs focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 outline-none"
            >
              {Array.from({ length: 32 }, (_, i) => i + 1).map((c) => (
                <option key={c} value={c}>/{c}</option>
              ))}
            </select>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="lg:col-span-7 space-y-4">
          {!calculations.isValid ? (
            <div className="p-6 rounded-2xl bg-rose-950/40 border border-rose-500/40 text-rose-200 text-sm">
              {calculations.message}
            </div>
          ) : (
            <>
              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                <div className="p-4 bg-slate-900/80 rounded-xl border border-slate-800">
                  <span className="text-xs text-slate-400 block mb-1">Địa chỉ mạng (Network)</span>
                  <span className="text-lg font-bold text-blue-400 font-mono">{calculations.networkAddress}</span>
                </div>
                <div className="p-4 bg-slate-900/80 rounded-xl border border-slate-800">
                  <span className="text-xs text-slate-400 block mb-1">Quảng bá (Broadcast)</span>
                  <span className="text-lg font-bold text-emerald-400 font-mono">{calculations.broadcastAddress}</span>
                </div>
                <div className="p-4 bg-slate-900/80 rounded-xl border border-slate-800">
                  <span className="text-xs text-slate-400 block mb-1">Subnet Mask</span>
                  <span className="text-lg font-bold text-white font-mono">{calculations.subnetMask}</span>
                </div>
                <div className="p-4 bg-slate-900/80 rounded-xl border border-slate-800">
                  <span className="text-xs text-slate-400 block mb-1">Số Host sử dụng được</span>
                  <span className="text-lg font-bold text-white font-sans tabular-nums">
                    {calculations.usableHosts.toLocaleString()} / {calculations.totalHosts.toLocaleString()}
                  </span>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="p-4 rounded-xl bg-slate-900/80 border border-slate-800 space-y-2 text-xs">
                <div className="flex justify-between">
                  <span className="text-slate-400">Dải IP khả dụng:</span>
                  <span className="font-mono text-white font-semibold">
                    {calculations.firstUsableIp} - {calculations.lastUsableIp}
                  </span>
                </div>
                <div className="flex justify-between">
                  <span className="text-slate-400">Lớp địa chỉ (Class):</span>
                  <span className="font-mono text-white font-semibold">{calculations.ipClass}</span>
                </div>
                <div className="flex justify-between">
                  <span className="text-slate-400">Wildcard Mask:</span>
                  <span className="font-mono text-white font-semibold">{calculations.wildcardMask}</span>
                </div>
              </div>
            </>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

import React, { useState, useMemo } from 'react';
import { Ruler, RotateCcw, ArrowRightLeft } from 'lucide-react';

const UNITS: Record<string, { name: string; factor: number }> = {
  m: { name: 'Mét (m)', factor: 1 },
  km: { name: 'Kilômét (km)', factor: 1000 },
  cm: { name: 'Xentimét (cm)', factor: 0.01 },
  mm: { name: 'Milimét (mm)', factor: 0.001 },
  mi: { name: 'Dặm (Mile)', factor: 1609.344 },
  yd: { name: 'Thước (Yard)', factor: 0.9144 },
  ft: { name: 'Bộ (Foot / Feet)', factor: 0.3048 },
  in: { name: 'Phao (Inch)', factor: 0.0254 },
  nmi: { name: 'Hải lý (Nautical Mile)', factor: 1852 },
};

export const LengthConverter: React.FC = () => {
  const [value, setValue] = useState<number>(100);
  const [fromUnit, setFromUnit] = useState<string>('m');
  const [toUnit, setToUnit] = useState<string>('ft');

  const result = useMemo(() => {
    const fromFactor = UNITS[fromUnit]?.factor || 1;
    const toFactor = UNITS[toUnit]?.factor || 1;
    const inMeters = value * fromFactor;
    return inMeters / toFactor;
  }, [value, fromUnit, toUnit]);

  const allConversions = useMemo(() => {
    const fromFactor = UNITS[fromUnit]?.factor || 1;
    const inMeters = value * fromFactor;
    return Object.entries(UNITS).map(([key, item]) => ({
      key,
      name: item.name,
      val: inMeters / item.factor
    }));
  }, [value, fromUnit]);

  const handleSwap = () => {
    setFromUnit(toUnit);
    setToUnit(fromUnit);
  };

  return (
    <div className="w-full max-w-4xl mx-auto space-y-6">
      <div className="p-4 sm:p-6 rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-r from-blue-900/40 via-slate-800 to-slate-900 border border-blue-500/30 flex items-center justify-between">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <div className="p-3 bg-blue-600/20 text-blue-400 rounded-xl border border-blue-500/30">
            <Ruler className="w-6 h-6" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <h1 className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-bold text-white tracking-tight">Length Converter – Chuyển Đổi Đơn Vị Độ Dài</h1>
            <p className="text-xs sm:text-sm text-slate-400">Chuyển đổi tức thì giữa mét, km, inch, foot, yard, dặm và hải lý</p>
          </div>
        </div>
        <button
          id="length-reset-btn"
          onClick={() => { setValue(100); setFromUnit('m'); setToUnit('ft'); }}
          className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs text-slate-300 hover:text-white bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 border border-slate-700 rounded-lg transition-colors cursor-pointer"
        >
          <RotateCcw className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
          <span>Đặt lại</span>
        </button>
      </div>

      <div className="p-6 bg-slate-900/90 rounded-2xl border border-slate-800 space-y-6">
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-7 gap-3 items-center">
          <div className="sm:col-span-3 space-y-2">
            <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-300">Giá trị ban đầu</label>
            <input
              id="length-val-input"
              type="number"
              value={value}
              onChange={(e) => setValue(Number(e.target.value))}
              className="w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-white font-sans focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 outline-none"
            />
            <select
              id="length-from-select"
              value={fromUnit}
              onChange={(e) => setFromUnit(e.target.value)}
              className="w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-white font-sans focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 outline-none"
            >
              {Object.entries(UNITS).map(([k, u]) => (
                <option key={k} value={k}>{u.name}</option>
              ))}
            </select>
          </div>

          <div className="sm:col-span-1 flex justify-center">
            <button
              id="length-swap-btn"
              onClick={handleSwap}
              className="p-3 rounded-full bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 border border-slate-700 text-blue-400 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
              title="Đảo chiều"
            >
              <ArrowRightLeft className="w-4 h-4" />
            </button>
          </div>

          <div className="sm:col-span-3 space-y-2">
            <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-300">Đơn vị đích</label>
            <div className="w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 bg-slate-800/60 border border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-blue-400 font-bold font-sans tabular-nums truncate">
              {result.toLocaleString(undefined, { maximumFractionDigits: 6 })}
            </div>
            <select
              id="length-to-select"
              value={toUnit}
              onChange={(e) => setToUnit(e.target.value)}
              className="w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-white font-sans focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 outline-none"
            >
              {Object.entries(UNITS).map(([k, u]) => (
                <option key={k} value={k}>{u.name}</option>
              ))}
            </select>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* All units grid */}
        <div className="pt-4 border-t border-slate-800">
          <h3 className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-400 mb-3">
            Quy đổi đồng thời sang các đơn vị khác
          </h3>
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-2">
            {allConversions.map((conv) => (
              <div key={conv.key} className="p-2.5 bg-slate-800/40 rounded-xl border border-slate-800 flex justify-between text-xs">
                <span className="text-slate-400">{conv.name}</span>
                <span className="font-semibold text-white font-sans tabular-nums">
                  {conv.val.toLocaleString(undefined, { maximumFractionDigits: 4 })}
                </span>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};


================================================================================
FILE: /src/components/tools/LoanCalculator.tsx
================================================================================
import React, { useState, useMemo, useEffect } from 'react';
import {
  Check,
  Copy,
  Table,
  ChevronDown,
  ChevronUp,
  TrendingDown,
  FileDown
} from 'lucide-react';
import { useCurrency } from '../../context/CurrencyContext';
import { CurrencySelector } from '../common/CurrencySelector';
import { AmortizationPdfModal } from './AmortizationPdfModal';

type LoanMethod = 'emi' | 'reducing';
type TenureUnit = 'years' | 'months';

export const LoanCalculator: React.FC = () => {
  const { currency, currencyInfo, formatMoney } = useCurrency();
  const [isPdfModalOpen, setIsPdfModalOpen] = useState<boolean>(false);

  const [principal, setPrincipal] = useState<number>(() => {
    if (typeof window === 'undefined') return 25000;
    const p = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get('amount') || new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get('principal');
    return p && !isNaN(Number(p)) ? Number(p) : 25000; // Base $25,000
  });

  // When currency changes, automatically adjust principal if it was at a default scale
  useEffect(() => {
    setPrincipal((prev) => {
      if (currency === 'VND' && prev < 1000000) {
        return 500000000;
      } else if (currency !== 'VND' && prev >= 10000000 && (currency === 'USD' || currency === 'EUR' || currency === 'GBP')) {
        return 25000;
      }
      return prev;
    });
  }, [currency]);
  const [interestRate, setInterestRate] = useState<number>(() => {
    if (typeof window === 'undefined') return 8.5;
    const r = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get('rate');
    return r && !isNaN(Number(r)) ? Number(r) : 8.5; // 8.5% / năm
  });
  const [tenureValue, setTenureValue] = useState<number>(() => {
    if (typeof window === 'undefined') return 5;
    const y = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get('years') || new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get('tenure');
    return y && !isNaN(Number(y)) ? Number(y) : 5; // 5 năm
  });
  const [tenureUnit, setTenureUnit] = useState<TenureUnit>('years');
  const [method, setMethod] = useState<LoanMethod>('emi');
  const [showSchedule, setShowSchedule] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState<boolean>(false);

  // Total months
  const totalMonths = useMemo(() => {
    return tenureUnit === 'years' ? tenureValue * 12 : tenureValue;
  }, [tenureValue, tenureUnit]);

  // Calculations
  const loanSummary = useMemo(() => {
    const P = principal;
    const r = interestRate / 100 / 12; // monthly rate
    const n = totalMonths;

    if (P <= 0 || n <= 0) {
      return {
        monthlyPayment: 0,
        firstMonthPayment: 0,
        lastMonthPayment: 0,
        totalInterest: 0,
        totalPayment: 0,
        schedule: [],
      };
    }

    if (method === 'emi') {
      // Fixed monthly EMI formula: [P * r * (1+r)^n] / [(1+r)^n - 1]
      let emi = 0;
      if (r === 0) {
        emi = P / n;
      } else {
        emi = (P * r * Math.pow(1 + r, n)) / (Math.pow(1 + r, n) - 1);
      }

      const totalPayment = emi * n;
      const totalInterest = totalPayment - P;

      // Generate schedule
      const schedule = [];
      let balance = P;
      for (let i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        const interestM = balance * r;
        const principalM = emi - interestM;
        balance = Math.max(0, balance - principalM);
        schedule.push({
          month: i,
          payment: emi,
          principalPaid: principalM,
          interestPaid: interestM,
          balance: balance,
        });
      }

      return {
        monthlyPayment: emi,
        firstMonthPayment: emi,
        lastMonthPayment: emi,
        totalInterest,
        totalPayment,
        schedule,
      };
    } else {
      // Reducing balance: Fixed principal per month + interest on remaining balance
      const fixedPrincipalMonthly = P / n;
      let totalInterest = 0;
      const schedule = [];
      let balance = P;

      for (let i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        const interestM = balance * r;
        const totalMonthM = fixedPrincipalMonthly + interestM;
        totalInterest += interestM;
        balance = Math.max(0, balance - fixedPrincipalMonthly);

        schedule.push({
          month: i,
          payment: totalMonthM,
          principalPaid: fixedPrincipalMonthly,
          interestPaid: interestM,
          balance: balance,
        });
      }

      const totalPayment = P + totalInterest;
      const firstMonthPayment = schedule[0]?.payment || 0;
      const lastMonthPayment = schedule[schedule.length - 1]?.payment || 0;

      return {
        monthlyPayment: firstMonthPayment,
        firstMonthPayment,
        lastMonthPayment,
        totalInterest,
        totalPayment,
        schedule,
      };
    }
  }, [principal, interestRate, totalMonths, method]);

  const principalPercent = useMemo(() => {
    if (loanSummary.totalPayment <= 0) return 100;
    return Math.round((principal / loanSummary.totalPayment) * 100);
  }, [principal, loanSummary.totalPayment]);

  const interestPercent = 100 - principalPercent;

  const copyResult = () => {
    const text = `Ước tính vay: Gốc ${formatMoney(principal)}, Lãi suất ${interestRate}%/năm, Thời hạn ${tenureValue} ${tenureUnit === 'years' ? 'năm' : 'tháng'}. Trả hàng tháng: ${formatMoney(loanSummary.monthlyPayment)}, Tổng lãi: ${formatMoney(loanSummary.totalInterest)}. Tính tại Web Calculator`;
    navigator.clipboard?.writeText(text);
    setCopied(true);
    setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 2000);
  };

  // Quick preset chips based on active currency
  const presetChips = useMemo(() => {
    if (currency === 'VND') {
      return [
        { label: '100 Tr', value: 100000000 },
        { label: '300 Tr', value: 300000000 },
        { label: '500 Tr', value: 500000000 },
        { label: '1 Tỷ', value: 1000000000 },
        { label: '2 Tỷ', value: 2000000000 },
      ];
    }
    if (currency === 'JPY' || currency === 'KRW') {
      return [
        { label: '1M', value: 1000000 },
        { label: '3M', value: 3000000 },
        { label: '5M', value: 5000000 },
        { label: '10M', value: 10000000 },
        { label: '20M', value: 20000000 },
      ];
    }
    // Base USD and others (EUR, GBP, CAD, AUD, etc.)
    return [
      { label: `${currencyInfo.symbol}10k`, value: 10000 },
      { label: `${currencyInfo.symbol}25k`, value: 25000 },
      { label: `${currencyInfo.symbol}50k`, value: 50000 },
      { label: `${currencyInfo.symbol}100k`, value: 100000 },
      { label: `${currencyInfo.symbol}250k`, value: 250000 },
    ];
  }, [currency, currencyInfo.symbol]);

  const pdfCalculations = useMemo(() => {
    const monthlySchedule = loanSummary.schedule.map((row) => ({
      month: row.month,
      year: Math.ceil(row.month / 12),
      payment: row.payment,
      principal: row.principalPaid,
      interest: row.interestPaid,
      balance: row.balance,
    }));

    const yearlyScheduleMap: Record<number, { year: number; principal: number; interest: number; balance: number; extra: number }> = {};
    monthlySchedule.forEach((m) => {
      if (!yearlyScheduleMap[m.year]) {
        yearlyScheduleMap[m.year] = {
          year: m.year,
          principal: 0,
          interest: 0,
          balance: m.balance,
          extra: 0
        };
      }
      yearlyScheduleMap[m.year].principal += m.principal;
      yearlyScheduleMap[m.year].interest += m.interest;
      yearlyScheduleMap[m.year].balance = m.balance;
    });

    return {
      baseMonthlyPayment: loanSummary.monthlyPayment,
      actualMonthlyPayment: loanSummary.monthlyPayment,
      totalInterestPaid: loanSummary.totalInterest,

import React, { useState, useMemo } from 'react';
import { Binary, RotateCcw } from 'lucide-react';

export const LogCalculator: React.FC = () => {
  const [value, setValue] = useState<number>(100);
  const [base, setBase] = useState<number>(10);

  const calculations = useMemo(() => {
    const x = value;
    const b = base;

    if (x <= 0) {
      return {
        isValid: false,
        message: 'Logarit chỉ xác định với giá trị x > 0.'
      };
    }
    if (b <= 0 || b === 1) {
      return {
        isValid: false,
        message: 'Cơ số logarit b phải lớn hơn 0 và khác 1 (b > 0, b ≠ 1).'
      };
    }

    const logBase = Math.log(x) / Math.log(b);
    const ln = Math.log(x);
    const log10 = Math.log10(x);
    const log2 = Math.log2(x);

    return {
      isValid: true,
      logBase: Number(logBase.toFixed(6)),
      ln: Number(ln.toFixed(6)),
      log10: Number(log10.toFixed(6)),
      log2: Number(log2.toFixed(6))
    };
  }, [value, base]);

  return (
    <div className="w-full max-w-4xl mx-auto space-y-6">
      <div className="p-4 sm:p-6 rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-r from-blue-900/40 via-slate-800 to-slate-900 border border-blue-500/30 flex items-center justify-between">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <div className="p-3 bg-blue-600/20 text-blue-400 rounded-xl border border-blue-500/30">
            <Binary className="w-6 h-6" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <h1 className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-bold text-white tracking-tight">Log Calculator – Máy Tính Logarit</h1>
            <p className="text-xs sm:text-sm text-slate-400">Tính logarit cơ số bất kỳ log_b(x), logarit tự nhiên ln(x) và logarit thập phân log10(x)</p>
          </div>
        </div>
        <button
          id="log-reset-btn"
          onClick={() => { setValue(100); setBase(10); }}
          className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs text-slate-300 hover:text-white bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 border border-slate-700 rounded-lg transition-colors cursor-pointer"
        >
          <RotateCcw className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
          <span>Đặt lại</span>
        </button>
      </div>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6">
        <div className="lg:col-span-5 space-y-4 bg-slate-900/80 p-5 rounded-2xl border border-slate-800">
          <h2 className="text-base font-semibold text-white">Tham số logarit</h2>

          <div>
            <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-300 mb-1">Cơ số (Base b)</label>
            <input
              id="log-base"
              type="number"
              value={base}
              onChange={(e) => setBase(Number(e.target.value))}
              className="w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-white font-sans focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 outline-none"
            />
          </div>

          <div>
            <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-300 mb-1">Giá trị cần tính (x)</label>
            <input
              id="log-value"
              type="number"
              value={value}
              onChange={(e) => setValue(Number(e.target.value))}
              className="w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-white font-sans focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 outline-none"
            />
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="lg:col-span-7 space-y-4">
          {!calculations.isValid ? (
            <div className="p-6 rounded-2xl bg-rose-950/40 border border-rose-500/40 text-rose-200 text-sm">
              {calculations.message}
            </div>
          ) : (
            <>
              <div className="p-6 rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-b from-blue-950/40 to-slate-900 border border-blue-500/40 text-center space-y-2">
                <span className="text-xs uppercase tracking-wider text-blue-300 font-semibold">
                  log_{base}({value})
                </span>
                <div className="text-4xl sm:text-5xl font-extrabold text-blue-400 font-sans tabular-nums">
                  {calculations.logBase}
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-3">
                <div className="p-3 bg-slate-900/80 rounded-xl border border-slate-800 text-center">
                  <span className="text-xs text-slate-400 block">ln({value})</span>
                  <span className="text-base font-bold text-white font-sans">{calculations.ln}</span>
                </div>
                <div className="p-3 bg-slate-900/80 rounded-xl border border-slate-800 text-center">
                  <span className="text-xs text-slate-400 block">log10({value})</span>
                  <span className="text-base font-bold text-white font-sans">{calculations.log10}</span>
                </div>
                <div className="p-3 bg-slate-900/80 rounded-xl border border-slate-800 text-center">
                  <span className="text-xs text-slate-400 block">log2({value})</span>
                  <span className="text-base font-bold text-white font-sans">{calculations.log2}</span>
                </div>
              </div>
            </>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

// Wedding Rings Icon Component
export const WeddingIcon: React.FC<{ className?: string }> = ({ className = "w-5 h-5" }) => (
  <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" className={className} stroke="currentColor">

  </svg>
