import React, { useState } from 'react';
import {
  X,
  RotateCcw,
  Check,
  Plus,
  Trash2,
  ShieldCheck,
  SlidersHorizontal,
  Percent,
  Coins,
  Building2,
  MapPin
} from 'lucide-react';
import { 
  CountrySalaryProfile, 
  INTERNATIONAL_CURRENCIES,
  COUNTRY_PROFILES 
} from '../../data/salaryInternationalData';

interface SalaryCustomSettingsModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  profile: CountrySalaryProfile;
  onSaveProfile: (updatedProfile: CountrySalaryProfile) => void;
  onResetToCountryDefault: () => void;
  lang: string;
}

export const SalaryCustomSettingsModal: React.FC<SalaryCustomSettingsModalProps> = ({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  profile,
  onSaveProfile,
  onResetToCountryDefault,
  lang
}) => {
  const isVi = lang === 'vi';
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<'insurance' | 'allowances' | 'tax' | 'subregions' | 'currency'>('insurance');
  const [editableProfile, setEditableProfile] = useState<CountrySalaryProfile>(profile);

  // Sync state when modal opens or profile changes
  React.useEffect(() => {
    setEditableProfile(profile);
  }, [profile, isOpen]);

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const handleSave = () => {
    onSaveProfile(editableProfile);
    onClose();
  };

  const handleReset = () => {
    onResetToCountryDefault();
    const defaultProf = COUNTRY_PROFILES[profile.id] || COUNTRY_PROFILES['CUSTOM'];
    setEditableProfile(defaultProf);
  };

  // Insurance handlers
  const updateEmpRate = (id: string, newRate: number) => {
    setEditableProfile(prev => ({
      ...prev,
      employeeInsurances: prev.employeeInsurances.map(item => 
        item.id === id ? { ...item, rate: newRate } : item
      )
    }));
  };

  const updateCompRate = (id: string, newRate: number) => {
    setEditableProfile(prev => ({
      ...prev,
      employerContributions: prev.employerContributions.map(item => 
        item.id === id ? { ...item, rate: newRate } : item
      )
    }));
  };

  const updateSubRegionRate = (id: string, newRate: number) => {
    setEditableProfile(prev => ({
      ...prev,
      subRegions: prev.subRegions?.map(item => 
        item.id === id ? { ...item, rate: newRate } : item
      )
    }));
  };

  // Bracket handlers
  const updateBracket = (index: number, field: 'min' | 'max' | 'rate', value: number) => {
    setEditableProfile(prev => {
      const nextBrackets = [...prev.taxBracketsAnnual];
      nextBrackets[index] = { ...nextBrackets[index], [field]: value };
      return { ...prev, taxBracketsAnnual: nextBrackets };
    });
  };

  const addBracket = () => {
    setEditableProfile(prev => {
      const len = prev.taxBracketsAnnual.length;
      const last = prev.taxBracketsAnnual[len - 1];
      const newMin = last ? (last.max === Infinity ? last.min + 50000 : last.max) : 0;
      return {
        ...prev,
        taxBracketsAnnual: [
          ...prev.taxBracketsAnnual,
          { bracket: len + 1, min: newMin, max: Infinity, rate: (last ? last.rate + 5 : 10) }
        ]
      };
    });
  };

  const removeBracket = (index: number) => {
    if (editableProfile.taxBracketsAnnual.length <= 1) return;
    setEditableProfile(prev => ({
      ...prev,
      taxBracketsAnnual: prev.taxBracketsAnnual.filter((_, idx) => idx !== index)
    }));
  };

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-3 sm:p-4 bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-xs animate-in fade-in duration-200">
      <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 rounded-2xl shadow-2xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 w-full max-w-3xl max-h-[92vh] flex flex-col overflow-hidden text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200">
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="px-5 py-4 border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 flex items-center justify-between bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-950/80">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-blue-600 text-white flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs">
              <SlidersHorizontal className="w-5 h-5" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <h3 className="text-base sm:text-lg font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white flex items-center gap-2">
                <span>{isVi ? 'Tùy chỉnh Tham số Tính Lương' : 'Customize Payroll Parameters'}</span>
                <span className="text-xs font-semibold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md bg-blue-100 dark:bg-blue-950 text-blue-800 dark:text-blue-300 border border-blue-200 dark:border-blue-800/60">
                  {editableProfile.flag} {editableProfile.name}
                </span>
              </h3>
              <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                {isVi ? 'Tự do thay đổi tỷ lệ bảo hiểm, mức giảm trừ, thuế suất và tiền tệ' : 'Adjust social contributions, tax brackets, allowances and currency'}
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
          <button 
            onClick={onClose} 
            className="p-2 text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-400 dark:hover:text-white hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 rounded-lg transition-colors cursor-pointer"
          >
            <X className="w-5 h-5" />
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Tab Navigation */}
        <div className="flex border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950/60 px-5 gap-2 overflow-x-auto text-sm font-medium">
          <button
            onClick={() => setActiveTab('insurance')}
            className={`py-3 px-3 border-b-2 flex items-center gap-2 whitespace-nowrap transition-colors cursor-pointer ${
              activeTab === 'insurance' 
                ? 'border-blue-600 text-blue-600 dark:border-blue-500 dark:text-blue-400 font-semibold' 
                : 'border-transparent text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-900 dark:hover:text-slate-200'
            }`}
          >
            <ShieldCheck className="w-4 h-4" />
            <span>{isVi ? 'Bảo hiểm & An sinh' : 'Social Security & Insurances'}</span>
          </button>
          <button
            onClick={() => setActiveTab('allowances')}
            className={`py-3 px-3 border-b-2 flex items-center gap-2 whitespace-nowrap transition-colors cursor-pointer ${
              activeTab === 'allowances' 
                ? 'border-blue-600 text-blue-600 dark:border-blue-500 dark:text-blue-400 font-semibold' 
                : 'border-transparent text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-900 dark:hover:text-slate-200'
            }`}
          >
            <Building2 className="w-4 h-4" />
            <span>{isVi ? 'Mức giảm trừ' : 'Allowances & Deductions'}</span>
          </button>
          <button
            onClick={() => setActiveTab('tax')}
            className={`py-3 px-3 border-b-2 flex items-center gap-2 whitespace-nowrap transition-colors cursor-pointer ${
              activeTab === 'tax' 
                ? 'border-blue-600 text-blue-600 dark:border-blue-500 dark:text-blue-400 font-semibold' 
                : 'border-transparent text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-900 dark:hover:text-slate-200'
            }`}
          >
            <Percent className="w-4 h-4" />
            <span>{isVi ? 'Biểu thuế TNCN' : 'Tax Brackets'}</span>
          </button>
          {editableProfile.subRegions && editableProfile.subRegions.length > 0 && (
            <button
              onClick={() => setActiveTab('subregions')}
              className={`py-3 px-3 border-b-2 flex items-center gap-2 whitespace-nowrap transition-colors cursor-pointer ${
                activeTab === 'subregions' 
                  ? 'border-blue-600 text-blue-600 dark:border-blue-500 dark:text-blue-400 font-semibold' 
                  : 'border-transparent text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-900 dark:hover:text-slate-200'
              }`}
            >
              <MapPin className="w-4 h-4" />
              <span>{isVi ? 'Khu vực / Tiểu bang' : 'Regions & States'}</span>
            </button>
          )}
          <button
            onClick={() => setActiveTab('currency')}
            className={`py-3 px-3 border-b-2 flex items-center gap-2 whitespace-nowrap transition-colors cursor-pointer ${
              activeTab === 'currency' 
                ? 'border-blue-600 text-blue-600 dark:border-blue-500 dark:text-blue-400 font-semibold' 
                : 'border-transparent text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-900 dark:hover:text-slate-200'
            }`}
          >
            <Coins className="w-4 h-4" />
            <span>{isVi ? 'Tiền tệ & Đơn vị' : 'Currency & Format'}</span>
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Modal Body */}
        <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-5 space-y-6">
          {/* TAB 1: INSURANCES */}
          {activeTab === 'insurance' && (
            <div className="space-y-6">
              {/* Employee Contributions */}
              <div className="bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950/60 rounded-xl p-4 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-3">
                  <h4 className="font-semibold text-sm text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-200 flex items-center gap-2">
                    <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-blue-500" />
                    <span>{isVi ? 'Đóng góp Người Lao Động (Khấu trừ vào lương)' : 'Employee Contributions (Deducted from Pay)'}</span>
                  </h4>
                  <span className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                    {isVi ? 'Tổng' : 'Total'}: {editableProfile.employeeInsurances.reduce((a, b) => a + b.rate, 0).toFixed(2)}%
                  </span>
                </div>

                <div className="space-y-3">
                  {editableProfile.employeeInsurances.map(item => (
                    <div key={item.id} className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-2 p-2.5 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800">
                      <div>
                        <span className="text-sm font-medium text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200">
                          {isVi && item.nameVi ? item.nameVi : item.name}
                        </span>
                        {item.description && (
                          <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">{item.description}</p>
                        )}
                      </div>
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 shrink-0">
                        <input
                          type="number"
                          step="0.05"
                          min="0"
                          max="100"
                          value={item.rate}
                          onChange={(e) => updateEmpRate(item.id, parseFloat(e.target.value) || 0)}
                          className="w-24 px-2.5 py-1.5 text-right font-semibold text-slate-900 dark:text-white bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-md focus:border-blue-500 focus:outline-hidden text-sm"
                        />
                        <span className="text-sm font-semibold text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">%</span>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Employer Contributions */}
              <div className="bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950/60 rounded-xl p-4 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-3">
                  <h4 className="font-semibold text-sm text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-200 flex items-center gap-2">
                    <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-emerald-500" />
                    <span>{isVi ? 'Đóng góp Doanh nghiệp (Người sử dụng LĐ)' : 'Employer Contributions (Company Cost)'}</span>
                  </h4>
                  <span className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                    {isVi ? 'Tổng' : 'Total'}: {editableProfile.employerContributions.reduce((a, b) => a + b.rate, 0).toFixed(2)}%
                  </span>
                </div>

                <div className="space-y-3">
                  {editableProfile.employerContributions.map(item => (
                    <div key={item.id} className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-2 p-2.5 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800">
                      <div>
                        <span className="text-sm font-medium text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200">
                          {isVi && item.nameVi ? item.nameVi : item.name}
                        </span>
                        {item.description && (
                          <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">{item.description}</p>
                        )}
                      </div>
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 shrink-0">
                        <input
                          type="number"
                          step="0.05"
                          min="0"
                          max="100"
                          value={item.rate}
                          onChange={(e) => updateCompRate(item.id, parseFloat(e.target.value) || 0)}
                          className="w-24 px-2.5 py-1.5 text-right font-semibold text-slate-900 dark:text-white bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-md focus:border-blue-500 focus:outline-hidden text-sm"
                        />
                        <span className="text-sm font-semibold text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">%</span>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* TAB 2: ALLOWANCES */}
          {activeTab === 'allowances' && (
            <div className="space-y-4">
              <div className="p-4 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950/60 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 space-y-4">
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 mb-1">
                    {isVi ? 'Mức giảm trừ cá nhân / bản thân (Năm)' : 'Personal / Standard Allowance (Annual)'}
                  </label>
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <span className="font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300">{editableProfile.currencySymbol}</span>
                    <input
                      type="number"
                      value={editableProfile.personalAllowanceAnnual}
                      onChange={(e) => setEditableProfile(prev => ({
                        ...prev,
                        personalAllowanceAnnual: parseFloat(e.target.value) || 0
                      }))}
                      className="flex-1 px-3 py-2 font-semibold text-slate-900 dark:text-white bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-lg focus:border-blue-500 focus:outline-hidden"
                    />
                  </div>
                  <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 mt-1">
                    {isVi ? `Tương đương ~${(editableProfile.personalAllowanceAnnual / 12).toLocaleString()} ${editableProfile.currencySymbol}/tháng` : `Approx ~${(editableProfile.personalAllowanceAnnual / 12).toLocaleString()} ${editableProfile.currencySymbol}/month`}
                  </p>
                </div>

                <div>
                  <label className="block text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 mb-1">
                    {isVi ? 'Mức giảm trừ Người Phụ Thuộc (Mỗi người / Năm)' : 'Dependent Allowance (Per Person / Annual)'}
                  </label>
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <span className="font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300">{editableProfile.currencySymbol}</span>
                    <input
                      type="number"
                      value={editableProfile.dependentAllowanceAnnual}
                      onChange={(e) => setEditableProfile(prev => ({
                        ...prev,
                        dependentAllowanceAnnual: parseFloat(e.target.value) || 0
                      }))}
                      className="flex-1 px-3 py-2 font-semibold text-slate-900 dark:text-white bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-lg focus:border-blue-500 focus:outline-hidden"
                    />
                  </div>
                  <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 mt-1">
                    {isVi ? `Tương đương ~${(editableProfile.dependentAllowanceAnnual / 12).toLocaleString()} ${editableProfile.currencySymbol}/tháng` : `Approx ~${(editableProfile.dependentAllowanceAnnual / 12).toLocaleString()} ${editableProfile.currencySymbol}/month`}
                  </p>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Vietnam specific regional salaries if VN */}
              {editableProfile.id === 'VN' && editableProfile.regions && (
                <div className="p-4 bg-blue-50 dark:bg-blue-950/40 rounded-xl border border-blue-200 dark:border-blue-900/50">
                  <h5 className="font-semibold text-sm text-blue-800 dark:text-blue-300 mb-2">
                    {isVi ? 'Lương tối thiểu theo 4 Vùng (Nghị định 74/2024/NĐ-CP)' : 'Vietnam Regional Minimum Wages'}
                  </h5>
                  <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-2 text-xs">
                    {editableProfile.regions.map(r => (
                      <div key={r.id} className="p-2 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 flex justify-between">
                        <span className="text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 font-medium">{r.name}</span>
                        <span className="font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white">{r.minMonthly.toLocaleString()} ₫</span>
                      </div>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          )}

          {/* TAB 3: TAX BRACKETS */}
          {activeTab === 'tax' && (
            <div className="space-y-4">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <div>
                  <h4 className="font-semibold text-sm text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-200">
                    {isVi ? 'Biểu thuế Lũy tiến Từng phần (Hàng năm)' : 'Annual Progressive Tax Brackets'}
                  </h4>
                  <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                    {isVi ? 'Thuế suất tính theo các bậc thu nhập tính thuế sau giảm trừ' : 'Marginal tax rates applied to taxable income'}
                  </p>
                </div>
                <button
                  onClick={addBracket}
                  className="px-3 py-1.5 bg-blue-100 dark:bg-blue-950 text-blue-800 dark:text-blue-300 border border-blue-200 dark:border-blue-800/60 hover:bg-blue-200 dark:hover:bg-blue-900 text-xs font-semibold rounded-lg flex items-center gap-1.5 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                >
                  <Plus className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  <span>{isVi ? 'Thêm bậc' : 'Add Bracket'}</span>
                </button>
              </div>

              <div className="overflow-x-auto rounded-xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800">
                <table className="w-full text-left text-xs sm:text-sm">
                  <thead className="bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-950 border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-300 font-semibold">
                    <tr>
                      <th className="py-2.5 px-3">{isVi ? 'Bậc' : '#'}</th>
                      <th className="py-2.5 px-3">{isVi ? 'Thu nhập từ' : 'From'}</th>
                      <th className="py-2.5 px-3">{isVi ? 'Đến trần' : 'Up to'}</th>
                      <th className="py-2.5 px-3 text-right">{isVi ? 'Thuế (%)' : 'Rate (%)'}</th>
                      <th className="py-2.5 px-2 text-center w-10"></th>
                    </tr>
                  </thead>
                  <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-200 dark:divide-slate-800">
                    {editableProfile.taxBracketsAnnual.map((b, idx) => (
                      <tr key={idx} className="hover:bg-slate-50 dark:hover:bg-slate-850/50">
                        <td className="py-2 px-3 font-semibold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200">
                          {b.bracket || idx + 1}
                        </td>
                        <td className="py-2 px-3">
                          <input
                            type="number"
                            value={b.min}
                            onChange={(e) => updateBracket(idx, 'min', parseFloat(e.target.value) || 0)}
                            className="w-24 sm:w-28 px-2 py-1 bg-white dark:bg-slate-950 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 text-slate-900 dark:text-white rounded-md text-xs font-medium focus:border-blue-500 focus:outline-hidden"
                          />
                        </td>
                        <td className="py-2 px-3">
                          {b.max === Infinity ? (
                            <span className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 italic px-2 py-1 bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 rounded-md">
                              {isVi ? 'Không giới hạn' : 'Unlimited (Max)'}
                            </span>
                          ) : (
                            <input
                              type="number"
                              value={b.max}
                              onChange={(e) => updateBracket(idx, 'max', parseFloat(e.target.value) || Infinity)}
                              className="w-24 sm:w-28 px-2 py-1 bg-white dark:bg-slate-950 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 text-slate-900 dark:text-white rounded-md text-xs font-medium focus:border-blue-500 focus:outline-hidden"
                            />
                          )}
                        </td>
                        <td className="py-2 px-3 text-right">
                          <div className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 justify-end">
                            <input
                              type="number"
                              step="0.5"
                              value={b.rate}
                              onChange={(e) => updateBracket(idx, 'rate', parseFloat(e.target.value) || 0)}
                              className="w-16 px-2 py-1 bg-white dark:bg-slate-950 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-md text-xs font-bold text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 text-right focus:border-blue-500 focus:outline-hidden"
                            />
                            <span className="text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 font-semibold text-xs">%</span>
                          </div>
                        </td>
                        <td className="py-2 px-2 text-center">
                          {editableProfile.taxBracketsAnnual.length > 1 && (
                            <button
                              onClick={() => removeBracket(idx)}
                              className="p-1 text-slate-400 hover:text-rose-500 rounded-md hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                            >
                              <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                            </button>
                          )}
                        </td>
                      </tr>
                    ))}
                  </tbody>
                </table>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* TAB: SUBREGIONS & LOCAL/STATE TAXES */}
          {activeTab === 'subregions' && editableProfile.subRegions && (
            <div className="space-y-4">
              <div>
                <h4 className="font-semibold text-sm text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-200 flex items-center gap-2">
                  <MapPin className="w-4 h-4 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400" />
                  <span>
                    {isVi 
                      ? (editableProfile.subRegionLabelVi || 'Các Khu Vực & Thuế Tiểu Bang / Địa Phương') 
                      : (editableProfile.subRegionLabel || 'Regions & Local / State Taxes')}
                  </span>
                </h4>
                <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 mt-0.5">
                  {isVi 
                    ? 'Tùy chỉnh tỷ lệ thuế địa phương, thuế bang hoặc phân loại quyền lợi đặc thù theo từng khu vực' 
                    : 'Configure regional tax rates, state surcharges, or local deduction parameters'}
                </p>
              </div>

              <div className="space-y-2.5">
                {editableProfile.subRegions.map((sr) => (
                  <div key={sr.id} className="p-3 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950/60 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-3">
                    <div className="flex-1">
                      <div className="font-semibold text-xs sm:text-sm text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-200">
                        {isVi ? sr.nameVi : sr.name}
                      </div>
                      {sr.description && (
                        <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 mt-0.5">
                          {sr.description}
                        </p>
                      )}
                    </div>

                    {sr.rate !== undefined && (
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 shrink-0">
                        <span className="text-xs text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 font-medium">
                          {isVi ? 'Thuế suất' : 'Rate'}:
                        </span>
                        <input
                          type="number"
                          step="0.1"
                          min="0"
                          max="50"
                          value={sr.rate}
                          onChange={(e) => updateSubRegionRate(sr.id, parseFloat(e.target.value) || 0)}
                          className="w-24 px-2.5 py-1.5 text-right font-semibold text-slate-900 dark:text-white bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-md focus:border-blue-500 focus:outline-hidden text-xs"
                        />
                        <span className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">%</span>
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>

              {editableProfile.id === 'VN' && editableProfile.regions && (
                <div className="mt-4 p-4 bg-blue-50 dark:bg-blue-950/40 rounded-xl border border-blue-200 dark:border-blue-900/50">
                  <h5 className="font-semibold text-xs sm:text-sm text-blue-800 dark:text-blue-300 mb-2">
                    {isVi ? 'Lương tối thiểu theo 4 Vùng (Nghị định 74/2024/NĐ-CP)' : 'Vietnam Regional Minimum Wages'}
                  </h5>
                  <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-2 text-xs">
                    {editableProfile.regions.map(r => (
                      <div key={r.id} className="p-2.5 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 flex justify-between items-center">
                        <span className="text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 font-medium">{r.name}</span>
                        <span className="font-bold text-blue-700 dark:text-blue-300">{r.minMonthly.toLocaleString()} ₫/tháng</span>
                      </div>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          )}

          {/* TAB 4: CURRENCY */}
          {activeTab === 'currency' && (
            <div className="space-y-4">
              <div className="p-4 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950/60 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800">
                <label className="block text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 mb-2">
                  {isVi ? 'Chọn đồng tiền hiển thị' : 'Select Display Currency'}
                </label>
                <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-4 gap-2">
                  {INTERNATIONAL_CURRENCIES.map(curr => (
                    <button
                      key={curr.code}
                      onClick={() => setEditableProfile(prev => ({
                        ...prev,
                        currencyCode: curr.code,
                        currencySymbol: curr.symbol,
                        decimals: curr.decimals
                      }))}
                      className={`p-2.5 rounded-lg border text-left flex items-center justify-between transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                        editableProfile.currencyCode === curr.code
                          ? 'border-blue-500 bg-blue-50 dark:bg-blue-950/60 text-blue-900 dark:text-blue-200 font-bold'
                          : 'border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 hover:border-slate-300 dark:hover:border-slate-700'
                      }`}
                    >
                      <div>
                        <div className="text-sm">{curr.code}</div>
                        <div className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 font-normal">{curr.name.split('(')[0]}</div>
                      </div>
                      <span className="text-base font-bold text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400">{curr.symbol}</span>
                    </button>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="flex items-center justify-between p-4 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950/60 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800">
                <div>
                  <div className="text-sm font-semibold text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-200">
                    {isVi ? 'Số chữ số thập phân (Decimals)' : 'Decimal Places'}
                  </div>
                  <div className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                    {isVi ? 'Ví dụ: 0 cho VND / JPY, 2 cho USD / EUR' : 'E.g., 0 for VND / JPY, 2 for USD / EUR'}
                  </div>
                </div>
                <div className="flex gap-2">
                  {[0, 2].map(d => (
                    <button
                      key={d}
                      onClick={() => setEditableProfile(prev => ({ ...prev, decimals: d }))}
                      className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold border transition-colors cursor-pointer ${
                        editableProfile.decimals === d
                          ? 'bg-blue-600 text-white border-blue-600'
                          : 'bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-800'
                      }`}
                    >
                      {d} {isVi ? 'chữ số' : 'decimals'}
                    </button>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* Modal Footer */}
        <div className="px-5 py-4 border-t border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-950/80 flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-center justify-between gap-3">
          <button
            onClick={handleReset}
            className="w-full sm:w-auto px-4 py-2 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-200 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 text-xs font-semibold rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
          >
            <RotateCcw className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            <span>{isVi ? 'Khôi phục chuẩn quốc gia' : 'Reset to Country Standards'}</span>
          </button>

          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 w-full sm:w-auto">
            <button
              onClick={onClose}
              className="flex-1 sm:flex-none px-4 py-2 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-200 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 text-xs font-semibold rounded-xl transition-colors cursor-pointer"
            >
              {isVi ? 'Hủy bỏ' : 'Cancel'}
            </button>
            <button
              onClick={handleSave}
              className="flex-1 sm:flex-none px-5 py-2 bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-500 text-white text-xs font-semibold rounded-xl shadow-xs flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
            >
              <Check className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              <span>{isVi ? 'Lưu & Áp dụng ngay' : 'Save & Apply Changes'}</span>
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

FILE: /src/components/tools/SalaryMultiPeriodTable.tsx

import React from 'react';
import { 
  DetailedCalculationResult,

import {

import { Calendar } from 'lucide-react';

interface SalaryMultiPeriodTableProps {
  result: DetailedCalculationResult;
  profile: CountrySalaryProfile;
  currentPeriod: PayPeriod;
  onSelectPeriod: (period: PayPeriod) => void;
  lang: string;
}

export const SalaryMultiPeriodTable: React.FC<SalaryMultiPeriodTableProps> = ({
  result,
  profile,
  currentPeriod,
  onSelectPeriod,
  lang
}) => {
  const isVi = lang === 'vi';
  const periods: PayPeriod[] = ['annual', 'monthly', 'biweekly', 'weekly', 'hourly'];

  const rows = [
    {
      key: 'gross',
      labelEn: 'Gross Salary',
      labelVi: 'Lương Gross (Tổng thu nhập)',
      isHighlight: false,

      color: 'text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 font-semibold'
    },
    {
      key: 'insurance',
      labelEn: 'Social Security & Insurances',
      labelVi: 'Bảo hiểm & An sinh NLĐ đóng',
      isHighlight: false,
      getValue: (p: PayPeriod) => result.periods[p].employeeInsurance,
      color: 'text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400 font-semibold'
    },
    {
      key: 'tax',
      labelEn: 'Income Tax',
      labelVi: 'Thuế Thu nhập Cá nhân (PIT)',
      isHighlight: false,
      getValue: (p: PayPeriod) => result.periods[p].tax,
      color: 'text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400 font-semibold'
    },
    {
      key: 'net',
      labelEn: 'Net Take-Home Pay',
      labelVi: 'LƯƠNG NET THỰC NHẬN',
      isHighlight: true,
      getValue: (p: PayPeriod) => result.periods[p].net,
      color: 'text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-300 font-bold bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-950/40'
    },
    {
      key: 'employerCost',
      labelEn: 'Total Employer Cost',
      labelVi: 'Tổng chi phí Doanh nghiệp trả',
      isHighlight: false,
      getValue: (p: PayPeriod) => result.periods[p].totalEmployerCost,
      color: 'text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-300 font-medium'
    }
  ];

  return (
    <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900/60 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 shadow-xs overflow-hidden">
      <div className="px-4 py-3.5 bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-950/70 border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-2">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <Calendar className="w-4 h-4 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400" />
          <h4 className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-200">
            {isVi ? 'Bảng Đối chiếu Chu kỳ Lương Chuẩn Quốc tế' : 'International Multi-Period Salary Conversion'}
          </h4>
        </div>
        <span className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
          {isVi ? 'Quy đổi Năm ↔ Tháng ↔ 2 Tuần ↔ Tuần ↔ Giờ' : 'Equivalents across Year ↔ Month ↔ Bi-week ↔ Week ↔ Hour'}
        </span>
      </div>

      <div className="overflow-x-auto">
        <table className="w-full text-xs sm:text-sm text-left">
          <thead className="bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950/90 text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-300 font-semibold border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800">
            <tr>
              <th className="py-3 px-3 sm:px-4">{isVi ? 'Hạng mục' : 'Component'}</th>
              {periods.map(p => {
                const isCurrent = currentPeriod === p;
                return (
                  <th 
                    key={p} 
                    className={`py-3 px-3 sm:px-4 text-right cursor-pointer transition-colors ${
                      isCurrent ? 'bg-blue-100 dark:bg-blue-950/60 text-blue-900 dark:text-blue-300 font-bold' : 'text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-800/60'
                    }`}
                    onClick={() => onSelectPeriod(p)}
                    title={isVi ? 'Nhấp để đổi chu kỳ tính' : 'Click to select this pay period'}
                  >
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-1">
                      <span>{isVi ? PERIOD_LABELS[p].vi : PERIOD_LABELS[p].en}</span>
                      {isCurrent && <span className="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-blue-600 dark:bg-blue-400" />}
                    </div>
                  </th>
                );
              })}
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-200 dark:divide-slate-800/80">
            {rows.map(row => (
              <tr 
                key={row.key} 
                className={`${row.isHighlight ? 'bg-emerald-50/70 dark:bg-emerald-950/30 font-semibold' : 'hover:bg-slate-50 dark:hover:bg-slate-800/30'}`}
              >
                <td className="py-2.5 px-3 sm:px-4 font-medium text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200">
                  {isVi ? row.labelVi : row.labelEn}
                </td>
                {periods.map(p => {
                  const val = row.getValue(p);
                  const isCurrent = currentPeriod === p;
                  return (
                    <td 
                      key={p} 
                      className={`py-2.5 px-3 sm:px-4 text-right tabular-nums ${row.color} ${
                        isCurrent ? (row.isHighlight ? 'bg-emerald-100 dark:bg-emerald-900/40 text-emerald-900 dark:text-emerald-200' : 'bg-blue-50 dark:bg-blue-950/50 text-blue-900 dark:text-blue-200') : ''
                      }`}
                    >
                      {formatCurrency(val, profile.currencySymbol, profile.decimals)}
                    </td>
                  );
                })}
              </tr>
            ))}
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>

      <div className="px-4 py-2 bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-950/70 border-t border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 text-[11px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 flex items-center justify-between">
        <span>
          {isVi 
            ? '* Chu kỳ giờ tính trên tiêu chuẩn quốc tế: 40 giờ/tuần (2.080 giờ/năm)' 
            : '* Hourly rate calculated on international standard: 40 hrs/week (2,080 hrs/year)'}
        </span>
        <span className="font-semibold text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400">
          {profile.flag} {profile.currencyCode}
        </span>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

FILE: /src/components/tools/SalaryPdfModal.tsx
================================================================================
import React, { useState, useRef } from 'react';
import { X, FileDown, Printer, Check, Loader2, Calendar, Wallet, ShieldAlert, Globe, ArrowRight, CheckCircle2, Share2 } from 'lucide-react';
import { useLanguage } from '../../context/LanguageContext';
import { exportElementPagesToPdf, PdfExportResult } from '../../utils/pdfExportHelper';
import {
  CountrySalaryProfile,
  PayPeriod,
  PERIOD_LABELS
} from '../../data/salaryInternationalData';
import { 
  formatCurrency,
  fromAnnualAmount,
  DetailedCalculationResult 
} from '../../utils/salaryEngine';

export interface SalaryPdfModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  activeProfile: CountrySalaryProfile;
  payPeriod: PayPeriod;
  salaryInput: number;
  dependents: number;
  subRegionName?: string;
  mode: 'gross_to_net' | 'net_to_gross';
  calculationResult: DetailedCalculationResult;
}

export const SalaryPdfModal: React.FC<SalaryPdfModalProps> = ({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  activeProfile,
  payPeriod,
  salaryInput,
  dependents,
  subRegionName,
  mode,
  calculationResult
}) => {
  const { language } = useLanguage();
  const isVi = language === 'vi';

  const [isExporting, setIsExporting] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [exportProgress, setExportProgress] = useState<string>('');
  const [isDone, setIsDone] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [exportResult, setExportResult] = useState<PdfExportResult | null>(null);

  const printContainerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const currentPeriodData = calculationResult?.periods?.[payPeriod] || {
    gross: salaryInput || 0,
    net: calculationResult?.monthlyNet || 0,
    employeeInsurance: 0,
    tax: 0,
    totalEmployerCost: salaryInput || 0,
    period: payPeriod,
    taxableIncome: 0,
    employerContribution: 0,
  };
  const grossCurrent = currentPeriodData.gross || 0;
  const netCurrent = currentPeriodData.net || 0;
  const insCurrent = currentPeriodData.employeeInsurance || 0;
  const taxCurrent = currentPeriodData.tax || 0;

  const periodLabel = isVi 
    ? (PERIOD_LABELS[payPeriod]?.vi || payPeriod) 
    : (PERIOD_LABELS[payPeriod]?.en || payPeriod);

  const handleExportPDF = async () => {
    if (isExporting) return;
    const source = printContainerRef.current || document.getElementById('salary-pdf-printable-source');
    if (!source) {
      window.print();
      return;
    }

    try {
      setIsExporting(true);
      setIsDone(false);
      setExportProgress(isVi ? 'Đang chuẩn bị trang in...' : 'Preparing payslip...');

      const dateStr = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
      const safeCountry = (activeProfile.id || 'VN').toUpperCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9_-]/gi, '_');
      const fileName = isVi
        ? `Phieu_Luong_${safeCountry}_Net_${Math.round(netCurrent)}_${dateStr}.pdf`
        : `Salary_Slip_${safeCountry}_Net_${Math.round(netCurrent)}_${dateStr}.pdf`;

      const result = await exportElementPagesToPdf(source, {
        fileName,
        pageSelector: '.pdf-report-page',
        onProgress: (text) => setExportProgress(text),
        isVi,
      });

      setExportResult(result);
      setIsDone(true);
      setExportProgress(isVi ? 'Xuất PDF thành công!' : 'PDF exported successfully!');
      setTimeout(() => {
        setIsDone(false);
        setExportProgress('');
      }, 4500);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Lỗi khi xuất PDF:', error);
      alert(isVi ? 'Có lỗi khi tạo PDF. Bạn có thể bấm "In / Lưu PDF" để in trực tiếp.' : 'Error generating PDF. Try "Print / Save" directly.');
    } finally {
      setIsExporting(false);
    }
  };

  const handlePrint = () => {
    window.print();
  };

  const currentDateFormatted = new Date().toLocaleDateString(isVi ? 'vi-VN' : 'en-US', {
    year: 'numeric',
    month: 'long',
    day: 'numeric',
  });

  return (
    <div className="salary-modal-root">
      {/* Modal Dialog for screen view */}
      <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-3 sm:p-4 bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-xs animate-in fade-in duration-200 print:hidden">
        <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 rounded-2xl shadow-2xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 w-full max-w-xl max-h-[92vh] flex flex-col overflow-hidden text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200">
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="px-5 py-4 border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 flex items-center justify-between bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-950/80">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-emerald-100 dark:bg-emerald-600/20 border border-emerald-300 dark:border-emerald-500/40 text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400 flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs">
              <Wallet className="w-5 h-5" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <h3 className="text-base sm:text-lg font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
                {isVi ? 'Xuất Phiếu Lương (Gross ↔ Net)' : 'Export Payslip (Gross ↔ Net)'}
              </h3>
              <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                {isVi 
                  ? `Hồ sơ ${activeProfile.flag} ${activeProfile.name} • Chu kỳ ${periodLabel}` 
                  : `${activeProfile.flag} ${activeProfile.name} profile • ${periodLabel}`}
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
          <button
            onClick={onClose}
            disabled={isExporting}
            className="p-2 text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-400 dark:hover:text-white hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 rounded-lg transition-colors cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-50"
          >
            <X className="w-5 h-5" />
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Modal Body */}
        <div className="p-5 overflow-y-auto space-y-4 text-sm">
          <div className="p-4 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950/60 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 space-y-3">
            <div className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-wider flex items-center justify-between">
              <span>{isVi ? 'Thông tin phiếu lương' : 'Payslip overview'}</span>
              <span className="text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400 font-bold">
                {mode === 'gross_to_net' ? 'Gross → Net' : 'Net → Gross'}
              </span>
            </div>

            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 text-xs">
              <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 p-2.5 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800">
                <span className="text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 block">{isVi ? 'Lương Gross' : 'Gross Salary'}</span>
                <span className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white tabular-nums">
                  {formatCurrency(grossCurrent, activeProfile.currencySymbol, activeProfile.decimals)}
                </span>
              </div>
              <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 p-2.5 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800">
                <span className="text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 block">{isVi ? 'Khấu trừ Bảo hiểm' : 'Social Deductions'}</span>
                <span className="text-sm font-bold text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400 tabular-nums">
                  -{formatCurrency(insCurrent, activeProfile.currencySymbol, activeProfile.decimals)}
                </span>
              </div>
              <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 p-2.5 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800">
                <span className="text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 block">{isVi ? 'Thuế thu nhập' : 'Income Tax'}</span>
                <span className="text-sm font-bold text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400 tabular-nums">
                  -{formatCurrency(taxCurrent, activeProfile.currencySymbol, activeProfile.decimals)}
                </span>
              </div>
              <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 p-2.5 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800">
                <span className="text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 block">{isVi ? 'Số người phụ thuộc' : 'Dependents'}</span>
                <span className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white tabular-nums">
                  {dependents} {isVi ? 'người' : 'persons'}
                </span>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="p-4 rounded-xl bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-gradient-to-r dark:from-emerald-950/60 dark:via-slate-900 dark:to-emerald-950/60 border border-emerald-300 dark:border-emerald-500/40 text-center space-y-1">
              <span className="text-xs text-emerald-800 dark:text-emerald-400 uppercase tracking-wider font-semibold">
                {isVi ? 'Thực nhận (Net Take-home Pay)' : 'Net Take-home Pay'}
              </span>
              <div className="text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-extrabold text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-300 tabular-nums">
                {formatCurrency(netCurrent, activeProfile.currencySymbol, activeProfile.decimals)}
                <span className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 font-normal"> /{periodLabel.toLowerCase()}</span>
              </div>
            </div>

            {subRegionName && (
              <div className="text-xs text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 px-1">
                {isVi ? 'Khu vực / Tùy chọn:' : 'Region / Mode:'} <strong className="text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-200">{subRegionName}</strong>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>

          {exportProgress && (
            <div className="p-3 bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-950/60 border border-emerald-300 dark:border-emerald-500/40 rounded-xl flex items-center gap-2.5 text-xs text-emerald-800 dark:text-emerald-300">
              {isExporting ? (
                <Loader2 className="w-4 h-4 animate-spin text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 shrink-0" />
              ) : isDone ? (
                <Check className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 shrink-0" />
              ) : null}
              <span>{exportProgress}</span>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Khi file PDF đã sẵn sàng, hiển thị nút tải trực tiếp và share (đặc biệt hữu ích trên iPhone/Android) */}
          {exportResult && (
            <div className="p-3 bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-950/60 border border-emerald-300 dark:border-emerald-600/50 rounded-xl flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-center justify-between gap-3 text-xs shadow-xs">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-emerald-800 dark:text-emerald-300 min-w-0">
                <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 shrink-0" />
                <span className="font-semibold shrink-0">{isVi ? 'File PDF đã sẵn sàng:' : 'PDF ready:'}</span>
                <span className="font-mono text-[11px] truncate max-w-[170px] text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300">{exportResult.fileName}</span>
              </div>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 w-full sm:w-auto shrink-0">
                <a
                  href={exportResult.blobUrl}
                  download={exportResult.fileName}
                  className="flex-1 sm:flex-none px-3.5 py-1.5 bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-500 text-white font-bold rounded-lg text-center shadow-xs flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 transition-colors"
                >
                  <FileDown className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  <span>{isVi ? 'Mở / Tải file' : 'Open / Save'}</span>
                </a>
                {typeof navigator !== 'undefined' && !!navigator.share && (
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={async () => {
                      try {
                        const file = new File([exportResult.blob], exportResult.fileName, { type: 'application/pdf' });
                        if (navigator.canShare && navigator.canShare({ files: [file] })) {
                          await navigator.share({ files: [file], title: exportResult.fileName });
                        } else {
                          window.open(exportResult.blobUrl, '_blank');
                        }
                      } catch (err: any) {
                        if (err.name !== 'AbortError') {
                          window.open(exportResult.blobUrl, '_blank');
                        }
                      }
                    }}
                    className="flex-1 sm:flex-none px-3 py-1.5 bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-300 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 font-bold rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                  >
                    <Share2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                    <span>{isVi ? 'Lưu vào Tệp' : 'Save to Files'}</span>
                  </button>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* Modal Footer */}
        <div className="px-5 py-4 border-t border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-950/80 flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-center justify-between gap-3">
          <div className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 flex items-center gap-1.5">
            <ShieldAlert className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-500 shrink-0" />
            <span>{isVi ? 'Phiếu lương chuẩn A4 rõ nét, in trực tiếp' : 'Official standard A4 payslip format'}</span>
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 w-full sm:w-auto">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={handlePrint}
              disabled={isExporting}
              className="flex-1 sm:flex-none px-3.5 py-2 bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-50 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 text-xs font-semibold rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 transition-colors cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-50"
            >
              <Printer className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              <span>{isVi ? 'In / Lưu PDF' : 'Print / Save'}</span>
            </button>

            <button
              type="button"
              id="confirm-download-salary-pdf-btn"
              onClick={handleExportPDF}
              disabled={isExporting}
              className="flex-1 sm:flex-none px-5 py-2 bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-500 text-white text-xs font-bold rounded-xl shadow-xs flex items-center justify-center gap-2 transition-all cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-50"
            >
              {isExporting ? (
                <>
                  <Loader2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5 animate-spin" />
                  <span>{isVi ? 'Đang tạo PDF...' : 'Generating...'}</span>
                </>
              ) : isDone ? (
                <>
                  <Check className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-300" />
                  <span>{isVi ? 'Đã tải xong!' : 'Downloaded!'}</span>
                </>
              ) : (

import React, { useState, useMemo } from 'react';
import { TrendingUp, RotateCcw } from 'lucide-react';

export const SlopeCalculator: React.FC = () => {
  const [x1, setX1] = useState<number>(1);
  const [y1, setY1] = useState<number>(2);
  const [x2, setX2] = useState<number>(4);
  const [y2, setY2] = useState<number>(8);

  const calculations = useMemo(() => {
    const dx = x2 - x1;
    const dy = y2 - y1;

    // Distance
    const distance = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);

    if (dx === 0) {
      return {
        isVertical: true,
        equation: `x = ${x1}`,
        distance: distance.toFixed(4),
        angleDeg: '90.00',
        message: 'Đường thẳng thẳng đứng (song song trục tung Oy), hệ số góc không xác định (vô cực).'
      };
    }

    const slope = dy / dx;
    const yIntercept = y1 - slope * x1;
    const angleRad = Math.atan(slope);
    const angleDeg = (angleRad * 180) / Math.PI;

    return {
      isVertical: false,
      slope: slope.toFixed(4),
      yIntercept: yIntercept.toFixed(4),
      equation: `y = ${slope.toFixed(2)}x ${yIntercept >= 0 ? `+ ${yIntercept.toFixed(2)}` : `- ${Math.abs(yIntercept).toFixed(2)}`}`,
      distance: distance.toFixed(4),
      angleDeg: angleDeg.toFixed(2),
      message: slope > 0 ? 'Đường thẳng dốc lên từ trái sang phải.' : slope < 0 ? 'Đường thẳng dốc xuống từ trái sang phải.' : 'Đường thẳng nằm ngang (song song trục Ox).'
    };
  }, [x1, y1, x2, y2]);

  return (
    <div className="w-full max-w-5xl mx-auto space-y-6">
      <div className="p-4 sm:p-6 rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-r from-blue-900/40 via-slate-800 to-slate-900 border border-blue-500/30 flex items-center justify-between">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <div className="p-3 bg-blue-600/20 text-blue-400 rounded-xl border border-blue-500/30">
            <TrendingUp className="w-6 h-6" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <h1 className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-bold text-white tracking-tight">Slope Calculator – Máy Tính Độ Dốc Đường Thẳng</h1>
            <p className="text-xs sm:text-sm text-slate-400">Tìm hệ số góc m, phương trình đường thẳng y = mx + b, góc nghiêng và khoảng cách giữa 2 điểm</p>
          </div>
        </div>
        <button
          id="slope-reset-btn"
          onClick={() => { setX1(1); setY1(2); setX2(4); setY2(8); }}
          className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs text-slate-300 hover:text-white bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 border border-slate-700 rounded-lg transition-colors cursor-pointer"
        >
          <RotateCcw className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
          <span>Đặt lại</span>
        </button>
      </div>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6">
        <div className="lg:col-span-5 space-y-4 bg-slate-900/80 p-5 rounded-2xl border border-slate-800">
          <h2 className="text-base font-semibold text-white">Tọa độ 2 điểm</h2>

          <div>
            <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-300 mb-1">Điểm thứ nhất P1 (x₁, y₁)</label>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
              <input
                id="slope-x1"
                type="number"
                value={x1}
                placeholder="x₁"
                onChange={(e) => setX1(Number(e.target.value))}
                className="px-3 py-2 bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-white font-sans focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 outline-none"
              />
              <input
                id="slope-y1"
                type="number"
                value={y1}
                placeholder="y₁"
                onChange={(e) => setY1(Number(e.target.value))}
                className="px-3 py-2 bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-white font-sans focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 outline-none"
              />
            </div>
          </div>

          <div>
            <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-300 mb-1">Điểm thứ hai P2 (x₂, y₂)</label>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
              <input
                id="slope-x2"
                type="number"
                value={x2}
                placeholder="x₂"
                onChange={(e) => setX2(Number(e.target.value))}
                className="px-3 py-2 bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-white font-sans focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 outline-none"
              />
              <input
                id="slope-y2"
                type="number"
                value={y2}
                placeholder="y₂"
                onChange={(e) => setY2(Number(e.target.value))}
                className="px-3 py-2 bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-white font-sans focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 outline-none"
              />
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="lg:col-span-7 space-y-4">
          <div className="p-6 rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-b from-blue-950/40 to-slate-900 border border-blue-500/40 text-center space-y-2">
            <span className="text-xs uppercase tracking-wider text-blue-300 font-semibold">Hệ số góc m (Slope)</span>
            <div className="text-4xl sm:text-5xl font-extrabold text-blue-400 font-sans tabular-nums">
              {calculations.isVertical ? 'Vô cực (∞)' : calculations.slope}
            </div>
            <p className="text-xs text-slate-400">{calculations.message}</p>
          </div>

          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-3">
            <div className="p-3.5 bg-slate-900/80 rounded-xl border border-slate-800">
              <span className="text-xs text-slate-400 block">Phương trình</span>
              <span className="text-sm font-bold text-white font-mono">{calculations.equation}</span>
            </div>
            <div className="p-3.5 bg-slate-900/80 rounded-xl border border-slate-800">
              <span className="text-xs text-slate-400 block">Khoảng cách P1-P2</span>
              <span className="text-sm font-bold text-white font-sans">{calculations.distance}</span>
            </div>
            <div className="p-3.5 bg-slate-900/80 rounded-xl border border-slate-800">
              <span className="text-xs text-slate-400 block">Góc nghiêng (θ)</span>
              <span className="text-sm font-bold text-white font-sans">{calculations.angleDeg}°</span>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

FILE: /src/components/tools/StandardDeviationCalculator.tsx

import React, { useState, useMemo } from 'react';
import { Sigma, RotateCcw } from 'lucide-react';

export const StandardDeviationCalculator: React.FC = () => {
  const [dataInput, setDataInput] = useState<string>('10, 12, 23, 23, 16, 23, 21, 16');

  const calculations = useMemo(() => {
    const numbers = dataInput
      .split(/[\s,;]+/)
      .map(Number)
      .filter((n) => !isNaN(n));

    const count = numbers.length;
    if (count === 0) {
      return null;
    }

    const sum = numbers.reduce((acc, val) => acc + val, 0);
    const mean = sum / count;

    // Sum of squared differences
    const sumSqDiff = numbers.reduce((acc, val) => acc + Math.pow(val - mean, 2), 0);

    // Population Standard Deviation (sigma) = sqrt(sumSqDiff / N)
    const popVariance = sumSqDiff / count;
    const popStdDev = Math.sqrt(popVariance);

    // Sample Standard Deviation (s) = sqrt(sumSqDiff / (n - 1))
    const sampleVariance = count > 1 ? sumSqDiff / (count - 1) : 0;
    const sampleStdDev = count > 1 ? Math.sqrt(sampleVariance) : 0;

    const min = Math.min(...numbers);
    const max = Math.max(...numbers);
    const range = max - min;

    return {
      count,
      sum,
      mean: mean.toFixed(4),
      sumSqDiff: sumSqDiff.toFixed(4),
      popVariance: popVariance.toFixed(4),
      popStdDev: popStdDev.toFixed(4),
      sampleVariance: sampleVariance.toFixed(4),
      sampleStdDev: sampleStdDev.toFixed(4),
      min,
      max,
      range
    };
  }, [dataInput]);

  return (
    <div className="w-full max-w-5xl mx-auto space-y-6">
      <div className="p-4 sm:p-6 rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-r from-indigo-900/40 via-slate-800 to-slate-900 border border-indigo-500/30 flex items-center justify-between">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <div className="p-3 bg-indigo-600/20 text-indigo-400 rounded-xl border border-indigo-500/30">
            <Sigma className="w-6 h-6" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <h1 className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-bold text-white tracking-tight">Standard Deviation Calculator – Tính Độ Lệch Chuẩn</h1>
            <p className="text-xs sm:text-sm text-slate-400">Tính phương sai và độ lệch chuẩn mẫu (s) & tổng thể (σ) với dữ liệu bất kỳ</p>
          </div>
        </div>
        <button
          id="sd-reset-btn"
          onClick={() => setDataInput('10, 12, 23, 23, 16, 23, 21, 16')}
          className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs text-slate-300 hover:text-white bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 border border-slate-700 rounded-lg transition-colors cursor-pointer"
        >
          <RotateCcw className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
          <span>Đặt lại</span>
        </button>
      </div>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6">
        <div className="lg:col-span-5 space-y-4 bg-slate-900/80 p-5 rounded-2xl border border-slate-800">
          <h2 className="text-base font-semibold text-white">Nhập chuỗi số liệu</h2>
          <div>
            <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-300 mb-1">
              Các số phân tách bằng dấu phẩy, khoảng trắng hoặc dấu chấm phẩy
            </label>
            <textarea
              id="sd-data-input"
              rows={5}
              value={dataInput}
              onChange={(e) => setDataInput(e.target.value)}
              className="w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-white font-sans focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-500 outline-none"
              placeholder="VD: 10, 12, 23, 23, 16, 23, 21, 16"
            />
          </div>

          <div className="p-3.5 rounded-xl bg-slate-800/60 border border-slate-700 text-xs text-slate-300 space-y-1">
            <div className="font-semibold text-indigo-400">Công thức thống kê:</div>
            <div>• Độ lệch chuẩn mẫu: <span className="font-bold text-white font-sans">s = √[Σ(x - x̄)² / (n - 1)]</span></div>
            <div>• Độ lệch chuẩn tổng thể: <span className="font-bold text-white font-sans">σ = √[Σ(x - μ)² / N]</span></div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {calculations && (
          <div className="lg:col-span-7 space-y-4">
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
              <div className="p-5 rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-b from-indigo-950/40 to-slate-900 border border-indigo-500/40 space-y-1 text-center">
                <span className="text-xs uppercase tracking-wider text-indigo-300 font-semibold">Độ lệch chuẩn mẫu (Sample s)</span>
                <div className="text-3xl sm:text-4xl font-extrabold text-indigo-400 font-sans tabular-nums">
                  {calculations.sampleStdDev}
                </div>
                <span className="text-xs text-slate-400">Phương sai mẫu s² = {calculations.sampleVariance}</span>
              </div>

              <div className="p-5 rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-b from-slate-900 to-slate-900 border border-slate-800 space-y-1 text-center">
                <span className="text-xs uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-400 font-semibold">Độ lệch chuẩn tổng thể (Pop σ)</span>
                <div className="text-3xl sm:text-4xl font-extrabold text-white font-sans tabular-nums">
                  {calculations.popStdDev}
                </div>
                <span className="text-xs text-slate-400">Phương sai tổng thể σ² = {calculations.popVariance}</span>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-4 gap-3">
              <div className="p-3.5 bg-slate-900/80 rounded-xl border border-slate-800">
                <span className="text-xs text-slate-400 block">Số lượng (n)</span>
                <span className="text-lg font-bold text-white font-sans">{calculations.count}</span>
              </div>
              <div className="p-3.5 bg-slate-900/80 rounded-xl border border-slate-800">
                <span className="text-xs text-slate-400 block">Trung bình (Mean)</span>
                <span className="text-lg font-bold text-white font-sans">{calculations.mean}</span>
              </div>
              <div className="p-3.5 bg-slate-900/80 rounded-xl border border-slate-800">
                <span className="text-xs text-slate-400 block">Tổng (Sum)</span>
                <span className="text-lg font-bold text-white font-sans">{calculations.sum}</span>
              </div>
              <div className="p-3.5 bg-slate-900/80 rounded-xl border border-slate-800">
                <span className="text-xs text-slate-400 block">Khoảng biến thiên (Range)</span>
                <span className="text-lg font-bold text-white font-sans">{calculations.range}</span>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

    </div>
  );
};

FILE: /src/components/tools/StatisticsCalculator.tsx

import React, { useState, useMemo } from 'react';
import { BarChart, RotateCcw } from 'lucide-react';

export const StatisticsCalculator: React.FC = () => {
  const [dataInput, setDataInput] = useState<string>('12, 15, 18, 20, 22, 25, 28, 30, 32, 40');

  const calculations = useMemo(() => {
    const nums = dataInput
      .split(/[\s,;]+/)
      .map(Number)
      .filter((n) => !isNaN(n));

    const n = nums.length;
    if (n === 0) return null;

    const sorted = [...nums].sort((a, b) => a - b);
    const sum = nums.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);
    const mean = sum / n;

    // Median
    const mid = Math.floor(n / 2);
    const median = n % 2 !== 0 ? sorted[mid] : (sorted[mid - 1] + sorted[mid]) / 2;

    // Quartiles Q1, Q3, IQR
    const lowerHalf = sorted.slice(0, mid);
    const upperHalf = n % 2 !== 0 ? sorted.slice(mid + 1) : sorted.slice(mid);

    const getMedian = (arr: number[]) => {
      if (arr.length === 0) return 0;
      const m = Math.floor(arr.length / 2);
      return arr.length % 2 !== 0 ? arr[m] : (arr[m - 1] + arr[m]) / 2;
    };

    const q1 = getMedian(lowerHalf);
    const q3 = getMedian(upperHalf);
    const iqr = q3 - q1;

    // Variance & StdDev
    const sumSq = nums.reduce((acc, val) => acc + Math.pow(val - mean, 2), 0);
    const sampleVar = n > 1 ? sumSq / (n - 1) : 0;
    const sampleStd = Math.sqrt(sampleVar);
    const popVar = sumSq / n;
    const popStd = Math.sqrt(popVar);

    return {
      n,
      sum,
      mean: mean.toFixed(4),
      median: median.toFixed(4),
      q1: q1.toFixed(4),
      q3: q3.toFixed(4),
      iqr: iqr.toFixed(4),
      sampleVar: sampleVar.toFixed(4),
      sampleStd: sampleStd.toFixed(4),
      popVar: popVar.toFixed(4),
      popStd: popStd.toFixed(4),
      min: sorted[0],
      max: sorted[sorted.length - 1],
      range: sorted[sorted.length - 1] - sorted[0]
    };
  }, [dataInput]);

  return (
    <div className="w-full max-w-5xl mx-auto space-y-6">
      <div className="p-4 sm:p-6 rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-r from-blue-900/40 via-slate-800 to-slate-900 border border-blue-500/30 flex items-center justify-between">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <div className="p-3 bg-blue-600/20 text-blue-400 rounded-xl border border-blue-500/30">
            <BarChart className="w-6 h-6" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <h1 className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-bold text-white tracking-tight">Statistics Calculator – Máy Tính Thống Kê Toàn Diện</h1>
            <p className="text-xs sm:text-sm text-slate-400">Thống kê mô tả: Tứ phân vị (Q1, Q3), IQR, phương sai, độ lệch chuẩn, khoảng biến thiên</p>
          </div>
        </div>
        <button
          id="stats-reset-btn"
          onClick={() => setDataInput('12, 15, 18, 20, 22, 25, 28, 30, 32, 40')}
          className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs text-slate-300 hover:text-white bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 border border-slate-700 rounded-lg transition-colors cursor-pointer"
        >
          <RotateCcw className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
          <span>Đặt lại</span>
        </button>
      </div>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6">
        <div className="lg:col-span-5 space-y-4 bg-slate-900/80 p-5 rounded-2xl border border-slate-800">
          <h2 className="text-base font-semibold text-white">Bộ dữ liệu thống kê</h2>
          <div>
            <textarea
              id="stats-input"
              rows={6}
              value={dataInput}
              onChange={(e) => setDataInput(e.target.value)}
              className="w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-white font-sans focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 outline-none"
            />
          </div>
        </div>

        {calculations && (
          <div className="lg:col-span-7 space-y-4">
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-3">
              <div className="p-3.5 bg-slate-900/80 rounded-xl border border-slate-800">
                <span className="text-xs text-slate-400 block">Kích thước mẫu (n)</span>
                <span className="text-base font-bold text-white font-sans">{calculations.n}</span>
              </div>
              <div className="p-3.5 bg-slate-900/80 rounded-xl border border-slate-800">
                <span className="text-xs text-slate-400 block">Trung bình (Mean)</span>
                <span className="text-base font-bold text-blue-400 font-sans">{calculations.mean}</span>
              </div>
              <div className="p-3.5 bg-slate-900/80 rounded-xl border border-slate-800">
                <span className="text-xs text-slate-400 block">Trung vị (Median)</span>
                <span className="text-base font-bold text-emerald-400 font-sans">{calculations.median}</span>
              </div>
              <div className="p-3.5 bg-slate-900/80 rounded-xl border border-slate-800">
                <span className="text-xs text-slate-400 block">Tứ phân vị Q1</span>
                <span className="text-base font-bold text-white font-sans">{calculations.q1}</span>
              </div>
              <div className="p-3.5 bg-slate-900/80 rounded-xl border border-slate-800">
                <span className="text-xs text-slate-400 block">Tứ phân vị Q3</span>
                <span className="text-base font-bold text-white font-sans">{calculations.q3}</span>
              </div>
              <div className="p-3.5 bg-slate-900/80 rounded-xl border border-slate-800">
                <span className="text-xs text-slate-400 block">Khoảng tứ phân vị (IQR)</span>
                <span className="text-base font-bold text-purple-400 font-sans">{calculations.iqr}</span>
              </div>
              <div className="p-3.5 bg-slate-900/80 rounded-xl border border-slate-800">
                <span className="text-xs text-slate-400 block">Độ lệch chuẩn mẫu (s)</span>
                <span className="text-base font-bold text-amber-400 font-sans">{calculations.sampleStd}</span>
              </div>
              <div className="p-3.5 bg-slate-900/80 rounded-xl border border-slate-800">
                <span className="text-xs text-slate-400 block">Phương sai mẫu (s²)</span>
                <span className="text-base font-bold text-white font-sans">{calculations.sampleVar}</span>
              </div>
              <div className="p-3.5 bg-slate-900/80 rounded-xl border border-slate-800">
                <span className="text-xs text-slate-400 block">Min / Max</span>
                <span className="text-base font-bold text-white font-sans">{calculations.min} / {calculations.max}</span>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

      { id: 'sg_b2', max: 2500, rate: 2, label: 'Bậc 2: $1,667 - $2,500 (2%)' },

    ]

    flag: '🇦🇺',

    dependentDeduction: 0,
    quickAmounts: [4000, 6000, 8000, 12000, 20000],

    insurances: [
      { id: 'au_medicare', name: 'Medicare Levy (Y tế Úc 2.0%)', rate: 2.0, salaryCap: 0, enabled: true, note: 'Không giới hạn trần' },
    ],
    brackets: [
      { id: 'au_b1', max: 3750, rate: 16, label: 'Bậc 1: Đến $3,750 (16%)' },

      { id: 'au_b3', max: 15833, rate: 37, label: 'Bậc 3: $11,250 - $15,833 (37%)' },

    quickAmounts: [3500, 5000, 7500, 11000, 18000],

    insurances: [
      { id: 'ca_cpp', name: 'CPP (Hưu trí Canada 5.95%)', rate: 5.95, salaryCap: 5708, enabled: true, note: 'Trần $5,708/tháng' },
      { id: 'ca_ei', name: 'EI (Bảo hiểm việc làm 1.66%)', rate: 1.66, salaryCap: 5266, enabled: true, note: 'Trần $5,266/tháng' },
    ],
    brackets: [
      { id: 'ca_b1', max: 4655, rate: 15, label: 'Bậc 1: Đến $4,655 (15%)' },
      { id: 'ca_b2', max: 9311, rate: 20.5, label: 'Bậc 2: $4,655 - $9,311 (20.5%)' },
      { id: 'ca_b3', max: 14434, rate: 26, label: 'Bậc 3: $9,311 - $14,434 (26%)' },
      { id: 'ca_b4', max: 20562, rate: 29, label: 'Bậc 4: $14,434 - $20,562 (29%)' },
      { id: 'ca_b5', max: Infinity, rate: 33, label: 'Bậc 5: Trên $20,562 (33%)' },
    ]
  },
  custom: {
    id: 'custom',
    name: 'Khu vực tùy chỉnh',
    flag: '🌐',
    currencyCode: 'USD',
    defaultGross: 5000,

    dependentDeduction: 200,
    quickAmounts: [2000, 5000, 8000, 15000, 30000],
    regionNotes: 'Chế độ hoàn toàn tự do: Tùy biến mọi mức thuế suất, ngưỡng lũy tiến, các loại BHXH, BHYT và các khoản cộng trừ theo nhu cầu.',
    insurances: [
      { id: 'custom_ins1', name: 'Bảo hiểm Xã hội (Social Insurance)', rate: 8.0, salaryCap: 0, enabled: true, note: 'Tùy chỉnh' },
