                title={`Lương Net: ${formatMoney(calculations.netMonthly)}`}
              />
              <div 
                style={{ width: `${Math.max(1, (calculations.totalTax / Math.max(1, calculations.totalGross)) * 100)}%` }}
                className="bg-violet-500 h-full transition-all"
                title={`Thuế TNCN: ${formatMoney(calculations.totalTax)}`}
              />
              <div 
                style={{ width: `${Math.max(1, (calculations.totalInsurance / Math.max(1, calculations.totalGross)) * 100)}%` }}
                className="bg-rose-500 h-full transition-all"
                title={`Bảo hiểm: ${formatMoney(calculations.totalInsurance)}`}
              />
            </div>

            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3 pt-1 text-[10px] text-slate-400">
              <span className="flex items-center gap-1">
                <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-emerald-500" />
                <span>Net ({calculations.totalGross > 0 ? Math.round((calculations.netMonthly / calculations.totalGross) * 100) : 0}%)</span>
              </span>
              <span className="flex items-center gap-1">
                <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-violet-500" />
                <span>Thuế ({calculations.effectiveRate}%)</span>
              </span>
              <span className="flex items-center gap-1">
                <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-rose-500" />
                <span>Bảo hiểm ({calculations.totalGross > 0 ? ((calculations.totalInsurance / calculations.totalGross) * 100).toFixed(1) : 0}%)</span>
              </span>
            </div>
          </div>

        </div>

      </div>
      </div>

      {/* --- PREVIEW MODAL & PRINTABLE A4 STATEMENT --- */}
      {showPrintModal && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-3 sm:p-6 bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-sm overflow-y-auto no-print">
          <div className="relative w-full max-w-4xl bg-slate-900 border border-slate-700 rounded-2xl shadow-2xl overflow-hidden my-auto flex flex-col max-h-[90vh]">
            {/* Modal Header Toolbar */}
            <div className="p-4 bg-slate-800/90 border-b border-slate-700 flex items-center justify-between gap-3 shrink-0">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <FileText className="w-5 h-5 text-violet-400" />
                <div>
                  <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-white">Mẫu Phiếu Lương &amp; Bảng Kê Thuế TNCN</h3>
                  <p className="text-xs text-slate-400">Xem trước chuẩn trang A4 để in hoặc xuất tải file PDF</p>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={handleDownloadPDF}
                  disabled={isExportingPdf}
                  className={`flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-white text-xs font-semibold transition-colors cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-50 ${
                    exportSuccess
                      ? 'bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-500'
                      : 'bg-rose-600 hover:bg-rose-500'
                  }`}
                  title="Tải bảng tính thuế thành file PDF"
                >
                  {isExportingPdf ? (
                    <Loader2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5 animate-spin" />
                  ) : exportSuccess ? (
                    <Check className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  ) : (
                    <Download className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  )}
                  <span>{isExportingPdf ? 'Đang tạo PDF...' : exportSuccess ? 'Đã tải xong PDF!' : 'Tải PDF'}</span>
                </button>

                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={handlePrint}
                  className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-sky-600 hover:bg-sky-500 text-white text-xs font-semibold transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                >
                  <Printer className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  <span>In / Lưu PDF</span>
                </button>

                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setShowPrintModal(false)}
                  className="p-1.5 text-slate-400 hover:text-white rounded-lg hover:bg-slate-700 transition-colors cursor-pointer ml-1"
                >
                  <X className="w-5 h-5" />
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Modal Body: A4 Paper Preview */}
            <div className="p-4 sm:p-8 overflow-y-auto bg-slate-950/80 flex justify-center">
              <div 
                id="tax-statement-modal-sheet"
                style={{ backgroundColor: '#ffffff', color: '#000000' }}
                className="w-full max-w-[210mm] pdf-report-page bg-white text-slate-900 rounded-lg p-6 sm:p-10 shadow-2xl space-y-6 text-sm border border-slate-300"
              >
                
                {/* Document Header */}
                <div className="border-b pb-4 border-slate-300 flex flex-col sm:flex-row justify-between items-start sm:items-end gap-3">
                  <div>
                    <div className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-widest text-slate-700">
                      BẢNG DỰ TOÁN THUẾ THU NHẬP CÁ NHÂN &amp; LƯƠNG NET
                    </div>
                    <h2 className="text-2xl font-black text-black tracking-tight mt-1">
                      PHIẾU TÍNH THUẾ &amp; LƯƠNG THỰC NHẬN
                    </h2>
                    <div className="text-xs text-slate-700 mt-1">
                      Khu vực áp dụng: <strong>{activePreset.flag} {activePreset.name}</strong> • Tiền tệ: <strong>{currencyInfo.code} ({currencyInfo.symbol})</strong>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  <div className="text-xs text-right text-slate-600">
                    <div>Ngày lập: <strong className="text-black">{new Date().toLocaleDateString('vi-VN')}</strong></div>
                    <div>Giờ lập: {new Date().toLocaleTimeString('vi-VN')}</div>
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* 1. Thu nhập Gross */}
                <div className="space-y-2">
                  <div className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-black bg-slate-100 p-2 rounded border border-slate-300">
                    1. Chi tiết Tổng Thu nhập Hàng tháng (Gross)
                  </div>
                  <table className="w-full text-xs border-collapse">
                    <tbody>
                      <tr className="border-b border-slate-200">
                        <td className="py-2 text-slate-800">Lương cơ bản Gross</td>
                        <td className="py-2 text-right font-bold text-black font-sans">{formatMoney(grossMonthly)}</td>
                      </tr>
                      {customIncomes.map((item) => (
                        <tr key={item.id} className="border-b border-slate-200">
                          <td className="py-1.5 text-slate-700 pl-4">
                            + {item.name} <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-500">({item.isTaxable ? 'Chịu thuế' : 'Miễn thuế'})</span>

                        <td className="py-2 text-black">TỔNG THU NHẬP GROSS HÀNG THÁNG</td>
                        <td className="py-2 text-right text-black text-sm font-sans">{formatMoney(calculations.totalGross)}</td>
                      </tr>
                    </tbody>
                  </table>
                </div>

                {/* 2. Bảo hiểm bắt buộc */}
                <div className="space-y-2">
                  <div className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-black bg-slate-100 p-2 rounded border border-slate-300">
                    2. Các Khoản Bảo Hiểm Bắt Buộc Người Lao Động Đóng
                  </div>
                  <table className="w-full text-xs border-collapse">
                    <thead>
                      <tr className="border-b border-slate-300 text-slate-700 text-left">
                        <th className="py-1.5 font-semibold">Tên bảo hiểm</th>
                        <th className="py-1.5 text-center font-semibold">Tỷ lệ</th>
                        <th className="py-1.5 text-right font-semibold">Mức trần lương</th>
                        <th className="py-1.5 text-right font-semibold">Số tiền đóng</th>
                      </tr>
                    </thead>
                    <tbody>
                      {calculations.insuranceDetails.map((ins, idx) => (
                        <tr key={idx} className="border-b border-slate-200">
                          <td className="py-1.5 text-slate-800">{ins.name}</td>
                          <td className="py-1.5 text-center text-slate-700 font-sans">{ins.rate}%</td>
                          <td className="py-1.5 text-right text-slate-700 font-sans">
                            {ins.cap > 0 ? formatMoney(ins.cap) : 'Không trần'}
                          </td>

                      <tr className="bg-slate-50 font-bold border-t-2 border-slate-400">
                        <td colSpan={3} className="py-2 text-black">TỔNG TIỀN BẢO HIỂM ĐÓNG GÓP</td>
                        <td className="py-2 text-right text-black font-sans text-sm">{formatMoney(calculations.totalInsurance)}</td>
                      </tr>
                    </tbody>
                  </table>
                </div>

                  </div>
                  <table className="w-full text-xs border-collapse">
                    <tbody>
                      <tr className="border-b border-slate-200">
                        <td className="py-1.5 text-slate-800">Giảm trừ bản thân người nộp thuế</td>
                        <td className="py-1.5 text-right font-sans text-black">{formatMoney(calculations.selfDeduction)}</td>
                      </tr>
                      <tr className="border-b border-slate-200">
                        <td className="py-1.5 text-slate-800">
                          Giảm trừ người phụ thuộc ({dependents} người x {formatMoney(dependentDeduction)})
                        </td>
                        <td className="py-1.5 text-right font-sans text-black">{formatMoney(calculations.totalDependentDeduction)}</td>
                      </tr>
                      {customDeductions.map((item) => (
                        <tr key={item.id} className="border-b border-slate-200">
                          <td className="py-1.5 text-slate-700 pl-4">+ Giảm trừ: {item.name}</td>
                          <td className="py-1.5 text-right font-sans text-black">{formatMoney(item.amount)}</td>
                        </tr>
                      ))}
                      <tr className="bg-slate-50 font-bold border-t-2 border-slate-400">
                        <td className="py-2 text-black">TỔNG CÁC KHOẢN GIẢM TRỪ</td>
                        <td className="py-2 text-right text-black font-sans">{formatMoney(calculations.totalDeductions)}</td>
                      </tr>
                      <tr className="bg-slate-100 font-bold text-black border-t-2 border-slate-400">
                        <td className="py-2.5">THU NHẬP TÍNH THUẾ (Taxable Income)</td>
                        <td className="py-2.5 text-right font-sans text-sm text-black">{formatMoney(calculations.taxableIncome)}</td>
                      </tr>
                    </tbody>
                  </table>
                </div>

                {/* 4. Biểu thuế lũy tiến từng phần */}
                <div className="space-y-2">
                  <div className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-black bg-slate-100 p-2 rounded border border-slate-300">
                    4. Chi Tiết Tính Thuế TNCN Theo Từng Bậc Lũy Tiến
                  </div>
                  <table className="w-full text-xs border-collapse">
                    <thead>
                      <tr className="border-b border-slate-300 text-slate-700 text-left">
                        <th className="py-1.5 font-semibold">Bậc lũy tiến</th>
                        <th className="py-1.5 text-center font-semibold">Thuế suất</th>
                        <th className="py-1.5 text-right font-semibold">Thu nhập trong bậc</th>
                        <th className="py-1.5 text-right font-semibold">Thuế nộp</th>
                      </tr>
                    </thead>
                    <tbody>
                      {calculations.bracketDetails.map((b, idx) => (
                        <tr key={idx} className="border-b border-slate-200">
                          <td className="py-1.5 text-slate-800">{b.label}</td>
                          <td className="py-1.5 text-center font-sans text-slate-700">{b.rate}%</td>
                          <td className="py-1.5 text-right font-sans text-slate-700">{formatMoney(b.taxableInBracket)}</td>
                          <td className="py-1.5 text-right font-sans font-bold text-black">{formatMoney(b.taxAmount)}</td>
                        </tr>
                      ))}
                      <tr className="bg-slate-100 font-black border-t-2 border-slate-400 text-black">
                        <td colSpan={3} className="py-2">TỔNG THUẾ TNCN PHẢI NỘP HÀNG THÁNG</td>
                        <td className="py-2 text-right text-black font-sans text-base">{formatMoney(calculations.totalTax)}</td>
                      </tr>
                    </tbody>
                  </table>
                </div>

                {/* 5. TỔNG KẾT LƯƠNG NET */}
                <div className="p-4 rounded-xl bg-slate-50 border-2 border-black text-black flex flex-col sm:flex-row justify-between items-center gap-3">
                  <div>
                    <div className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-black">
                      LƯƠNG THỰC NHẬN HÀNG THÁNG (NET TAKE-HOME)
                    </div>
                    <div className="text-xs text-slate-700 mt-0.5">
                      Đã trừ toàn bộ bảo hiểm ({formatMoney(calculations.totalInsurance)}) và thuế TNCN ({formatMoney(calculations.totalTax)})
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <div className="text-right">
                    <div className="text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-black text-black font-sans">
                      {formatMoney(calculations.netMonthly)}
                    </div>
                    <div className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-800">
                      Thuế suất thực: {calculations.effectiveRate}% • Net/Gross: {calculations.totalGross > 0 ? ((calculations.netMonthly / calculations.totalGross) * 100).toFixed(1) : 0}%
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* Signatures */}
                <div className="pt-8 grid grid-cols-2 text-center text-xs text-slate-700">
                  <div>
                    <div className="font-bold text-black">NGƯỜI NỘP THUẾ / LAO ĐỘNG</div>
                    <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 mt-0.5">(Ký và ghi rõ họ tên)</div>
                    <div className="h-16" />
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <div className="font-bold text-black">BỘ PHẬN KẾ TOÁN / TIỀN LƯƠNG</div>
                    <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 mt-0.5">(Xác nhận dự toán)</div>
                    <div className="h-16" />
                  </div>
                </div>

              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Modal Footer */}
            <div className="p-4 bg-slate-800/90 border-t border-slate-700 flex justify-end gap-2 shrink-0">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setShowPrintModal(false)}
                className="px-4 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-300 hover:text-white bg-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-600 rounded-lg transition-colors cursor-pointer"
              >
                Đóng
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={handleDownloadPDF}
                disabled={isExportingPdf}
                className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-4 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-white bg-rose-600 hover:bg-rose-500 rounded-lg transition-colors cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-50"
              >
                {isExportingPdf ? <Loader2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5 animate-spin" /> : <Download className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />}
                <span>{isExportingPdf ? 'Đang tạo...' : 'Tải file PDF'}</span>
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={handlePrint}
                className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-4 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-white bg-sky-600 hover:bg-sky-500 rounded-lg transition-colors cursor-pointer"
              >
                <Printer className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                <span>In trang này</span>
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Hidden Printable Container — dùng position offscreen thay vì display:none */}
      <div 
        id="tax-statement-printable"
        aria-hidden="true"
        className="printable-tax-statement bg-white text-slate-900 p-8 space-y-6 text-sm"
        style={{
          position: 'fixed',
          left: '-9999px',
          top: 0,
          width: '800px',
          visibility: 'hidden',
          pointerEvents: 'none',
          zIndex: -9999,
          backgroundColor: '#ffffff',
          color: '#0f172a',
        }}
      >
        <div
          className="pdf-report-page bg-white text-slate-900 p-8 space-y-4 text-xs"
          style={{
            width: '794px',
            minHeight: '1123px',
            height: 'auto',
            boxSizing: 'border-box',
            backgroundColor: '#ffffff',
            color: '#0f172a',
            display: 'block',
          }}
        >
          <div className="space-y-4">
            {/* Header */}
            <div className="border-b pb-3 border-slate-300 flex justify-between items-end">
              <div>
                <div className="text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-widest text-slate-700">
                  BẢNG DỰ TOÁN THUẾ THU NHẬP CÁ NHÂN &amp; LƯƠNG NET
                </div>
                <h2 className="text-xl font-black text-black tracking-tight mt-0.5">
                  PHIẾU TÍNH THUẾ &amp; LƯƠNG THỰC NHẬN
                </h2>
                <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-700 mt-0.5">
                  Khu vực: <strong>{activePreset.flag} {activePreset.name}</strong> • Tiền tệ: <strong>{currencyInfo.code} ({currencyInfo.symbol})</strong>
                </div>
              </div>
              <div className="text-[11px] text-right text-slate-600">
                <div>Ngày lập: <strong className="text-black">{new Date().toLocaleDateString('vi-VN')}</strong></div>
                <div>Giờ: {new Date().toLocaleTimeString('vi-VN')}</div>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* 1. Thu nhập Gross */}
            <div className="space-y-1">
              <div className="text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-black bg-slate-100 p-1.5 rounded border border-slate-300">
                1. Chi tiết Tổng Thu nhập Hàng tháng (Gross)
              </div>
              <table className="w-full text-[11px] border-collapse">

                    <td className="py-1 text-right font-bold text-black font-sans">{formatMoney(grossMonthly)}</td>
                  </tr>

                    <tr key={item.id} className="border-b border-slate-200">
                      <td className="py-1 text-slate-700 pl-3">
                        + {item.name} <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-500">({item.isTaxable ? 'Chịu thuế' : 'Miễn thuế'})</span>
                      </td>
                      <td className="py-1 text-right font-sans text-black">{formatMoney(item.amount)}</td>
                    </tr>
                  ))}
                  <tr className="bg-slate-50 font-bold border-t-2 border-slate-400">
                    <td className="py-1.5 text-black">TỔNG THU NHẬP GROSS HÀNG THÁNG</td>
                    <td className="py-1.5 text-right text-black font-sans">{formatMoney(calculations.totalGross)}</td>
                  </tr>
                </tbody>
              </table>
            </div>

            {/* 2. Bảo hiểm bắt buộc */}
            <div className="space-y-1">
              <div className="text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-black bg-slate-100 p-1.5 rounded border border-slate-300">
                2. Các Khoản Bảo Hiểm Bắt Buộc Người Lao Động Đóng
              </div>
              <table className="w-full text-[11px] border-collapse">
                <thead>
                  <tr className="border-b border-slate-300 text-slate-700 text-left">
                    <th className="py-1 font-semibold">Tên bảo hiểm</th>
                    <th className="py-1 text-center font-semibold">Tỷ lệ</th>
                    <th className="py-1 text-right font-semibold">Mức trần lương</th>
                    <th className="py-1 text-right font-semibold">Số tiền đóng</th>
                  </tr>

                <tbody>

                    <td className="py-1 text-slate-800">Giảm trừ bản thân người nộp thuế</td>
                    <td className="py-1 text-right font-sans text-black">{formatMoney(calculations.selfDeduction)}</td>

                      Giảm trừ người phụ thuộc ({dependents} người x {formatMoney(dependentDeduction)})

                      <td className="py-1 text-slate-700 pl-3">+ Giảm trừ: {item.name}</td>

                    <td className="py-1.5">THU NHẬP TÍNH THUẾ (Taxable Income)</td>
                    <td className="py-1.5 text-right font-sans text-black">{formatMoney(calculations.taxableIncome)}</td>
                  </tr>

            {/* 4. Biểu thuế lũy tiến từng phần */}
            <div className="space-y-1">
              <div className="text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-black bg-slate-100 p-1.5 rounded border border-slate-300">

                    <td colSpan={3} className="py-1.5">TỔNG THUẾ TNCN PHẢI NỘP HÀNG THÁNG</td>

              <div>
                <div className="text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-black">
                  LƯƠNG THỰC NHẬN HÀNG THÁNG (NET TAKE-HOME)
                </div>
                <div className="text-[10px] text-slate-700">
                  Bảo hiểm ({formatMoney(calculations.totalInsurance)}) • Thuế TNCN ({formatMoney(calculations.totalTax)})

                <div className="text-xl font-black text-black font-sans">
                  {formatMoney(calculations.netMonthly)}
                </div>

                  Thuế suất thực: {calculations.effectiveRate}% • Net/Gross: {calculations.totalGross > 0 ? ((calculations.netMonthly / calculations.totalGross) * 100).toFixed(1) : 0}%
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Signatures & Footer */}
          <div className="pt-4 border-t border-slate-300">
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 text-center text-xs text-slate-700">

                <div className="font-bold text-black">KẾ TOÁN TRƯỞNG / ĐẠI DIỆN DOANH NGHIỆP</div>

              Bảng dự toán thuế và lương được tính toán dựa trên quy định pháp luật hiện hành và các tham số do người dùng thiết lập.
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );

FILE: /src/components/tools/TemperatureConverter.tsx
================================================================================
import React, { useState, useMemo } from 'react';
import { Thermometer, RotateCcw, ArrowRightLeft } from 'lucide-react';

type TempUnit = 'c' | 'f' | 'k';

export const TemperatureConverter: React.FC = () => {
  const [val, setVal] = useState<number>(25);
  const [fromUnit, setFromUnit] = useState<TempUnit>('c');
  const [toUnit, setToUnit] = useState<TempUnit>('f');

  const conversions = useMemo(() => {
    // First convert to Celsius
    let celsius = 0;
    if (fromUnit === 'c') celsius = val;
    else if (fromUnit === 'f') celsius = (val - 32) * (5 / 9);
    else if (fromUnit === 'k') celsius = val - 273.15;

    // Convert from Celsius to all
    const fahrenheit = celsius * (9 / 5) + 32;
    const kelvin = celsius + 273.15;

    let target = 0;
    if (toUnit === 'c') target = celsius;
    else if (toUnit === 'f') target = fahrenheit;
    else if (toUnit === 'k') target = kelvin;

    return {
      target: Number(target.toFixed(2)),
      c: Number(celsius.toFixed(2)),
      f: Number(fahrenheit.toFixed(2)),
      k: Number(kelvin.toFixed(2))
    };
  }, [val, fromUnit, toUnit]);

  return (
    <div className="w-full max-w-4xl mx-auto space-y-6">
      <div className="p-4 sm:p-6 rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-r from-blue-900/40 via-slate-800 to-slate-900 border border-blue-500/30 flex items-center justify-between">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <div className="p-3 bg-blue-600/20 text-blue-400 rounded-xl border border-blue-500/30">
            <Thermometer className="w-6 h-6" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <h1 className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-bold text-white tracking-tight">Temperature Converter – Chuyển Đổi Nhiệt Độ</h1>
            <p className="text-xs sm:text-sm text-slate-400">Chuyển đổi tức thời giữa Độ C (°Celsius), Độ F (°Fahrenheit) và Kelvin (K)</p>
          </div>
        </div>
        <button
          id="temp-reset-btn"
          onClick={() => { setVal(25); setFromUnit('c'); setToUnit('f'); }}
          className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs text-slate-300 hover:text-white bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 border border-slate-700 rounded-lg transition-colors cursor-pointer"
        >
          <RotateCcw className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
          <span>Đặt lại</span>
        </button>
      </div>

      <div className="p-6 bg-slate-900/90 rounded-2xl border border-slate-800 space-y-6">
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-7 gap-3 items-center">
          <div className="sm:col-span-3 space-y-2">
            <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-300">Nhiệt độ nguồn</label>
            <input
              id="temp-val-input"
              type="number"
              value={val}
              onChange={(e) => setVal(Number(e.target.value))}
              className="w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-white font-sans focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 outline-none"
            />
            <div className="flex gap-2">
              {[
                { id: 'c', label: '°C (Celsius)' },
                { id: 'f', label: '°F (Fahrenheit)' },
                { id: 'k', label: 'K (Kelvin)' },
              ].map((u) => (
                <button
                  key={u.id}
                  onClick={() => setFromUnit(u.id as TempUnit)}
                  className={`flex-1 py-1.5 text-xs rounded-lg border font-medium ${
                    fromUnit === u.id ? 'bg-blue-600 text-white border-blue-500 font-bold' : 'bg-slate-800 text-slate-400 border-slate-700'
                  }`}
                >
                  {u.label}
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="sm:col-span-1 flex justify-center">
            <button
              id="temp-swap-btn"
              onClick={() => { setFromUnit(toUnit); setToUnit(fromUnit); }}
              className="p-3 rounded-full bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 border border-slate-700 text-blue-400 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
              title="Đảo chiều"
            >
              <ArrowRightLeft className="w-4 h-4" />
            </button>
          </div>

          <div className="sm:col-span-3 space-y-2">
            <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-300">Kết quả quy đổi</label>
            <div className="w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 bg-slate-800/60 border border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-blue-400 font-bold font-sans text-xl tabular-nums">
              {conversions.target} {toUnit === 'c' ? '°C' : toUnit === 'f' ? '°F' : 'K'}
            </div>
            <div className="flex gap-2">
              {[
                { id: 'c', label: '°C (Celsius)' },
                { id: 'f', label: '°F (Fahrenheit)' },
                { id: 'k', label: 'K (Kelvin)' },
              ].map((u) => (
                <button
                  key={u.id}
                  onClick={() => setToUnit(u.id as TempUnit)}
                  className={`flex-1 py-1.5 text-xs rounded-lg border font-medium ${
                    toUnit === u.id ? 'bg-blue-600 text-white border-blue-500 font-bold' : 'bg-slate-800 text-slate-400 border-slate-700'
                  }`}
                >
                  {u.label}
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-3 pt-4 border-t border-slate-800">
          <div className="p-3 bg-slate-800/40 rounded-xl border border-slate-800 text-center">
            <span className="text-xs text-slate-400 block mb-1">Celsius</span>
            <span className="text-base font-bold text-white font-sans">{conversions.c} °C</span>
          </div>
          <div className="p-3 bg-slate-800/40 rounded-xl border border-slate-800 text-center">
            <span className="text-xs text-slate-400 block mb-1">Fahrenheit</span>
            <span className="text-base font-bold text-white font-sans">{conversions.f} °F</span>
          </div>
          <div className="p-3 bg-slate-800/40 rounded-xl border border-slate-800 text-center">
            <span className="text-xs text-slate-400 block mb-1">Kelvin</span>
            <span className="text-base font-bold text-white font-sans">{conversions.k} K</span>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

FILE: /src/components/tools/TimeCalculator.tsx

import React, { useState, useMemo } from 'react';
import {
  Clock,
  Plus,
  Minus,
  Check,
  Copy
} from 'lucide-react';

export const TimeCalculator: React.FC = () => {
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<'duration' | 'arithmetic' | 'timesheet'>('duration');
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState<boolean>(false);

  // Tab 1: Duration between two times
  const [startTime, setStartTime] = useState<string>('08:30');
  const [endTime, setEndTime] = useState<string>('17:45');
  const [breakMinutes, setBreakMinutes] = useState<number>(60); // Lunch break

  // Tab 2: Add/Subtract from a time
  const [baseTime, setBaseTime] = useState<string>('14:30');
  const [op, setOp] = useState<'add' | 'subtract'>('add');
  const [addHours, setAddHours] = useState<number>(3);
  const [addMinutes, setAddMinutes] = useState<number>(45);

  // Tab 3: Timesheet simple list
  const [shifts, setShifts] = useState<{ day: string; start: string; end: string; breakMin: number }[]>([
    { day: 'Thứ Hai', start: '08:00', end: '17:00', breakMin: 60 },
    { day: 'Thứ Ba', start: '08:00', end: '17:30', breakMin: 60 },
    { day: 'Thứ Tư', start: '08:30', end: '17:30', breakMin: 60 },
    { day: 'Thứ Năm', start: '08:00', end: '17:00', breakMin: 60 },
    { day: 'Thứ Sáu', start: '08:00', end: '16:30', breakMin: 30 },
  ]);

  // Calculations for Duration
  const durationResult = useMemo(() => {
    const [sh, sm] = startTime.split(':').map(Number);
    const [eh, em] = endTime.split(':').map(Number);

    let startTotalM = sh * 60 + sm;
    let endTotalM = eh * 60 + em;

    // Overnight support (e.g. 22:00 to 06:00 next day)
    if (endTotalM < startTotalM) {
      endTotalM += 24 * 60;
    }

    const grossMinutes = endTotalM - startTotalM;
    const netMinutes = Math.max(0, grossMinutes - breakMinutes);

    const hours = Math.floor(netMinutes / 60);
    const minutes = netMinutes % 60;
    const decimalHours = Number((netMinutes / 60).toFixed(2));
    const totalSeconds = netMinutes * 60;

    return {
      grossMinutes,
      netMinutes,
      hours,
      minutes,
      decimalHours,
      totalSeconds
    };
  }, [startTime, endTime, breakMinutes]);

  // Calculations for Arithmetic
  const arithmeticResult = useMemo(() => {
    const [h, m] = baseTime.split(':').map(Number);
    let totalMinutes = h * 60 + m;
    const delta = addHours * 60 + addMinutes;

    if (op === 'add') {
      totalMinutes += delta;
    } else {
      totalMinutes -= delta;
    }

    // Wrap around 24 hours
    totalMinutes = ((totalMinutes % (24 * 60)) + (24 * 60)) % (24 * 60);

    const resH = Math.floor(totalMinutes / 60);
    const resM = totalMinutes % 60;
    const formatted = `${String(resH).padStart(2, '0')}:${String(resM).padStart(2, '0')}`;

    return {
      formatted,
      resH,
      resM
    };
  }, [baseTime, op, addHours, addMinutes]);

  // Calculations for Timesheet
  const timesheetResult = useMemo(() => {
    let totalMins = 0;
    const rows = shifts.map(shift => {
      const [sh, sm] = shift.start.split(':').map(Number);
      const [eh, em] = shift.end.split(':').map(Number);
      let sM = sh * 60 + sm;
      let eM = eh * 60 + em;
      if (eM < sM) eM += 24 * 60;
      const net = Math.max(0, eM - sM - shift.breakMin);
      totalMins += net;
      return {
        ...shift,
        netHours: Number((net / 60).toFixed(2))
      };
    });

    const totalHours = Math.floor(totalMins / 60);
    const totalRemainingMinutes = totalMins % 60;
    const totalDecimal = Number((totalMins / 60).toFixed(2));

    return {
      rows,
      totalHours,
      totalRemainingMinutes,
      totalDecimal
    };
  }, [shifts]);

  const handleCopy = () => {
    let text = '';
    if (activeTab === 'duration') {
      text = `Khoảng thời gian: từ ${startTime} đến ${endTime} (nghỉ ${breakMinutes} phút)\n- Kết quả: ${durationResult.hours} giờ ${durationResult.minutes} phút\n- Số giờ quy đổi thập phân: ${durationResult.decimalHours} giờ`;
    } else if (activeTab === 'arithmetic') {
      text = `Cộng/Trừ thời gian: ${baseTime} ${op === 'add' ? '+' : '-'} ${addHours}h ${addMinutes}m = ${arithmeticResult.formatted}`;
    } else {
      text = `Bảng chấm công tổng tuần: ${timesheetResult.totalHours} giờ ${timesheetResult.totalRemainingMinutes} phút (${timesheetResult.totalDecimal} giờ)`;
    }
    navigator.clipboard?.writeText(text);
    setCopied(true);
    setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 2000);
  };

  return (
    <div id="time-calculator" className="p-4 sm:p-7 space-y-6">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-3 pb-5 border-b border-slate-200">
        <div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <span className="p-2 rounded-xl bg-indigo-50 text-indigo-600 border border-indigo-100">
              <Clock className="w-5 h-5" />
            </span>
            <h2 className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-black text-slate-900 tracking-tight">
              Time Calculator (Tính Thời Gian)
            </h2>
          </div>
          <p className="text-xs sm:text-sm text-slate-500 mt-1">
            Cộng trừ giờ phút, đo khoảng cách thời gian giữa 2 mốc và quy đổi số giờ công tính lương.
          </p>
        </div>

        <button
          onClick={handleCopy}
          className="self-start sm:self-auto flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3.5 py-2 text-xs font-semibold rounded-xl bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 text-slate-700 transition-colors active:scale-95"
        >
          {copied ? <Check className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-600" /> : <Copy className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-500" />}
          <span>{copied ? 'Đã sao chép' : 'Sao chép kết quả'}</span>
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* Tabs */}
      <div className="flex gap-2 p-1.5 bg-slate-100 rounded-2xl w-fit">
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => setActiveTab('duration')}
          className={`px-4 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition-all ${
            activeTab === 'duration' ? 'bg-blue-600 text-white shadow-xs' : 'text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-900'
          }`}
        >
          Khoảng cách 2 mốc giờ
        </button>
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => setActiveTab('arithmetic')}
          className={`px-4 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition-all ${
            activeTab === 'arithmetic' ? 'bg-blue-600 text-white shadow-xs' : 'text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-900'
          }`}
        >
          Cộng / Trừ giờ phút
        </button>
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => setActiveTab('timesheet')}
          className={`px-4 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition-all ${
            activeTab === 'timesheet' ? 'bg-blue-600 text-white shadow-xs' : 'text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-900'
          }`}
        >
          Chấm công tuần
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* Mode 1: Duration */}
      {activeTab === 'duration' && (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6">
          <div className="lg:col-span-6 bg-slate-50 p-5 rounded-3xl border border-slate-200 space-y-4">
            <h3 className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 uppercase tracking-wider">
              Nhập mốc thời gian bắt đầu &amp; kết thúc
            </h3>

            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 text-xs">
              <div>
                <label className="text-slate-600 font-semibold block mb-1.5">Giờ bắt đầu:</label>
                <input
                  type="time"
                  value={startTime}
                  onChange={(e) => setStartTime(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full p-2.5 bg-white border border-slate-300 rounded-xl font-bold text-sm text-slate-900 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-500"
                />
              </div>
              <div>
                <label className="text-slate-600 font-semibold block mb-1.5">Giờ kết thúc:</label>
                <input
                  type="time"
                  value={endTime}
                  onChange={(e) => setEndTime(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full p-2.5 bg-white border border-slate-300 rounded-xl font-bold text-sm text-slate-900 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-500"
                />
              </div>
            </div>

            <div>
              <div className="flex justify-between text-xs mb-1">
                <span className="text-slate-600 font-semibold">Thời gian nghỉ trừ ra:</span>
                <span className="font-bold text-slate-900">{breakMinutes} phút ({Number((breakMinutes / 60).toFixed(1))} giờ)</span>
              </div>
              <input
                type="range"
                min={0}
                max={180}
                step={5}
                value={breakMinutes}
                onChange={(e) => setBreakMinutes(Number(e.target.value))}
                className="w-full accent-indigo-600"
              />
              <div className="flex gap-2 pt-1">
                {[0, 30, 45, 60, 90].map(m => (
                  <button
                    key={m}
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => setBreakMinutes(m)}
                    className={`text-[11px] px-2 py-1 rounded-lg border font-semibold ${
                      breakMinutes === m ? 'bg-indigo-600 text-white border-indigo-600' : 'bg-white text-slate-600 border-slate-200'
                    }`}
                  >
                    {m}m
                  </button>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>

            <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-400">
              * Tự động nhận diện trường hợp ca làm việc qua đêm (qua 00:00 sáng hôm sau).
            </p>
          </div>

          <div className="lg:col-span-6 space-y-4">
            <div className="bg-gradient-to-br from-indigo-900 via-slate-900 to-blue-950 p-6 rounded-3xl text-white shadow-xl space-y-4">
              <span className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-indigo-300">
                Tổng thời gian thực tế (Net Duration)
              </span>

              <div className="flex items-baseline gap-2">
                <span className="text-4xl sm:text-6xl font-black font-mono tracking-tight text-white">
                  {durationResult.hours}h {durationResult.minutes}m
                </span>
              </div>

              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 pt-3 border-t border-slate-800 text-xs">
                <div className="p-3 rounded-2xl bg-slate-800/70 border border-slate-700/50">
                  <span className="text-slate-400 block mb-0.5">Số giờ thập phân (tính lương)</span>
                  <span className="text-xl font-black text-indigo-400 font-mono">
                    {durationResult.decimalHours} giờ
                  </span>
                </div>
                <div className="p-3 rounded-2xl bg-slate-800/70 border border-slate-700/50">
                  <span className="text-slate-400 block mb-0.5">Tổng số giây</span>
                  <span className="text-xl font-black text-emerald-400 font-mono">
                    {durationResult.totalSeconds.toLocaleString()} s
                  </span>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Mode 2: Arithmetic (Add / Subtract) */}
      {activeTab === 'arithmetic' && (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6">
          <div className="lg:col-span-6 bg-slate-50 p-5 rounded-3xl border border-slate-200 space-y-4">
            <h3 className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 uppercase tracking-wider">
              Cộng hoặc trừ từ một mốc thời gian
            </h3>

            <div className="text-xs">
              <label className="text-slate-600 font-semibold block mb-1.5">Mốc thời gian ban đầu:</label>
              <input
                type="time"
                value={baseTime}
                onChange={(e) => setBaseTime(e.target.value)}
                className="w-full p-2.5 bg-white border border-slate-300 rounded-xl font-bold text-sm text-slate-900"
              />
            </div>

            <div className="flex gap-2 text-xs">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setOp('add')}
                className={`flex-1 py-2 rounded-xl font-bold flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 ${
                  op === 'add' ? 'bg-indigo-600 text-white' : 'bg-white border border-slate-200 text-slate-700'
                }`}
              >
                <Plus className="w-4 h-4" /> Cộng thêm (+)
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setOp('subtract')}
                className={`flex-1 py-2 rounded-xl font-bold flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 ${
                  op === 'subtract' ? 'bg-indigo-600 text-white' : 'bg-white border border-slate-200 text-slate-700'
                }`}
              >
                <Minus className="w-4 h-4" /> Trừ đi (-)
              </button>
            </div>

            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 text-xs">
              <div>
                <label className="text-slate-600 font-semibold block mb-1">Số giờ:</label>
                <input
                  type="number"
                  min={0}
                  max={100}
                  value={addHours}
                  onChange={(e) => setAddHours(Number(e.target.value))}
                  className="w-full p-2 bg-white border border-slate-300 rounded-xl font-bold text-slate-900"
                />
              </div>
              <div>
                <label className="text-slate-600 font-semibold block mb-1">Số phút:</label>
                <input
                  type="number"
                  min={0}
                  max={59}
                  value={addMinutes}
                  onChange={(e) => setAddMinutes(Number(e.target.value))}
                  className="w-full p-2 bg-white border border-slate-300 rounded-xl font-bold text-slate-900"
                />
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="lg:col-span-6 space-y-4">
            <div className="bg-gradient-to-br from-indigo-900 via-slate-900 to-purple-950 p-6 rounded-3xl text-white shadow-xl space-y-3">
              <span className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-indigo-300">
                Mốc thời gian kết quả
              </span>

              <div className="text-5xl sm:text-7xl font-black font-mono tracking-tight text-white py-2">
                {arithmeticResult.formatted}
              </div>

              <p className="text-xs text-indigo-200 border-t border-slate-800 pt-3">
                {baseTime} {op === 'add' ? 'cộng' : 'trừ'} {addHours} giờ {addMinutes} phút = {arithmeticResult.formatted}
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Mode 3: Timesheet */}
      {activeTab === 'timesheet' && (
        <div className="space-y-4">
          <div className="bg-slate-50 p-4 sm:p-5 rounded-3xl border border-slate-200 space-y-3 overflow-x-auto">
            <table className="w-full text-xs text-left min-w-[500px]">
              <thead>
                <tr className="border-b border-slate-200 text-slate-500 font-bold">
                  <th className="py-2">Thứ</th>
                  <th className="py-2">Vào ca</th>
                  <th className="py-2">Tan ca</th>
                  <th className="py-2">Nghỉ trưa (phút)</th>
                  <th className="py-2 text-right">Giờ công</th>
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-200/60">
                {shifts.map((shift, idx) => {
                  const [sh, sm] = shift.start.split(':').map(Number);
                  const [eh, em] = shift.end.split(':').map(Number);
                  let sM = sh * 60 + sm;
                  let eM = eh * 60 + em;
                  if (eM < sM) eM += 24 * 60;
                  const net = Math.max(0, eM - sM - shift.breakMin);
                  const netH = Number((net / 60).toFixed(2));
                  return (
                    <tr key={shift.day} className="hover:bg-slate-100/50">
                      <td className="py-2.5 font-bold text-slate-800">{shift.day}</td>
                      <td className="py-2">
                        <input
                          type="time"
                          value={shift.start}
                          onChange={(e) => {
                            const newShifts = [...shifts];
                            newShifts[idx].start = e.target.value;
                            setShifts(newShifts);
                          }}
                          className="p-1.5 bg-white border border-slate-300 rounded-lg font-mono font-semibold"
                        />
                      </td>
                      <td className="py-2">
                        <input
                          type="time"
                          value={shift.end}
                          onChange={(e) => {
                            const newShifts = [...shifts];
                            newShifts[idx].end = e.target.value;
                            setShifts(newShifts);
                          }}
                          className="p-1.5 bg-white border border-slate-300 rounded-lg font-mono font-semibold"
                        />
                      </td>
                      <td className="py-2">
                        <input
                          type="number"
                          step={5}
                          min={0}
                          max={120}
                          value={shift.breakMin}
                          onChange={(e) => {
                            const newShifts = [...shifts];
                            newShifts[idx].breakMin = Number(e.target.value);
                            setShifts(newShifts);
                          }}
                          className="w-16 p-1.5 bg-white border border-slate-300 rounded-lg font-mono font-semibold"
                        />
                      </td>
                      <td className="py-2 text-right font-bold text-indigo-600 font-mono text-sm">
                        {netH}h
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  );
                })}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>

          <div className="bg-gradient-to-br from-indigo-900 via-slate-900 to-blue-950 p-5 rounded-3xl text-white flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-4">
            <div>
              <span className="text-xs uppercase font-bold text-indigo-300 tracking-wider">Tổng giờ làm việc trong tuần</span>
              <div className="text-3xl sm:text-4xl font-black font-mono text-white mt-0.5">
                {timesheetResult.totalHours} giờ {timesheetResult.totalRemainingMinutes} phút
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="text-right sm:border-l sm:border-slate-800 sm:pl-6">
              <span className="text-xs text-slate-400 block">Quy đổi số thập phân</span>
              <span className="text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-black text-indigo-400 font-mono">
                {timesheetResult.totalDecimal} giờ
              </span>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};


================================================================================
FILE: /src/components/tools/TipCalculator.tsx

import React, { useState, useMemo, useEffect } from 'react';
import {
  Receipt,
  Users,
  Check,
  Copy
} from 'lucide-react';
import { useCurrency } from '../../context/CurrencyContext';
import { CurrencySelector } from '../common/CurrencySelector';

export const TipCalculator: React.FC = () => {
  const { currency, currencyInfo, formatMoney } = useCurrency();

  // Base bill amount in selected currency ($85 USD base)
  const [billAmount, setBillAmount] = useState<number>(() => {
    return currency === 'VND' ? 500000 : 85;
  });
  const [tipPercent, setTipPercent] = useState<number>(18);
  const [peopleCount, setPeopleCount] = useState<number>(3);
  const [roundUp, setRoundUp] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState<boolean>(false);

  // Sync default bill amount when switching currency
  useEffect(() => {
    setBillAmount((prev) => {
      if (currency === 'VND' && prev < 1000) return 500000;
      if (currency !== 'VND' && prev >= 10000) return 85;
      return prev;
    });
  }, [currency]);

  const calculations = useMemo(() => {
    const rawTip = (billAmount * tipPercent) / 100;
    let totalBill = billAmount + rawTip;

    if (roundUp) {
      totalBill = Math.ceil(totalBill);
    }

    const finalTip = Math.max(0, totalBill - billAmount);
    const tipPerPerson = peopleCount > 0 ? finalTip / peopleCount : 0;
    const totalPerPerson = peopleCount > 0 ? totalBill / peopleCount : 0;
    const billPerPerson = peopleCount > 0 ? billAmount / peopleCount : 0;

    return {
      finalTip,
      totalBill,
      tipPerPerson,
      totalPerPerson,
      billPerPerson
    };
  }, [billAmount, tipPercent, peopleCount, roundUp]);

  const handleCopy = () => {
    const text = `Chia hóa đơn & Tiền Tip:
- Hóa đơn gốc: ${formatMoney(billAmount)}
- Tiền tip (${tipPercent}%): ${formatMoney(calculations.finalTip)}
- Tổng hóa đơn: ${formatMoney(calculations.totalBill)}
- Chia ${peopleCount} người:
  + Mỗi người trả: ${formatMoney(calculations.totalPerPerson)}
  + (Tiền món: ${formatMoney(calculations.billPerPerson)} + Tip: ${formatMoney(calculations.tipPerPerson)})`;
    navigator.clipboard?.writeText(text);
    setCopied(true);
    setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 2000);
  };

  return (
    <div id="tip-calculator" className="p-4 sm:p-7 space-y-6">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-3 pb-5 border-b border-slate-200">
        <div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <span className="p-2 rounded-xl bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-600 border border-emerald-100">
              <Receipt className="w-5 h-5" />
            </span>
            <h2 className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-black text-slate-900 tracking-tight">
              Tip Calculator (Tính Tiền Tip &amp; Chia Bill)
            </h2>
          </div>
          <p className="text-xs sm:text-sm text-slate-500 mt-1">
            Tính toán tiền tip theo chuẩn quốc tế và chia đều hóa đơn cho nhóm bạn hoặc gia đình.
          </p>
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <CurrencySelector variant="compact" align="left" />
          <button
            onClick={handleCopy}
            className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3.5 py-2 text-xs font-semibold rounded-xl bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 text-slate-700 transition-colors active:scale-95 cursor-pointer"
          >
            {copied ? <Check className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-600" /> : <Copy className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-500" />}
            <span>{copied ? 'Đã sao chép' : 'Sao chép kết quả'}</span>
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6">
        {/* Left Form Inputs */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-6 space-y-4">
          {/* Bill Amount */}
          <div className="bg-slate-50 p-5 rounded-3xl border border-slate-200 space-y-3">
            <div className="flex justify-between items-center">
              <label className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 uppercase tracking-wider">
                Tổng hóa đơn ({currencyInfo.symbol} {currencyInfo.code})
              </label>
              <span className="text-xs font-bold text-emerald-600 font-mono">
                {formatMoney(billAmount)}
              </span>
            </div>

            <div className="relative">
              <span className="absolute left-3.5 top-3 text-slate-400 font-bold text-base">{currencyInfo.symbol}</span>
              <input
                type="number"
                min={0}
                step={currency === 'VND' ? 10000 : 1}
                value={billAmount}
                onChange={(e) => setBillAmount(Math.max(0, Number(e.target.value)))}
                className="w-full pl-9 pr-14 py-2.5 bg-white border border-slate-300 rounded-2xl text-lg font-black text-slate-900 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-emerald-500 outline-none"
              />
              <span className="absolute right-4 top-3 text-slate-400 font-bold text-xs">{currencyInfo.code}</span>
            </div>

            <div className="flex gap-1.5 overflow-x-auto pt-1">
              {(currency === 'VND' 
                ? [100000, 200000, 500000, 1000000, 2000000]
                : [25, 50, 85, 120, 200]
              ).map((v) => (
                <button
                  key={v}
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setBillAmount(v)}
                  className={`text-[11px] px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg border font-semibold transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                    billAmount === v
                      ? 'bg-blue-600 text-white border-blue-600'
                      : 'bg-white text-slate-600 border-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-100'
                  }`}
                >
                  {currency === 'VND' ? `${v / 1000}k` : `${currencyInfo.symbol}${v}`}
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Tip Percentage Selection */}
          <div className="bg-slate-50 p-5 rounded-3xl border border-slate-200 space-y-3">
            <div className="flex justify-between items-center">
              <label className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 uppercase tracking-wider">
                Chọn mức tiền Tip (%)
              </label>
              <span className="text-sm font-bold text-blue-600 font-mono">
                {tipPercent}%
              </span>
            </div>

            <div className="grid grid-cols-5 gap-1.5">
              {[10, 15, 18, 20, 25].map((pct) => (
                <button
                  key={pct}
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setTipPercent(pct)}
                  className={`py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                    tipPercent === pct
                      ? 'bg-blue-600 text-white shadow-xs scale-102 font-black'
                      : 'bg-white border border-slate-200 text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-100'
                  }`}
                >
                  {pct}%
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>

            <div className="flex items-center gap-3 pt-1">
              <span className="text-xs text-slate-500 whitespace-nowrap">Tùy chỉnh:</span>
              <input
                type="range"
                min={0}
                max={50}
                value={tipPercent}
                onChange={(e) => setTipPercent(Number(e.target.value))}
                className="flex-1 accent-emerald-600 cursor-pointer"
              />
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Number of People */}
          <div className="bg-slate-50 p-5 rounded-3xl border border-slate-200 space-y-3">
            <div className="flex justify-between items-center">
              <label className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 uppercase tracking-wider flex items-center gap-1.5">
                <Users className="w-4 h-4 text-indigo-600" /> Số người chia tiền
              </label>
              <span className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-900 font-mono">
                {peopleCount} người
              </span>
            </div>

            <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setPeopleCount(Math.max(1, peopleCount - 1))}
                className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-white border border-slate-300 font-bold text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-100 active:scale-95 cursor-pointer"
              >
                -
              </button>
              <input
                type="number"
                min={1}
                max={100}
                value={peopleCount}
                onChange={(e) => setPeopleCount(Math.max(1, Number(e.target.value)))}
                className="flex-1 p-2 text-center bg-white border border-slate-300 rounded-xl font-black text-slate-900 outline-none"
              />
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setPeopleCount(peopleCount + 1)}
                className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-white border border-slate-300 font-bold text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-100 active:scale-95 cursor-pointer"
              >
                +
              </button>
            </div>

            {/* Round up checkbox */}
            <div className="pt-2">
              <label className="flex items-center gap-2 cursor-pointer select-none text-xs text-slate-700 font-semibold">
                <input
                  type="checkbox"
                  checked={roundUp}
                  onChange={(e) => setRoundUp(e.target.checked)}
                  className="w-4 h-4 rounded text-emerald-600 accent-emerald-600 cursor-pointer"
                />
                <span>Làm tròn tổng hóa đơn lên số nguyên gần nhất</span>
              </label>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Right Output Receipt */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-6 space-y-4">
          {/* Main Per Person Hero */}
          <div className="hero-result-card bg-white dark:bg-gradient-to-br dark:from-emerald-900 dark:via-slate-900 dark:to-teal-950 p-6 rounded-3xl text-slate-900 dark:text-white border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 shadow-xl space-y-4">
            <span className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-300">
              Số tiền mỗi người cần trả ({peopleCount} người)
            </span>

            <div className="flex items-baseline gap-2">
              <span className="text-3xl sm:text-5xl font-black font-mono tracking-tight text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
                {formatMoney(calculations.totalPerPerson)}
              </span>
              <span className="text-sm font-semibold text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-200">/ người</span>
            </div>

            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 pt-3 border-t border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 text-xs">
              <div className="p-3 rounded-2xl bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800/70 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700/50">
                <span className="text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 block mb-0.5">Tiền món mỗi người</span>
                <span className="text-base font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white font-mono">
                  {formatMoney(calculations.billPerPerson)}
                </span>
              </div>
              <div className="p-3 rounded-2xl bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-slate-800/70 border border-emerald-200 dark:border-slate-700/50">
                <span className="text-emerald-800 dark:text-slate-400 block mb-0.5">Tiền tip mỗi người</span>
                <span className="text-base font-bold text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400 font-mono">
                  {formatMoney(calculations.tipPerPerson)}
                </span>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Grand Totals */}
          <div className="bg-slate-50 p-5 rounded-3xl border border-slate-200 space-y-3">
            <span className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 uppercase tracking-wider block">
              Tổng kết toàn bộ bàn ăn
            </span>

            <div className="space-y-2 text-xs">
              <div className="flex justify-between items-center p-2 rounded-xl bg-white border border-slate-200">
                <span className="text-slate-600">Hóa đơn ban đầu:</span>
                <span className="font-bold text-slate-800 font-mono">{formatMoney(billAmount)}</span>

                <span className="text-slate-600">Tổng tiền tip ({tipPercent}%):</span>
                <span className="font-bold text-emerald-600 font-mono">{formatMoney(calculations.finalTip)}</span>

FILE: /src/components/tools/TriangleCalculator.tsx

import React, { useState, useMemo } from 'react';
import { Triangle, RotateCcw } from 'lucide-react';
import { TriangleVisualizer } from './geometry/TriangleVisualizer';

export const TriangleCalculator: React.FC = () => {
  const [sideA, setSideA] = useState<number>(5);
  const [sideB, setSideB] = useState<number>(6);
  const [sideC, setSideC] = useState<number>(7);

  const calculations = useMemo(() => {
    const a = Math.max(0.001, sideA);
    const b = Math.max(0.001, sideB);
    const c = Math.max(0.001, sideC);

    // Triangle inequality theorem check
    const isValid = (a + b > c) && (a + c > b) && (b + c > a);

    if (!isValid) {
      return {
        isValid: false,
        message: 'Ba cạnh không thỏa mãn bất đẳng thức tam giác (tổng độ dài 2 cạnh bất kỳ phải lớn hơn cạnh còn lại).'
      };
    }

    // Law of Cosines: cos(A) = (b^2 + c^2 - a^2) / (2bc)
    const cosA = (b * b + c * c - a * a) / (2 * b * c);
    const cosB = (a * a + c * c - b * b) / (2 * a * c);
    const cosC = (a * a + b * b - c * c) / (2 * a * b);

    const angleARad = Math.acos(Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, cosA)));
    const angleBRad = Math.acos(Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, cosB)));
    const angleCRad = Math.acos(Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, cosC)));

    const angleADeg = (angleARad * 180) / Math.PI;
    const angleBDeg = (angleBRad * 180) / Math.PI;
    const angleCDeg = (angleCRad * 180) / Math.PI;

    // Perimeter & Semi-perimeter
    const perimeter = a + b + c;
    const s = perimeter / 2;

    // Heron's Formula for Area: sqrt(s * (s - a) * (s - b) * (s - c))
    const area = Math.sqrt(Math.max(0, s * (s - a) * (s - b) * (s - c)));

    // Altitudes
    const heightA = (2 * area) / a;
    const heightB = (2 * area) / b;
    const heightC = (2 * area) / c;

    // Type of triangle
    let type = 'Tam giác thường (Scalene)';
    if (Math.abs(a - b) < 1e-4 && Math.abs(b - c) < 1e-4) {
      type = 'Tam giác đều (Equilateral)';
    } else if (Math.abs(a - b) < 1e-4 || Math.abs(b - c) < 1e-4 || Math.abs(a - c) < 1e-4) {
      type = 'Tam giác cân (Isosceles)';
    }

    if (Math.abs(angleADeg - 90) < 0.05 || Math.abs(angleBDeg - 90) < 0.05 || Math.abs(angleCDeg - 90) < 0.05) {
      type += ' & Vuông (Right-angled)';
    } else if (angleADeg > 90 || angleBDeg > 90 || angleCDeg > 90) {
      type += ' & Tù (Obtuse)';
    } else {
      type += ' & Nhọn (Acute)';
    }

    return {
      isValid: true,
      angleA: angleADeg.toFixed(2),
      angleB: angleBDeg.toFixed(2),
      angleC: angleCDeg.toFixed(2),
      perimeter: perimeter.toFixed(2),
      semiPerimeter: s.toFixed(2),
      area: area.toFixed(2),
      heightA: heightA.toFixed(2),
      heightB: heightB.toFixed(2),
      heightC: heightC.toFixed(2),
      type
    };
  }, [sideA, sideB, sideC]);

  return (
    <div className="w-full max-w-5xl mx-auto space-y-6">
      <div className="p-4 sm:p-6 rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-r from-blue-900/40 via-slate-800 to-slate-900 border border-blue-500/30 flex items-center justify-between">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <div className="p-3 bg-blue-600/20 text-blue-400 rounded-xl border border-blue-500/30">
            <Triangle className="w-6 h-6" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <h1 className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-bold text-white tracking-tight">Triangle Calculator – Tính Toán Hình Tam Giác</h1>
            <p className="text-xs sm:text-sm text-slate-400">Giải tam giác theo 3 cạnh (SSS): tính diện tích Heron, 3 góc, chu vi và đường cao</p>
          </div>
        </div>
        <button
          id="triangle-reset-btn"
          onClick={() => { setSideA(5); setSideB(6); setSideC(7); }}
          className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs text-slate-300 hover:text-white bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 border border-slate-700 rounded-lg transition-colors cursor-pointer"
        >
          <RotateCcw className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
          <span>Đặt lại</span>
        </button>
      </div>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6">
        <div className="lg:col-span-5 space-y-4 bg-slate-900/80 p-5 rounded-2xl border border-slate-800">
          <h2 className="text-base font-semibold text-white">Độ dài 3 cạnh tam giác</h2>

          <div>
            <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-300 mb-1">Cạnh a</label>
            <input
              id="triangle-side-a"
              type="number"
              value={sideA}
              onChange={(e) => setSideA(Number(e.target.value))}
              className="w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-white font-sans focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 outline-none"
            />
          </div>

          <div>
            <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-300 mb-1">Cạnh b</label>
            <input
              id="triangle-side-b"
              type="number"
              value={sideB}
              onChange={(e) => setSideB(Number(e.target.value))}
              className="w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-white font-sans focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 outline-none"
            />
          </div>

          <div>
            <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-300 mb-1">Cạnh c</label>
            <input
              id="triangle-side-c"
              type="number"
              value={sideC}
              onChange={(e) => setSideC(Number(e.target.value))}
              className="w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-white font-sans focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 outline-none"
            />
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="lg:col-span-7 space-y-4">
          {!calculations.isValid ? (
            <div className="p-6 rounded-2xl bg-rose-950/40 border border-rose-500/40 text-rose-200">
              {calculations.message}
            </div>
          ) : (
            <>
              <div className="p-6 rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-b from-blue-950/40 to-slate-900 border border-blue-500/40 text-center space-y-2">
                <span className="text-xs uppercase tracking-wider text-blue-300 font-semibold">Diện tích tam giác (Công thức Heron)</span>
                <div className="text-4xl sm:text-5xl font-extrabold text-blue-400 font-sans tabular-nums">
                  {calculations.area}
                </div>
                <p className="text-xs text-slate-400">
                  Phân loại hình học: <span className="text-white font-semibold">{calculations.type}</span>
                </p>
              </div>

              <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-3">
                <div className="p-3 bg-slate-900/80 rounded-xl border border-slate-800 text-center">
                  <span className="text-xs text-slate-400 block">Góc A</span>
                  <span className="text-base font-bold text-white font-sans">{calculations.angleA}°</span>
                </div>
                <div className="p-3 bg-slate-900/80 rounded-xl border border-slate-800 text-center">
                  <span className="text-xs text-slate-400 block">Góc B</span>
                  <span className="text-base font-bold text-white font-sans">{calculations.angleB}°</span>
                </div>
                <div className="p-3 bg-slate-900/80 rounded-xl border border-slate-800 text-center">
                  <span className="text-xs text-slate-400 block">Góc C</span>
                  <span className="text-base font-bold text-white font-sans">{calculations.angleC}°</span>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                <div className="p-3.5 bg-slate-900/80 rounded-xl border border-slate-800">
                  <span className="text-xs text-slate-400 block">Chu vi tam giác</span>
                  <span className="text-lg font-bold text-white font-sans">{calculations.perimeter}</span>
                </div>
                <div className="p-3.5 bg-slate-900/80 rounded-xl border border-slate-800">
                  <span className="text-xs text-slate-400 block">Nửa chu vi (p)</span>
                  <span className="text-lg font-bold text-white font-sans">{calculations.semiPerimeter}</span>
                </div>
              </div>

              <TriangleVisualizer
                sideA={sideA}
                sideB={sideB}
                sideC={sideC}
                isValid={calculations.isValid}
                angleA={calculations.angleA}
                angleB={calculations.angleB}
                angleC={calculations.angleC}
                area={calculations.area}
                type={calculations.type}
              />
            </>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};
