export const CURRENCIES_BY_CODE: Record<CurrencyCode, CurrencyItem> = SUPPORTED_CURRENCIES.reduce(
  (acc, item) => {
    acc[item.code] = item;
    return acc;
  },
  {} as Record<CurrencyCode, CurrencyItem>
);

interface CurrencyContextType {
  currency: CurrencyCode;
  setCurrency: (code: CurrencyCode) => void;
  currencyInfo: CurrencyItem;
  currencies: CurrencyItem[];
  formatMoney: (amount: number, customDecimals?: number) => string;
  convertFromUSD: (usdAmount: number) => number;
  convertToUSD: (amountInCurrent: number) => number;
}

const CurrencyContext = createContext<CurrencyContextType | undefined>(undefined);

export const CurrencyProvider: React.FC<{ children: React.ReactNode }> = ({ children }) => {
  // GỐC LÀ USD ($) - International Base
  const [currency, setCurrencyState] = useState<CurrencyCode>(() => {
    if (typeof window === 'undefined') return 'USD';
    try {
      const urlParam = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get('currency')?.toUpperCase() as CurrencyCode;
      if (urlParam && CURRENCIES_BY_CODE[urlParam]) {
        return urlParam;
      }
      const saved = localStorage.getItem('ac_calc_base_currency') as CurrencyCode;
      if (saved && CURRENCIES_BY_CODE[saved]) {
        return saved;
      }
    } catch {
      // ignore
    }
    return 'USD';
  });

  const setCurrency = (code: CurrencyCode) => {
    if (CURRENCIES_BY_CODE[code]) {
      setCurrencyState(code);
      try {
        localStorage.setItem('ac_calc_base_currency', code);
      } catch {
        // ignore
      }
    }
  };

  const currencyInfo = useMemo(() => {
    return CURRENCIES_BY_CODE[currency] || CURRENCIES_BY_CODE.USD;
  }, [currency]);

  // Convert functions
  const convertFromUSD = (usdAmount: number): number => {
    return usdAmount * currencyInfo.rateToUSD;
  };

  const convertToUSD = (amountInCurrent: number): number => {
    return currencyInfo.rateToUSD > 0 ? amountInCurrent / currencyInfo.rateToUSD : amountInCurrent;
  };

  // High precision & beautiful money formatting based on selected currency
  const formatMoney = (amount: number, customDecimals?: number): string => {
    if (isNaN(amount) || amount === null || amount === undefined) {
      return currencyInfo.symbolPosition === 'suffix' ? `0 ${currencyInfo.symbol}` : `${currencyInfo.symbol}0`;
    }

    const decimals = customDecimals !== undefined ? customDecimals : currencyInfo.decimals;

    // Use Intl.NumberFormat for the current currency
    const isNegative = amount < 0;
    const absVal = Math.abs(amount);

    let formattedNum: string;
    if (currencyInfo.code === 'VND') {
      formattedNum = new Intl.NumberFormat('vi-VN', {
        maximumFractionDigits: decimals,
        minimumFractionDigits: decimals,
      }).format(Math.round(absVal));
      return isNegative ? `-${formattedNum} ₫` : `${formattedNum} ₫`;
    } else if (currencyInfo.code === 'EUR') {
      formattedNum = new Intl.NumberFormat('de-DE', {
        maximumFractionDigits: decimals,
        minimumFractionDigits: decimals,
      }).format(absVal);
      return isNegative ? `-€${formattedNum}` : `€${formattedNum}`;
    } else {
      formattedNum = new Intl.NumberFormat('en-US', {
        maximumFractionDigits: decimals,
        minimumFractionDigits: decimals,
      }).format(absVal);

      if (currencyInfo.symbolPosition === 'suffix') {
        return isNegative ? `-${formattedNum} ${currencyInfo.symbol}` : `${formattedNum} ${currencyInfo.symbol}`;
      } else {
        return isNegative ? `-${currencyInfo.symbol}${formattedNum}` : `${currencyInfo.symbol}${formattedNum}`;
      }
    }
  };

  return (
    <CurrencyContext.Provider
      value={{
        currency,
        setCurrency,
        currencyInfo,
        currencies: SUPPORTED_CURRENCIES,
        formatMoney,
        convertFromUSD,
        convertToUSD,
      }}
    >
      {children}
    </CurrencyContext.Provider>
  );
};

export const useCurrency = (): CurrencyContextType => {
  const ctx = useContext(CurrencyContext);
  if (!ctx) {
    throw new Error('useCurrency must be used within a CurrencyProvider');
  }
  return ctx;
};

FILE: /src/context/LanguageContext.tsx

import React, { createContext, useContext, useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { MAJOR_LANGUAGES, LanguageCode, LanguageItem } from '../i18n/languages';
import { TRANSLATIONS, TranslationDictionary } from '../i18n/translations';

interface LanguageContextType {
  language: LanguageCode;
  setLanguage: (lang: LanguageCode) => void;
  t: TranslationDictionary;
  languages: LanguageItem[];
  currentLanguageItem: LanguageItem;
  isRTL: boolean;
}

const LanguageContext = createContext<LanguageContextType | undefined>(undefined);

export const LanguageProvider: React.FC<{ children: React.ReactNode }> = ({ children }) => {
  const [language, setLanguageState] = useState<LanguageCode>(() => {
    if (typeof window === 'undefined') return 'vi';

    // 1. Check path prefix (e.g. /en/bmi, /vi/loan, /ja/basic, /en)
    const pathParts = window.location.pathname.replace(/^\/+|\/+$/g, '').split('/');
    const firstSegment = pathParts[0]?.toLowerCase() as LanguageCode;
    if (firstSegment && TRANSLATIONS[firstSegment]) {
      return firstSegment;
    }

    // 2. Check URL param ?lang=xx
    const urlParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
    const paramLang = urlParams.get('lang') as LanguageCode;
    if (paramLang && TRANSLATIONS[paramLang]) {
      return paramLang;
    }

    // 3. Check localStorage
    const saved = localStorage.getItem('ac_studio_calc_lang') as LanguageCode;
    if (saved && TRANSLATIONS[saved]) {
      return saved;
    }

    // 4. Check browser navigator language
    const browserLang = navigator.language?.slice(0, 2).toLowerCase() as LanguageCode;
    if (browserLang && TRANSLATIONS[browserLang]) {
      return browserLang;
    }

    return 'vi';
  });

  const setLanguage = (lang: LanguageCode) => {
    if (TRANSLATIONS[lang]) {
      setLanguageState(lang);
      localStorage.setItem('ac_studio_calc_lang', lang);

      // Cleanly update URL path with new language prefix: e.g. /en/bmi -> /vi/bmi
      if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
        const pathParts = window.location.pathname.replace(/^\/+|\/+$/g, '').split('/').filter(Boolean);
        let toolPart = 'basic';

        if (pathParts.length >= 2) {
          toolPart = pathParts[1];
        } else if (pathParts.length === 1) {
          // Could be /en or /bmi
          if (TRANSLATIONS[pathParts[0] as LanguageCode]) {
            toolPart = 'basic';
          } else {
            toolPart = pathParts[0];
          }
        }

        const newPath = toolPart === 'basic' ? `/${lang}/` : `/${lang}/${toolPart}`;
        const search = window.location.search || '';
        window.history.pushState({ lang, toolId: toolPart }, '', `${newPath}${search}`);
        window.dispatchEvent(new Event('popstate'));
      }
    }
  };

  const currentLanguageItem = MAJOR_LANGUAGES.find(l => l.code === language) || MAJOR_LANGUAGES[0];
  const isRTL = currentLanguageItem.dir === 'rtl';

  useEffect(() => {
    // Update HTML tag attributes for SEO & Accessibility
    document.documentElement.lang = language;
    document.documentElement.dir = isRTL ? 'rtl' : 'ltr';
  }, [language, isRTL]);

  const value: LanguageContextType = {
    language,
    setLanguage,
    t: TRANSLATIONS[language] || TRANSLATIONS.vi,
    languages: MAJOR_LANGUAGES,
    currentLanguageItem,
    isRTL
  };

  return (
    <LanguageContext.Provider value={value}>
      {children}
    </LanguageContext.Provider>
  );
};

export const useLanguage = (): LanguageContextType => {
  const context = useContext(LanguageContext);
  if (!context) {
    throw new Error('useLanguage must be used within a LanguageProvider');
  }
  return context;
};

import React, { createContext, useContext, useState, useLayoutEffect, useEffect } from 'react';

export type ThemeId = 'light' | 'dark';

export interface ThemeConfig {
  id: ThemeId;
  name: string;
  tag: string;
  tagClass: string;
  description: string;
  dotColor: string;
  bg: string;
  headerBg: string;
  surface: string;
  subsurface: string;
  border: string;
  inputBg: string;
  inputBorder: string;
  accent: string;
  checkColor: string;
  textPrimary: string;
  textSecondary: string;
  textMuted: string;
}

export const THEMES: ThemeConfig[] = [
  {
    id: 'light',
    name: 'Chế độ Sáng',
    tag: 'Sáng',
    tagClass: 'bg-blue-50 text-blue-700 border-blue-200',

  {

    name: 'Chế độ Tối',
    tag: 'Tối',
    tagClass: 'bg-slate-800 text-cyan-300 border-cyan-800/60',
    description: 'Nền tối chống mỏi mắt (#141526), ô nhập xám chữ trắng',
    dotColor: '#00E5FF',
    bg: '#141526',

    surface: '#1B1D33',
    subsurface: 'rgba(27, 29, 51, 0.75)',
    border: '#272A47',
    inputBg: '#252525',
    inputBorder: '#3F3F3F',
    accent: '#00E5FF',
    checkColor: '#00E5FF',
    textPrimary: '#FFFFFF',
    textSecondary: '#CBD5E1',
    textMuted: '#94A3B8',
  }
];

const THEME_STORAGE_KEY = 'ac_studio_theme_mode';

/**
 * Áp dụng theme vào DOM một cách đồng bộ và triệt tiêu toàn bộ giật lag:
 * 1. Chèn tạm thời khối CSS chặn transition trên toàn bộ DOM (* { transition: none !important }).
 * 2. Cập nhật đồng bộ các biến CSS --app-*, attribute data-theme, class .dark và màu body.
 * 3. Ép reflow 1 lần duy nhất (window.getComputedStyle) để mọi phần tử nhận màu mới trong cùng 1 frame.
 * 4. Khôi phục lại transition ở frame kế tiếp qua requestAnimationFrame.
 */
export const applyThemeToDOM = (id: ThemeId, config: ThemeConfig, freezeTransitions: boolean = true) => {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined' || typeof document === 'undefined') return;

  const root = document.documentElement;
  let freezerEl: HTMLStyleElement | null = null;

  if (freezeTransitions) {
    // Kiểm tra xem freezer đã tồn tại chưa để tránh trùng lặp
    freezerEl = document.getElementById('ac-theme-transition-freezer') as HTMLStyleElement | null;
    if (!freezerEl) {
      freezerEl = document.createElement('style');
      freezerEl.id = 'ac-theme-transition-freezer';
      freezerEl.textContent = `
        *, *::before, *::after {
          -webkit-transition: none !important;
          -moz-transition: none !important;
          -o-transition: none !important;
          -ms-transition: none !important;
          transition: none !important;
        }
      `;
      document.head.appendChild(freezerEl);
    }
  }

  // Cập nhật tất cả biến CSS đồng bộ trên root
  root.style.setProperty('--app-bg', config.bg);
  root.style.setProperty('--app-header-bg', config.headerBg);
  root.style.setProperty('--app-surface', config.surface);
  root.style.setProperty('--app-subsurface', config.subsurface);
  root.style.setProperty('--app-border', config.border);
  root.style.setProperty('--app-input-bg', config.inputBg);
  root.style.setProperty('--app-input-border', config.inputBorder);
  root.style.setProperty('--app-accent', config.accent);
  root.style.setProperty('--app-text-primary', config.textPrimary);
  root.style.setProperty('--app-text-secondary', config.textSecondary);
  root.style.setProperty('--app-text-muted', config.textMuted);

  // Cập nhật data-theme và class .dark
  root.setAttribute('data-theme', id);
  if (id === 'dark') {
    root.classList.add('dark');
  } else {
    root.classList.remove('dark');
  }

  // Đồng bộ màu body
  if (document.body) {
    document.body.style.backgroundColor = config.bg;
    document.body.style.color = config.textPrimary;
  }

  // Cập nhật meta theme-color cho thanh địa chỉ mobile
  const metaThemeColor = document.querySelector('meta[name="theme-color"]');
  if (metaThemeColor) {
    metaThemeColor.setAttribute('content', id === 'light' ? '#FFFFFF' : '#0F1628');
  }

  try {
    localStorage.setItem(THEME_STORAGE_KEY, id);
  } catch {
    // Ignore storage errors
  }

  if (freezeTransitions && freezerEl) {
    // Ép reflow 1 lần duy nhất trong frame này để toàn bộ các phần tử nhận màu đồng loạt
    try {
      void window.getComputedStyle(document.body).opacity;
    } catch {
      // Ignore
    }

    // Gỡ bỏ style chặn transition ở frame tiếp theo để không ảnh hưởng hover/focus thông thường
    requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        const el = document.getElementById('ac-theme-transition-freezer');
        if (el && el.parentNode) {
          el.parentNode.removeChild(el);
        }
      });
    });
  }
};

interface ThemeContextType {
  themeId: ThemeId;
  currentTheme: ThemeConfig;
  setTheme: (id: ThemeId) => void;
  toggleTheme: () => void;
  themes: ThemeConfig[];
  isDark: boolean;
}

const ThemeContext = createContext<ThemeContextType | undefined>(undefined);

export const ThemeProvider: React.FC<{ children: React.ReactNode }> = ({ children }) => {
  const [themeId, setThemeId] = useState<ThemeId>(() => {
    if (typeof window === 'undefined') return 'light';
    try {
      const saved = localStorage.getItem(THEME_STORAGE_KEY) as ThemeId;
      if (saved === 'light' || saved === 'dark') {
        return saved;
      }
    } catch {
      // Ignore storage errors
    }
    return 'light'; // Mặc định chế độ sáng (nền trắng chữ đen)
  });

  const currentTheme = THEMES.find(t => t.id === themeId) || THEMES[0];

  // Sử dụng useLayoutEffect để đồng bộ DOM trước paint lần đầu, loại bỏ flash giao diện
  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    applyThemeToDOM(themeId, currentTheme, false);
  }, []);

  // Đảm bảo đồng bộ khi themeId thay đổi
  useEffect(() => {
    applyThemeToDOM(themeId, currentTheme, false);
  }, [themeId, currentTheme]);

  const setTheme = (id: ThemeId) => {
    const config = THEMES.find(t => t.id === id) || THEMES[0];
    // Áp dụng DOM đồng bộ ngay khi người dùng bấm, đóng băng transition để không bị giật lag
    applyThemeToDOM(id, config, true);
    setThemeId(id);
  };

  const toggleTheme = () => {
    const nextId: ThemeId = themeId === 'light' ? 'dark' : 'light';
    const config = THEMES.find(t => t.id === nextId) || THEMES[0];
    // Áp dụng DOM đồng bộ ngay khi người dùng bấm, đóng băng transition để không bị giật lag
    applyThemeToDOM(nextId, config, true);
    setThemeId(nextId);
  };

  return (
    <ThemeContext.Provider value={{
      themeId,
      currentTheme,
      setTheme,
      toggleTheme,
      themes: THEMES,
      isDark: themeId === 'dark',
    }}>
      {children}
    </ThemeContext.Provider>
  );
};

export const useTheme = (): ThemeContextType => {
  const context = useContext(ThemeContext);
  if (!context) {
    throw new Error('useTheme must be used within a ThemeProvider');
  }
  return context;
};

export function getToolSEO(toolId: ToolId, lang: LanguageCode): LocalizedToolSEO {
  // 1. Direct match in target language matrix (high-intent handcrafted)
  const langMatrix = INTERNATIONAL_SEO_MATRIX[lang];
  if (langMatrix && langMatrix[toolId]) {
    return langMatrix[toolId]!;
  }

  // 2. Exact match in English matrix if user requested English
  if (lang === 'en' && INTERNATIONAL_SEO_MATRIX.en && INTERNATIONAL_SEO_MATRIX.en[toolId]) {
    return INTERNATIONAL_SEO_MATRIX.en[toolId]!;
  }

  // 3. Smart Localized Generation using real native tool names and language SEO templates
  const toolKey = String(toolId);
  const localizedName = NATIVE_TOOL_NAMES[lang]?.[toolKey] || NATIVE_TOOL_NAMES.en?.[toolKey] || toolKey;
  const template = NATIVE_SEO_TEMPLATES[lang] || NATIVE_SEO_TEMPLATES.en;

  return {
    title: template.formatTitle(localizedName),
    description: template.formatDescription(localizedName),
    keywords: template.generateKeywords(localizedName, toolKey),
    lsiTerms: [localizedName, `${toolKey} calculator`, 'online tool']
  };
}

// Fallback generator for any tool in a specific language
export function getKeywordDirectory(lang: LanguageCode): KeywordLinkItem[] {
  return MULTILINGUAL_KEYWORD_DIRECTORY[lang] || MULTILINGUAL_KEYWORD_DIRECTORY.en;
}

/**
 * Returns localized tool content (name, tagline, description, steps, faqs, formulas)
 * For Vietnamese, it retrieves rich native content.
 * For English and all international languages, it returns clean, fully translated English content.
 */
export function getLocalizedToolContent(toolId: ToolId, lang: LanguageCode): LocalizedToolContent {
  const defaultTool = TOOLS_CONFIG[toolId] || TOOLS_CONFIG.basic;

  if (lang === 'vi') {
    return {
      name: defaultTool.name,
      tagline: defaultTool.tagline || 'Máy tính online đa năng chuẩn xác 100%',
      description: defaultTool.description || 'Công cụ tính toán trực tuyến chuẩn xác, bảo mật và miễn phí.',
      formulaDescription: defaultTool.formulaDescription || '',
      formulaEquation: defaultTool.formulaEquation || '',
      usageSteps: defaultTool.usageSteps || [],
      faqs: defaultTool.faqs || []
    };
  }

  const enContent = ENGLISH_TOOL_CONTENT[toolId];
  if (enContent) {
    return enContent;
  }

  // Fallback to basic english content
  return ENGLISH_TOOL_CONTENT.basic;
}

// International Salary & Tax Configurations for Multi-Country Support
// Compliant with major international payroll systems (US, UK, Germany/EU, Japan, Singapore, Australia, Canada, Vietnam & Custom)

export type PayPeriod = 'annual' | 'monthly' | 'biweekly' | 'weekly' | 'hourly';

export interface TaxBracket {
  bracket: number;
  min: number;
  max: number; // Infinity for top bracket
  rate: number; // % e.g. 10 for 10%
}

export interface InsuranceItem {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  nameVi?: string;
  rate: number; // % e.g. 6.2 for 6.2%
  capAnnual?: number; // annual cap ceiling if any
  capMonthly?: number; // monthly cap ceiling if any
  minAnnual?: number; // threshold under which 0%
  minMonthly?: number; // monthly threshold under which 0%
  aboveCapRate?: number; // rate for amount above ceiling (e.g. UK NI 2% above UEL)
  description?: string;
}

export interface CountrySubRegion {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  nameVi: string;
  description?: string;
  descriptionVi?: string;
  rate?: number; // Optional flat or average rate
  minMonthly?: number; // For VN minimum wage
}

export interface CountrySalaryProfile {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  nameVi: string;
  flag: string;
  currencyCode: string;
  currencySymbol: string;
  decimals: number;
  defaultPeriod: PayPeriod;
  defaultSalary: number;
  personalAllowanceAnnual: number;
  dependentAllowanceAnnual: number;
  personalAllowanceLabel: string;
  dependentAllowanceLabel: string;
  subRegionLabel?: string;
  subRegionLabelVi?: string;
  subRegions?: CountrySubRegion[];
  defaultSubRegionId?: string;
  employeeInsurances: InsuranceItem[];
  employerContributions: InsuranceItem[];
  taxBracketsAnnual: TaxBracket[];
  presets: number[];
  notes: string;
  notesVi: string;
  // Legacy regions compatibility
  regions?: {
    id: number;
    name: string;
    minMonthly: number;
  }[];
}

const DEFAULT_COLOR_THEME: ToolColorTheme = {
  iconColor: 'text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400',
  badgeClass: 'bg-blue-50 text-blue-600 border border-blue-200/80 dark:bg-blue-950/50 dark:text-blue-400 dark:border-blue-800/50 shadow-xs',
  activeClass: 'bg-white/20 text-white',
  hoverClass: 'group-hover:border-blue-400'
};

export const getToolColorTheme = (id: ToolId): ToolColorTheme => {
  return TOOL_COLOR_MAP[id] || DEFAULT_COLOR_THEME;
};

declare module 'mammoth' {
  interface ExtractResult {
    value: string;
    messages: any[];
  }
  interface Options {
    arrayBuffer?: ArrayBuffer;
    buffer?: Buffer;
    path?: string;
  }
  export function extractRawText(input: Options): Promise<ExtractResult>;
  export function convertToHtml(input: Options): Promise<ExtractResult>;
  const mammoth: {
    extractRawText(input: Options): Promise<ExtractResult>;
    convertToHtml(input: Options): Promise<ExtractResult>;
  };
  export default mammoth;
}

for (const [lang, names] of Object.entries(NATIVE_TOOL_NAMES)) {

      ...(TRANSLATIONS[langKey].toolNames || {})
    };

import { LanguageCode } from '../i18n/languages';
import { ToolId } from '../types';
import { getToolSEO } from '../data/internationalSEO';
import { TOOLS_CONFIG } from '../data/toolsData';
import { getLocalizedToolContent } from '../data/localizedToolContent';
import { INTERNATIONAL_SECTION_UI } from '../data/internationalSections';

export const SUPPORTED_LANGS: LanguageCode[] = [
  'en', 'vi', 'ja', 'ko', 'zh', 'es', 'fr', 'de', 'pt', 'ru',
  'id', 'th', 'hi', 'ar', 'it', 'nl', 'tr', 'pl', 'ms', 'sv'
];

export const SEO_MARKETS: { code: LanguageCode; hreflang: string; name: string }[] = [
  { code: 'en', hreflang: 'en', name: 'English' },
  { code: 'vi', hreflang: 'vi', name: 'Tiếng Việt' },
  { code: 'ja', hreflang: 'ja', name: '日本語' },
  { code: 'ko', hreflang: 'ko', name: '한국어' },

  { code: 'sv', hreflang: 'sv', name: 'Svenska' }
];

export const VALID_TOOLS: ToolId[] = Object.keys(TOOLS_CONFIG) as ToolId[];

export function getApplicationCategory(toolId: ToolId): string {
  switch (toolId) {
    case 'bmi':
    case 'calorie':
    case 'bodyfat':
    case 'ovulation':
    case 'pace':
    case 'bmr':
    case 'idealweight':
    case 'pregnancy':
    case 'armybodyfat':
    case 'healthyweight':
      return 'HealthApplication';
    case 'salary':
    case 'loan':
    case 'compound':
    case 'mortgage':
    case 'tax':
    case 'tip':
    case 'discount':
    case 'percentage':
    case 'autoloan':
    case 'interest':
    case 'payment':
    case 'retirement':
    case 'amortization':
    case 'investment':
    case 'inflation':
    case 'finance':
    case 'currency':
      return 'FinanceApplication';
    case 'trigonometry':
    case 'gpa':
    case 'concrete':
    case 'fraction':
    case 'triangle':
    case 'standarddeviation':
    case 'average':
    case 'meanmedianmode':
    case 'root':
    case 'exponent':
    case 'log':
    case 'quadratic':
    case 'slope':
    case 'area':
    case 'volume':
    case 'perimeter':
    case 'circle':
    case 'righttriangle':
    case 'statistics':
    case 'probability':
      return 'EducationalApplication';
    case 'basic':
    case 'unit':
    case 'age':
    case 'time':
    case 'date':
    case 'random':
    case 'password':
    case 'length':
    case 'weight':
    case 'temperature':
    case 'ipsubnet':
    case 'ai':
    default:
      return 'UtilitiesApplication';
  }
}

export function renderServerHtml(
  templateHtml: string,
  lang: LanguageCode,
  toolId?: ToolId,
  domain: string = 'https://web-calculator.com'
): string {
  const activeLang: LanguageCode = SUPPORTED_LANGS.includes(lang) ? lang : 'en';
  const activeToolId: ToolId = toolId && VALID_TOOLS.includes(toolId) ? toolId : 'basic';
  const isToolPage = Boolean(toolId && VALID_TOOLS.includes(toolId) && toolId !== 'basic');
  const isRtl = activeLang === 'ar';

  const localizedContent = getLocalizedToolContent(activeToolId, activeLang);
  const toolSEO = getToolSEO(activeToolId, activeLang);
  const sectionUi = INTERNATIONAL_SECTION_UI[activeLang] || INTERNATIONAL_SECTION_UI.en;

  const pageTitle = isToolPage 
    ? (toolSEO.title.includes('Web Calculator') ? toolSEO.title : `${toolSEO.title} | Web Calculator`)
    : (toolSEO.title.includes('Web Calculator') ? toolSEO.title : `${toolSEO.title || 'Web Calculator – Free Online Smart Calculation Tools'} | AC Studio`);
    
  const pageDescription = toolSEO.description || localizedContent.description;

  const cleanDomain = domain.replace(/\/+$/, '');

  const canonicalUrl = (activeToolId === 'basic')
    ? `${cleanDomain}/${activeLang}/`
    : `${cleanDomain}/${activeLang}/${activeToolId}`;

  // 1. Build Hreflang Tags with Canonicalization for 'basic'
  const hreflangToolSuffix = (activeToolId === 'basic') ? '' : activeToolId;
  const hreflangTags = [
    `<link rel="alternate" hreflang="x-default" href="${cleanDomain}/en/${hreflangToolSuffix}" />`,
    ...SEO_MARKETS.map(m => 
      `<link rel="alternate" hreflang="${m.hreflang}" href="${cleanDomain}/${m.code}/${hreflangToolSuffix}" />`
    )
  ].join('\n    ');

  // 2. Build Structured Data JSON-LD
  const schemaGraph: any[] = [
    {
      "@type": "Organization",
      "@id": `${cleanDomain}/#organization`,
      "name": "AC Studio",
      "url": `${cleanDomain}/`,
      "logo": `${cleanDomain}/og-image.png`
    },
    {
      "@type": "WebApplication",
      "@id": `${canonicalUrl}#webapp`,
      "url": canonicalUrl,
      "name": toolSEO.title,
      "alternateName": localizedContent.name,
      "applicationCategory": getApplicationCategory(activeToolId),
      "operatingSystem": "All modern browsers (Chrome, Safari, Firefox, Edge, Android, iOS)",
      "browserRequirements": "Requires JavaScript. Requires HTML5.",
      "inLanguage": activeLang,
      "description": toolSEO.description,
      "featureList": localizedContent.usageSteps,
      "offers": {
        "@type": "Offer",
        "price": "0",
        "priceCurrency": "USD"
      }
    },
    {
      "@type": "BreadcrumbList",
      "@id": `${canonicalUrl}#breadcrumb`,
      "itemListElement": [
        {
          "@type": "ListItem",
          "position": 1,
          "name": sectionUi.homeBreadcrumb || "Web Calculator",
          "item": `${cleanDomain}/${activeLang}/`
        },
        ...(isToolPage ? [{
          "@type": "ListItem",
          "position": 2,
          "name": localizedContent.name,
          "item": canonicalUrl
        }] : [])
      ]
    },
    {
      "@type": "FAQPage",
      "@id": `${canonicalUrl}#faq`,
      "mainEntity": localizedContent.faqs.map(faq => ({
        "@type": "Question",
        "name": faq.question,
        "acceptedAnswer": {
          "@type": "Answer",
          "text": faq.answer
        }
      }))
    },
    {
      "@type": "HowTo",
      "@id": `${canonicalUrl}#howto`,
      "name": `${sectionUi.guideTitle(localizedContent.name)}`,
      "description": toolSEO.description,
      "step": localizedContent.usageSteps.map((step, idx) => ({
        "@type": "HowToStep",
        "position": idx + 1,
        "name": `${localizedContent.name} - Step ${idx + 1}`,
        "text": step
      }))
    }
  ];

  // 3. Build Semantic Rich SSR Content inside #root for crawlers before hydration
  const semanticRootContent = `
    <div style="padding: 24px 16px; max-width: 960px; margin: 0 auto; color: #f8fafc; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; line-height: 1.6;">
      <header style="margin-bottom: 24px; border-bottom: 1px solid #334155; padding-bottom: 16px;">
        <nav aria-label="Breadcrumb" style="font-size: 13px; color: #94a3b8; margin-bottom: 8px;">
          <a href="/${activeLang}/" style="color: #38bdf8; text-decoration: none;">${sectionUi.homeBreadcrumb || 'Home'}</a> &rsaquo; 
          <span style="color: #cbd5e1;">${localizedContent.name}</span>
        </nav>
        <h1 style="font-size: 28px; font-weight: 800; color: #60a5fa; margin: 0 0 10px 0; letter-spacing: -0.5px;">${toolSEO.title}</h1>
        <p style="color: #cbd5e1; font-size: 15px; margin: 0;">${toolSEO.description}</p>
      </header>

      <main style="display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 24px;">
        <!-- Formula and Calculation Methodology -->
        <section style="background: #1e293b; padding: 20px; border-radius: 12px; border: 1px solid #334155;">
          <h2 style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 700; color: #38bdf8; margin: 0 0 10px 0;">${sectionUi.formulaTitle}</h2>
          <div style="background: #0f172a; padding: 12px 16px; border-radius: 8px; font-family: monospace; color: #fbbf24; font-size: 15px; margin-bottom: 10px; border-left: 4px solid #38bdf8;">
            ${localizedContent.formulaEquation}
          </div>
          <p style="color: #94a3b8; font-size: 14px; margin: 0;">${localizedContent.formulaDescription}</p>
        </section>

        <!-- Step-by-Step Instructions -->
        <section style="background: #1e293b; padding: 20px; border-radius: 12px; border: 1px solid #334155;">
          <h2 style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 700; color: #38bdf8; margin: 0 0 12px 0;">${sectionUi.guideTitle(localizedContent.name)}</h2>
          <ol style="margin: 0; padding-left: 20px; color: #cbd5e1; font-size: 14px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px;">
            ${localizedContent.usageSteps.map(step => `<li>${step}</li>`).join('\n')}
          </ol>
        </section>

        <!-- FAQ Accordion -->
        <section style="background: #1e293b; padding: 20px; border-radius: 12px; border: 1px solid #334155;">
          <h2 style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 700; color: #38bdf8; margin: 0 0 14px 0;">${sectionUi.faqTitle}</h2>
          <div style="display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px;">
            ${localizedContent.faqs.map(faq => `
              <details style="background: #0f172a; padding: 12px 16px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid #334155;">
                <summary style="font-weight: 600; color: #f1f5f9; cursor: pointer; font-size: 14px;">${faq.question}</summary>
                <p style="margin: 8px 0 0 0; color: #94a3b8; font-size: 13.5px; line-height: 1.5;">${faq.answer}</p>
              </details>
            `).join('')}
          </div>
        </section>

        <!-- Related Tools Directory -->
        <section style="margin-top: 8px;">
          <h3 style="font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; color: #cbd5e1; margin: 0 0 12px 0;">${sectionUi.relatedTitle}</h3>
          <div style="display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(240px, 1fr)); gap: 10px;">
            ${VALID_TOOLS.slice(0, 10).map(tId => {
              const otherSEO = getToolSEO(tId, activeLang);
              const otherContent = getLocalizedToolContent(tId, activeLang);
              const isCurrent = tId === activeToolId;
              const targetPath = tId === 'basic' ? `/${activeLang}/` : `/${activeLang}/${tId}`;
              return `
                <a href="${targetPath}" style="display: block; padding: 10px 14px; background: ${isCurrent ? '#2563eb' : '#1e293b'}; color: #f8fafc; text-decoration: none; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid #334155; font-size: 13px;">
                  <strong>${otherContent.name}</strong>
                  <div style="font-size: 11px; color: ${isCurrent ? '#dbeafe' : '#94a3b8'}; margin-top: 2px;">${otherSEO.title.slice(0, 50)}...</div>
                </a>
              `;
            }).join('')}
          </div>
        </section>
      </main>

      <footer style="margin-top: 32px; padding-top: 16px; border-top: 1px solid #334155; font-size: 12px; color: #64748b; text-align: center;">
        <p>&copy; 2026 AC Studio. All rights reserved. 100% Client-Side Privacy Standard.</p>
      </footer>
    </div>
  `;

  // 4. Inject into HTML Template
  let result = templateHtml;

  // Replace <html lang="...">
  result = result.replace(/<html[^>]*>/i, `<html lang="${activeLang}" dir="${isRtl ? 'rtl' : 'ltr'}">`);

  // Replace <title>...</title>
  result = result.replace(/<title>[\s\S]*?<\/title>/i, `<title>${pageTitle}</title>`);

  // Replace meta description
  result = result.replace(/<meta\s+name=["']description["'][\s\S]*?>/i, `<meta name="description" content="${pageDescription}" />`);

  // Enforce noindex robots meta tags
  result = result.replace(/<meta\s+name=["']robots["'][\s\S]*?>/i, `<meta name="robots" content="noindex, nofollow, noarchive, nosnippet" />`);
  if (!result.includes('name="googlebot"')) {
    result = result.replace('</head>', `    <meta name="googlebot" content="noindex, nofollow, noarchive, nosnippet" />\n  </head>`);
  }

  // Replace canonical link
  result = result.replace(/<link\s+rel=["']canonical["'][\s\S]*?>/i, `<link rel="canonical" href="${canonicalUrl}" />`);

  // Replace Open Graph and Twitter
  result = result.replace(/<meta\s+property=["']og:title["'][\s\S]*?>/i, `<meta property="og:title" content="${pageTitle}" />`);
  result = result.replace(/<meta\s+property=["']og:description["'][\s\S]*?>/i, `<meta property="og:description" content="${pageDescription}" />`);
  result = result.replace(/<meta\s+property=["']og:url["'][\s\S]*?>/i, `<meta property="og:url" content="${canonicalUrl}" />`);
  result = result.replace(/<meta\s+property=["']og:image["'][\s\S]*?>/i, `<meta property="og:image" content="${cleanDomain}/og-image.png" />`);
  result = result.replace(/<meta\s+name=["']twitter:title["'][\s\S]*?>/i, `<meta name="twitter:title" content="${pageTitle}" />`);
  result = result.replace(/<meta\s+name=["']twitter:description["'][\s\S]*?>/i, `<meta name="twitter:description" content="${pageDescription}" />`);
  result = result.replace(/<meta\s+name=["']twitter:image["'][\s\S]*?>/i, `<meta name="twitter:image" content="${cleanDomain}/og-image.png" />`);

  // Inject dynamic keywords meta
  const keywordsMeta = `<meta name="keywords" content="${toolSEO.keywords.join(', ')}" />`;
  if (result.includes('<meta name="keywords"')) {
    result = result.replace(/<meta\s+name=["']keywords["'][\s\S]*?>/i, keywordsMeta);
  } else {
    result = result.replace('</head>', `    ${keywordsMeta}\n  </head>`);
  }

  // Replace hreflang alternate links
  const hreflangRegex = /<!-- Hreflang Alternate Links[\s\S]*?<!-- Open Graph/i;
  if (hreflangRegex.test(result)) {
    result = result.replace(
      hreflangRegex,
      `<!-- Hreflang Alternate Links for 20 International Markets -->\n    ${hreflangTags}\n\n    <!-- Open Graph`
    );
  }

  // Replace Structured Data JSON-LD
  const schemaScriptRegex = /<script\s+type=["']application\/ld\+json["']>[\s\S]*?<\/script>/i;
  const newSchemaScript = `<script type="application/ld+json">\n${JSON.stringify({ "@context": "https://schema.org", "@graph": schemaGraph }, null, 2)}\n    </script>`;
  if (schemaScriptRegex.test(result)) {
    result = result.replace(schemaScriptRegex, newSchemaScript);
  }

  // Replace content inside <div id="root">...</div> with our SEO-rich semantic HTML
  const rootRegex = /<div\s+id=["']root["']>[\s\S]*?<\/div>\s*<script/i;
  if (rootRegex.test(result)) {
    result = result.replace(rootRegex, `<div id="root">${semanticRootContent}</div>\n    <script`);
  }

  return result;
}

export function generateDynamicSitemap(baseUrl: string): string {
  const cleanBase = baseUrl.replace(/\/+$/, '');
  const today = new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0];

  let xml = `<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>\n`;
  xml += `<urlset xmlns="http://www.sitemaps.org/schemas/sitemap/0.9" xmlns:xhtml="http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml">\n`;

  // 1. Root URL
  xml += `  <url>\n`;
  xml += `    <loc>${cleanBase}/</loc>\n`;
  xml += `    <lastmod>${today}</lastmod>\n`;
  xml += `    <changefreq>daily</changefreq>\n`;
  xml += `    <priority>1.0</priority>\n`;
  xml += `    <xhtml:link rel="alternate" hreflang="x-default" href="${cleanBase}/en/" />\n`;
  for (const m of SEO_MARKETS) {
    xml += `    <xhtml:link rel="alternate" hreflang="${m.hreflang}" href="${cleanBase}/${m.code}/" />\n`;
  }
  xml += `  </url>\n`;

  // 2. Language Index URLs (Canonical for basic tool)
  for (const m of SEO_MARKETS) {
    xml += `  <url>\n`;
    xml += `    <loc>${cleanBase}/${m.code}/</loc>\n`;
    xml += `    <lastmod>${today}</lastmod>\n`;
    xml += `    <changefreq>daily</changefreq>\n`;
    xml += `    <priority>0.9</priority>\n`;
    xml += `    <xhtml:link rel="alternate" hreflang="x-default" href="${cleanBase}/en/" />\n`;
    for (const alt of SEO_MARKETS) {
      xml += `    <xhtml:link rel="alternate" hreflang="${alt.hreflang}" href="${cleanBase}/${alt.code}/" />\n`;
    }
    xml += `  </url>\n`;
  }

  // 3. Tool URLs for every specialized tool (excluding basic, which is canonicalized to /${m.code}/)
  const specializedTools = VALID_TOOLS.filter(tId => tId !== 'basic');
  for (const toolId of specializedTools) {
    for (const m of SEO_MARKETS) {
      xml += `  <url>\n`;
      xml += `    <loc>${cleanBase}/${m.code}/${toolId}</loc>\n`;
      xml += `    <lastmod>${today}</lastmod>\n`;
      xml += `    <changefreq>weekly</changefreq>\n`;
      xml += `    <priority>${toolId === 'salary' || toolId === 'loan' || toolId === 'compound' ? '0.9' : '0.8'}</priority>\n`;
      xml += `    <xhtml:link rel="alternate" hreflang="x-default" href="${cleanBase}/en/${toolId}" />\n`;
      for (const alt of SEO_MARKETS) {
        xml += `    <xhtml:link rel="alternate" hreflang="${alt.hreflang}" href="${cleanBase}/${alt.code}/${toolId}" />\n`;
      }
      xml += `  </url>\n`;
    }
  }

  xml += `</urlset>`;
  return xml;
}

export function generateRobotsTxt(_baseUrl: string): string {
  return `User-agent: *\nDisallow: /\n\nUser-agent: Googlebot\nDisallow: /\n\nUser-agent: Googlebot-Image\nDisallow: /\n\nUser-agent: Mediapartners-Google\nDisallow: /\n`;
}

export type ToolCategory = 'math' | 'geometry' | 'financial' | 'fitness' | 'conversion' | 'utility' | 'knowledge';

export type ToolId = 
  // Financial
  | 'mortgage'
  | 'loan'
  | 'autoloan'
  | 'interest'
  | 'payment'

/**
 * Date utilities with strict Local Timezone safety.
 * Standard `new Date("YYYY-MM-DD")` parses as UTC midnight, which causes off-by-one errors
 * in timezones behind UTC (such as UTC-5, UTC-7, UTC-8) or date mismatch in Asian timezones.
 */

/**
 * Parse "YYYY-MM-DD" into a local midnight Date object (local 00:00:00.000)
 */
export function parseLocalDate(dateStr: string): Date {
  if (!dateStr) return new Date();
  const parts = dateStr.split('-').map(Number);
  if (parts.length < 3 || isNaN(parts[0]) || isNaN(parts[1]) || isNaN(parts[2])) {
    return new Date(dateStr);
  }
  return new Date(parts[0], parts[1] - 1, parts[2], 0, 0, 0, 0);
}

/**
 * Format Date object into "YYYY-MM-DD" string based on LOCAL time (not UTC)
 */
export function formatLocalISODate(d: Date): string {
  if (isNaN(d.getTime())) return '';
  const y = d.getFullYear();
  const m = String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0');
  const day = String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');
  return `${y}-${m}-${day}`;
}

/**
 * Get current system date in "YYYY-MM-DD" format in user's local timezone
 */
export function getTodayLocalISODate(): string {
  return formatLocalISODate(new Date());
}

/**
 * Calculate precise calendar age (years, months, days)
 * Robust against month-end differences (e.g. birth on 31st, target on Feb 28 / Mar 1)
 */
export function calculateCalendarAge(birth: Date, target: Date): { years: number; months: number; days: number } {
  let years = target.getFullYear() - birth.getFullYear();
  let months = target.getMonth() - birth.getMonth();
  let days = target.getDate() - birth.getDate();

  if (days < 0) {
    months -= 1;
    // Number of days in the month immediately preceding targetDate
    const daysInPrevMonth = new Date(target.getFullYear(), target.getMonth(), 0).getDate();
    // Cap birth day to the previous month's maximum days if birth date was on 29, 30 or 31
    const adjustedBirthDay = Math.min(birth.getDate(), daysInPrevMonth);
    days = target.getDate() + (daysInPrevMonth - adjustedBirthDay);
  }

  if (months < 0) {
    years -= 1;
    months += 12;
  }

  return {
    years: Math.max(0, years),
    months: Math.max(0, months),
    days: Math.max(0, days)
  };
}

/**
 * Safe and fast mathematical expression evaluator for f(x)
 * Supports:
 * - Basic arithmetic: +, -, *, /, %, ^ (power)
 * - Functions: sin, cos, tan, cot, asin, acos, atan, sqrt, abs, ln, log, exp
 * - Constants: pi, e
 * - Implicit multiplication: 2x -> 2*x, 3x^2 -> 3*x^2, 4(x+1) -> 4*(x+1), x(x-1) -> x*(x-1)
 * - Degree notation or custom power formats like x^2, x^3
 */

export function sanitizeExpression(expr: string, params?: Record<string, number>): string {
  let s = expr.trim();
  if (!s) return '0';

  // Strip leading y = , f(x) = , g(x) = , y1 = , y2 =
  s = s.replace(/^(y\d*|f\(x\)|g\(x\)|h\(x\))\s*=\s*/i, '');

  // Replace unicode powers
  s = s.replace(/²/g, '^2').replace(/³/g, '^3');

  // Replace constants
  s = s.replace(/π/g, `(${Math.PI})`);
  s = s.replace(/\bpi\b/gi, `(${Math.PI})`);
  s = s.replace(/\be\b/g, `(${Math.E})`);

  // Support parameter d or other variables in params
  if (params) {
    for (const [key, val] of Object.entries(params)) {
      const regex = new RegExp(`\\b${key}\\b`, 'gi');
      s = s.replace(regex, `(${val})`);
    }
  }

  // Handle dx or d*x if d is treated as parameter without params specified
  s = s.replace(/\bdx\b/gi, 'd*x');

  // Normalize implicit multiplications:
  // e.g. 2x, 2.5x -> 2*x
  s = s.replace(/(\d+(\.\d+)?)\s*([a-zA-Z(])/g, '$1*$3');

  // e.g. x( -> x*(
  s = s.replace(/([xX])\s*\(/g, '$1*(');

  // e.g. )x -> )*x
  s = s.replace(/\)\s*([xX])/g, ')*$1');

  // e.g. ) ( -> )*(
  s = s.replace(/\)\s*\(/g, ')*(');

  // e.g. )2 -> )*2
  s = s.replace(/\)\s*(\d)/g, ')*$1');

  return s;
}

/**
 * Tokenizes and evaluates an expression at variable x with optional parameters
 */
export function evaluateExpression(rawExpr: string, x: number, params?: Record<string, number>): number {
  const expr = sanitizeExpression(rawExpr, params);

  try {
    // Parser using recursive descent or shunting-yard
    return evaluateTokens(tokenize(expr, x, params));
  } catch {
    return NaN;
  }
}

type TokenType = 'num' | 'op' | 'func' | 'lparen' | 'rparen';

interface Token {
  type: TokenType;
  value: string | number;
}

function tokenize(expr: string, xVal: number, params?: Record<string, number>): Token[] {
  const tokens: Token[] = [];
  let i = 0;
  const n = expr.length;

  while (i < n) {
    const char = expr[i];

    if (/\s/.test(char)) {
      i++;
      continue;
    }

    if (char === '(') {
      tokens.push({ type: 'lparen', value: '(' });
      i++;
      continue;
    }

    if (char === ')') {
      tokens.push({ type: 'rparen', value: ')' });
      i++;
      continue;
    }

    if (/[0-9.]/.test(char)) {
      let numStr = '';
      while (i < n && /[0-9.]/.test(expr[i])) {
        numStr += expr[i];
        i++;
      }
      tokens.push({ type: 'num', value: parseFloat(numStr) });
      continue;
    }

    if (/[a-zA-Z]/.test(char)) {
      let word = '';
      while (i < n && /[a-zA-Z]/.test(expr[i])) {
        word += expr[i];
        i++;
      }
      const lower = word.toLowerCase();
      if (lower === 'x') {
        tokens.push({ type: 'num', value: xVal });
      } else if (params && params[lower] !== undefined) {
        tokens.push({ type: 'num', value: params[lower] });
      } else if (['sin', 'cos', 'tan', 'cot', 'sqrt', 'abs', 'ln', 'log', 'exp', 'asin', 'acos', 'atan'].includes(lower)) {
        tokens.push({ type: 'func', value: lower });
      } else {
        // Unknown identifier, fallback to NaN
        tokens.push({ type: 'num', value: NaN });
      }
      continue;
    }

    if (['+', '-', '*', '/', '^', '%'].includes(char)) {
      // Check unary plus/minus
      const prev = tokens[tokens.length - 1];
      const isUnary = !prev || prev.type === 'op' || prev.type === 'lparen';
      if (isUnary && (char === '+' || char === '-')) {
        tokens.push({ type: 'num', value: 0 });
        tokens.push({ type: 'op', value: char });
      } else {
        tokens.push({ type: 'op', value: char });
      }
      i++;
      continue;
    }

    i++;
  }

  return tokens;
}

function precedence(op: string): number {
  if (op === '+' || op === '-') return 1;
  if (op === '*' || op === '/' || op === '%') return 2;
  if (op === '^') return 3;
  return 0;
}

function isRightAssociative(op: string): boolean {
  return op === '^';
}

function evaluateTokens(tokens: Token[]): number {
  const outputQueue: Token[] = [];
  const operatorStack: Token[] = [];

  for (const token of tokens) {
    if (token.type === 'num') {
      outputQueue.push(token);
    } else if (token.type === 'func') {
      operatorStack.push(token);
    } else if (token.type === 'op') {
      const o1 = token.value as string;
      while (operatorStack.length > 0) {
        const top = operatorStack[operatorStack.length - 1];
        if (top.type === 'func') {
          outputQueue.push(operatorStack.pop()!);
        } else if (top.type === 'op') {
          const o2 = top.value as string;
          if (
            (isRightAssociative(o1) && precedence(o1) < precedence(o2)) ||
            (!isRightAssociative(o1) && precedence(o1) <= precedence(o2))
          ) {
            outputQueue.push(operatorStack.pop()!);
          } else {
            break;
          }
        } else {
          break;
        }
      }
      operatorStack.push(token);
    } else if (token.type === 'lparen') {
      operatorStack.push(token);
    } else if (token.type === 'rparen') {
      while (operatorStack.length > 0 && operatorStack[operatorStack.length - 1].type !== 'lparen') {
        outputQueue.push(operatorStack.pop()!);
      }
      if (operatorStack.length > 0 && operatorStack[operatorStack.length - 1].type === 'lparen') {
        operatorStack.pop(); // discard lparen
      }
      if (operatorStack.length > 0 && operatorStack[operatorStack.length - 1].type === 'func') {
        outputQueue.push(operatorStack.pop()!);
      }
    }
  }

  while (operatorStack.length > 0) {
    outputQueue.push(operatorStack.pop()!);
  }

  // Evaluate RPN
  const valStack: number[] = [];
  for (const token of outputQueue) {
    if (token.type === 'num') {
      valStack.push(token.value as number);
    } else if (token.type === 'op') {
      const b = valStack.pop();
      const a = valStack.pop();
      if (a === undefined || b === undefined) return NaN;
      const op = token.value as string;
      switch (op) {
        case '+': valStack.push(a + b); break;
        case '-': valStack.push(a - b); break;
        case '*': valStack.push(a * b); break;
        case '/': valStack.push(b === 0 ? (a >= 0 ? Infinity : -Infinity) : a / b); break;
        case '%': valStack.push(a % b); break;
        case '^': valStack.push(Math.pow(a, b)); break;
        default: return NaN;
      }
    } else if (token.type === 'func') {
      const a = valStack.pop();
      if (a === undefined) return NaN;
      const fn = token.value as string;
      switch (fn) {
        case 'sin': valStack.push(Math.sin(a)); break;
        case 'cos': valStack.push(Math.cos(a)); break;
        case 'tan': {
          const cos = Math.cos(a);
          valStack.push(Math.abs(cos) < 1e-12 ? NaN : Math.tan(a));
          break;
        }
        case 'cot': {
          const sin = Math.sin(a);
          valStack.push(Math.abs(sin) < 1e-12 ? NaN : 1 / Math.tan(a));
          break;
        }
        case 'sqrt': valStack.push(a < 0 ? NaN : Math.sqrt(a)); break;
        case 'abs': valStack.push(Math.abs(a)); break;
        case 'ln': valStack.push(a <= 0 ? NaN : Math.log(a)); break;
        case 'log': valStack.push(a <= 0 ? NaN : Math.log10(a)); break;
        case 'exp': valStack.push(Math.exp(a)); break;
        case 'asin': valStack.push(Math.asin(a)); break;
        case 'acos': valStack.push(Math.acos(a)); break;
        case 'atan': valStack.push(Math.atan(a)); break;
        default: return NaN;
      }
    }
  }

  return valStack.length === 1 ? valStack[0] : NaN;
}

/**
 * Formats a number to π notation if close to a rational fraction of π
 */
export function formatPiNotation(val: number, trigContext: boolean = false): string | null {
  const clean = Math.abs(val) < 1e-5 ? 0 : val;
  if (clean === 0) return '0';

  const pi = Math.PI;
  const denominators = [1, 2, 3, 4, 6];
  let bestMatch: { num: number; den: number; diff: number } | null = null;
  const maxAllowedDiff = trigContext ? 0.05 : 0.025;

  for (const den of denominators) {
    const k = (clean * den) / pi;
    const roundK = Math.round(k);
    if (roundK === 0) continue;
    const diff = Math.abs(clean - (roundK * pi) / den);
    if (diff < maxAllowedDiff) {
      if (!bestMatch || diff < bestMatch.diff) {
        bestMatch = { num: roundK, den, diff };
      }
    }
  }

  if (!bestMatch) return null;

  const gcd = (a: number, b: number): number => (b === 0 ? Math.abs(a) : gcd(b, a % b));
  const g = gcd(bestMatch.num, bestMatch.den);
  let num = bestMatch.num / g;
  let den = bestMatch.den / g;

  const sign = num < 0 ? '-' : '';
  num = Math.abs(num);

  if (den === 1) {
    if (num === 1) return `${sign}π`;
    return `${sign}${num}π`;
  } else {
    if (num === 1) return `${sign}π/${den}`;
    return `${sign}${num}π/${den}`;
  }
}

/**
 * Advanced Exact Mathematical Recognizer:
 * Detects whether a real number matches an exact algebraic representation:
 * - Integers: 0, 1, -2, 3...
 * - Multiples of π: π, -π, π/2, 2π/3...
 * - Radicals (căn bậc hai): √2, -√3, √3, √5, 2√2, 2√3, 3√2...
 * - Radical fractions: √3/2, √2/2, √3/3, √6/2...
 * - Shifted quadratic radicals: 1 + √3, 1 - √3, -1 + √2...
 * - Cube roots: ∛2, ∛3...
 * - Rational fractions: 1/2, -1/3, 2/3, 3/4, -5/2...
 */
export function formatExactMath(
  val: number,
  isTrigContext: boolean = false
): { exact: string | null; formatted: string } {
  const clean = Math.abs(val) < 1e-5 ? 0 : val;
  if (clean === 0) return { exact: '0', formatted: '0' };

  // 1. Integer check
  if (Math.abs(clean - Math.round(clean)) < 1e-4) {
    const rounded = Math.round(clean);
    return { exact: `${rounded}`, formatted: `${rounded}` };
  }

  const sign = clean < 0 ? '-' : '';
  const absVal = Math.abs(clean);

  // 2. Pi multiples check (with tight tolerance)
  const pi = Math.PI;
  const maxPiDiff = isTrigContext ? 0.015 : 0.008;
  for (const den of [1, 2, 3, 4, 6]) {
    const k = (clean * den) / pi;
    const roundK = Math.round(k);
    if (roundK === 0) continue;
    if (Math.abs(clean - (roundK * pi) / den) < maxPiDiff) {
      const gcd = (a: number, b: number): number => (b === 0 ? Math.abs(a) : gcd(b, a % b));
      const g = gcd(roundK, den);
      let num = roundK / g;
      let d = den / g;
      const s = num < 0 ? '-' : '';
      num = Math.abs(num);
      const str = d === 1 
        ? (num === 1 ? `${s}π` : `${s}${num}π`) 
        : (num === 1 ? `${s}π/${d}` : `${s}${num}π/${d}`);
      return { exact: str, formatted: str };
    }
  }

  // Helper to extract square factors: sqrt(N) = k * sqrt(b) where b is square-free
  const simplifySqrt = (N: number): { k: number; b: number } => {
    let k = 1;
    let rem = N;
    for (let f = Math.floor(Math.sqrt(N)); f >= 2; f--) {
      if (rem % (f * f) === 0) {
        k *= f;
        rem = rem / (f * f);
        break;
      }
    }
    return { k, b: rem };
  };

  // 3. Pure & simplified square roots: ±√N or ±k√b
  const testRadicands = [2, 3, 5, 6, 7, 8, 10, 11, 12, 13, 14, 15, 17, 18, 19, 20, 21, 24, 27, 28, 32, 40, 45, 48, 50];
  for (const N of testRadicands) {
    if (Math.abs(absVal - Math.sqrt(N)) < 0.003) {
      const { k, b } = simplifySqrt(N);
      const radStr = k === 1 ? `√${b}` : `${k}√${b}`;
      return { exact: `${sign}${radStr}`, formatted: `${sign}${radStr}` };
    }
  }

  // 4. Radical fractions: ±√N / d or ±(k√b) / d (d in [2, 3, 4, 6])
  for (const d of [2, 3, 4, 6]) {
    const scaled = absVal * d;
    for (const N of [2, 3, 5, 6, 7, 8, 10, 11, 12, 15, 18, 20, 24, 27]) {
      if (Math.abs(scaled - Math.sqrt(N)) < 0.004) {
        const { k, b } = simplifySqrt(N);
        const gcd = (a: number, b: number): number => (b === 0 ? Math.abs(a) : gcd(b, a % b));
        const g = gcd(k, d);
        const kRed = k / g;
        const dRed = d / g;

        let res = '';
        if (dRed === 1) {
          res = kRed === 1 ? `√${b}` : `${kRed}√${b}`;
        } else {
          res = kRed === 1 ? `√${b}/${dRed}` : `${kRed}√${b}/${dRed}`;
        }
        return { exact: `${sign}${res}`, formatted: `${sign}${res}` };
      }
    }
  }

  // 5. Shifted quadratic roots: m ± √N (e.g. 1 + √3, 1 - √3, -1 + √2)
  for (const m of [-4, -3, -2, -1, 1, 2, 3, 4]) {
    for (const N of [2, 3, 5, 6, 7]) {
      const sqrtN = Math.sqrt(N);
      if (Math.abs(clean - (m + sqrtN)) < 0.003) {
        return { exact: `${m} + √${N}`, formatted: `${m} + √${N}` };
      }
      if (Math.abs(clean - (m - sqrtN)) < 0.003) {
        return { exact: `${m} - √${N}`, formatted: `${m} - √${N}` };
      }
    }
  }

  // 6. Cube roots: ±∛N
  for (const N of [2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 9, 10]) {
    if (Math.abs(absVal - Math.cbrt(N)) < 0.003) {
      return { exact: `${sign}∛${N}`, formatted: `${sign}∛${N}` };
    }
  }

  // 7. Rational fractions with small denominators: p / q with q in [2..10]
  for (const q of [2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10]) {
    const p = Math.round(absVal * q);
    if (p === 0) continue;
    if (Math.abs(absVal - p / q) < 0.0015) {
      const gcd = (a: number, b: number): number => (b === 0 ? Math.abs(a) : gcd(b, a % b));
      const g = gcd(p, q);
      const redP = p / g;
      const redQ = q / g;
      if (redQ === 1) {
        return { exact: `${sign}${redP}`, formatted: `${sign}${redP}` };
      }
      const fracStr = `${sign}${redP}/${redQ}`;
      return { exact: fracStr, formatted: fracStr };
    }
  }

  // 8. Fallback: Clean decimal format
  return { exact: null, formatted: clean.toFixed(2) };
}

/**
 * Returns formatted string representing coordinate x or y
 */
export function formatExactCoord(val: number, isTrigContext: boolean = false): string {
  const res = formatExactMath(val, isTrigContext);
  return res.exact || res.formatted;
}

import html2canvas from 'html2canvas-pro';

export interface PdfExportOptions {

  orientation?: 'portrait' | 'landscape';

  isVi?: boolean; // default auto-detected from html lang or true

/**
 * Kiểm tra thiết bị di động (iOS / Android / Máy tính bảng)
 */
export function isMobileDevice(): boolean {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined' || typeof navigator === 'undefined') return false;
  const ua = navigator.userAgent || '';
  const isIOS = /iPad|iPhone|iPod/.test(ua) || (navigator.platform === 'MacIntel' && navigator.maxTouchPoints > 1);
  const isAndroid = /Android/i.test(ua);
  const isMobileUa = /Mobi|Tablet|Opera Mini|CriOS|FxiOS/i.test(ua);
  return isIOS || isAndroid || isMobileUa;
}

/**
 * Kiểm tra thiết bị Apple iOS (iPhone, iPad, iPod)
 */
export function isIOSDevice(): boolean {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined' || typeof navigator === 'undefined') return false;
  const ua = navigator.userAgent || '';
  return /iPad|iPhone|iPod/.test(ua) || (navigator.platform === 'MacIntel' && navigator.maxTouchPoints > 1);
}

/**
 * Hiển thị Bottom Sheet / Floating Action Banner trên điện thoại để người dùng
 * chạm trực tiếp tải file hoặc mở native Share Sheet (Lưu vào Tệp / Files).
 * Điều này khắc phục 100% tình trạng popup blocker hoặc Safari/Chrome chặn tải ngầm.
 */
export function showMobilePdfDownloadSheet(result: PdfExportResult, isVi = true): void {
  // Xóa sheet cũ nếu đang hiển thị
  const existingSheet = document.getElementById('mobile-pdf-export-sheet');
  if (existingSheet && document.body.contains(existingSheet)) {
    document.body.removeChild(existingSheet);
  }

  const sheet = document.createElement('div');
  sheet.id = 'mobile-pdf-export-sheet';
  sheet.style.position = 'fixed';
  sheet.style.bottom = '0px';
  sheet.style.left = '0px';
  sheet.style.right = '0px';
  sheet.style.zIndex = '999999';
  sheet.style.backgroundColor = '#0f172a';
  sheet.style.color = '#ffffff';
  sheet.style.borderTop = '1px solid #334155';
  sheet.style.boxShadow = '0 -10px 25px -5px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5)';
  sheet.style.padding = '16px';
  sheet.style.fontFamily = 'system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif';
  sheet.style.boxSizing = 'border-box';
  sheet.style.animation = 'fadeInUp 0.25s ease-out';

  const canNativeShare = typeof navigator !== 'undefined' && !!navigator.share;

  sheet.innerHTML = `
    <div style="max-width: 540px; margin: 0 auto; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px;">
      <div style="display: flex; items-center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px;">
        <div style="display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; min-width: 0;">
          <div style="width: 38px; height: 38px; border-radius: 10px; background-color: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.2); border: 1px solid rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.4); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; color: #34d399; font-size: 18px; flex-shrink: 0;">
            📄
          </div>
          <div style="min-width: 0;">
            <div style="font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; color: #ffffff; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis;">
              ${result.fileName}
            </div>
            <div style="font-size: 11px; color: #94a3b8;">
              ${isVi ? 'File PDF đã sẵn sàng! Chạm bên dưới để mở hoặc lưu về máy:' : 'PDF ready! Tap below to open or save to your device:'}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <button id="close-mobile-pdf-sheet-btn" style="background: transparent; border: none; color: #94a3b8; font-size: 20px; cursor: pointer; padding: 4px 8px; line-height: 1;">
          ✕
        </button>
      </div>

      <div style="display: grid; grid-template-columns: ${canNativeShare ? '1fr 1fr' : '1fr'}; gap: 8px;">
        <a id="direct-mobile-download-link" href="${result.blobUrl}" download="${result.fileName}" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" style="display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; padding: 12px 14px; background-color: #059669; color: #ffffff; text-decoration: none; border-radius: 12px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; text-align: center; box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(5, 150, 105, 0.3);">
          <span>📥</span>
          <span>${isVi ? 'Mở / Tải file PDF' : 'Open / Save PDF'}</span>
        </a>

        ${canNativeShare ? `
          <button id="native-mobile-share-btn" type="button" style="display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; padding: 12px 14px; background-color: #1e293b; color: #f8fafc; border: 1px solid #475569; border-radius: 12px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer;">
            <span>📤</span>
            <span>${isVi ? 'Lưu vào Tệp / Share' : 'Save to Files / Share'}</span>
          </button>
        ` : ''}
      </div>

      <div style="display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; font-size: 11px; color: #64748b; padding-top: 2px;">
        <span>${isVi ? '💡 Mẹo: Nhấn "Lưu vào Tệp" (iPhone) hoặc "Tải về" (Android)' : '💡 Tip: Choose "Save to Files" (iPhone) or "Download" (Android)'}</span>
        <button id="print-fallback-mobile-btn" type="button" style="background: none; border: none; color: #38bdf8; font-size: 11px; text-decoration: underline; cursor: pointer; padding: 0;">
          ${isVi ? 'In trực tiếp' : 'Print directly'}
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  `;

  document.body.appendChild(sheet);

  // Gắn sự kiện đóng
  const closeBtn = document.getElementById('close-mobile-pdf-sheet-btn');
  if (closeBtn) {
    closeBtn.onclick = () => {
      if (document.body.contains(sheet)) {
        document.body.removeChild(sheet);
      }
    };
  }

  // Gắn sự kiện in
  const printBtn = document.getElementById('print-fallback-mobile-btn');
  if (printBtn) {
    printBtn.onclick = () => {
      window.print();
    };
  }

  // Gắn sự kiện Share Native khi người dùng chạm trực tiếp (đảm bảo user gesture hợp lệ)
  const shareBtn = document.getElementById('native-mobile-share-btn');
  if (shareBtn && canNativeShare) {
    shareBtn.onclick = async () => {
      try {
        const file = new File([result.blob], result.fileName, { type: 'application/pdf' });
        if (navigator.canShare && navigator.canShare({ files: [file] })) {
          await navigator.share({
            files: [file],
            title: result.fileName,
            text: isVi ? 'Tài liệu bảng tính PDF' : 'Financial Statement PDF',
          });
        } else {
          // Fallback share link nếu không share được file trực tiếp
          await navigator.share({
            title: result.fileName,
            url: result.blobUrl,
          });
        }
      } catch (err: any) {
        if (err.name !== 'AbortError') {
          console.warn('Lỗi khi chia sẻ file:', err);
          // Mở trực tiếp link PDF nếu share gặp sự cố
          window.open(result.blobUrl, '_blank');
        }
      }
    };
  }
}

/**
 * Xuất toàn bộ các trang tài liệu (A4) từ một container HTML thành file PDF chất lượng cao.
 * Tối ưu hóa đặc biệt cho thiết bị di động (Android & iPhone/iPad):
 * - Tách biệt vùng dựng hình A4 chuẩn 794px không bị co dúm hay cắt góc bởi viewport điện thoại.
 * - Loại bỏ các vòng lặp tính toán pixel nặng để không gây tràn bộ nhớ (Jetsam) làm Safari tự động reload trang.
 * - Kích hoạt Native Web Share API và Drawer tải trực tiếp để vượt qua popup/download blocker trên di động.
 */
export async function exportElementPagesToPdf(
  containerEl: HTMLElement,
  options: PdfExportOptions
): Promise<PdfExportResult> {
  if (!containerEl) {
    throw new Error('Không tìm thấy phần tử tài liệu để xuất PDF');
  }

  const pageSelector = options.pageSelector || '.pdf-report-page';
  let pageElements = Array.from(containerEl.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>(pageSelector));

  // Nếu bản thân containerEl chính là trang hoặc querySelectorAll không tìm thấy phần tử con nào
  if (pageElements.length === 0) {
    if (containerEl.matches && containerEl.matches(pageSelector)) {
      pageElements = [containerEl];
    } else {
      pageElements = [containerEl];
    }
  }

  if (pageElements.length === 0) {
    throw new Error('Không tìm thấy trang tài liệu nào để xuất PDF');
  }

  // Chờ phông chữ tải xong hoàn chỉnh để các con số và ký hiệu tài chính sắc nét
  if (document.fonts && document.fonts.ready) {
    try {
      await document.fonts.ready;
    } catch {
      // Bỏ qua nếu môi trường không hỗ trợ font API
    }
  }

  const isLandscape = options.orientation === 'landscape';
  const pdf = new jsPDF({
    orientation: isLandscape ? 'landscape' : 'portrait',
    unit: 'mm',
    format: options.format || 'a4',
    compress: true,
  });

  const pdfWidth = isLandscape ? 297 : 210;
  const pdfHeight = isLandscape ? 210 : 297;

  // Tạo khung chứa render tạm thời cô lập, định vị tuyệt đối để không bị giới hạn bởi màn hình điện thoại
  const host = document.createElement('div');
  host.id = 'pdf-isolated-render-host';
  host.setAttribute('data-pdf-rendering', 'true');
  host.setAttribute('data-theme', 'light');
  host.style.position = 'absolute';
  host.style.top = '0px';
  host.style.left = '0px';
  host.style.width = '794px';
  host.style.minWidth = '794px';
  host.style.maxWidth = 'none';
  host.style.height = 'auto';
  host.style.minHeight = '1123px';
  host.style.zIndex = '-100'; // Đặt z-index âm vừa đủ, không dùng -9999 để tránh bị browser culling trên iOS
  host.style.backgroundColor = '#ffffff';
  host.style.color = '#000000';
  host.style.overflow = 'visible';
  host.style.pointerEvents = 'none';
  host.style.boxSizing = 'border-box';
  host.style.margin = '0';
  host.style.padding = '0';
  host.style.opacity = '1';
  host.style.visibility = 'visible';

  // Nhúng style cưỡng chế tài liệu PDF in ra 100% đen trắng rõ nét, độ tương phản cao
  const bwStyle = document.createElement('style');
  bwStyle.id = 'pdf-bw-style-enforcer';
  bwStyle.textContent = `
    #pdf-isolated-render-host,
    #pdf-isolated-render-host * {
      -webkit-print-color-adjust: exact !important;
      print-color-adjust: exact !important;
      box-sizing: border-box !important;
    }
    #pdf-isolated-render-host {
      background-color: #ffffff !important;
      color: #000000 !important;
    }
    #pdf-isolated-render-host .pdf-report-page {
      background-color: #ffffff !important;
      color: #000000 !important;
      box-shadow: none !important;
      filter: grayscale(100%) !important;
    }
    #pdf-isolated-render-host [class*="text-emerald"],
    #pdf-isolated-render-host [class*="text-blue"],
    #pdf-isolated-render-host [class*="text-amber"],
    #pdf-isolated-render-host [class*="text-rose"],
    #pdf-isolated-render-host [class*="text-red"],
    #pdf-isolated-render-host [class*="text-cyan"],
    #pdf-isolated-render-host [class*="text-indigo"],
    #pdf-isolated-render-host [class*="text-violet"],
    #pdf-isolated-render-host [class*="text-purple"] {
      color: #000000 !important;
    }
    #pdf-isolated-render-host [class*="border-emerald"],
    #pdf-isolated-render-host [class*="border-blue"],
    #pdf-isolated-render-host [class*="border-amber"],
    #pdf-isolated-render-host [class*="border-rose"],
    #pdf-isolated-render-host [class*="border-cyan"],
    #pdf-isolated-render-host [class*="border-indigo"] {
      border-color: #cbd5e1 !important;
    }
    #pdf-isolated-render-host thead {
      background-color: #f1f5f9 !important;
      color: #000000 !important;
      border: 1px solid #000000 !important;
    }
    #pdf-isolated-render-host table {
      border-color: #cbd5e1 !important;
    }
    #pdf-isolated-render-host th,
    #pdf-isolated-render-host td {
      border-color: #cbd5e1 !important;
      color: #000000 !important;
    }
    #pdf-isolated-render-host svg {
      stroke: #000000 !important;
      color: #000000 !important;
    }
  `;
  host.appendChild(bwStyle);
  document.body.appendChild(host);

  try {
    for (let i = 0; i < pageElements.length; i++) {
      if (options.onProgress) {
        options.onProgress(
          `Đang xử lý trang ${i + 1}/${pageElements.length}...`,
          i + 1,
          pageElements.length
        );
      }

      const sourcePage = pageElements[i];
      const isFixedPage = sourcePage.classList.contains('pdf-report-page');

      // Clone trang nguồn để render độc lập
      const clone = sourcePage.cloneNode(true) as HTMLElement;
      clone.style.visibility = 'visible';
      clone.style.position = 'relative';
      clone.style.top = '0px';
      clone.style.left = '0px';
      clone.style.margin = '0';
      clone.style.boxSizing = 'border-box';
      clone.style.backgroundColor = '#ffffff';
      clone.style.color = '#000000';
      clone.style.transform = 'none';
      clone.style.opacity = '1';
      clone.style.filter = 'grayscale(100%)';

      if (isFixedPage) {
        clone.style.width = '794px';
        clone.style.minHeight = '1123px';
        clone.style.height = 'auto';
        clone.style.maxHeight = 'none';
        clone.style.display = 'flex';
        clone.style.flexDirection = 'column';
        clone.style.justifyContent = 'space-between';
      } else {
        clone.style.width = '794px';
        clone.style.height = 'auto';
        clone.style.minHeight = 'auto';
        clone.style.display = 'block';
      }

      // Làm sạch các node con của host trừ thẻ style cưỡng chế đen trắng
      const existingStyle = host.querySelector('#pdf-bw-style-enforcer');
      host.innerHTML = '';
      if (existingStyle) {
        host.appendChild(existingStyle);
      }
      host.appendChild(clone);

      // Đợi trình duyệt layout xong các thẻ, bảng và SVG icons
      await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 80));

      const targetHeight = clone.scrollHeight || clone.offsetHeight || 1123;

      const canvas = await html2canvas(clone, {
        scale: 2, // Độ phân giải 2x chuẩn sắc nét
        useCORS: true,
        allowTaint: true,
        logging: false,
        backgroundColor: '#ffffff',
        imageTimeout: 15000,
        scrollX: 0,
        scrollY: -window.scrollY,
        windowWidth: 794,
        width: 794,
        height: targetHeight,
      });

      if (!canvas || canvas.width === 0 || canvas.height === 0) {
        throw new Error(`Lỗi kết xuất canvas trang ${i + 1}`);
      }

      const imgData = canvas.toDataURL('image/png');

      const a4Ratio = pdfHeight / pdfWidth; // 297 / 210 = 1.4142857
      const canvasRatio = canvas.height / canvas.width;

      if (canvasRatio <= a4Ratio * 1.05) {
        if (i > 0) {
          pdf.addPage();
        }
        const renderedHeight = Math.min(pdfHeight, (canvas.height * pdfWidth) / canvas.width);
        pdf.addImage(imgData, 'PNG', 0, 0, pdfWidth, renderedHeight, undefined, 'FAST');
      } else {
        // Tự động phân trang cho tài liệu dài liên tục
        const pageCanvasHeight = Math.floor(canvas.width * a4Ratio);
        let renderedOffset = 0;
        let sliceIdx = 0;

        while (renderedOffset < canvas.height) {
          if (i > 0 || sliceIdx > 0) {
            pdf.addPage();
          }

          const sliceHeight = Math.min(pageCanvasHeight, canvas.height - renderedOffset);
          const pageCanvas = document.createElement('canvas');
          pageCanvas.width = canvas.width;
          pageCanvas.height = pageCanvasHeight;
          const ctx = pageCanvas.getContext('2d');
          if (ctx) {
            ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
            ctx.fillRect(0, 0, pageCanvas.width, pageCanvas.height);
            ctx.drawImage(
              canvas,
              0,
              renderedOffset,
              canvas.width,
              sliceHeight,
              0,
              0,
              canvas.width,
              sliceHeight
            );
            const pageImg = pageCanvas.toDataURL('image/png');
            pdf.addImage(pageImg, 'PNG', 0, 0, pdfWidth, pdfHeight, undefined, 'FAST');
          }

          renderedOffset += sliceHeight;
          sliceIdx++;
        }
      }
    }

    if (options.onProgress) {
      options.onProgress('Đang chuẩn bị file PDF...', pageElements.length, pageElements.length);
    }

    const rawName = (options.fileName || 'Bang_Tinh_Thue.pdf').replace(/[^a-z0-9_.-]/gi, '_');
    const finalFileName = rawName.endsWith('.pdf') ? rawName : `${rawName}.pdf`;

    // Tạo blob trực tiếp với MIME type chuẩn application/pdf
    const pdfBlob = pdf.output('blob');
    const pdfBlobUrl = URL.createObjectURL(pdfBlob);

    const isMobile = isMobileDevice();
    const isIOS = isIOSDevice();
    let sharedDirectly = false;

    // 1. Nếu là thiết bị di động và hỗ trợ Web Share API với files:
    // Thử gọi navigator.share để mở native Action Sheet (Lưu vào Tệp / Chia sẻ)
    if (isMobile && typeof navigator !== 'undefined' && navigator.canShare) {
      try {
        const pdfFile = new File([pdfBlob], finalFileName, { type: 'application/pdf' });
        if (navigator.canShare({ files: [pdfFile] })) {
          await navigator.share({
            files: [pdfFile],
            title: finalFileName,
            text: 'Tài liệu PDF bảng tính tài chính',
          });
          sharedDirectly = true;
        }
      } catch (shareErr: any) {
        if (shareErr.name === 'AbortError') {
          // Người dùng chủ động bấm Hủy trên Share Sheet của điện thoại
          sharedDirectly = true;
        } else {
          console.warn('Native share không khả dụng trong ngữ cảnh async:', shareErr);
        }
      }
    }

    // 2. Kích hoạt tải tự động (chủ yếu cho Desktop hoặc trình duyệt cho phép)
    if (!sharedDirectly) {
      try {
        const downloadLink = document.createElement('a');
        downloadLink.href = pdfBlobUrl;
        downloadLink.download = finalFileName;
        document.body.appendChild(downloadLink);
        downloadLink.click();
        setTimeout(() => {
          if (document.body.contains(downloadLink)) {
            document.body.removeChild(downloadLink);
          }
        }, 3000);
      } catch (linkError) {
        console.warn('Tải tự động qua liên kết bị hạn chế:', linkError);
      }
    }

    const exportResult: PdfExportResult = {
      blob: pdfBlob,
      blobUrl: pdfBlobUrl,
      fileName: finalFileName,
      sharedDirectly,
    };

    // 3. ĐỐI VỚI ĐIỆN THOẠI (Android & iOS):
    // Luôn luôn hiển thị Mobile PDF Action Sheet tương tác (trừ khi người dùng đã share thành công)
    // để người dùng có thể chạm trực tiếp 1 chạm tải về máy 100% không bao giờ bị chặn!
    const shouldShowMobileSheet = options.showMobileSheet !== false && isMobile;
    const isVietnamese = options.isVi !== undefined 
      ? options.isVi 
      : (typeof document !== 'undefined' && document.documentElement.lang === 'vi');
    if (shouldShowMobileSheet && !sharedDirectly) {
      showMobilePdfDownloadSheet(exportResult, isVietnamese);
    }

    // Giữ blob URL sống trong 10 phút để người dùng có thể tải nhiều lần mà không bị lỗi đứt link
    setTimeout(() => {
      try {
        URL.revokeObjectURL(pdfBlobUrl);
      } catch {
        // ignore
      }
    }, 600000);

    return exportResult;
  } finally {
    // Dọn dẹp khung render tạm
    if (document.body.contains(host)) {
      document.body.removeChild(host);
    }
  }
}
